comments:
Nice apartment, clean, easily accessible, and beautifully decorated with all the amenities we need. The only thing to note is that the location might be a little noisy for a light sleeper.

Thanks Adreinne.
Not 100% what I expected from the airbnb visuals, but serviceable. If you need a place to stay close to Franklin station - this is the place.
Very near to the subway to Manhattan! Nice flat with everything you need. The wifi works without any problems. We can recommend this Place absolutly.

My friends and I had a pleasant stay in Adreinne’s apartment. I really loved and enjoyed all the art on the walls. The apartment has everything you need. You are super connected if you stay at Adreinne’s apartment. The subway station is just 2 min away and you are super fast in Downtown Brooklyn and Manhattan with the C and A train. Thank you for this lovely stay!

Adrienne's place is excellent! We loved the neighborhood, how walkable everything was, and how quickly we could get to Manhattan. The place was cozy and had all the things we wanted, including a great bathtub and comfortable bed.
The apartment was immaculate. The neighborhood was great. The mattress was amazing. Communication was great. It’s a very nice spot in Clinton Hill/Bed Stuy and very accurately depicted in the photos.
Adreinne has been really helpful. The location is very convenient and safe. The apartment is spacious and well equipped.

I stayed at Adrienne’s Airbnb for four months and had a very good experience. From the start, I felt at home. Adrienne is a helpful host who responds quickly and was always available when I had questions.
The apartment is spacious and the bed is comfortable, which made it easy to settle in. I also appreciated the natural light throughout the space.
The location is convenient, with the train station right across the street and the grocery store just around the corner.
Overall, I was happy with my stay and would recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient home base.

Six colleagues and I stayed at Robin’s loft for a weekend and we had a marvelous stay!  The loft was very roomy, cozy, and quiet.  The surrounding area was very safe. There was parking directly in front of the apartment, and it was only two blocks away from the subway which made traveling convenient.  In addition, Robin and her family were GREAT hosts and the price was unbeatable!!! I would definitely recommend staying at her loft!

Robin was a wonderful hostess, and her loft is amazing: beautiful, spacious, well-maintained and equipped.  Some mornings my family lingered longer than we needed to before heading out for the day, just because we felt so comfortable.  Robin also helped us out when we hit a snafu on the last day of our stay and almost missed our flight.  I would stay with Robin again without hesitation.

I spent 3 weeks in this amazing loft! It's very spacious, beautiful, clean and very quiet! And everything you need is close by: quintessentiel Harlem, shops, restaurants, the subway. And Robin is very charming and a great host. I highly recommend it highly.

Thank you so much Robin.....We had a fantastic time in New York! We arrived late, Robin had organised agreat taxi service ride for us and they even turned up after our flight was 3 hours late-what a relief, we were so pleased to have that ride sorted at 10pm!!! Robin kindly bought food in for us also. We spent most days out from 9am till 8pm got back and forward on the subway very easily. The apartment was huge and we had to walk down to talk to the kids in the bedrooms cause they couldn't even hear us yelling at them from the kitchen!!! The apartment has a fully equipped laundry such a bonus for travelers like us. Totally recommend staying with Robin!

Robyn's loft was amazing, spacious, well fitted out and great for a large family such as ours. Robyn was friendly and keen to help with anything, local knowledge she shared, a great source. Only a short walk to the easy-to-use subway.
Would recommend this loft to others very highly.

Dear George & Robin,
My family is very satisfied with your accommodation. Your place is spacious, private, clean, quiet, and most of all your service was extraordinary.
Your accommodation and service had not only met our expectation but exceeded our satisfaction. I would recommend your place to anyone.
This is to all guests………….do not let ‘Harlem’ reputation or whatever you’ve heard about the area and environment hesitate you from consider of renting this wonderful SpaHa Loft. The area is safe!

Thank you so much,
Chai & Crystal
Apartment was great! Very spacious. All amenities were provided as described. Neighbourhood was also good. Robin was very nice and helpful. All in all a wonderful experience and highly recommended.

Loved our stay! NYC with some flavor. Robin and George were fabulous, available, and super friendly.

Near downtown express stop and several crosstown buses. Highly recommend SpaHa Loft. Do not be put off by the neighborhood ... Unless you're a princess :)

We were very welcome by Robin and her husband. If we had any question she was there for us.
The apartment was as describe on the pictures, a lot of space, very beautifull and very practical. The only little thing is that the walls of the rooms do not go up to the ceiling so there s not a lot of privacy.
But we enjoyed very much our stay. The aprtment is very near the metro and a lot of commerces. Thanks again to Robin and her husband.

Our stay in the SpaHa loft was wonderful! Being a party of eight, the spacious four bedrooms and living area worked out great. The apartment was stocked well with kitchen goods, full-size w/d, and plenty of towels. The beds were very comfortable and the apartment is quiet during the night.....which is VERY IMPORTANT in Manhattan....also only a few blocks to the subway and the Metro-North train.
Robin was so very helpful and generous! We had a series of unforeseen occurrences due to weather and flight cancellations, and she went out of her way to accommodate our stay. I visit New York every winter and plan on staying here again.

My mother, sister, aunt, two cousins and I stayed here for 5 nights. The set-up was perfect for our group. The condo is huge! Having two washrooms available for 6 ladies was great. Robin and George were welcoming, helpful and quick to reply to any questions we had. Would definitely recommend this place for groups.

SpaHa Loft is a great place to stay. Our host, Robin, was so attentive to our needs and greeted us on arrival, made sure we had all we needed and gave us advice when we had questions on New York generally. The apartment is in Harlem but within walking distance of subways, a supermarket around the corner and a very convenient place to stay. The apartment was huge with great amenities, kitchen appliances and utensils, crockery, etc, cupboard spaces, laundry in the unit, ironing room set up. We had a group of five ladies staying and it was perfect for our needs. Definitely recommend this great apartment. Thanks Robin for being such a great host.
Had a great experience. Quick response time, clean,  spacious, short distance to subway, affordable parking lot near by. Would definitely recommend!

Robin is a wonderful host and the space was perfect for our extended family gathering.  We had eight people and appreciated having enough bedrooms and bathrooms.  The unit is very spacious.  The bedrooms are large with plenty of open area.  Washer and dryer are a bonus too.  It is convenient to the subway and bus lines.  LaGuardia airport is a quick trip.  Highly recommend it and would definatly stay again. Thank you, Robin!!

Apartment is massive so was perfect for the 5 of us and having the 2 bathrooms was great. Everything we needed was in there. Location wise it was nice and handy to the 116th Street metro stop so was easy to get to and from Midtown and beyond. Supermarkets were super close as well.

Our vacation was so wonderful; all six of us had an amazing time. Many Thank you extras thrown in to accommodate us both on check in and check out!!
The loft is truly amazing... lot’s of room ... centrally located between so many places; stores. ... if items are needed on a short notice (grocery and liquor store, Dollar Tree .. McDonald’s ,Wendy’s)... and loads of nice restaurants in the opposite direction are all close by .. minutes only by foot. Robin arranged our pick up at the airport through TLC Limo Service. Luis was amazing and very punctual with each event we used him for... ( multiple occasions)
We are so lucky to say we had both of you to “show us the ropes”.. of New York City!! We would definitely like to return in the future and use both this Spaha loft & TLC Limo services.
Sending Many blessings from Texas!!!

Wow. What an amazing loft apartment. We spent 10 nights here over Christmas 2019 with another family. 4 x adults and 3 x kids under 10. The space is huge, a long building with main bedrooms at either end, that's functional for large groups or families. 2 x large bathrooms, plus a large kitchen and separate laundry and dryer. The location is fantastic: we found it really safe with 2 x great supermarkets/grocery stores literally around the corner, a nice park next door & an easy 4 block walk to the 116th Street Subway station. Highly recommend. Robin and her family were very hospitable and helpful. If/when we head back to NYC, we will be back!!!

Robin and George were just the best! My girlfriends and I had a great time at their gorgeous loft. The rooms were spacious, clean and they had plenty of amenities. The area was fun and the street they live on is very quiet.

This loft is huge! And sunny! It is vey well equipped with kitchen items, towels, bedding, local info and so forth. Between the many great local restaurants and the markets around the corner, eating was a joy. It’s close to two subway stations so getting around is easy. And it’s a quick walk to Columbia and the west side parks. The hosts were responsive, helpful, organized and responsible. A really great visit. I highly recommend.
Robins place was clean and fresh. All the amenities were accurate. All the basics and a few extras to make your stay easier were there.  I would recommend her place.

This apartment is great at a great price, it is near to all the places from NYC. Robin gives a welcome information, very accurate about the neighborhood and the best station to take. All and all, this is an awesome place to be on vacation and it is bigger that you expect from photos.

This place is one of the best deals available to stay in NYC. Very convenient location with supermarkets not even a block away and amazing hispanic restaurants nearby. Also walking distance from both the 4,5,6 & 1,2,3 lines, so you can get to downtown NYC pretty conveniently too
Robin is also responsive and flexible. She made the check-in process a breeze and was able to work around our schedule so we weren't lugging our suitcases around NYC

Robin is an excellent host.  Very insighful for new travelers to NYC.  The apartment is on point with access to multiple places.  The loft was spot on with ample space for large groups.  Two thumbs up.

Robin and George were wonderful, caring and supportive hosts. I absolutely loved my stay here. Location is great as it's not too far from Central Park, Midtown etc and not too close to the busy city. Rooms were spacious and really clean.  We didn't even see a single spider! Ample space for children to play and stay. Beds were super comfortable and everything just there. We didn't need to worry about anything. Supermarket downstairs and easy transport links. Absolutely loved it and if we come back to NYC, we'd be delighted to come back here.

The landlord was super nice! She also informed us in detail about the nearby supermarket stores and parks. She was very patient. The house is very big and has all kinds of appliances. There are many kinds of kitchenware too. I will definitely book this place again next time I come to New York!

Michael is the ideal host - very helpful and always willing to share his profound knowledge about NYC. His flat is very well located, just a few minutes to a lot of sights. The flat is like it's swohn on the pictures, you find everything you need - TV, fridge, two A/C (really a must in summer). And on top of it all you have (or not, it's on Michael)) access to an amazing rooftop with a really impressing view. Michael also offered us  to buy some very cheap broadway tickets. All in all, a perfect stay in NYC and we will definitely come again.

Michael's apartment was in a great location, just a couple of blocks from times square. The apartment is quirky and cute with lots of great books and things to look at! Like the description says.. it us up several flights of stairs so keep that in mind and decide if that suits you. But remember, you're in New York, so expect a lot of walking anyway!

Michael is a great host, who loves to have guests. He knows a lot about the city and the neighborhood and has tons of good tips, for example for Broadway shows. He helps whenever he can. The location is great for a single person.

Some people might be put off by the little penis figurines, toys of porn stars like Ron Jeremy laying around, "breast" books and Playboy retrospectives in the bathroom, the stuffed animals laid out carefully on our bed (really), and the host's opening discussion with my girlfriend alone about his avid love of Grindhouse exploitation movies ... or the extremely small apartment, extremely small bedroom and loft bed. But, to us, that's what makes New York special. Michael is very helpful.

Michael's place was clean and central, though the Halloween decoration (plastic cockroach, spiders everywhere..) was a bit odd..
I stayed there only for one night, mainly needed a place to sleep.

My stay at Michael's was great, the apartment has a great location and the decor is amazing, has a variety of fun and surprising objects. Mike was very flexible with me and let me leave my luggage at his place (a safe place) until night because I had a late returning flight. He also gave me several basic tips that helped me. Mike and Natalia made ​​me feel really comfortable on my last day in New York. Thank you very much. :)

We (myself and 2 friends) stayed at Michael's for the whole week and
had a great time! The location is perfect for exploring Manhattan and
I think it would be very hard to find something with a better
location/price ratio. The room itself is small (as stated in the
description) but very clean and smartly arranged, so that even the
three of us were able to stay there for the whole week. Michael and
his girlfriend were very friendly and flexible. He daily supplied us
with useful information about special offers and interesting events in
the neighborhood, adding to our beautiful NY experience. Thanks for
everything!
We had a great experience with Mike and Natalia.  We would definitely recommend staying with them.  The location was great and they were very welcoming!

Jon Snow was a fantastic host. He stayed in good communication  with me and met me on  my arrival. His place was great and had lots of cool stuff! Very friendly and welcoming. Great spot to stay in nyc!!

Mike was a great host, with an awesome setup. I recommend this place for an average sized person, as getting up and down the building is a tight squeeze, as well as the lofted bed. Other than that I highly recommend this place if you need to be in or near Hell's Kitchen.
Good location, nice private room. And Michael is an excellent host with great local tips. Would recommend.

My stay at Michael's place was great. One of the most helpful hosts out there, Michael showed me local tips about the city and i ended up going to quite a few of them! The highlight of my NY trip was going to brooklyn for a burlesque musical that he got me tickets for on a wayy discounted price! The space itself is funky 80s vibe with records all over and an stunning skyline view, although not from the room but from a exclusive space that only Michael can show you! Neighbourhood is really cool also with plenty of places to eat and short walk to all the main spots! Thank you !

I had a great time staying in NYC at Michaels place! The location is really great and it only takes 15 minutes walking to Times Square. Further, Michael knows a lot of tips and tricks for the city and you should take advantage of that! His place has really interesting decorations (as you can probably tell from the photos) and it's fun to check out the walls and ceiling. Space-wise it's not the biggest place (which seems to be typical for NYC) but who's staying indoors when you should explore the city anyway?! The bed is very comfy. Thanks for your hospitality, Michael!

Our stay here was great! The location was perfect! Michael was an amazing host,with all his tips and recommendations. He even hooked us up with a fun show in Brooklyn!  We walked all over the place and got back to the room late at night and felt very safe walking around! The place is definitely fun and eclectic! If you are fun and adventurous you will definitely enjoy this place! Definitely the New York vibe of a walk up building in Manhattan.  In the heart of Hell's Kitchen close to all food and drinks you want, whenever you want! I would definitely stay here again, great value! The place is exactly as described.

Great location and great privacy. Loft bed was a unique experience. You can wander your mind looking at 80s post everywhere. Michael is very prompt and accurate in his communication. Unfortunately we never had a chance to meet in person but I will definitely check back in the future.
Very convenient location for getting around in NYC. Host gave very helpful for a first time visit and his communication was good throughout booking process and during the stay itself.

Michael was a fantastic host. His place was “funky” as described and he made suggestions of things to see and places to eat that we found very enjoyable. He was also quite helpful in figuring out how to get Broadway tickets at the best price. The location was walkable to Times Square and Broadway and felt safe walking home late at night.  Would definitely stay here again.

Great place! Michael was extremely kind and helpful, always reaching out and responding extremely fast.
Place was very cozy and a extremely good location relative to all tourist destinations and Lincoln Center/Juilliard.
Will definitely come again when in NYC!

I had a wonderful stay at Michael’s. Loved the neighborhood! It was a fantastic location, a 10 minute walk to Broadway and close to all transit. The room was the perfect size for me. Michael was an excellent host - very communicative and always had advice on things to do or how to get places. He was also flexible with the check in and out times. I would stay here again! 👍🏽👍🏽

Mike’s place was as advertised and I had a great stay! Lots of interesting and funky stuff. If you’re looking for a totally spotless/sterile place, this might not be the right fit, but if you have a sense of humor and adventure, Mike’s place is a great (and affordable) option in the heart of the city! Loved it as a launching pad to Broadway.
It might be a bit of a tight squeeze for two (or for anyone taller than 5’8), and anyone mobility-challenged might struggle with the ladder to the loft bed, but it worked for me and was a great value for the price. Bed was very comfortable.
Mike was super communicative and helpful and met me at the apartment. He let me check in early and check out late. Thanks for your flexibility, Mike!
Michael was a great host and we would definitely come back! We recommend staying with michael when visiting nyc!
The apartment is 15 minutes walking from times square and is well connected. Michael is kind and available.

Very good stay for stay for à trip in New York. The location is very convenient.
Mike is a really nice host with good advices and is accomodating. The bed is confortable.

Michael's place was AMAZING. The stay was great and he could not have been more thoughtful or accommodating. He gave us recommendations for Broadway and things to do around Hell's Kitchen. Love the unique decor in the perfect location. The disco ball was the star of the apartment. I look forward to my next stay!

We were unable to stay with Michael due to last minute unforeseen circumstances. Michael was a great communicator, and he reached out to me before we went. When I had to respond that we couldn’t make it, he was very kind and understanding. I would love to stay with him in the future. :)

Mike was a phenomenal host. Great communication and went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and needed anything for my stay while I was visiting. Highly recommend and will stay there again when I’m back in town.

Michael was super helpful getting me keys and making super I got in ok. He was very communicative throughout my stay and the room was as described. His bathroom was also extra clean. As someone who formerly lived in NYC, it was a fun apartment to stay in, and in a good location. Thanks again for your hospitality Michael!

The place was extremely clean and tidy. Very spacious for a New York studio unit. Ron was always extremely prompt at replying to all questions, and seemed to be accessible at all hours...
Location was perfect, easy access to subway and right in Chelsea...
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would recommend the place to anyone else looking to stay in manhattan...
Ron was a friendly, helpful and accommodating host. His communication was clear and prompt. The apartment was clean, comfortable and secure, and in a great location.

The studio was really nicely furnished and conveniently located near the subway station and across a Wholefoods. Ron was really helpful - he personally showed me around the place a day before I moved in and was very accommodating with move in and move out times. He was always available via email and text. Would recommend!

Fantastic location convenient to everything in the city. Whole Foods right across the street was an added bonus. Place was a little tight for two, but worthwhile for the prime location. Ron communicated well, mailed a key in advance, and was very accommodating.
Ron’s place was stylish, comfortable, and clean. If you want a beautiful place in Chelsea, this is the place for you.
Ron's place was great. It was clean, quiet, and had all the things one could need. It's in a great neighborhood as well!

Ron is a wonderful host and his apt is lovely and has everything you would need for a great stay in NY.  He responded incredibly quickly in all our correspondence and was very accommodating.  We would definitely stay with him again.

Ron’s apartment is clean, well-furnished, and well-situated, near two subway lines. It’s also one of the quietest apartments I’ve ever encountered in New York. Since I’m a light sleeper, this meant a lot to me. It also stays cool in hot summer weather. While it has AC, I often didn’t need to use it.  Ron himself was hospitable and made everything go seamlessly. I would definitely stay here again.

Ron was very accommodating and the apartment was great!
Excellent location, comfy bed and amazing TV app selection.
Would stay again for sure!
Ron’s apartment was EXCELLENT!! We would love to stay here again when we visit NYC! Very convenient and an excellent host!

Ron was an amazing host! Before we arrived, he was in contact making sure we knew how to get there and made checking in super easy. His place was clean and very put together (also the bed is so soft). He even left us a little welcome treat which isn’t something you see often at places like this. He was super communicative, making sure we were doing alright and everything was good with our stay. I highly recommend staying here!

Felt just like home! Thank you Ron for the accommodations and for being so nice throughout all of the stay. Location is amazing, you are at walking distance of so many things. Apartment is very comfortable and neighborhood is very safe/quiet. Would love to come back and stay at Ron’s
Ron was a very helpful host, and his place was perfect for a week stay in Midtown. We would book it again next time we’re in the city.

We couldn't have been happier staying at this lovely quiet studio apartment. The bed was so comfortable with a great comforter.   Well equipped with utensils and nice glassware.  Great water pressure in the shower too. Big t.v. with all the apps and also Apple TV.  Close to subways and Whole Foods right across the street. Safe building with 24 hour front desk coverage. Also, Ron left us a nice bottle of red wine and chocolates and great instructions from the airport to the apartment.  We had a wonderful stay.

Ron’s place is awesome! We plan on staying there every time we go to NYC in the future!
Great location and very cozy!

Perfect oasis and very quiet at night so we could recharge from Manhattan.  Whole Foods on the corner and the unit felt spacious for New York City. Host was very accommodating and responsive. Couldn’t have been better.  Plan on returning.

Great place on a quiet street in a wonderfully vibrant neighborhood.
A much better deal than the hotel we usually stay in while in NYC.
Hearing the young child practicing the piano in the next apartment made
us feel like part of an extended family. It has become our prime location when we travel to the city.
Very cozy, well-appointed studio in a great location. The Morgan's  handle everything well and the neighbors are friendly.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

We have just spent two weeks in NYC staying in this fabulous apartment. Its exactly as advertised and described on Airbnb site. Very cool and comfortable to come home to after much walking and sightseeing during a recent heatwave.

Our stay in Ted and Diane's sun-drenched studio couldn't have been sweeter! The apartment was comfortable and charming- they have thought of every detail. The location is so wonderful. Ted and Diane were warm and gracious hosts! We thank them!
Liz and Stan

We had a lovely stay in New York. Our hosts Diane and Ted were very helpfull with any questions we had. Diane was very helpful with additional sheets and towels we required as we had a long 19 night stay in the appartment. The location was fantastic.
A perfect location in NYC for those wanting access to Central Park, the Beacon Theater, subway connections and food in and around the area where Broadway meeting Columbus.

Perfect location for a stay in NYC!  We loved the neighborhood with A+ host services!  Enjoyed running in central park every morning, clothes shopping 2 blocks away, 1.5 blocks from train station, Trader Joe's and Fairway market within 2 blocks walking distance.  The hosts Ted and Diane are super friendly, helpful with all our needs.  Both took the time to help with whatever we asked via email or phone.  It was super fun to live like a New Yorker for a week.  I would recommend this apt. to anyone who wants a get away from the hustle and bustle and wants the convenience of a kitchen, large closet space and cozy space..  Diane even had the newspaper and chocolates for our arrival. Try it for a sweet simple stay in NYC>

Diane & Ted are consumate hosts! From their quick & warm response to the ease of check out w/gourmet chocolates for the road, this booking was just a pleasure. They even handled our 3 hr arrival delay with the utmost ease. The apartment itself is located on a quiet street just steps away from 72nd St. 1/2/3 stop to get you downtown. French Roast coffee was at the ready along w/Teas & bottled water.  Free Wifi was an added bonus to be able to keep tabs on my business while away.  Would highly recommend this well appointed location for a party of 2 or 3 who want to visit the Big Apple but stay in a trendy part of the city that actually sleeps.

Ted and Diane were very hospitable and friendly hosts. They helped us carry our luggage upstairs upon our arrival and left us a lovely welcome hamper with lots of city guides, their personal tips for the city, and a delicious block of chocolate. We had our sheets and towels replaced during our 12 night stay, and Diane was always more than happy to help with anything and have a chat. We loved the location of the apartment - easily accessible to the subway and taxis, and a short walk to Central Park. We were there during the middle of winter and always came home to a warm place, which was beautiful. We would definitely recommend this apartment to those who want a clean, cosy and convenient place to stay in Manhattan.

At the risk of the risk of finding this place rented out out next visit to NYC, we had the most wonderful experience imaginable while staying here. The apartment was cozy and had everything we needed. The hosts were kind, helpful and respectful, and the location was perfect. Five stars!!

I completely recommend this place! If you are looking for a place to stay in New York City, seriously don't look any further- this is it!! Ted and Diane are so hospitable, accommodating, genuine and kind people. You feel at home and well taken care of. The neighbourhood is safe and you are minutes away from a major subway line which is so convenient. My husband and I stayed for a week in New York and had the best time- we recommend this place and would stay again!

Our second visit to NYC staying at Diane and Ted's apartment was even nicer than the first. We were familiar with the neighborhood and really took advantage of the local restaurants and much more. Central park is a short walk away and using the subway system is easy and affordable from here.  Diane's welcome is warm and she is all about making her guests comfortable and happy.  She was thoughtful enough to bring us an umbrella when the forecast was for rain.  The apartment is warm and clean or you can open a window if you want cooler air.  The location is pretty quiet and we liked that a lot.  We will seek to stay with Diane and Ted whenever we visit NYC in the future.

My stay at this apartment was FANTASTIC.
The apartment is beautiful, clean and with everything you need. The location is amazing, close to the subway, stores and restaurants.
The hosts were extremely nice. They made sure I had all I needed and felt at home.
This was my first experience with Airbnb and I think I will never stay in a hotel again.

My GF and I stayed for 3 nights at Ted and Diane's studio and absolutely loved it. Studio is exactly as seen in pictures, and is very conveniently located. Central Park, Riverside park and the 72nd street subway station are all a quick a walk away. Ted and Diane were prompt with communicating and made our check in as comfortable and seamless as possible. I highly recommend staying here if you're looking to explore the city and want to stay in a nice, quiet and clean building with wonderful hosts.

Diane and Ted's apartment was wonderful. It was very convenient in terms of location and had everything I needed. They were great about checking to see if I needed anything and made sure that I settled in okay on the day of my arrival. I especially appreciated the bottled water and treat they left for me, along with clear information about the apartment. What a thoughtful touch!

Diane was a very friendly and helpful host, excellent communication before and during the stay. Apartment is lovely, just as shown, perfect for a couple. We had a week there and it was a wonderful base for exploring, very short walk to 72nd street station, trains up and down town, can walk to central park, lincoln centre, columbus circle, and very easy to access mid or down town on the 1 or A train. Plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. Would love to have stayed longer!

Very happy with our stay here. Location was perfect with everything we needed in walking distance including Trader Joes and the 1/2/3 lines. Diane was a great host, very attentive. The apartment, itself, is spacious and comfortable. Great for a couple. Highly recommend!
Quaint studio in a neighborhood of luxurious apartments. Short walk to the subway. Ted and Diane are wonderful hosts.

I loved everything about this Airbnb. So cute and comfortable. Could not ask for a better location. Close to restaurants, supermarkets, Central Park, movie theaters, 24-hour pizza.  Ted and Diane were really nice. Also, I felt very safe in this neighborhood!

Demi is a great host ! So nice and very available !
The place is great, in a quite neighborhood and the subway is juste at 10 minutes walk with many lines to go to Manhattan !
We really loves to be in Brooklyn and not in Manhattan, peapole are great and we can discover an other NYC, maybe the true one ?

If you go to NYC, go at Demi's !

I'm so glad I picked Demi's place! I spent a week in the larger of her two units and enjoyed my stay. Prospect Heights has some really great bars (Weather Up, Hot Bird) and food (Gen, Kimchi) and is super convenient to get to Manhattan. The unit is large, quiet, comfortable, and clean. I would stay here again without reserve.
Demi is a wonderful host, her apartment is tidy, we loved having 2 windows to the backyard, the bed is super comfortable.

Demi's apartment was cute and clean and lovely. My Mother and I spent this past Mother's Day weekend there and we couldn't have been happier with the place.
The back yard was a highlight and provided a lovely backdrop for morning coffees and evening heart to hearts. Out only regret is that we did not get to see her eclectic garden in bloom.
Speaking of blooms make sure to check out the nearby Brooklyn Botanical Gardens. Definitely a highlight of our trip.

This apartment is an absolute gem! It's in the perfect location and Demi is incredibly responsive and organized. Meeting up to check-in/out was super convenient. It is stylish and clean -- a real home away from home. I didn't want to leave! Also, there was a brief problem with the hot water and Demi responded super quickly and solved it! I would definitely stay here again.

I loved the apartment. It was perfect for me. Demi's place was clean and very comfortable. I enjoyed it much more than a hotel because of the space and privacy for the cost. This was the first time I used AirBnB,  but I will certainly use it again if I can get Demi or a host that is just as attentive. There was just one hiccup was when the cable went out. But that was not on Demi but the cable company and it came on the next day.

We stayed for 6 days in this lovely apartment and will definitely recommend to stay at Demis place. It met us clean and was equipped with everything we needed, including Demis homemade granola, which indeed was delicious! What we valued most though was the privacy, we didn't really realized that someone else lived upstairs in the building. Though, when we needed something Demi was always quick to respond to our text messages and to help us. Again, definitely recommend.

Demi is a great host and the apartment was just as described on the website.
The place is comfortable and well maintained. We would definitely check with Demi if we were to come back for a full week. The place is certainly suited for a longer stay.
It's an easy walk to the park. And we found interesting places to eat (ranging from budget/ethnic to near-gourmet). We didn't exhaust the possibilities and are looking forward to further exploring the area.

Demi was very welcoming. She greeted us at the door, showed us around and even took us out into "our" private garden, picking us a cucumber and some cherry tomatoes. We sat out there one morning watching the butterflies and birds. Demi lives upstairs so we knew she'd help us out if we needed it. The apartment was very clean. It's about 5 blocks to the subway station at the Brooklyn Museum and about 3 long blocks  to another line which takes you over the bridge rather than a tunnel to Manhattan.

Demi's apartment is in a great location. Prospect Heights is a really cool neighbourhood with lots of nice places to eat/drink and get coffee. It was also a great base from which to explore NYC & Brooklyn; with Prospect Park, the Brooklyn museum and Subway to Manhattan all within walking distance.

The apartment itself was nice and clean. We didn't meet Demi during our stay, but she was easy enough to get hold of and left us her contact details. Would certainly recommend.

We loved Demi's place. The neighborhood is very nice with different restaurants, cafes..and all what do you need. Close to the Subway and Prospect Park. Arrange with Demi was very easy and nice..all worked perfectly. We really enjoyed our stay by Demi's place.
Great host, very accommodating. Apartment is bigger than it looks in the pictures. Great location on the border of Prospect and Crown Heights near lots of cool stuff, we very much enjoyed our stay.
Demi is a wonderful host and really easy to communicate with. The flat is comfortable, amazingly quiet, and in a great location. I liked it so much I'm coming back in a few weeks!

Demi arranged to have the key available to us early and welcomed us via e-mail. Though we never met Demi, she checked in with us after we were there a day to make sure everything was OK. The neighborhood is the same as our daughter's apartment in Prospect Hts. so we were familiar with it.

Demi was very welcoming and organized. Apartment was clean and as advertised in pictures. Excellent location in beautiful neighborhood. Close walk to subway lines, Prospect Park, and good restaurants. Would definitely stay again. Thanks!

Demi and her place were fantastic! After a long drive in from Ontario, Demi greeted us shortly after we found our way inside. Her friendliness was very welcome after such a long trip. The place was clean, bright and quiet - exactly what we wanted for our trip to such a big city. Great place!
My girlfriend and I had a wonderful time in Brooklyn, thanks to Liz! The place was really clean and next to the subway. We felt really comfortable and would recommend this place without reservations!

I stayed with Liz and Izzy and the fabulous birds whilst i was looking to find somewhere more permanent having just arrived in NYC. Liz was a fab host, lots of fun and energy, and i would happily recommend her if you are looking for somewhere to stay. And, in the way of the world showing just how small NYC is, she even happened to know one of my 2 colleagues quite well.

Liz was wonderfully accommodating.  The apartment is cosy and very much a family home. We felt very welcome during our brief stay.  There was delicious coffee and bagels for us in the morning. Thank you for having us !
Liz was friendly and helpful. She is artist and the room was clean and comfortable and the location was great for me. I hope I can still live in here next times.

Liz was a really great, uncomplicated host who helped us with everything and always had an awesome coffee in the morning ready waiting for us.
Thanks for everything!

Liz was an amazing host. She made sure that our area was private, but also sat down and chatted with us in the morning while we drank her wonderful coffee and had delicious chocolate croissants. The first night we were there she walked us around the neighborhood to help us find food and introduce us to her friend that owned a shop in the neighborhood. There is so much that she did for us to make us feel comfortable. To much to mention. Also, her daughter was amazing and it was very nice to sit down and talk to her. Thank you Liz!  Definitely a place to come back to.
Liz was a fantastic host and her apartment is wonderful. Exactly what we needed for our stay, plus the bonus of waking up to hot coffee in the morning. Highly recommended!

We enjoyed our 3 night stay at Liz's. The area was great with a close by subway station, convenient store just other side of the street and a few minute walk to the beautiful Prospect Park. The apartment was clean and comfortable and Liz and her daughter were great hosts. She  treated us with great coffee and fresh bagels as well as tips of local happenings. Thank you Liz. One thing worth to mention is that the living space is only separated by a curtain and a space separator, not with an actual door. This was though not a big issue for us since Liz was very respectful of the private space reserved for us.

This was an amazing experience! Liz is super nice and really cares about her guests, she has some great suggestions about things to do in the area and she is always available if you need anything. The room is really nice and the location feels really safe. It is also super easy to get anywhere from there using the subway, so overall everything is really good. Would highly recommend!

Liz is one of the nicest hosts I have ever stayed at! The aparment is in a nice neighborhood with excellent coffee place and convenience store across the street, few steps away from the F train that takes you straight to Manhattan. Excellent value for money!!

Thanks for being so helpful, careful and cool! I highly recommand your place and your person, my friend and I had a very pleasant trip by staying at your home... It was also a pleasure to discover your artistic universe. Take care! xox
Liz is a very nice host. She bought water and breakfast (eggs, bagels, spreads, coffee, tea etc.) for us to consume every day.
Liz was such a fantastic host! She’s unbelievably friendly and inviting! We had a lovely time at her place! The space itself is gorgeous!
The location of the house is convenient, closed to the train station. And Mark is nice, he replied every questions quickly.

Booked Mark's place for my Mom and her cousins. It was very last minute but Mark was very prompt in getting back to me so I could make the booking. My family enjoyed their stay here, the rooms were a good size and the beds were nice and comfortable. Mark was very helpful during their stay. I would recommend to anyone looking for a good spot at a decent price.

Great stay. B was incredibly accommodating when I needed a place to stay at the lat minute. They were immediately responsive, and got the place cleaned and ready to go very quickly. I was impressed and grateful. The place itself is small (about what you would expect at this price point in this area), but cozy and clean. The location is perfect. I would recommend this place if you are looking for good value in this area, and I can vouch for the service being top notch!

Nicole is a fantastic host with a lovely home. It provided the perfect base for my girlfriend and I, such that we were able to walk around Brooklyn and see the less touristy areas of NYC, as well as getting a short subway ride into Manhattan. Nicole was incredibly helpful and prior to arriving she even sent me the journey plan for JFK to her home. She often messaged us just to check everything was going well and provided suggestions for things we could do during the day. Nicole's apartment is very nice, tidy and spacious - the area is safe and has some great deli's nearby. I would highly recommend staying with Nicole, her hospitality and generosity were second to none.

I'm new to the airbnb community and if all hosts are anything like Nicole?, then I'm a customer for life. Her place looked exactly like it did  in the photos  (which was comforting) and she had everything so organized that our stay was easy breezy! She interacted as little and as much as we wanted yet she was always available. It's no wonder her place is always booked.

Nicole's place was perfect. Completely as described and so cosy! She also left us water, cookies and a card welcoming us which was so sweet. She introduced herself to us not long after we arrived and was super friendly! We definitely felt like we could get in touch with her about anything. She kept in contact with us and let us know about stuff on in the area. The location was great, we got lost for quite awhile but that was our own fault, Nicole recommended a really good app which was so helpful for our entire trip! From JFK, get the air train to Jamaica, then the J train will bring you to Myrtle Ave,  a 10min walk to Nicole's place which also passes a supermarket, we used this stop daily and had no issues! Nicole's husband also printed out boarding passes for us which was such a huge help! Thank you both for having us!

We really enjoyed our stay in Brooklyn.  Nicole and her husband were great hosts; both were very welcoming and helpful.  Additionally, her guidebook has some great recommendations - try tacos at Tepache or coffee at Rabbit Moon.  The apartment was spacious, well-stocked, and clean.  Since we were spending the majority of our time in Manhattan, we took the C line downtown each day; do be aware that this isn't a short trip, you'll walk ~15 minutes to the nearest stop and ride the train ~30 minutes.  Overall, I'd definitely recommend this location.

Nicole and her husband were the perfect hosts, very friendly, caring and helpful! They gave us every help we asked for and even checked in on us. The recommendations she gave were great but we didn't had time to see them all. The apartment was larger and cozier than expected, everything we needed was there, espacially the A/C in the bedroom saved our nights as it had even 25ºC/80ºF. We would stay with Nicole any time again!

We had a lovely time at Nicole's apartment. Everything was as it looks in the photos and as described; she kept in contact and was available if we needed anything; and she was really flexible on check in and out which was very helpful. We couldn't have asked for more. The area is nice and we never felt unsafe. It's close enough to the C, J and Z subway lines to make it easy to get around. Also the bed was super comfy!
We had a wonderful stay. Nicole showed a lot of hospitality upon arrival and we felt very welcomed. The apartment is lovely and conveniently located.  Nicole is a fantastic host!  thank you so much!

Nicole's place is beautifully decorated and kept, and the bed is extremely comfortable. It's a bit of a walk to any of the subway stations, we didn't mind at all but it's always good to know. I would definitely stay again if we ever visit NY again.

The place was nice. We were happy to see that it had the whole kitchen and bathroom for us. Nicole was great to answer really fast all our question.
The only thing that could have been better was the comforter on the bed, it was really thin and sometimes the nights were getting cold. I would suggest to put a thicker / more comfortable one.
The rest was really great. Sweet host and really pretty apartment for the price!

The location is quiet, but within a 10-15 minute walk of public transit. Bedstuy has some great restaurants and this location makes all neighborhood locations very walkable.
Thank you!
Very clean and spacious in an awesome neighborhood. A bit of a walk to the trains but we would definitely stay again!
Nicole is super nice, helpful, and responsive. The AirBnB was clean and very cute. I felt safe staying here.
Lit host ! Space is a really great apartment.the host isn't in your face so your free to chill and feel very at home.i didn't really feel like I was staying in an Airbnb.

If you don't mind a few stairs then this is an ideal spot for two-three ppl, couple or individual looking for their own space thats in the middle of everything you may need to do in Brooklyn. Everything was clean and the extra room came in clutch to do some work in. Maybe amenities like
I'llA blender would compliment this spot much better but all in all a great buy. Would recommend staying here again. Lavonne was always available to answer any questions and accommodations!
We had a great stay in this place. It had everything we needed, and Nicole made everything very easy.!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Nicole’s place. The space was exactly as described and the place was spotless.
Thank you for having us, Nicole!
Lovely area where ppl are very friendly. Great local food (try the chips with cheese!) the buss to the airport (JFK) is a one minute walk. Perfect!

Me and a buddy came from California to see New York for the first time. Nicole's place was perfect for that. A short walk to the subway so there was easy access to the Manhattan. There were many options for food and groceries. Laundromats were also nearby and the A/C was nice and cold for the summer. Overall a great place to stay at
Very nice place, stylish. It was perfect for two people. Quick walk to the train, numerous restaurants, and bodegas. Host stayed in contact and was quick to respond to messages. Loved the stay here.
Nicole’s place was very nice to stay in for the weekend. She checked in to make sure we were doing fine. The neighborhood is very chilled and only adds to the atmosphere of the apartment.

Good location for what we wanted to do for a few days.  Good basic accomodations, clean and pretty quiet considering the busy streets nearby. Parking was easy, and we walked everywhere once we arrived from out of town.  Kitchen amenities are very basic, but there are delis everywhere to get what you need.

This stay was great! Cute place and good value. Bit of a walk up, but otherwise perfect! Super close to bus stops and grocery. Nicole was very communicative, even checking in in the middle of our stay to make sure everything was going well. Loved it!

Loved staying at this apartment! It is a 15 minute walk to the subway, but after a few days it goes by fast. There are also plenty of bus stops 2 blocks away. There are a few grocery stores and laundry services in the neighborhood that were super useful. Nicole and her husband were super nice as well.

The place was very clean and well equipped.  Nicole's instruction and communication were VERY clear and easy to follow.  The location was great and within walking distance of a lot of neat stuff.  Would recommend 100%!
Mary's apartment is simply awesome. Perfect location near many nice bars, coffeeshops and just 2 steps away to the L-train subway. 10 minutes and you'll be on Union Square. We'll be back for sure.

Mary and Charles have a beautiful home in a wonderful neighborhood. What I loved most about their home is the convenience and comfort I was provided – with more than enough storage space and an ample living area, this home will make you feel welcomed. The L train is located just a block away while Grand St. provides a variety of shops, restaurants, and bars nearby. My boyfriend and I stayed here for a month and would definitely stay here again.

We never met our hosts. Unfortunately. Nevertheless, everything worked out just perfect. Mary and Charles responded to our questions within hours. When we arrived, we opened the door and felt like home. Our hosts provided us with all the informations we needed. The apartment was clean and in good shape. The bed is veeery comfy. A quiet neighborhood with man grocery stores and fancy restaurants, bars and boutiques...just a few stops away from the Big Apple.

The apartment is so great, very close to a convenient subway station and to bars and restos. We spent more than a week there, it was very quiet and comfortable. With a bonus: a so cool rooftop with a full view on the skyline!

Great apartment,great location, great landlords.

Definetely, I would come back to this place!

Thank you Charles and Mary.

Best!

Great apartment in a perfect location! I generally felt safe in the neighborhood and the apartment is very close to the subway that gets into Manhattan in 10 minutes. Also very easy to get other trendy parts of Williamsburg which has a variety great bars and restaurants! Hosts were very nice and responsive to any questions I had and sorted out any issues straight away. The apartment itself is very spacious for New York and has all the amenities one needs for longer stays - it even has a washing machine and dryer, which is very useful. Overall it is also very quiet, occasionally you might hear the neighbours, but nothing major and it is much quieter than staying somewhere in Manhattan. I had a lovely stay and definitely recommend!
This place was great. It felt very comfy. Charles and Mary are very helpful if you need anything. The place met all my needs.

We had a very good time and we would repeat this experience.
The house was very comfortable and clean.
Perfect communication with our host Carl.

This is a very roomy space and made a long stay in New York much more pleasant.  Great kitchen and play areas.  The patio in the back was an added plus especially in the current environment.  We really enjoyed our stay.

This is an incredible place. Unlike many places these days, this is a house that people actually live in. Therefore, it's full of all the basic things you might need during a week-long stay.  Great deck, very walkable neighborhood, and excellent host. Don't miss this place.

We had such a great long break at Carl’s home. With our young kids everything worked perfectly and we had everything we needed to manage our family life while on holiday. Carl went way above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and had everything we needed to make our stay special. It felt like being at home in a new city, which is everything we wanted

With Katerine's description the place was very easy to find. It is good located (close to the Subway (R) to Manhattan and 10 minutes walkway from the Prospect Park) and pretty cosy. The only one very annoying thing (not speaking about it earlier was my fault as well) was the message I've got in the last evening that I have to leave the studio next day at 11 A.M. latest. Because my flight was in the evening I was sure to stay until afternoon.

I was so glad that I found this place on Airbnb because it was the deal of the century. The studio is in a quiet neighbor, but close to transportation and some great places to eat. Katherine and Francois were so easy to communicate with and gave some great suggestions for places to eat. Would absolutely book again.

Expect timely responses and detailed information to help your stay. Beautiful home! Upon arrival it was clean and tidy. There were personal touches added throughout the home which enhanced the experience and made the time spent more “homey” and personable. The experience exceeded my expectations. I told me family about my experience and they want to book! They will not be disappointed.

Katherine's place is a cozy and quiet spot and yet conveniently located (food, restaurants, bars, transportation).  The descriptions & pics are 100% accurate: The upstairs studio is small but has all the appliances you need. Katherine is super-responsive with any request you may have and takes great care of the house. I had a wonderful time, thank you!

I very much liked my stay in Violetta's apartment! The appartment is clean, comfortable, quiet and very well equipped with everything you might need. Violleta is a great host, friendly and interesting to talk with!

Very good apartment in a great location.  Spacious living area, delightful terrace and very clean.  Close to the subway and only a few blocks from Central Park.  I would recommend this apartment to other travellers.
Perfect place to stay on the upper west side of Manhattan. Close to the subway and restaurants but a quiet place for New York.Very clean and has everything you need.

Perfect view, awesome apartment! Stay here if you like a central apartment close to Central Park, Hudson River and Broadway with some extra privacy, a quiet get-away in the middle of NYC and a huge apartment for yourself. Best choice ever :)

Violetta was a brilliant host, responsive and friendly. The apartment is really wonderful in the best location in New York. It has everything you need and is really cosy and quiet. I can’t recommend more highly.
We stayed at Olivier's place for about three weeks. The appartment was clean (+cleaning lady on a weekly basis

Thanks to paul and Barbara , we really enjoy our stay in their place , we 'd love to come anothera time in your place if se come back to NY ... Everything was clean , the subway is very close.
I recomand paul and barbara place :)

Very accurate listing. Super nice place and very affordable for Brooklyn. Olivier's recommendations directed me to some great spots in the area and it was easy to get in and out of Manhattan for work. Olivier let me check in early, checked in on me during my stay to make sure I had everything I needed and even helped me with a towel when I realized I'd forgotten one.

This is my first airbnb experience and my first visit to the US! I had a great time at Olivier's place. The other housemates were very friendly and everyone was quiet at night! I slept very good. There's a nice supermarket nearby so that's great if you want to buy groceries. It's also good commute to Manhattan with the A-train. Communications with Olivier was good, he helped me with Uber when I left because I've never tried that app before! Thank you so much for taking the time to do that! Also his dog Hugo is very cute!! ^^ I had a great stay!
Oliver's apartment was great for those looking for a longer term stay in NYC or between houses! Very clean and communication was good.
Enjoyed our stay in Hamilton Heights! The place was well kept and spacious, and we enjoyed getting to know Sheri.

Paul's place in Woodside is very cozy and comfortable, up 1 flight of stairs in a very secure building (behind 3 locked doors) on a quiet neighborhood street.    Wifi and AC unit were a plus.  Paul's manager Barbara was very responsive to text.  The location is very convenient to the Jackson Heights area which is buzzing with activity, as well as just a few minutes walk from the subway. While you're there, try Sammy's Halal cart in Jackson Heights near the subway line.  Delightful!

The place was exactly as described, with plenty of accommodations and a very comfortable space to relax in after a long day of exploring the city. For a week stay, it provided everything we needed and we'd absolutely love to stay here again whenever we have another chance to visit.
great place with everything you need. good location too. We'd stay here again if we're in queens.

This was a great place to stay. Superb location in a quiet neighborhood. Super close to several subway lines that quickly go directly to the heart of Manhattan. Lots of stores, restaurants, laundromats nearby.  We highly recommend No. 1 Chinese restaurant. Great food at a great price. We loved the Szechuan chicken and Szechuan shrimp. Yong Mei laundromat nearby has a good price on drop off service. They do a good job and seemed to be the best price in the area (we shopped around). We loved having two TV sets in the apartment. Shower was great—good pressure and plenty of hot water. Apartment was well stocked with supplies and plenty of towels and sheets. Wi-Fi worked well. We felt safe at night. We would stay here again. Thanks for a great stay!
Great place in Queens.  Walkable to subway.  Very neighborhood vibe.  Accommodating host.  Very comnnunicative.  Perfect location for our needs this summer.

The space is great, and exactly as pictured.  Everyone liked how it was close to the subway, clean, comfortable and a good experience for the price.  The only small drawback was not having a supermarket within walking distance.

If you're looking for a place that's reasonably priced for a moderate group of individuals, Paul's place is great. There's a few subway stations all within 5 minute walk and is one train to Grand Central, Times Square and other places in Manhattan.
This place is the perfect location for people wanting the real newyork experience, it's just two minutes away from two subway stations that take you straight into the city in 20 minutes  2

The apartment is in a very convenient location to visit NY, access is simple and public transportation is at hand. Apartment is clean and you have all that you need. Paul and Barbara are very kind and flexible, communication is very good. I recommend it.

Great location and easily access to everything.  It was very easy to communicate to the host. The place was clean and have everything we need.  The restroom had a little issue with blockage but I'm sure Paul will take care of it. Overall, I'll recommend the place.

Phenomenal location in the heart of Queens, within an easy walk of basically every train line in the borough, including Long Island Railroad (super-quick access to Penn and JFK). Woodside and Jackson Heights also have some of the best food anywhere in NYC — my favorite Nepalese, Tibetan, Salvadoran, Filipino, and Peruvian places are all nearby.
The apartment itself has everything you need, and is spacious by NYC standards. You’ll need to punch different codes into three keypads to get into the unit, so it’s a safe place — and the neighborhood is safe, anyway. Highly recommended, especially if you want a taste of a non-touristy NYC neighborhood.

My brother and I shared Paul’s 2BR apartment for 6 nights. Paul setup this apartment nicely. Equipped kitchen, clean bathroom, comfy beds, bright living space. The area is convenient with public transportations, supermarkets, international eats, but the apartment is in a quiet street. We really enjoyed our stay here. Thank you Paul and Barbara!

Good stay, the apartment is as described, has everything you might need and is very close to 2 subway stops which made it really easy to go to Manhattan. A little noise from the street, but not really disturbing.

Great location. Beds weren’t too comfortable, but it was a nice setup for a medium term rental. The place stayed warm even in the winter months  so the AC had to be on or windows open to keep the temp comfortable. Overall good location and would stay there again.
Great place. Great deal.  Definitely worth this day.   Public transportation is easily accessible from this location.

I had wonderful staying at Wowa's flat. She was warm, communicative and authentic. She made my experience in Harlem very special that totally changed my perception about this friendly area. We had fun, laugh and new friendship which were all beyond my expectations. The bed and interior environment were clean and homey. If you expect more than just touristy experience in New York City, you won't want to miss Wowa's place.

Wowa was such an amazing host!  Her love and knowledge of the community was amazing!  Her home is beautiful, very cozy and clean.  I would love to stay again.  Wowa is friendly, easy-to-talk to and extremely helpful.  It was by art the best stay that I've had.
Wowa's place was very clean and in a perfect location if you want to stay in Harlem, close to many restaurants and the metro.

Wowa's place is located perfectly for seeing all the sites and she is a perfect host. She made me feel at home in her gorgeous flat and would recommend staying there.
It's exactly as described--clean, spacious, warm and "American".
Wowa was also very welcoming and encouraged me to make myself at home. Would definitely recommend for any travel in NYC. I can't wait to come back.
Wowa is a wonderful host! The place was clean and stylish and in a convenient location for my trip! I highly recommend booking with her.

We have been all over New York and had terrible experiences with hosts, it's really hard to find friendly and genuine people like Wowa over here, she makes you feel like you are staying with family, she's caring, always a message away and she keeps her apartment super clean.
The kitchen has everything you need to cook, the express lines to go into the heart of nyc are only a couple blocks away from her place, central park is walking distance and so is the riverside park, beautiful places to walk around.
Harlem has a lot of night life, cafes with live music and cheerful people.
You are going to be staying in a living-room-made room, it's perfect for couples who are looking for a comfy place to stay while visiting nyc as tourists.

She was a really nice girl sharing her living room with us, she gave us advices and was always ready to answer to our questions. The flat itself is in harlem, close to the central park, to metro stations and to a supermarket too.
Thank you for the kindness! :)

Great place and a kind host. Upon arrival we were greeted with some hot tea! Wowa was quick to provide a whole list of things to do in ny along with things to do within the area. Less than a 10 min walk to the subway station which made getting around easy. Would definitely recommend her place.

I was met by Synthia's son, and I was welcomed very well. The flat is situated in East Village, which is a very cool neighbourhood. Basically, you can connect to different neighbourhood through Subway on either Union square or 3rd Ave - it's very convenient. The room is not very large, but it's perfect for a single tourist who comes to sleep and take a shower. And the dog is adorable.

It was a very lovely stay at Cynthia's! Cynthia is a very friendly and helpful, always giving me very useful pointers. The location is superb: it's very near Union square and also a few blocks away from St Marks where you can find tons of good food! The room is very cozy and the decor is artsy. And the cute little dog, Luna, is a pleasure to be with and she loves belly scrubbing. Overall, I loved this stay and would definitely recommend it to whoever coming to New York!
The room was nice and clean and Cyntia is a good host, I had as much privacy as I needed, worked very well for me. The area is also very good, lots of nice cafes and plenty of things to do.

Cynthia was an absolutely lovely host, and although there were minor problems with the room (there was a leak) she did everything she could to make sure I had a comfortable stay. The apartment was clean (although small, but didn't feel so) and in a great area. Her dog Luna was so friendly and adorable and made the space feel more like home. Would stay again!

The location is AHHMAZING!!!
Access to pretty much anything you want while visiting NY. I found a few spots that I will return to no doubt every time I visit which is often for work.
Karen was great and gave a lot of info on where to eat etc.
I recommend her place highly.
Great location with clean and comfortable facilities. Perfect base to get around downtown in New York. Karen was also a very personable host and didn’t hurt that her dog Luna was so sweet too!
The place was very clean and exactly as advertised! It’s in a great location and Karen is a very accommodating and kind host. Would definitely recommend!

My stay at Cynthia Karen's place was awesome. Cynthia is a very good host and very responsive. I would recommend her place to anyone who would like to stay in NY, Manhattan either for meetings at the UN HQ or for visit.
Checking time was good and I found her waiting for me. She is a lovely person, FRIENDLY and accommodative.
The apartment is in a very good location and very clean. I would like to stay again at Cynthia Karen's place
I love this place! I need not say more! Oh, but the dog is an attention-seeker and will hassle you for belly rubs but I didn’t mind 😂.

Karen is a wonderful host!
she is always open for chatting and giving suggestions of places to see and eat if you would like but if you prefer to keep to yourself you have the privacy of your room all for yourself, which is warm and cozy.
Communication was excellent and for everything I needed she was always helpful and quick to reply.
And of course it’s hard not to fall in love with her dog Luna. She is a little princess who loves belly rubs and is always greeting you when getting back home.
The area is amazing and vibrant and there are so many different places to discover. One of the main subway stations with different lines is very close so it’s super easy to move around the city.
I can honestly say I found a friend in her and I absolutely would go back and would recommend her place to anyone I know.

Very nice apartment with wonderful classic feel.  Mark was very helpful getting us settled and helping orient us to the neighborhood.  Lots of shops and restaurants nearby, access to Subway, and a great spot to explore Brooklyn from!  All the modern amenities you want and parking wasn't a hassle at all.  The apartment was a great place for us to stay and we would definitely stay here again on our next trip to the city.

Staying at Mark's Air BNB apartment was absolutely delightful! Mark was a pleasure to have as a host and gave us a great deal of useful information about New York  and the area. The area is quite safe and there are bars and lovely cafes down the road as well as a subway station close by. The apartment was very clean and cozy and Mark was very attentive to our needs. I would definitely stay there again and recommend this apartment to anyone looking to get a real NYC experience.

This was a great place. It is clean and comfortable in a reasonably safe area of Brooklyn. Mark was flexible and helpful, giving us an introduction to New York in general and the area in particular. The 3 of us stayed for 10 days and have nothing but praise for this place. We will certainly try to book it our next trip to New York, and recommend it highly to anyone else going.

Mark was very polite and a great host. The apartment is exactly what is described. He provide us with a lot info about the neighborhood. The neighborhood is quiet and located near the subway entrance. We highly recommend this apartment.
Excellent location. Excellent knowledgable host. Fantastic apartment. Could not have asked for more.

Mark has communicated very clearly to us before our arrival and has been very flexible and available the whole time. It was very handy to have the metro station very close to the appartment to access Manhattan as well as reach the JFK airport directly. Mark made us feel at home and the appartment was both pleasant to live in and quiet for a good rest at the end of a busy day. We all enjoyed our time there.
The listing was exactly as advertised. Lots of room and well appointed. The neighborhood is nice and only about a 10 minute walk to the closest subway stop.
It's really a nice experience to stay in this ancient house. Mark is so nice he prepared all in advance for our easy living. Thanks a lot.

The place is around five blocks away from the subway, and 30 to 45 mins train trip from manhattan.
The apartment was just like the pictures, with lots of space and light, very comfortable couchs and beds and a very nice kitchen. Bedrooms were comfortable and clean. The neighbourhood was very safe and quite, with a couple of grocery stores just a few steps away of the apartment and some very nice restaurants and pubs around.
Mark is a really great host, he gives you all the information you need and is available to answer any question, he even help us to book a taxi to the airport, we are very grateful!
It was a great trip in a very nice apartment!

We had a great stay with mark at the beautiful brownstone. It was just as described, and he was very easy to get ahold of. Subway, restaurants and stores are all a short walk. Would definitely stay again.

Mark very graciously welcomed us to Brooklyn and to his lovely home. The house was a real treat to be in, so homely and calming especially after days in the hustle and bustle of Manhattan.
Upon arrival, we were given good suggestions for restaurants, bars and bakeries in the area, as well as useful information about the area, which is well located and very convenient.
Thank you for your wonderful hospitality Mark, we could not have been more pleased! A very relaxing time.

Very nice apartment for 4. We had a great stay. Slept well, quiet neighborhood and quiet house. We loved having breakfast near the windows with the fresh baked bread from Sarafina's bakery. Cost a leg but was totally worth it. We would love to come again to this place and host Mark is really nice and friendly.
The place is in a great area in Brooklyn, around 10 minutes walking distance from the Subway. The apartment is very charming and has everything one could need for a stay in the city.

We had a very nice stay at Mark's place. The house was big enough for us and complete. The beds were comfy.The neighboorhood is nice with enough shops and restaurants and a 10 minute walk to the subway. Mark was very helpfull!

Marks place is accurate , clean and spacious . Mark is very accommodating with my time and very professional . There is a market called the harvest market around the area with the nicest owners ! I enjoyed my stay here and felt very at peace .

This apartment was full of charm and character and ideal for anybody able for a 15 minute walk to a great sub-way service. The apartment is in an old brownstone house and Mark the helpful but unobtrusive host lives upstairs. We had everything we needed for our 8 night stay, very near local shops and restaurants. This is not a touristy area and we felt we had an authentic Brooklyn experience.

Mark’s place is charming, quiet, and in a great location. It was very easy to both get around brooklyn and metro into Manhattan via the express subway. The local market and eateries were super convenient after a long day of sightseeing. Mark was very responsive and helpful with tips about brooklyn. I will definitely stay there again when I return.

Really enjoyed staying in Mark’s apartment and getting to know this part of Brooklyn. It’s a remarkably quiet place to stay once you close the door on the street. Beds were really comfortable so slept well and my 2 teenage kids and I had all the space and amenities we needed and Mark was charming and helpful (he even printed out tickets for my son to see a basketball match).
It’s about a 10 minute walk to the subway and around 25 mins into Manhattan, closer to an hour if you’re travelling up to Central Park and changing lines. Bed Stuy is friendly area and has some nice architecture, but is still pretty scruffy, in a relaxed sort of way!
Would definitely recommend you go to Saraghina, which does amazing pizza, and Peaches for brunch, but give yourself plenty of time as you’ll have to wait in both!
Would happily come back to stay here.
Mark's place was super lovely. A beautiful house that made our New York stay cosy and comfortable. Mark was very lovely and helped us with all of our needs. Would highly recommend!!
Comfortable stay. Enjoyed neighbor and walking. Mark is very knowledgable and passionate about his community. Cordial host.
my family and me are very grateful with Mark's hospitality it was very pleasant to return to his pretty and confortable appart after long days walking and visiting thanks again we recomand this place
Its like visiting family. Mark is the most hospitable host I have encountered. Extremely helpful , available and warm.

Mark is a very informative and genial host.  Questions were answered promptly and welcome suggestions offered.  The apartment is extremely quiet, comfortable and well equipped for cooking meals. It is located in an interesting upcoming area with local shops, restaurants and coffee bars within easy walking distance. Great for walking or taking the subway to explore other areas of Brooklyn and beyond.

Mark was a great host and his home was lovely. It was beautiful inside and really warm and comfy which was nice when it was so cold outside. The location was really handy and we really enjoyed exploring Brooklyn as well as doing the touristy things in Manhattan. Mark was really helpful and gave us lots of tips. We would highly recommend  staying here.

Staying at Mark's place was one of the best experiences with Airbnb I've had. Mark is a wonderful host and was truly a pleasure to meet and talk to. He was able to accommodate when I requested a 3-week stay on very short notice, and I really got lucky because this was an amazing apartment for the price. I really felt at home the entire time and knew Mark was always available if I needed anything. Also, Stuyvesant Heights is a great neighborhood and subway access is easy and close. Highly recommended!!
Mark’s is a fantastic host and his apartment is spacious, lovely with historic touches, and a great value for a larger group. We will definitely stay again!

Mark's place was amazing and had everything what we needed! Mark was a great host and was very helpful. The kitchen was well equiped and the appartment was very clean. The living room was spacious and the appartment was perfect for 4 people. The neighbourhood is great with a lot of restaurants and bars and is also well connected to Manhattan by Metro.

Our stay at Mark's place was wonderful. He was very helpful and friendly throughout and let us store our luggage before and after our stay. The apartment was beautifully designed and contained everything we could need.  The neighborhood is vibrant and full of joy and all necessary amenities are close by.  The beds were so comfortable that we had great difficulties getting up in the morning!  We highly recommend the apartment and Mark was a wonderful host!
Mark was a great host, quick to answer to my questions and making sure we had everything we needed for our stay.

A fantastic apartment in a great location for getting to know Brooklyn and with easy access to Manhatten via the metro. Mark was a very accommodating host as we had to arrive quite a bit later than expected due to delays at the airport.  The apartment is equipped with everything you could need and the beds are super comfy. We would highly recommend a stay at Mark's apartment.

Our family enjoyed Mark's place a lot. The A/C came in handy as NYC was hit by a remarkable heatwave during our stay. The apartment is located in a quiet street, just a few blocks away from the nearest metro station. And it was equipped with everything we needed (I mentioned the A/C above).  Mark's place was our first Airbnb experience and it was a very one.
We had a great stay at Mark’s place! He was really easy to communicate with & the apartment is in a pretty great location with easy food and transport links!
Loads of space, unique decor and great location- small walk to subway and lots of little shops and restaurants nearby. Would really recommend.

My colleague and I had a lovely time in NYC. As a host, Mark was easy and correct to deal with. We changed our arriving time last minute, which was no problem after consultation. The apartment is very spacious – my colleague and I each had our own room, and that for a very reasonable price. The apartment is also well equipped. And there is a great bakery around the corner as well as some supermarkets and deli’s and a few restaurants nearby. It is within walking distance of the subway although it takes you about 40 minutes in total to the centre of Manhattan (easy connection). If you prefer a more quiet neighborhood than hectic Manhattan (what may be welcome after a busy day in NYC), I would definitely recommend Mark’s apartment!
lovely place to stay in Brooklyn. Mark was super helpful with anything I needed. Bedstuy was a really chill place to spend a month. Had a great time

We really enjoyed our stay. It’s an old apartment with an interior to match but everything is clearly well taken care of. Very cozy. Had almost everything we needed.
Mark was a great host. We never actually met but we communicated over chat when needed and Mark was always able to help us with our questions.
Amazing neighborhood, green and lively streets, friendly people, lots of restaurants and bars nearby, groceries, laundry, etc. Convenient location close to trains and buses. The fire department is very close, so that makes a bit of noise if you’re in the living room, but it didn’t wake us up as the bedrooms are on the other side.
Overall, a great place and host, would stay again and recommend to others!
