Mark’s Stuyvesant Heights retreat was so lovely. The neighborhood is gorgeous and peaceful, and the interior of the apartment is beautifully preserved. A friend and I stayed here for a month while preparing to move to Brooklyn and we had a wonderful time!
Mark was prompt and responsive in alleviating any issues and I would recommend staying at his place to anyone! His prose in the airbnb manual is very fun to read which I recommend to any guest as well.

Mark’s place was clean and close to lot of restaurants and shops. Mark was very responsive and always checking in to make sure everything was okay. He got a new Microwave while I was there. There was no issue finding street parking. There is a subway station within a 10 minute walk. Definitely recommend.
Evelyn was very accommodating!  We had a later than expected check in due to our delayed flight and key pick up was still very smooth and easy!

I actually stayed in the Parlor 2nd floor apartment. Very charming and comfortable flat. Easy check in at a nearby restaurant. Perfect location to explore Manhattan, close to everything including many subway lines. Highly recommend, would love to stay here again.

The location off of Bleeker is great. The apartment is below street level with lower ceilings. It's comfortable and the hosts (Evelyn and her family) are eco-friendly with an eye for up-cycling. The hosts own a wonderful cafe around the corner. If you choose to stay here, I would definitely recommend breakfasts there. (I had toasted oatmeal and avocado toast while I stayed. It was yummy!)

This was the ultimate New York City experience.  Having a cozy home in the middle of Greenwich Village was as close to local as I could imagine.   The apartment was the perfect getaway. Cozy and warm with the best bed I've ever slept in.  This will forever be my secret hideout in Manhattan.  The sounds of the city lulled me to sleep.   It was a quiet and clean home away from home in the dead centre of a wonderfully vibrant cultural hotbed.  I will never go back to hotel living in Manhattan.  This beats every cool hotel I've stayed in hands down.
A nice homey place in the perfect Village location.  Evelyn is a wonderful and attentive host.  Highly recommended!

This apartment was a fantastic place to stay while visiting NYC. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and accessible. The location is fantastic and steps away from cute restaurants, shops, bars, and mid-rise buildings. The Hudson river path is near by, a great place to rent bikes. I felt extremely safe in this area of town. Evelyn responded to my needs and was accommodating.

Evelyn was an excellent host and made my fiance and I feel very welcome. The room was cozy and warm and had everything we needed. We got engaged while we were in NYC and found the room to be a very romantic stay. The location is unbeatable if you want to stay in the West Village/Greenwich Village area. It's on a quiet street but just a short stroll from plenty of restaurants, cafes, and bars. The West 4th subway station is very close by as well.
Evelyn was super friendly and responsive.  The location was perfect and the place was cute, clean, and just as described.

Evelyn was great, met us after we checked in and gave us some tips for the neighborhood (along with the extensive book in the room) and was very nice/helpful. The room was cozy, plenty big for 2 people, was quiet and getting in and out was very easy.

I really enjoyed my stay! Location is awesome - so close to some great shopping, restaurants, and sightseeing. Communication with Evelyn was easy breezy and I will definitely try to book here next time I am back in the city!
The place was in an awesome location - very close to the subway, as well as many great restaurant and bar options! Though it was small, it was very cute and clean. Highly recommend!
Really enjoyed it. Great location and comfortable bed. The apartment is clean and perfect for one or two people. I would definitely stay here again.

The place was just as described.  Very charming in an amazing neighborhood - I am ready to move there.  There is tons of stuff to in the neighborhood and it's also close to a couple of subway lines.getting the key was easy.  I thought it was pretty quiet at night.  The bed was super comfortable!

Had a lovely stay in the first floor guesthouse. Clean, comfortable and homely. Situated in a great location. While I did not get to meet my host, I appreciated her efforts to check in via email to see how my stay was going. Would definitely recommend it to others.

Evelyn was very prompt with her replies, and super helpful. Her place is in a great neighbourhood, so close to so many places to eat and drink, a nice oasis you can come back to after walking through Manhattan! The subway lines are so close, you can be uptown or downtown in 10 min!  I will definitely return!
Evelyn's place is very cute and quaint. Great location and very responsive host. Would definitely stay again!

Evelyn’s place is roomy and very well located for NYU or anyone wanting to be in Greenwich village.  I stayed in the basement apartment which was clean and well-equiped, however a bit claustrophobic (being a basement apartment).  One can hear and feel the subway underneath and there were some noises from the heating system, which is why I haven’t given it a 4 star rating.  The check-in/check-out process is very smooth and the communication is excellent.

Terrific spot in West Village complete with location, tin roof, all the amenities and walkable to so much. I would deduct one one-thousandth of a percent for slower internet on one side of the apartment where I stayed downstairs and simply say to you all what I said to myself: get your head out of your computer, you are in the heart of the Village!

Evelyn was an ideal host, the location is primo, the place is great for two people and we even managed to squeeze in three.  Having a little kitchen and all the comforts of home was helpful for us. Most of all, there is no hotel in this exact spot, at any price. This place is a real find.

Such a great apartment in the very heart of the west village.
Evelyn is very helpful and kind.
For sure, i would book it again!
Evelyns place is really cute and extremely well located for just about anything. Super clean and relaxed vibe. I’d recommend this place to all.

Great location!! Super easy check-in and check-out process. Felt very safe and had quick responses from host when needed. Ceilings are a bit low and WiFi was spotty at times. Plenty of extra bedding and well stocked kitchen area. Air purifier, A/C and heat available. Easy access to apartment from street, which was nice with luggage. Bed was good size and very comfortable. This was a great value and thoroughly enjoyed!
Evelyn’s place has everything you need in a great location. The bed was super comfortable and the shower was strong. I would happily go back!
Evelyn is truly amazing! such a cute little space in a really great location. A perfect space for a little New York City getaway.
Great location- so close to so many great spots in NYC. Evelyn is also a great host!!

The apartment is the most adorable, peaceful space. I was so grateful for Evelyn‘s tips and suggestions regarding Greenwich Village and beyond. You can’t get a better location if you want to really “live” in NYC!
Great location with tons of great places within a one block radius and quick response times if I ever had a question.

This place and host is an absolute gem. The location cannot be beat and the space has everything you could need. Evelyn is quick to respond if you need anything and makes you feel very welcome. I plan on staying here again sometime.

Evelyn is a tremendous host! Everything was superb. Her communication made it easy for me to know what was happening, and the place is awesome! It’s such a nice little NY apartment in a great neighborhood. Stay here if you ever have a chance.
Super easy check in, great communication, and exactly as described.  An outstanding location right in the thick of the West Village.  I highly recommend this place!

Excellent location, and a very kind and hospitable host. Listing is as described, a little rough around the edges but great value for the convenient location. Highly recommend for your time in the city.

Awesome location just steps aways from bars, cafes etc, yet very quiet once you're inside. It has a distinctly bohemian feel but everything that needs to be clean and fresh is clean and fresh. Highly recommend it!

Evelyn’s place was simply amazing! Description/ pictures were accurate to the apartment. She was very attentive and communication was great. Location was perfect and at walking distance to many restaurants and many go- to locations. Highly recommended!!
Very cute and comfortable room right near the blind tiger in the West Village. Great spot, very cozy! Host was super responsive and welcoming.

Evelyn's place is sweet and charming! It has a rustic village vibe. The accommodations are comfortable. All our needs were met~ small fridge, brand new toaster oven/air fryer, portable induction cook-top, small drip coffee pot. There were plenty of electrical outlets, a good shower. All was perfect. The location is perfect, right in the middle of the West Village. It's located right off Bleecker Street, which can be active and noisy, But~ this location is quiet and serene! Evelyn is quick to reply to any and all queries! We highly recommend staying here!

Evelyn’s apartment is in a perfect location — Quite street near to all the sites the Village has to offer. Evelyn is super accommodating and very thoughtful about what her guests need. Highly recommend staying here if you’re in NY!
The location couldn't be better. I found this to be exactly as described & it's perfect for someone who wants a comfortable place to crash after a busy day in the city.

Evelyn's place is in the perfect location, nestled in the West Village. Plenty of great restaurants, cafes and bars in the locale. The interior is cosy and unique, and it was the ideal base from which to explore the surrounding area and city more broadly. Highly recommended! We hope to be back.
Great apartment! Nice and clean, beds were comfortable, and Aswad was great! Would definitely stay there again, and would recommend this place to anyone visiting the city.
Aswads apartment was perfect. It was very cozy and home like. His communication with us was perfect. He was there to answer any questions or help with anything we needed. Thank you for hosting us!
super amazing, way clean very spacious. the beds were so so so comfortable very nice place. loved it!!

We had an excellent stay! Aswad has been an excellent host. He is very attentive to your needs and will respond immediately with any questions you have. Our flight arrived early and Aswad was able to accomodate an early check-in for us.  Our place was very stylish and very clean, we had everything we need. The location was also great as we were close to the train stations. I would definitely come back and stay again when I visit NYC!
Aswad has created a very nice flat for travelers to Brooklyn.  Lot’s of attention to details; very clean, comfortable beds, lots of space to lounge. We would definitely stay again.

Aswad's place was awesome.  I really like how he renovated the space to show a rustic feel but he had modern touches.  The space was very clean.  The pictures doesn't do the interior justice with renovation of an old house.  Love how he save the architectural features too.

Came to New York for my sisters bachelorette. Finding a great place to accommodate 5 guest is hard especially when you aren’t looking to pay tons of money. We arrived and everything was great. The home was very comfy and had everything we needed. Beds to sleep  and a super cute bathroom with a kitchen if you don’t feel like going out. Had the New Yorker feeling when we were there. I would recommend this spot for anyone that is visiting. You’ll love the spacious room and the feel of the home.
Great place to spend some days in NY. Aswad was very kind and helpfull!!! The Design on the apartment beautifull!!! Highly recommended! Will be back for sure.

For visitors looking for an authentic NY experience, our stay here felt like exactly that. I love how alive the neighborhood was on the weekends. Aswad’s flat has a stylish mix of old school and modern features that give the space its own unique flare. We looked forward to returning to the flat after a long day around the city and hope to stay again!
Aswad place was beautiful and we enjoyed our stay. The beds were really comfortable and the house was sparkling clean.

Mark's apartment was great!!! It's clean and very comfortable. We were there for 10 days and I would highly recommend it.
It was located in a nice neighborhood, near two subways stations, Central Park, Lexington Ave. and 3rd Ave. with a lot of restaurants and shops where you can buy everything you need.
Mark is a nice host, he was always available for help us and if I will come back to NY, I would stay there again.

I had a very nice time in New York in this excellent apartment. It was very well located, near the subway, delis, supermarkets, restaurants, wine stores and bars. It is exactly what it looks in the pictures. Mark is a very good person and host. He was waiting for me, showed me the apartment and called me 3 times to see if everything was OK. For sure, I will be back.

Great apartment, wonderful guy, excellent communications. Neighborhood is quiet, the apartment also, except for some neighbors on some nights during our stay. Good bed, nice and cosy sphere, excellent equipped.

This was the first time traveling with our baby & had many specific needs for this trip to NYC. Mark was very responsive with answering our questions about his apartment - which was really helpful. Mark was very accommodating on our check-in time as well. Which was excellent! He even went out of his way to meet the crib delivery company -which came really early with delivery. The place a clean, nicely decorated & as advertised on the Airbnd listing.

Mark went above & beyond for us, as our host. I highly recommend him & his apartment on Airbnb.

Very comfortable and well-situated location. Apt was clean and well-stocked. Mark was very responsive to our needs and friendly. We liked the duplex and having the bedroom upstairs for privacy when friends visited. Walking distant to great NYC museums, Central Park, the East River and excellent restaurants and grocery/food shopping.

This being our first Airbnb experience, our stay in Mark's apartment exceeded our expectations.  Immaculate and comfortable apartment.  Loft bedroom arrangement made apartment feel spacious. Second bathroom was a true luxury.  Location also excellent: quiet street, less than 3 blocks from major subway, cross town buses, and wonderful restaurants.  Recommended are TBar, Lusardis, and UVA.  Best feature of our stay was our wonderful host, Mark.  He contacted us before our trip, made sure our check-in was seamless, gave us helpful information about the neighborhood, and, also, checked in with us during our stay to be sure everything was perfect.  And it was!!!

Apartment was exactly like the pictures and host was super friendly and easy to coordinate check in with, which made all the difference since we were checking in very early in the morning. Big apartment for NY, felt like a home away from home.
Perfect location: close to shops, great restaurants, quick walk from the subway and central park - will definitely stay there again next time.

Rented the apartment for my kids. Mark was extremely helpful and let me know that the kids had settled in nicely and followed up immediately if they had any issues or questions.The apartment was just as described. The area was safe and had lots of restaurants .( especially the shake shack and insomnia cookies). I highly recommend  Marks apartment. If the kids get placed in New York City again I will definitely be in touch.

Mark's duplex on the Upper East Side was in the perfect location for us and we so enjoyed having the opportunity to stay here.  The apartment is clean and well-equipped and has an endless supply of hot water, which was truly a delight.  The duvet cover and sheets were so comfortable, I was searching for a manufacturer's tag so I could steal his good ideas for my own AirBnB place!
Gray place & great location. We had a terrific weekend in the City. Mark was very responsive and his place was as advertised. We'd definitely stay with Mark again!

Mark was so helpful and quick to respond. Answered any questions I had. His place was perfect if you don’t want to deal with the “hustle and bustle “. The extra half bath was perfect for my wife and I. The 6 and the Q subway are within a 5 minute walk. I will look to book with him again when we are in New York.

I had a great stay in Mark's place. The location is excellent, there are lots of restaurants , dry cleaners, subway, etc .  The apartment is vey confortable, particularly the bedroom.  Mark is always available and is really nice! I would would stay there again when I go back to NY!!

Expect a great host and clean and wonderful place to stay. If you have the opportunity to stay at Marks place don’t hesitate, you will definitely be pleased with the accommodations and location. It is easy to find and the area we loved. Easy to get a cab or take the subway. Wonderful restaurants and easy access to buy groceries. I give Mark 5 Stars.

Perfect location and spacious apartment with 2 levels and 2 bathrooms.  Very clean and comfortable with some nice touches.  Mark was a very gracious host, consistently communicating to make sure our stay was going well.  We've had lots of Airbnb stays (many in NYC) and this was one of the absolute best.   Definitely will be returning !

Wow!! My favorite place yet! Mark is so friendly, welcoming, and hospitable. His home is spacious, sparkling clean, and I absolutely love the set up. Everything is as I would want it if I lived there. It’s all new and done very tastefully. There is a balcony which is rare in NYC. Even more rare is that this single unit has TWO FLOORS! The bed is a dream, I slept like a rock. The shower has great pressure and everything is provided for in the bathrooms. All that you need for cooking is also provided in the kitchen. The cleanliness is so appreciated. I loved this apartment and will definitely be back. Mark is great and so is his apartment, I highly suggest!!
Clean, comfortable, convenient, and a convivial Italian restaurant 20 yards away. What more could you want? Host is very attentive and helpful.

We stayed here with our 18 month old to be close to family while in Manhattan. Mark got in touch with us proactively a few days ahead of our stay, met us when we arrived, then helpfully checked in throughout the week. His place had everything we needed for a comfortable week together on the Upper East Side.

Great little duplex in the heart of Upper East Side. We traveled with 2 children (10 and 14). The stay worked for the 4 of us really well, in part because I could release the kids to go and explore the neighborhood on their own; conversely, I would not recommend for much smaller children or for those (of any age) who would not manage themselves around the city. The place is ideal for couples though. Quiet and safe location, very friendly and helpful doormen (give them some tips on the way out!). Stayed for 5 nights and used wash and fold laundry (very NYC) on the avenue block. Excellent communication and flexibility with Mark the host.

We loved our stay at Mark's apartment. Mark was an excellent host. Great communication, and was quick to respond to any questions. We loved the location too. The apartment was comfy and clean... Highly recommend!

Mark met us when we arrived and was easy to communicate with. He checked to make sure everything was going well during our stay.  The apartment has a unique and compact layout  but has everything you might want or need. The bedroom is in a loft area which gives nice separation and privacy from the living area. Up to date technology, smart bed (adjustable firmness), small balcony, nice amenities, convenient location, secure entry to the building, door person and elevator and close to restaurants, transportation and shops. I would definitely stay at this location again when the opportunity arose.

Mark is an amazing host.  He made sure that every aspect of my stay went smoothly and I felt very well taken care of from check in to check out.  The apartment is quiet, clean, cozy, and comfortable for relaxing and remote work.  The bed is super comfy.  The space is light and airy.  And the location is perfect, near everything I was looking for when not working.  I hope to be back soon, and thank you Mark!
Great location; few blocks from Central Park; host very accommodating, friendly and accessible; everything as described and in photos; definitely worth staying if you are in the UES.
Mark was a great host, super responsive, apartment was exactly as described.  Great location and overall very positive experience!!

I recommend Karim and his apartment highly. He was a generous and flexible host who organised my stay with only a day's notice while he was on a plane flying out of New York.

The apartment is excellent. Exactly as specified, it is replete with mod cons and provided a welcome sanctuary during my stay in New York. The sofas look good in the photos and are very comfortable for those times you may have to lounge around.

Great place!  Perfect for anyone visiting New York for business or pleasure.  Karim was very responsive and a great communicator.  The place was very clean, comfy and close to our office.  Thanks Karim! We will be contacting you for future stays in Manhattan!

This apartment is advertised as a Great Bushwick Studio, and that's exactly what it is. A home from home!

Wilfredo is the perfect host, accommodating me at the last minute, when my initial booking fell through. A quick and easy booking, with all areas covered (routes to the apartment, best places to go, map provided, and generally anything that would be needed)

I found the neighbourhood safe, and felt 100% confident and comfortable walking around. The area has great transportation links, and lots of nearby food shops.

The studio was clean and a very very good size!! There was no disturbances and I was very happy at the apartment.

I would defiantly book again. Well worth the money.

A friend and I had a very nice 5-night stay at Wilfredo's place in Bushwick. The apartment is as it looks in the pictures: charming, clean, full of natural light, spacious. The location was great: felt safe and a very close walk to the L line and a quick commute into Manhattan and other parts of Brooklyn. The check-in was seamless, despite our flight being delayed by 4 hours and arriving after midnight. Wilfredo was a gracious and welcoming host; he was very responsive to any questions we had and was overall lovely. I really cannot recommend this place enough. We would surely stay here again on future trips to NYC.

I never met Wilfredo. I let him know I would be arriving late several days in advance and then at the last minute he asked me to pick up keys early. Had to send someone else to get them. The apartment is minimalist in the extreme: one towel, I had to buy soap, ripped shower curtain/liner.  It is close to transportation.

I stayed at Wilfredo’s place for a week and a half in June. Wilfredo greeted me when I arrived and helped me settle in providing maps of the area, restaurants nearby, and even recommended a great jogging route around a bird sanctuary that I ran many times while I was there. Not much going on in Bushwick, but the apartment is 2 blocks from the L, and only 15mins from Williamsburg and 20 to Union Square. Two 24 hour laundry services within walking distance were definitely a plus. No AC is something to consider during the summer months, but I would definitely recommend staying here.

We enjoyed the stay in Bushwick, at Wilfredo. Everything was ok and we even had a larger apartment.
Nice and quiet surroundings, and easy to get to, from the subway.
Wilfredo was a nice host, although we did not stay in the apartment, during the day, and therefore did not speak to him, a lot.
We had a good feeling about the place and was able to relax, after a long NYC-day.
The place was very clean and Wilfredo was really accommodating. He even gave us suggestions for where to go and helped us with navigating that area of Brooklyn.
Wilfred is very nice and did bring extra towels when asked.  We did not get the studio we requested, kitchen was unclean and not well equipped to prepare any meals.

Great host - was quick to help accommodate a request when my plans changed. The space was comfortable and close to the train, and the air conditioning worked great on a sweltering day/night. Nice big kitchen table to eat or work at, but don't expect a ton of personality out of the place (no personal touches to make it feel like "home"). Regardless, a good place to lay your head.
Spacious, clean apartment with a great host. That's what I needed when traveling. Thanks Wilfredo.
Niceee place with a lot of privacy and good location. Is easy to move around the city from there.
Such an awesome place and just the best host!! Everything was outstanding and can’t wait to stay there again in the near future!

We really enjoyed the stay. We liked:
- The quick feedback
- the fab atmosphere
- the great location
- the accuracy of the description online
- the friendly welcome
- the neighborhood which was safe and calm but not boring
- good communications, subways, buses
- great wifi
- friendly host who gives local recommendations and nice chats

Wilfredo is a very nice and welcoming host. The place itself is very quiet, clean and great if you're visiting people in Brooklyn. The L train is just two blocks away so it's easy to get into Manhattan, too. There's a great place for breakfast or brunch just around the corner called Father Knows Best. We would definitely stay there again.
Spacious studio, great location, and excellent host! Communication with Wilfredo was easy and stress-free. Overall a great experience!

Wilfredo is a tremendously great host. Everything was spotless and organized. Communication is great. Wilfredo was kind enough to make sure we got in safe since we didn’t check in till later. A lot of helpful tips and maps for maneuvering around the city were provided. We would definitely be back.
Make sure you speak to him . He booked me with out confirming and stole my money I never stood in his apartment when I reached out to him he never wrote back
Definitely if you have a chance to bunk at Wilfredo’s place do so. It’s serene, safe, clean. And the communication was stellar !

My parents came for their first visit (in a decade) to New York, so I booked Judy's second-floor apartment, just down the block from my flat. They spent a long weekend (three nights) in this spacious airy apartment.  The accommodations are clean, comfortable, secure, and include a well-equipped modern kitchen.   Judy was very nice and welcoming, providing a supply of breakfast staples as well as great hints about neighborhood cafes and restaurants.  My mother - always apprehensive about parking - was especially pleased that there is lots of free on-street parking available in the surrounding neighborhood.  Judy was easy to correspond with in advance and to connect with the day they arrived - she's very responsive, and even let me preview the space to ensure it would be accessible for my older parents. I hope the apartment is available the next time they visit Brooklyn - which they are excited to do as a result of a very restful, comfortable weekend.

Excellent experience! Judy met me at the curb and even helped carry our bags upstairs. We mostly communicated via text, she always responded promptly so it was very useful. The apartment itself is incredibly convenient, near many subway lines, excellent restaurants, and various interesting sections of Brooklyn. It was lots of space for two people, with plenty of light and a comfortable bed. Recommended all around as classy and convenient NYC lodging.

The apartment is superb: spacious, immaculate, furnished with impeccable taste, and renovated with excellent quality materials!!!!! We loved the open space full of light and the spaciousness to relax after a busy day .Judy added so many touches that made our stay remarkable: basics like juice, milk, coffee and granola; toiletries, laundry detergent, fresh flowers. Everything was very clean and there were cleaning products available for our use.  The washer and dryer were a big plus. We were not able to meet Judy since she was not in town  but all our communications and the arrival/departure arrangements were perfect. We liked the neighborhood: diverse, vibrant, close to Atlantic terminal/subway/buses and with nice grocery/dinner options. It was a wonderful way to enjoy Manhattan since it was an easy and short subway ride away. We had the best pizza in many years at Lucali's. We could not asked for anything else and we are extremely thankful to Judy.

If you wanna explore Manhattan and especially Brooklyn (which has so much to offer), this is the place to stay and relax! We felt instantly at home in Judy's stylish apartment, which has every amenity you can think of. Moreover Judy was a kind and helpful host. We recommend this place warmly!
Judy was great all around. And the place was lovely and clean and convenient with plenty of space. Would definitely stay there again.

We had a great stay at Judy's; the apartment was just what we wanted as far as facilities and location were concerned. We were a few hundred yards from the A line which gives straightforward access into Manhattan and up the west side and it is also within walking distance of many other subway routes. The area around Atlantic avenue abounds in restaurants, cafés, shops and bars but is not as frenetic as parts of Manhattan. Judy was a very kind and helpful host.

Judy and the apartment exceeded my expectations. Judy was easy to coordinate with and lovely. The apartment was a little oasis...a home away from home in every sense. The bed was super comfy, apartment was clean and tidy with all the little amenities you could need (hair dryer, washer/dryer should you need that, and yummy coffee for the morning), and love how they decorated the place.
Overall a great experience - I have bookmarked this place for future visits.

This was a wonderful apartment. We enjoyed the light, the privacy, the comfy bed and the coffee experience. It was new for us to grind our beans and drip our coffee! The apartment was well stocked in the kitchen and bath, plus there is a washer and dryer!

The location is very convenient and safe. I highly recommend Judy and her apartment.
We were very happy at Judy's apartment in Boerum Hill. Bright, spacious, comfortable, convenient to transportation, thoughtful host. Highly recommended!

We spent 3 weeks at Judy's apartment and what a great/lovely place to stay!
Spacious, lightful, comfortable and beautifully decorated. Just as described.
We wanted to discover Brooklyn and Boerum Hill was the perfect place to start. A charming neighborhood with great restaurants, cafes, groceries and an easy access by subway or even bus to the so many key sights of Brooklyn and Manhattan.
And Judy was so nice and helpful: simply a great host!
We had a great time and would love to come back.
Perfect apartment for our trip - exactly as described, and a very pleasant homebase for all of us. We plan to stay whenever we visit Brooklyn.

We stayed here for a week in April with our six-month-old son. Judy was great. She was really helpful and the arrival and departure went really smoothly. The apartment is in a great part of Brooklyn and is a spacious one-bedroom place with a nice living room and kitchen/diner. It's just round the corner from the subway and it's just a few stops into Manhattan. There are also really good restaurants and great grocery stores within a few minutes of the apartment. We were easily able to drive right up to the apartment to drop off our luggage and Judy had left a really good guide about the local area with everything we needed to know. She was sweet enough to leave us fresh milk and baby juice in the fridge and the kitchen is a really good size with great oven, dishwasher and fridge/freezer. There is also good room in the bathroom for the washer/dryer. Would really recommend to anyone looking for a  place in Brooklyn.

I rented the apartment for my In laws. They had a lovely stay.  The apartment was in a quiet area, walking distance to many subway lines and downtown Brooklyn. A short walk away from us in Cobble Hill. Apartment was comfortable and Judy was available for any questions regarding the place. Txs Judy!

This is an adorable place in a cool part of Brooklyn, we had a super smooth check in even with getting in late and the apartment was a cozy place to arrive to! Felt like home with some essentials in the fridge and light cereal options available.  Really clean and had a very upscale feel! Would highly recommend this apartment if you are interested in checking out Brooklyn- and it only took us 20 min to get into manhattan on the subway.

very good appartement, very good location, very friendly an professional host!
We had a wonderful stay in NY!

Judy's apartment was great.  The location off Atlantic Avenue was fantastic, everything we needed was within a short walk.  Subway connectivity into Manhattan and the rest of Brooklyn is very good in the area.  Super convenient to have a washer and dryer at our disposal, the kitchen was well-equipped.  Judy was out of the country for work but Alex was around and made sure everything went smoothly.

We very much enjoyed our stay in Judy's beautiful appartment. It was very clean, comfortable and spacious.
Judy was very helpful and gave us "Insider" tipps for our stay. We very much appreciated that she accommodated us on short notice (after our original host Ronnie cancelled on us 27 hours prior to our arrival in NY)

Lovely flat in one of NYC's best neighbourhoods. Judy made it easy to check in and out and gave us great tips for eating and drinking. We revisited lots of old favourites in the area, but also discovered new places thanks to their guide book.
Judy is a great hostess. Easy to communicate with. The apartment is very comfortable. Lot of light came inside. The neighborhood is charming. Definitely we'll stay here again.
Judy was quick to respond and offer assistance. I booked the place for my parents visiting town for a week and they had an incredible time. Judy space is clean and convenient. Would recommend!

We stayed here for a few nights while visiting relative, who also live in Brooklyn. The place is great, although up a flight of stairs. Check in was easy, communication with our hosts was smooth. Easy few minute walk to a couple of nearby subway stops, stores, restaurants. I’d recommend it. 🙂

We stayed at Judy’s place over the thanksgiving holiday and hosted thanksgiving dinner for 6 adults and 2 children while there.   The apartment is very comfortable, great bed, updated bathroom with great shower/tub and updated kitchen.   Located in a wonderful neighborhood in Brooklyn with easy access to lots of restaurants and shops.   And while the bedroom faces the street the windows were doubled for soundproof and we found it very quiet for New York.  We highly recommend the Judy’s place.

Judy's place is in a great location, just off Atlantic Ave near downtown Brooklyn and a few minutes walk from a ton of subway lines. The bed was super comfy, the kitchen extra nice, and the whole process very simple and uncomplicated. Thanks Judy!
Great apartment, conveniently located, super clean and with all the amenities. The new A/C was definitely worth it in the summer.
Brilliant location in a fabulous neighbourhood.  We just loved coming back to such a well stocked apartment each day.

I can’t say enough good things about Judy’s place and Judy and Alex. The apartment was clean, very tastefully decorated, stocked with all the necessities and super convenient to groceries , restaurants, all kinds of shops and most important of all literally a 5-min walk to a Subway station with trains taking you directly to Manhattan in a short time.
Judy provided us with all kinds of information (restaurants, shopping, highlights of neighborhoods, etc.) prior to our arrival. We had a couple of questions during our stay, Judy responded within minutes! All in all it was a great place and we’d definitely stay here again in the future!

We had a great stay at Judy's place - it is well located, close to restaurants, shops and the subway.   The apartment is well decorated, and was very clean.  It is located close to the subway/buses as well as many restaurants shops.    Judy was incredibly responsive and very helpful throughout - as we stayed for a month, she organized an additional cleaning halfway through and was flexible about check-in and check-out.  There were many nice touches - like snacks etc. on arrival. The apartment had all of the kitchen and other amenities (i.e. iron etc.).  Would definitely stay here again!
J.J. was extremely nice and helpful. A great place to stay and I would come back again in the future.

J.J. was a great host and super responsive to all our questions. The spot is lovely and the location is very accessible, in a lovely area and surrounded by a lot of cool spots. The apartment itself was lovely for two people and has all the amenities that one might need for an extended stay!

We stayed 1 month at J.J.'s place. It was fantastic. The location and neighborhood are excellent (easy transportation, great restaurants and shops a few minutes walk away, quiet streets of cobblestone houses all around, etc). We fleet at home at J.J.'s place. Quiet, well equipped, safe.
We would definitely welcome the opportunity to come back!

The room is very large. The location is near everything you could need. Subway is on the same block. Minutes from Manhattan. The neighbourhood is extremely safe. The host is a wonderful person. Will book again when it is available.
Andrian’s room is huge, well decorated and has everything you need for a comfy quiet stay in Brooklyn. Perfect location - coffee, trains, restaurants galore.
What a perfect place. Finally lived my dream of being a block away from Fort Greene Park in a brownstone haha. Clean Place, easy check in, great value
Danielle and America loved the flat Antoinette rented out. They said it felt like home and it was very peaceful and beautiful.

My stay in this apartment was delightful. It's a clean, cozy space with all the essentials, making it feel like a home away from home. The host deserves a special mention for their responsiveness and kindness. They were always on hand to ensure my stay was comfortable and hassle-free. Thanks for a memorable experience and your warm hospitality. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a comfortable and well-managed stay!
Bob's apartment is great. Really close to Subway for Downtown. A nice large open living room and kitchen and great to access to the back yard.
Place was as described. Bedroom is very small but clean. Easy access to Subway and lots of places to eat and shop for groceries in the area. Enjoyed my stay.
Nice place, easy check-in and check-out.  Close to the Metro.  We'd stay here again!
the apartment is comfortable, clean and pleasant. close to the subway station 168st, where you connect with any point of New York

The price for this place is good, especially for more than one person.  It was clean.  That said, it was in a very seedy part of town.  Fear arose in me when I approached the front door.  Instructions for entering were insufficient.  It is relatively convenient and a four block walk to the subway.  I had to ask for TP, AC and coffee.  Host was responsive but lives in Florida and has a cousin as an intermediary.  The main room and kitchen are spacious with high ceilings.  Wifi was good.  Water pressure was good.  It was very quiet.  Backyard was piled with garbage.  Bed had no backboard.  Still, all in all, I managed and I was alone.  If more than one person shared this pace, it would be a pretty good bargain.
Bob is a very nice host. He is very attentive and reagent. He gave us a list of things to do in NY. Very nice trip.

Thoroughly enjoyed staying at Bob’s place! Very spacious with everything you need, close to the metro and to various stores, laundry, restaurants etc. I noticed some ppl mentioned how it wasn’t the safest neighbourhood, but we felt safe and at ease the entire time. Very vibrant, and community-oriented neighbourhood with great latin american food options available. The only issue we found was the slow wifi, especially in the evenings. For just a couple of phones should be fine but laptop connection and netflix/tv connections were not the best.
Overall the host was very communicative and we enjoyed our week-long stay here. Highly recommended!
The space was not even half of what I expected. There were an overwhelming amount of filth and bugs. Bathtub wasn't even cleaned. Took a big roll out of my vacation.

We stayed at Tabita's apartment for a week. The apartment was modest, clean with artistic ambience.  The place is near the High Line & Chelsea Market and within a few minutes' walk from 3 subway stations. Tabita was very nice tried to make our stay comfortable.

Tabita was such a warm, kind and hospitable person who was attentive and considerate. The apartment is rustic and cosy with adequate facilities for my needs. The apartment is ideal for one person, (2 if you do not mind not needing too much privacy) thank you Tabita!
A very cozy and very quiet apartment in a great location! The apartment had no street noise and Tabita was an outstanding and thoughtful host. Charming decor and courtyard and an art-filled space.

We had wonderful time in NYC staying at Hannah's place. Hannah made an effort to be in touch with us during our travel. She personally met us for check in at the time that was convenient for her and us. Apartment was clean with clean linens and towels. There are ceiling fans in two rooms and same rooms have window air conditioners. It was very hot in NYC during our stay and it was nice to come to air conditioning room. Hannah left some food for us in fridge which was very helpful as well. We followed host advise and did not cook in the kitchen except making tea and coffee which were left for us by the host as well. Check out was easy and on time. Overall good choice to stay.

Everything went smoothly for our stay at Hannah's. Clean apartment with plenty of space for 3 people, and in a nice Brooklyn neighborhood. Hannah was easy to get in touch with and sent a lot of helpful information before check-in.

Hannah was a great host.  The apartment was as described.  Communication was thorough - Hannah let us know in advance that the bathroom ceiling had been undergoing renovations, which we appreciated.  We loved her welcome kit, and the place was right around the corner from a few great bars, restaurants & cafes.

We had a great time in Hannah’s place! She was extremely communicative and helpful. It was a comfortable space and very well air-conditioned with wall units. It is right near the S Line—which was convenient for us to move through the neighborhood and not noisy from inside the apartment—but I would not recommend for extremely light sleepers. Overall very good experience!
Place was great, if you don't mind some street noise from the subway line. Great location and close to a lot of great places to eat or get coffee.

Tabita is very kind and a wonderful host. Good position but the apartment and the parquet are a bit old and noisy, the kitchen small. The shower is outside the bathroom and there were no soaps. Good for short periods.
Tabita was the perfect host. Gracious, attentive, caring. You will not be disappointed.

Wonderful former artists studio with lots of charm. Great location, clean, warm and a comfortable bed. Tabita is very responsive and helpful. Kitchen facilities are limited but fine for us as we did not cook.

The location is excellent. Hannah's apartment was clean and inviting. We enjoyed our stay very much and appreciated Hannah's flexibility in coordinating the logistics of our stay. She was thoughtful about leaving glassware, towels, etc for us to use. We slept well and had a great time.

The apartment is roomy (much roomier than most NY apartments) and very clean. Hannah is easy to communicate with and a lovely person. I recommend the place with one reservation - there is noise both from the subway which is right outside the window and from the pipes in the building. I would stay there again because for me the many pros outweigh the one con, and because I realize that Brooklyn in general tends to be noisy. But if you are bothered by noise then you might want to look into other options.
Hannah was a lovely host and very communicative. Her apartment is clean and in a great location.

Hannah's place was close to family members, so the proximity was a key for us in renting it. Although written up as a three bedroom apartment, the front bedroom in winter is very noisy due to the subway and the clanking heater. We did sleep soundly in the inner bedroom, though. It is important to know that all three bedrooms are connected. We were fine with the food restrictions and Hannah even left us a loaf of homemade bread.
All good, as described, and Hannah was very helpful. I hadn't noticed that the S train goes by the apartment, so you hear it whoosh by overnight. OK to sleep through but worth knowing.
Hannah’s place was perfect for our quick weekend stay. She gave very clear instructions and it was easy to get in and out of her cozy apartment. Plus it’s in a great neighborhood!

Nehprii was a fantastic host, making everything for our stay really easy. Her place is warm, clean and really close to the subway. Really, I have nothing bad to say about our stay at her place. We felt like home!

We are a family of four, my wife, two sons 5 and 3, and myself. We drove from Toronto, Canada to Brooklyn to visit family and sight-see in Brooklyn. I went into mid-town manhattan for a few work meetings. The space worked perfectly for us. We were able to find parking each day for our car, though the street cleaning schedule took some getting used to. The Utica subway on the A-Line was perfect, I could get anywhere in midtown with just one transfer.

Nephrii was amazing, she found some toys for our boys to play with before we arrived. She gave great advice on transportation and neighbourhood amenities. Plus she is generally a really cool person. The old brownstone is as advertised, with most of the original character of the apartment intact. It comfortably slept my family of four, and we immediately felt at home.

Check in was a breeze, and it was very easy to get to from JFK airport. Nephrii was a good host - gave us plenty of space while checking in on us occasionally. Very close to the subway and several restaurants. Neighbourhood was nice, people were all friendly.
Quiet, close to a couple good restaurants and subway.  Parked my car on the street no problem.  Nehprii is very nice and was an excellent host.

This place was great! Really nice older brownstone that made me feel like was at home in New York. Brooklyn has alot of history and I felt like I was in the heart of it all. The place really helped  make this trip unforgettable and appreciate the time spent there. Thank you!
The place was really well thought of. Travel from JFK ans to Manhattan is very convenient with A train being 2 mins walk away. Dont forget to visit the French restaurant on malcom x ;)

Nehprii's apartment is comfortable and charming and had everything we needed for our three days in Brooklyn. The Location was great, close to the subway and surrounded by some great restaurants and coffee shops. Nehprii was very responsive and super helpful with all of my questions and concerns. I would highly recommend her as a host in her lovely neighborhood brownstone.

As an Airbnb host who has a type A personality, I am an extremely tough critic, however I can only sing praises to my experience with Nehprii. She is extremely personality and has a truly lovely space that felt like home during my friend and I's weekend trip to New York. It was very clean, super trendy/eclectic, had all the amenities that we needed, and was in a great location. I would stay here again and highly recommend it to travelers.

Nehprii’s place was a great slice out of Brooklyn’s beautiful and historic Brownstones. The neighborhood was quiet and we felt safe walking back after dark. It is conveniently located just a quick walk from the A or C subway lines which bring you right into Manhattan in about 30 minutes. Nehprii is a kind and caring host. She communicated very well, answered questions, gave great advice on local restaurants and even let us check in early.
We enjoyed our stay and appreciated Nehprii opening her home to us!

My friend and I truly enjoyed our stay at Nehprii’s brownstone. She greeted us upon arrival and made us feel right at home, and also offered some great suggestions for restaurants and art in town. I particularly loved the art and culture theme throughout her place. It felt like a true Brooklyn experience. I’ll definitely book here again next time I visit.

We had an incredible stay at Nehprii's space. The accommodations were beautiful, clean, and spacious. Nehprii was incredibly hospitable and accessible. If I had any question, she was very quick to respond. We will definitely stay here again!

This space is in a lovely brownstone in a great neighbourhood. Nephrii is a great communicator and you can expect anything that might come up to be dealt with swiftly and decisively. We wish we could have stayed longer!

This was our second stay with Nehprii, and we would absolutely stay there again. The location is great, very near a train stop, with great local dining options. The apartment itself is clean and lovingly maintained, with beautiful intact woodwork. Nehprii is a great host, very responsive and kind. Many thanks for providing such a tranquil & lovely place for us to rest our spirits after active days in the city!
Awesome brownstone house in a lovely, quiet neighborhood with an awesome host, Nehprii, always friendly, reacts very quickly. We had a great time. Thank you Nehprii!

We absolutely LOVED staying at this airbnb!  It was so lovely and refreshing and has such a homey vibe.  Also there are so many beautiful design features to the apartment.  Usually when I stay in an airbnb it feels very empty and neutral and sort of vague, but this place was so wonderful because there were books and a thing of wonderful tea and food in the refrigerator etc.  Also the bed and futon were super comfy and the sheets smelled great etc. etc. etc..  I can't recommend this place enough!  Bonus points for the subway stop being super close too!  11/10 :)
we loved our stay here and will definitely return for any other nyc trips! the location is peaceful and convenient, and Nehprii was a friendly and attentive host.

My friend and I stayed with Erica for 6 weeks for a summer internship in the city. Erica was a gracious host. Whenever we had questions, she was always willing to help out! She also told us plenty of places to visit while we were in the city. While staying at her house, a couple of things went wrong. For example, the kitchen sink broke and our internet wasn't working in our room. When we notified Erica of these issues, she contacted us back in a very timely matter and had the problem fixed right away. She was also very willing to come over to the house at any time to deal with any problems we had. Sometimes things go wrong in older homes and Erica dealt with any issues right away so that her tenants are happy. Erica is an extremely kind and caring host! She provides a great place to stay whether you're in NYC for a short or long period of time. I would HIGHLY recommend her listing!!! Thanks, Erica!!!

This place is more like an "entire home" than a private room. It's large and you get your own bathroom/shower!!!!! It's clean, in a great location, and Erica is totally cool. I'd definitely stay here again.

A perfect quiet stay in a spacious bright room. Everything worked beautifully for us and enjoyed the location very much. Didn't get to meet Erica but she was helpful and attentive through the whole stay. Would definitely recommend!

Erica's place was terrific. My husband, son, and I were there for 9 days. Erica was an excellent host, very responsive. Her place worked well for us. She says it's a private room, but it was just us in the house at the time. We could come "home" every day and make dinner. The kitchen is large and well-equipped. The housekeeper came by to clean while we were there and my husband asked about a toaster and one showed up later that day. There is a washer and dryer in the house as well, which was enormously convenient. The location is near transportation and walking distance to BAM. We would definitely stay there again. Thank you Erica.
Our stay at Erica's was fantastic. The place is just as described and the neighborhood is excellent. I would definitely try to book the place again if I were needing a place in Brooklyn.

We enjoyed our stay with Erica. The room was clean, the bathroom  was small but well equipped with towels, etc. The location was perfect for us, and it's a nice neighborhood. It was one of the best values that we could find. We would definitely like to stay there again!
Amazing host, very responsive and helpful. Place was very clean and had everything you needed. Right next to subway stop. Kitchen was large and had a lot of supplies.

I had a great time. The room was incredibly spacious with several closets (more than I needed!). I was more comfortable at Erica's than in most AirBNB's, and I have stayed at quite a few around the world. I don't always stay in a private room with other people in the house, but with my own bathroom and access to the large and well-equipped kitchen, my needs were met and then some. As far as the other guests, they were fabulous people. Respectful, quiet. I slept well every night. Great big bed and good shower (water pressure is everything).  Clinton Hill is a great part of Brooklyn. Great restaurants on DeKalb. And it's easy getting into Manhattan. G train super close. And C as well. I'm a New Yorker now living in CA and can say, if I move back east, it will be to this area!

The location was very accommodating! The train stops were a couple of block away, and the LaGuarida Airport is a short cab drive away. I  had to attend a funeral for a family member, Nicole and K were very helpful with my situation. The room was clean, there was a heater just in case if it got too cold. It is very quite and I was able to get enough rest after the family events. I actually left some items at home and I got to shop at the local stores. Their is a 24hr laundry mat across the street with other convenient stores nearby. K is very sweet and he was very understanding of making sure my guest and I were taken care of. I will definitely book this room again, and I am honored to be Nicole and K's first guest! Thanks again! :)

This apartment is a GEM in the heart of Astoria. Yiota & Co. were incredibly helpful in meeting to exchange keys and with any/all questions. The apartment was perfect for a much needed quiet evening, yet the busy street life was footsteps away. Very cozy, clean, and relaxing! Thank you for a great stay!

The place is quaint and nice.  Great Irish bar across the street and a little bakery at the end of the block which makes amazing coffee and Italian cookies.  The subway is close by and very convenient. Yiota and her Uncle are very accommodating.  I hope to come stay again.
we couldnt cook but we could use microwave. and there were very delicous restaurants. so we really enjoyed our time. thank u.

"Our stay at Yiota/Kiri's place was phenomenal! The place was clean, quaint and quite comfortable.
We really enjoyed the 'neighborhood feel' to the area and were quite pleased with all of the nearby shops & restaurants.

Kiri was, extremely, pleasant and helpful with our questions/needs.

We would definitely recommend their place to others and would go back again!

Thanks again Kiri and Yiota!!!!"
Place was great, Hosts were great, everything was perfect and as advertised... if you are looking for a real New York experience, this is the place for you!

Lola was a great host.  She was very helpful and provided me with lots of useful information.  The apartment was just as described and I have never slept so good in my life.  The only issue was there was some renovations going on but other than that my trip was great.
My friend and I needed a place to crash in the city ASAP and Lola was a gracious host who made us feel at home.
Lola was the most amazing and nice host ever! She is so helpfull, fun and gentle. Just loved her.

Our stay at the 'Gem' was amazing! The apartment is simple but has everything a single/couple needs when visiting NYC. The location is unbeatable as it's located at the heart of Queens' local melting pot, with just a 5 subway stop away from the heart of Manhattan.
Access to the apartment was easy, checkin and checkout was breeze. Yiota and the gang in charge have it all figured out!
I would recommend this spot to anyone visiting NYC, wants a great deal on a place away from touristy madness and is traveling as a single or couple.

Yoita made it very simple to check in and out of the apartment. The place was clean but the windows were drafty so for this time of the year it could be chilly but a space heater made the place nice and toasty! The apartment is conveniently located near LGA which made it simple for us to get around. There are a lot of great places on the street where the apartment is and we had a blast trying new foods!

A fantastic apartment in a fantastic part of town. Just a short subway ride to the centre of NYC. Lots of great New York life near the apartment, but once inside peace and tranquility give the weary sightseer a haven to recharge. Just a perfect size for two, there is everything you need to tour the city that never sleeps (with the occasional 40 winks!). We never got to meet Yiota or her 'team' but the emailed conversations and instructions were perfect. Highly recommended.

This apartment had some important features to me:  very responsive hosts with great communication (thanks, Marilena and Yiota!), a comfortable bed, a very convenient location in a safe but vibrant neighborhood and quiet enough to get a good sleep. (Note that you will hear rumbling of the subway from time to time, but I didn't find it disruptive at all). The marble bench in the shower was a nice touch, too! Thanks for hosting me at the GEM. :)
Lola is a wonderful host along with her cats and dog. Room was clean and she provided hygiene accessories. Would definitely stay here again.
Everything was nice! Lola is amazing person! The apartment was clean, everything was as it is said in description! The location is in the center, so Central Park is 15 min to go. Recommend!
The room is small as stated though the location is amazing!! Very close to so many things and easy to get around on the trains.

Check the ad, its correct.
If you like cats then this is a good place.
The house was perfect... bed was so comfortable, and its close to the subway system... it takes 15 mins to get to Manhattan.

I had a great stay, the apartment was clean and tidy. Yiota and Marilena were really clear in their communication and were always available for questions. It was a nice and safe neighborhood and the metro to Manhattan was only 5 mins away. All in all a great place to stay when you want to visit New York.
Great location, perfect for a solo traveler. Lola is very welcoming and helpful, would definitely stay here again!
Lolas place was a very good stay. Lola is super friendly! I would recommend the place.

The room was very small but not unexpected. I slept well (bring earplugs, it's NYC!) and was off in the morning back in the late afternoon for a nap and shower and out again for dinner and NY stuff. If another guess is staying there bathroom time requires patience and respect (the bathroom is small and cramped too, but like the bedroom functional. Lola is a great host: friendly , good communicator, and was respectful of  privacy. The place is what it is, affordable, and two thumbs up for Lola!
Good stay. Very responsive and nice host, the apartment was clean and nice but a bit small and subway noise quite often.

That's a studio in a nice neighborhood with a lot of bars\cafes around. The connection to all the attractions is easy cause the subway station is few steps away. The place was exactly as described and clean. We really appreciated early check in as it was very important for us. Yiota and Marilena are very friendly and it was pleasure to communicate.Thank you!

The apartment is awesome! It's in a great location. The Astoria area was amazing and everything is a short subway ride away. The hosts are also amazing, and very accommodating. We had to stay past checkout by an hour and they gladly obliged. I will definitely stay here again, and recommend it for you! :)

The location of the appartment is pretty good. There are nice restaurants around and the subwaystation is near by.
The appartment itself is really noisy, you could hear every subway going by (sleeping is possible). The place could be cleaner especially the rugs are sticky, stains are on the bedsheets and towels. The first wifi didn't work so we got the password for another one. the second one worked out but wasn't great. If you're out in the city all day and only use the appartment as a place to sleep it's perfectly fine. The communication was good the responding time was adequate.
A great place to stay in a fun location! Yiota was very helpful and made our first time using Air Bnb a breeze. Thanks so much!
Yiota's place was great! It was very conveniently located, which made it so easy to get around the city. It was perfect for a quick weekend in NYC.
Clean studio apt in a cute neighborhood that felt very safe and 5 min walk to the subway.
A clean, warm and functional space that is well located near major subway lines. The subway runs past regularly, however the noise/disturbance is barely noticeable. We enjoyed our time here!

We had a fantastic stay at Yiota's place in Astoria. The location is very convenient to the subway and several appealing food options (Bagels and brews...highly recommend the bagels and specialty cream cheeses.) The apartment was very clean and the bed was one of the most comfortable we've encountered at an Air BnB. The place is smaller than it appears in the photos but it is New York and we touring the city so we didn't really care. If you can snag this place, it's a charming and comfortable hub to explore New York.
We had a great time!  Location is perfect.  It was very easy to get in and out of the city.  Take in all their food recommendations.  Thank you so much for driving us to get our luggage;).
This is nice place with good location. Only down side is sometimes phone signal is very low and wifi is not the bestest.
Excellent location, sparkling clean, great communication from host. Very comfortable bed. Would definitely stay again!!

Quick to respond, clean,comfortable, close to shops and markets. Sitting on the back porch was a delight wasn't expecting to hear birds chirping as well as Firefly's at night.
No those hot night the AC was a huge plus.
Thanks again

This is a great apartment! Loved the area, so convenient to commute into Manhattan, just 20 mins. I felt safe coming back late too because it's on a main road with lots of shops and restaurants open until late. The area has a real community, family friendly feel too. I would live here if i moved to the US.
You pay for what you get. Great location near train station. Small semi basement bedroom. One think the restroom had mildew and smelled like it.

We had a great stay at Jill's house. The place is very beautifully decorated, the kitchen big, next to the back yard so you can enjoy the sunlight during breakfast. It has a lot very interesting cooking books (a lot of vegetarian ones), a great collection of pots and pans and many interesting spices in the drawer, (you could guess Jill is a great cook).
They left us a welcome tray with bagels and wine which was very appreciated!
There was also a note saying we could help ourselves to everything on the fridge (packed with a lot of organic and gourmet stuff) which is a dangerous thing to say to a group of Argentinians. :)
We also enjoyed some of the cds of their big collection in a great sound system they have set up.
Books all over the place.
Would definitely stay there again.

We absolutely enjoyed Jill's Home. The location was ideal for a Crown Heights Wedding. The home was cozy and warm, and my entire family enjoyed the convenience and warmth of being in a HOME. Jill was a great host and provided lots of great details, communication and tips. I would definitely recommend this home if someone needs a fabulous place in Brooklyn!

THANKS JILL!
Jill's home is beautiful and is in a great location.  It is a quick walk to the subway and also to lots a great restaurants, etc.  Thanks for a great visit.

A warm and cosy welcome awaits in this stylish family home.  A well equipped kitchen for cooking. The house is clean and quiet. Good location close to the subway for easy access to Manhattan and centrally located for Brooklyn neighbourhoods. Good recommendations provided and communication with owner. Would recommend to families looking for an authentic experience.
We had a great Thanksgiving in Jill's place.  It is big, roomy, close to the subway and great restaurants, and a very well equipped kitchen.  It is exactly as advertised.  A great experience
izi was a very gracious host that answered any questions promptly.  place looked brand new, neiborhood was great, very quiet apartment.   definitely would stay there again!

The place was clean and quiet. My girlfriend and I really enjoyed staying at Denae's place. Parking took circling around the block a few times, but we ended up with spots. I would definitely stay there again the next time we're in the city
My sister and I felt at home staying at Denae's place. Great location, communication was excellent. I'd definitely stay here again!

Everything was exactly as described. Place was very clean!! It’s a little walk to get to eastern parkway where he shops and everything is but it is Dede walkable and not that far of a walk. Her communication was impeccable and response rate is fast. She made sure to make sure my stay was comfortable. I didn’t get the chance to meet Denae but her neighbor was just just as sweet and always checked in with us. Would stay again.
I stayed in Denae’s home for about a month and a half. I enjoyed the beautiful space she created. The home was pleasant and peaceful.
This is a nice and cute studio; overall the place and neighborhood is very nice, nice TV, people in the building are friendly, bed is very comfortable

The Home and space listed on the site were as stated.  A large common area, bathrooms were nicely appointed, 3 up one down stairs. I thought it might be to good to be true. We loved the space and location. 1 blk to the bus line, short walk to the G line,  reasonable walking distance to the A,C line, a 1/2 block  to restaurants,  grocery stores, coffee and Bagel shops. We would stay there again.
Deborah‘s place was fantastic. So close to everything. Right in the middle of everything going on in Brooklyn. Super cool area. Great restaurants everywhere.

We really enjoyed staying at your house, Deborah. Not only did it provide everything we'd hoped for but the house has so much character and was incredibly relaxing to return to after our busy days pounding the streets of Brooklyn and New York.
The location was perfect for us, with great coffee shops, restaurants and and bars nearby. Our personal favourites included: Pecks (coffee shop - 2 minutes from front door); The Gentleman Farmer (restaurant with excellent value Prix Fixe menu - 5 minutes up Myrtle Avenue); Putnam's Pub & Cooker (relaxed pub-type bar - 5 minutes up Myrtle Avenue); and Bar Bolinas (small bar - 2 minutes from house).
We'd have no hesitation in staying here again and in recommending the property to others looking for a great base in a very pleasant, friendly, relaxed and well-provided area of Brooklyn.

We were visiting New York for a wedding in Brooklyn which was very near to this location. The house is very spacious and the location was great. There is a very nice coffee shop around the corner called Pecks. The manager, Starr is very nice and accommodating.
Check in was very easy. The owner lives in the house and still had food etc. in the same space we used so it made it a little inconvenient trying to keep our food separate from theirs. Also a lot of the the closets are locked and drawers taped so we did have trouble finding a place to hang our clothes.
All in all we had a very nice time.

This is a beautiful house located in a safe quiet neighborhood. The description of the house is accurate. Checking in and out is a breeze. The host is quick to respond and very accommodating. I would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful, spacious home in a cozy, quiet location. This was an optimal space for our extended family to stay for several days during our visit to NY. Even better than the photos!

We loved our stay at Debbie’s place. The beds were comfortable, the rooms were large, leaving plenty of space for our big crew. The place was easy to find - it was quite cold when we arrived, and took about six hours to warm up, but then stayed nice and warm for our whole visit. We would definitely stay here again! Great location!
This is an amazing place to stay very spacious great amenities and excellent communication. If you looking for a place to stay you will not be disappointed
Deborah and Starr were great hosts and home was perfect. Communication was easy and they were kindly very flexible with our needs. Would highly recommend a stay there!
We enjoyed our stay. It fit my whole family of 11. Perfect location and parking was a plus for us. I recommend and will be returning. Communication was excellent.
Excellent location and the backyard is incredible!  Nice open home-great for groups who want their own space to relax.

This home was the perfect place for our family to gather between Christmas and New Year’s Eve.  Much quieter than Manhattan but not too far by subway. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance.  The great room couch was a comfy place where we could all hang out. And the kitchen was outfitted with all the glasses and dishes we needed and all the coffee appliances!  Like any renovated older home, the place has its quirks but the lack of perfection makes it more comfortable.  You aren’t afraid to put your feet up on the couch!

The Master bedroom is everything. The location is perfect . So many restaurants. Especially if you like Culture foods.
As Far as the home, it's open, plenty of space for a large group. bedroomswere comfy.
As a Butler I love the Butler pantry, I was well pleased with the communication. Thank you

Amazing stay in NYC at Peter and Kathys gorgeous apartment. Huge, clean space with great roof top views. Such a fab neighbourhood to stay in and so close to all the action. Fantastic, effortless communication and organisation. My first experience of Airbnb and was very pleasantly surprised. Thank you!

Great host - good communication and very accommodating.  The apt is very comfortable and as described.  Cool neighborhood - right by St Marks Pl and plenty of other great parks and areas.  Highly recommend.

Peter and Kathy were wonderfully communicative, helpful, and kind. Their place was so comfortable -- and so hip! They gave us tips about how to get around, how to get the most out of their air conditioners, and what to check out in their incredible neighbourhood. We felt like true New Yorkers for the weekend! It was such a pleasure staying there, and I would absolutely book the place again!
Great hosts. Vibrant neighborhood. Great, clean apartment with all amenities needed for a pleasant stay.

Great location and hospitality! Kathy was great at communicating before the trip. Once arriving Peter was our main contact and he was awesome! We had the pleasure of being able to personally meet him and he personally walked us through everything in the apartment and even suggested a great pizza place up the street. The apartment is exactly as it appears in the photos, very artsy and cozy. During the trip Peter was very responsive to any questions through call or text. I would definitely stay here again!
Amazing place! Super neat and clean... Thank you so much for everything! Very prompt if we had a question or we had to communicate .  Definitely will stay here again!! Thanks Peter and Kathy!

We where really pleased by everything in that apartment:  Peter was very helpful, always available, the neighbourhood is bustling with nightlife and good restaurants, the subway is a 5-10 minutes walk away, the apartment is very functional, well furnished and exactly as in the pictures.  I highly recommend this apartment!

Peter and Kathy's place is a fantastic option for anyone looking to explore New York. It's a lovely apoartment as described with everything you would need for a short stay. They were especially accomodating with our arrival and departure times!
Thanks Peter and Kathy, a clear 5 stars from me.
James

Peter and Kathy were helpful  did everything possible to make our trip enjoyable.  They replied to emails and text messages and were very flexible. We were provided with excellent advice and tips as it was our first time in NYC. Apartment was very spacious and in a very nice area with many bars and restaurants. Inside everything was very clean and felt like home.  Would recommend! We loved our stay.

Peter and Kathy's home was lovely and in a super awesome location. We had a great time in the city. Their home is walking distance from public transit and many great bars and restaurants, plus it's in a really cool neighborhood. Kathy and Peter were really accesible during our stay and made communication, check in and check out really simple. We can't wait to come back to ny and stay in their place again.

This is a fantastic place to stay, you are right in the heart of the east village and you get to be part of the neighborhood. It is close to everything you want to see and so much you didn't even know existed. The place is a gem.

Peter's place was amazing. Great location, and the apartment itself had all the amenities we needed. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. Peter was also extremely responsive to any of our questions. Would definitely recommend.
This is a great place to stay!!!  East village has so many cool things in walking distance!!! Room was very nice and slept like a baby!!!  Thank you Peter and Kathy for sharing your home!!!

The place is amazing and in a perfect location. The only thing to mention is that there is not an elevator so be prepared to haul your luggage up 4-5 flights of stairs. Peter and Katherine were wonderful hosts and we very much enjoyed our time in NYC.

Absolutely beautiful space. It was immaculately clean and was very comfortable and stylish. The surrounding area is amazing, and so much fun to explore. Both Kathy and Peter were extremely kind and friendly, and definitely made there space feel comfortable and cozy. Definitely would recommend to anyone looking to stay in the area

Great location, a very spacious studio in the East village. Close to subway stations and lots of nice food spots and bars around. Peter and Kathy are very thoughtful people and responds to our messages fast.

A great place! It was our first time in NYC and we were very lucky to find a great apartment, very clean, cosy and charming. The area is calm, the subway is close and there are some restaurant and good place over. Peter and Kathleen are amazing, very nice and responsive. We definitely recomand this place!

Nicely decorated cozy space with a great vibe. I didn't meet Peter and Kathy , but can say for sure than they are very considerate and generous hosts. The house is located at a great location and we loved our time there.
Peter and Kathy’s place was lovely! It was spacious and clean, and in such a fun area with so much to do. We had a great stay!
Peter was about the best host you could ask for! Very knowledgeable about the city, and his apartment is seriously to die for. Couldn't have made me and my girlfriend feel more welcome and at home.

Peter and Kathy were amazing hosts, making sure that our stay was a comfortable one. They responded quickly and checked in frequently to make sure that everything was going well. The apartment is stylish, clean, had a spacious kitchen, and also had A/C units which we were thankful to have for the summer weather. The location is unbeatable - East Village has a lot to offer in terms of unique bars and restaurants. The street which the apartment is located on felt safe to return to even when we were out until quite late. I would definitely love to stay here again next time I visit New York City.

Peter's place is in a great part of the East Village close to many restaurants and shops.  He communicated and responded almost immediately to our questions.  The place was very clean with plenty of towels.  There is a nice street view from the 5th floor.  Check-in and check-out was a breeze.   The A/C works well and will keep you nice and cool in the summer.  Would return here again.

It's a breath of fresh air when you stay with a stellar host who seemingly thinks of everything to make your stay comfortable. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Peter's place.
The bed was very comfortable and I greatly appreciated the air conditioning. The apartment was quite stylish and spacious. Perfect for two people. The amenities (kitchen, shower, internet, towels, etc) were much better than other East Village Airbnbs I've stayed at.

This was such a good choice and we had no regrets. The apartment has everything (and I mean everything!) you could need.  I especially love that he had coffee for the guests. The Apartment is exactly as pictured and is huge by NY standards. Neighborhood is great, lots of cool things that were on our list are nearby.  Kathy and Peter were super helpful and flexible,  and checked with us by phone to ensure we had everything and can answer questions. We traveled by bus, subway, bike, uber and taxi. They all have their purpose depending where you're going to or from, and this location is super convenient to see all of your NY sites. Note that the five flights up is for the agile traveler, but you can actually access the roof which was cool to view everything from up there.  I highly recommend this listing and would stay again to avoid surprises elsewhere since this was everything I wanted.
A great place to stay in the city! The apartment was comfortable, clean and everything was just exactly as we needed.

Peter and Kathy were absolutely amazing. their place is huge ! two units attached so great value for the investment !!
we are planning our next visit
many thanks
