Peter and Kathy were very helpful and flexible. The area is really nice and it is easy to get around the city from there.

Peter's apartment is an oasis in Alphabet City. Check in was super easy- our hosts met us at the apartment to hand off the keys and explain everything. The apartment was spotlessly clean, and the kitchen and bathroom were well stocked. The location is in the heart of the East Village, with tons of great restaurants and bars nearby.

David did not meet us in person. His neighbor helped us check in. David's loft is absolutely wonderful! Not far away from the subway and several excellent restaurants around the block. The building is next to the road so it's a little bit noisy at night.

Wow! David's place is awesome, the building is clean, neighbors are super friendly, the loft itself is just as you see from the pictures, his lights and plants definitely make the loft nicer. The neighborhood at first didn't give me a very safe impression, but it's actually just a feeling, nothing more, everyone I spoke to around the area are friendly. Recommend to anyone who's looking to stay at David's loft.

Comfortable and Good place to stay.
Close to manhattan good food around, laundry and supermarkets.
David was fast responsive for my any questions.
Thanks David

I had a wonderful stay at this lovely garden flat on Bergen Street! I found it to be clean, very comfortable bed, lots of space and very relaxed!!  I found Chris to be very helpful and welcoming. At the start of my stay my wifi did not appear to be working and when I mentioned this he fixed things immediately. The location is great in Brooklyn and easily accessible to the city and other areas of Brooklyn. I would very much highly recommend and would definitely stay here again!!

Chris' space is great! Very large and comfortable with nice touches like coffee and tea. Loved the backyard chickens- they are very quiet but friendly.  Super convenient to neighborhood restaurants and activities.  Chris was always available to answer questions, and kept in touch throughout the visit. I would definitely book this place again!
The apartment was as listed.  The check in was easy and flexible.  The chickens add originality to a city apartment.  No problems.

Christopher is so prompt with his replies and provides so much useful information.  We were warmly greeted and the kitchen is very well equipped and well stocked!  Thanks so much for the fresh eggs and bagels.  The apartment is very spacious and so convenient to several sub stations.  I loved the neighborhood with such a variey of ethnic restaurants.  Everyone we met was so friendly and helpful.  Great NYC experience!

A very comfortable apartment. Great comfortable bed. The location cant be beat; on a nice residential street.

Chris is a caring host. He communicated with us to ensure we were doing well.

We expect to stay here during our next visit to Brooklyn.
Great place in a cool neighborhood at a very reasonable price. Chris very kindly left drinks and snacks s well. Really enjoyed the stay.

Chris' apartment in Boerum Hill is delightful. It is spacious and comfortable, very well equipped, and close to all the loveliness of this part of Brooklyn. The tree-lined street of brownstones is charming.
Chris has been very friendly and helpful, and easy to contact, despite being away some of the time.
We would love to stay here again.

From the first time I inquired about dates, to incidental texts while there about wifi or restaurants, Chris responded immediately and was very helpful. Really nice guy and gracious host. The apartment was just as it appears in the pictures, the bed was very comfortable and Chris has clearly put effort into having more than the necessities all there and waiting for his guests. Way more. Couldn't had a better location as well. Look no further for a place to stay.

Chris made sure we had all the information we needed to make entry seamless. The place was clean, welcoming, well-appointed and well-stocked. There were more than enough towels, toilet paper and we were pleasantly surprised to see the bathroom stocked with toiletries and the kitchen and fridge stocked with snacks, plus coffee/ tea. We got in late our first night, so it was so lovely to be able to have morning beverages without venturing out.
The huge full length mirror in the bedroom was a definite bonus, as were the washer and dryer, especially in NYC.
Additionally, he checked in several times just to make sure we had everything we needed, were getting around the neighborhood ok and that we were having no issues with the place.
I'd say this was one of my favorite Air b-n-b experiences to date.

I lived in this neighborhood for five years before moving west. Now I'm traveling back every 1-2 months for work, and this spot was a great find for me. I love the neighborhood and wanted a place that felt like home, that was spacious and quiet, that had all the benefits of an apartment away from home (clean bathroom, comfortable bed, laundry, a complete kitchen, iron and ironing board...) and found all that and more here.

Chris is an exceptianally generous and kind host.  The apartment is warm, roomy and everything provided was so helpful from shopping cart to iron to amazingly comfortable bed, outside space and more.  The beautiful garden was so welcoming in early spring.  Chris was very easy to communicate with and all instructions were perfect.  The location is cheerful and easy to walk to everything interesting and fun to do around the neighborhood. Thank you Chris!

This is really nice place in Brooklyn. Bedroom with a double bed and a livingroom and kitchen in one. Quiet street, nice neighborhood and 5 min. walk to three different subways going to Manhatten in just a few stops. Deli stores on every corner (it seems). Chris was traveling while we where there, but was very responsive and helpfull and everything was super clean and functional. I really recommend this place.

We had a great stay at Chris' apartment! With his clear description it was easy to find and had everything we could have wished for. Chris is a great host who tried everything to make our stay very comfortable. When we arrived at the house the fridge was stuffed with nice cool drinks and there were a lot of other supplies as well. We felt at home immediately. Besides the house, the neighbourhood is realy nice as well. A great place to stay when visiting NYC!
What a great place to stay!  Chris could not have been more responsive, the apartment was very clean, well equipped and comfortable. We will definitely look to stay here when we return to Brooklyn.
Everything was as described.  Very clean and easy to get to from public transport.  Chris was very easy to get a hold of.  Overall, a great stay!!

Chris was very attentive to making my arrival seamless, and he is genuinely hospitable. He answered my few questions immediately with good humor. The listing is accurate, but be prepared for much more in the way of things he stocks to make one feel pampered.
It's a classic tree-lined brownstone neighborhood so well situated between two east-west subway stops that one can do and go everywhere daytime and into the late night with ease. I packed so much into each 24 hours that I left practically feeling like a native.

Chris is a wonderful host and the garden apartment was a great place
to stay in Brooklyn. The apartment was comfortable and Chris provided a lot of goodies in the kitchen and bathroom to get you by. It is close to public transportation, restaurants and cafes. We enjoyed our stay very much and will be back next time around. Thank you, Chris!
Fantastic apartment in an awesome location with easy access to great bars, restaurants and the subway into manhattan. Chris was a great host.
Great place.  Location is convenient to public transportation and the neighborhood is lovely.  Chris has the apartment well stocked and responsive.  Great value

This is the best Airbnb experience I have had so far. Chris's place is very well furnished and clean. Chris was quick to respond to any questions we had was very friendly. If I visit Brooklyn in the future I will definitely try and stay here again if it is available.

Chris is a great host with a great location in Brooklyn. From start to finish, Chris was on top of communication and easily reachable. The apartment is stocked with anything you could need, and it's perfectly located in Brooklyn right by many different subway lines. Highly recommend.

Super convenient location for anything you need in a safe neighborhood. Very clean and well-stocked with snacks, coffee, etc. Cristobal is a great host- and we were appreciative of the fresh flowers upon arrival!

Great and spacious place with a garden in a beautiful brownstone neighbourhood in Brooklyn with great transport links, this is an absolutely fantastic place to base yourself to explore Brooklyn and Manhatten. Cristobal really generously provides lots of food, drinks and snacks. I don't think you will find many airbnbs this good.

I live in the neighborhood and rented Cristobal's apartment for my parents to stay in while they visited. It's spacious but still a cozy place. And man was that refrigerator stocked! This will be my go-to Brooklyn Airbnb for friends and family needing to stay nearby. And Chris is the friendliest host!
Great location, easy access to multiple subway lines.  Very clean and tidy with a pleasant quite back yard that allows you to relax once returning for the noisy city.

This is a really great place to stay in Brooklyn - very close to lots of fun things to do but very quiet once you're inside. The apartment is in great condition and came equipped with everything we might need. We also appreciated the AC and washer/dryer which kept us cool and clean during our visit in summer. Cristobal was available when/if we needed but we had the apartment completely to ourselves. We would absolutely recommend it and will seek to stay here again.

My friend and I had a fantastic time staying at Cristobal's place on our recent Brooklyn/NYC trip. The place was very clean when we arrived, looked exactly as the photos did, and was spacious and very nice all around! The location is a very short walk to a metro station on a main line. The street it's on is pleasant and picturesque as well. I will definitely be staying here again on any future NYC area trips!
This place is a gem--beautifully furnished and well stocked with extras, such as snacks and a blow dryer.  Highly recommend!  Cris is an excellent host and immediately available to help in any way.

A well located and very comfortable apartment in a historic Brooklyn neighborhood of brownstones. Near lots of restaurants, coffee shops and stores, as well as the subway. The apartment has everything you need - even slippers!
Great place to stay. Great location, close to numerous subway lines. Cristobal was an attentive and gracious host. Would definitely recommend this place.

Chris's apartment was a dream, great location, well set out. It was an oasis for us while we visited NYC.
And Chris was so helpful as well.
Five stars.

Fantastic place.
The apartment is very ‘cool’ and in a hip part of town. Good shops, local deli’s and bars are all close. Several subway stations are within a third of a mile so easy access to several lines to travel into Manhattan.
The apartment itself is clean and well stocked. Comfy bed was welcome after long days exploring NYC. Also a cozy sitting room with large screen tv and well stocked kitchen. Chris takes time to add some essentials which many hosts don’t bother about.
Chris is a great host with plenty of tips on places to go, to eat at or even have a drink. Very thoughtful and understands what the guest needs.
Don’t think about it, book it.
Great place to stay in a terrific location, right in the middle of the neighborhood-walking distance to the subway with an amazing host who went out of his way to make sure our stay was perfect.

Cristobal is a delightful host. His place is immediately warm and inviting, and thoughtfully stocked with anything you could possibly desire, from coffee, soups, drinks, chocolate ,...., in the kitchen, to slippers and tote bags for getting around near the door. Regardless, Cristobal was super responsive, and even thoughtfully left us cookies upon our arrival.  At one point, I wrote him to apologize for the noise we were making, and instead of making me feel bad, he offered us cookies. The bed is soft and comfortable, and there are books, DVDs, and good WIFI. It’s a great place to cozy up, and we will definitely plan on staying at Cristobal’s place in the future.
It was the perfect place for us and Cristobal is always available and makes you well at ease. Surely we'll come back next year.
This is a wonderful spot in Brooklyn. I guarantee that whatever you anticipate wanting or needing, it has more than likely been provided by the host.

Perfect location in the most beautiful neighborhood in Brooklyn. Walking distance to everything you need. Cristobal had the house stocked with everything we could think of. Easy check-in communication, highly recommend!

Cristobal's downstairs apartment was perfect for us - great location, near subway, local shops and restaurants, quiet, spacious, everything perfectly labeled, complimentary snacks, coffee and tea, two large video screens, excellent internet access, Cristobal was readily available. Perfect!
Cristobal is a wonderful and thoughtful host. This is our second stay at his amazing place.

Excellent place to visit New York and Cristobal really deserves the price of the best host. There is everything you need to spend a nice and pleasant trip in Brooklyn and be near all the means of transport as well. Highly recommended.
Great host, always available, the apt was perfect for us including location. The tips from Chris are the best.
Cris is a fantastic host. The apartment is cozy and warm. The location is great. And the best amenities we've had at an Airbnb.

This is probably the best AirBNB we have ever stayed in. The location is really good. The neighborhood is pleasant and there are a lot of subway stations nearby. The apartment itself is extremely well equipped with all you could ever wish for. And Cristobal is very easy to contact and ready to help whenever you need it. Highly recommended!

Cristobal is an extraordinarily kind and accommodating person, and was very responsive if I had any questions regarding my stay. The space is clean, and relaxing, and also stocked with water and other necessities that made my stay much easier.  Overall, this was one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had, and will definitely be staying here again in the future.
We were happy to be able to stay at this lovely apartment again. It felt like home in the best way. Thoughtful host, great location. Thank you, Cris!

Amazing spot in a cute neighborhood in Brooklyn. Cristobal is a great host (dropped off an umbrella for the rain, there is already some food in the place). Close to multiple subway stations and very safe feel.

This apartment in Brooklyn is beautiful and in a great neighborhood with tons of things to do. Really an ideal location to get the best of both Brooklyn or jump into Manhattan. Very clean, comfortable place, with an insanely comfortable bed. Cristobal was a fantastic host, very friendly and right there to help any time I needed it.
Cristobal is extremely communicative. His place was absolutely perfect for my needs! I highly recommend staying at his place. I really can't speak more highly of him!

Cristobal's place is exactly as described - spacious, clean and in a great location. There are loads of small touches like books, boardgames and a well stocked kitchen that made our stay even more pleasant. Cristobal is a thoughtful host and we will definitely stay again!

This was my second time staying at this Airbnb. Does not disappoint. Conveniently located near train stations in a quiet and lovely neighborhood. Cristobal was quick and friendly to answer any questions and went above and beyond, we were grateful.  I recommend his place!

We had a great stay. It's a quiet apartment in a nice neighborhood close to restaurants and shops. Parking mostly was easy. The apartment had everything we needed, and it all worked as expected. There are even labels on drawers and cabinets. Cristobal shows a lot of care for this space. He is responsive, and we even chatted for a few minutes one evening. Could not have asked for more.
Enjoyed our stay at Cris' place! Comfortable apartment, great location, great host.

Overall great stay! Joyce is a great host, more than accommodating, plus, the house is very quiet, no disturbances. It’s clean, and well equipped with everything you would possibly need during your stay. If you are looking for a quiet, cozy, place to stay, this is it.

We stayed with Joyce for 1 month as we were relocating from Seattle to Brooklyn. It was the perfect "1st home" for my family. Her brownstone is in a very nice neighborhood. She provided all the tools necessary for us to live comfortably (kitchen, bathroom, etc). She was incredibly gracious and kind, answered all of our questions and was very conveniently located to trains, food, shopping and the Brooklyn Children's Museum. Her place had the perfect amount of space for 3 of us and our dog. I definitely recommend staying here to anyone traveling to Brooklyn or the NYC area. I will always look back fondly at my first NY home.

My stay at Joyce's was awesome. Joyce and her family are great hosts. The house was in a very nice neighborhood, and close to two metro lines. It was a great experience for me and my family, I would recommend the place to anyone who want to visit New York.

Joyce was an accommodating and friendly host.  I arrived a bit later than expected (around 9:30 pm) and she was waiting at the door.  The apartment is spacious and clean, and is within walking distance to 2 different subway lines.  The kitchen is well equipped, and there were fresh towels in the bathroom.  I had driven to NY, and was able to park for free on the street with no issues.  I highly recommend Joyce and her apartment.
Chris is great. So easy to communicate with, so generous. I had a lively stay in his sweet little place.

We stayed here for two months and would have stayed longer if we could. The place was cozy and welcoming in a central area near bars, the Botanic garden, Brooklyn museum and more! We miss the place already and Ms. Joyce became like family to us! She gave us privacy but came around when ever we needed her. She’s so friendly and nurturing and has even looked out for us after checking out. While our stay here, we enjoyed the large kitchen area and cooked many meals here. I especially appreciated the large bed and master bedroom area that had many shelves for us to unpack and feel right at home. One the hottest of days we stayed inside and enjoyed the AC and TV. This is a central spot that is very relaxing and I recommend this to anyone! Miss Joyce was so sweet! If you need anything just let her know she has your back :) ❤️
Lovely spacious brownstone in a neat, quiet street. Joyce is a friendly host and the neighbourhood has a lot to offer

Joyce’s garden-level townhouse unit is cozy and full of character. She’s a super friendly, inviting, personable host who always made me feel welcome and comfortable. I felt right at home in her unit, almost like I was just a fellow neighbor! My only critique would be that the unit doesn’t get much natural light, so it can be quite dark, even during the day, so just know that ahead of time. Otherwise, recommended!

Great location, easy access to pretty much everywhere including Manhattan on the L train. Great host, happy to help with anything! The apartment is as big as it looks in the photos, lovely quiet garden and private access. We were really happy and would definitely recommend/stay again!
Great Host! Great Appartment very close to the Metro! Everything was Fine! When we Come back we will book here again!
Great cosy studio in a creative, vibrant area that was perfect for my trip. Close to the metro (L train) for trips uptown.
Guillermo was a really nice and flexible host and the apartment was comfortable and clean. We would definitely recommend this apartment.

The appartment has all the necessary facilities for a comfortable stay and is only 1 block away from the L train that takes you into Manhattan. A small supermarket and a coffee bar are just around the corner.
Guillermo was a great host and gave us some good NY tips. We could leave our luggage till 3pm the last day of our stay. Higly recommended

Guillermo was a great host. Easy to get in contact with and just up stairs if we needed him. The studio was perfect for what my girlfriend and I were looking for. Clean and bright. Comes with everything you should need for you stay and only a short walk to the metro.

The apartment was fantastic, just what we needed, comfortable, homely and clean. Great location for the subway, 20 minutes to Manhattan. We enjoyed the area and some great recommendations of places to eat/drink. We asked for some advice on getting back to the airport and Guillermo happily booked us a car service which was very helpful. Fantastic host and a lovely apartment. Very enjoyable stay.

Host was on site to give us a friendly welcome along with suggestions of where to go during our stay. Great location close to subway and lots of local restaurants. Neighbourghood felt safe too which was great as we were two young women. Apartment was exactly as described, clean, tidy with fresh bedding and towels. Overall this is a great place to stay and would highly recommend.
Great apartment very nicely decorated...perfect for just me.  Although I didn't have time to use it the patio is a plus!

What to say, not your normal NY stay but equally one I really liked. The area of Bushwick/ East Williamsburg isn't your classic tourist location (as pointed out by a number of locals) but that said this is definitely an area on the up and up with plenty of coffee shops, bars and enough restaurants close by to keep you interested for the most part of the week.
Well placed to hit Manhattan or mainstream Williamsburg (via the L line - 2 close by subway stations) I thought location although a little sketchy when first arriving was one I'd happily stay in again.

Very nice studio apartment, located in a nice neighbourhood and very close to Montrose subway (L line). Guillermo is a very good host, nice and helpful, communication was great.
Highly recommended

We enjoyed our stay at Guillermo's apartment, it was clean and tidy and had everything we needed. Close to L train and small deli shops. It was a great base for our NY vacation. Communicating with Guillermo went smoothly he was very easy going and nice. Would recommend to other travellers :)

I enjoyed my three nights at Guillermo's place. It was clean and comfortable and had everything I needed to cook breakfast in the mornings. It was walking distance to the shopping hubs I was interested in visiting. Highly recommend.
Very nice studio and in a great location close to the L subway which made it very easy to get across to the city. We enjoyed our time here very much, thanks for having us!

Our stay in NYC was amazing. Guillermo's studio was super close to the metro which we took daily, the place was quite warm while it was snowing outside. Guillermo was very helpful and provided everything we needed promptly. Hopefully we can go visit again someday!
Amazing little airbnb! It was extremely private and quiet which made our trip in NY even better. Would recommend this place to anybody.

The apartment was bright and clean,  just like the photos suggested. In fact, we took home some design  inspiration for the basement renovation we have planned. The backyard was stunning! Parking was a breeze, right out front. And the location was an ideal jumping-off point for exploring North Brooklyn on foot, with a lot of great stuff just a couple of blocks away. We plan to come back!
We had a great stay at Guillermo’s place. It was very clean. Great location near the subway!

The place is pretty nice and Guillermo is really helpful. We had a small issue and he came over and fixed it right away. The bed was surprisingly comfortable for me. I’m 6mos pregnant and was worried I would be miserable. The area is okay. Of course, it isn’t somewhere i would want to walk around alone at night. But the home itself was fine!
This is such a great and extremely comfortable apartment. We went that bed! It’s also an easy walk to the subway.

A really good choice if you want to stay in Brooklyn! The apartment is like it's shown on the pictures. The bed is really comfortable, and so is the shower. The communication with Guillermo was great. The only downside is the noise of the boiler in the apartment, we woke up from it a couple of times. And although we didn't feel unsafe in the area, we get that other people did. But other than that, we really did enjoy our stay and we would totally recommend it!

This place is amazing. Location wise, you're right between Bushwick and Williamsburg, so plenty to go around
Guillermo is also very responsive and very hospitable in accommodating your requests
9.5/10

Lauren was so sweet, helpful and pleasant.  Her apartment is in such a central location; safe and convenient.  The elevator in her building is a HUGE bonus!  Lauren provides a warm and homey place to call your own during your stay.  The view of Manhattan is spectacular!  We have found our NY home thru AirBnB with Lauren.  Highly recommend without reservation!

Lauren's apartment is great, clean, beautiful and spacious. It is very well connected with Manhattan and the neighborhood is cool. Lauren is very kind and gave us a list of suggestions with places to eat and have a drink nearby. 100% recommended!

Lauren's premise is very well situated, near restaurants and convenience store. What ever you need is not far away. The pictures show the reality. You get what you see. Lauren is a great host ready to help and very reactive. I can really recommend Lauren as an host and her premise for your next stay in New York.

Lauren's place is the nicest apartment I've ever lived in actually.  Nice building, great apartment, super clean, amazing views, well furnished, great neighborhood.  Lauren is a great host too - very responsive and had the place super well kept for my stay - everything worked with no issues.

I stayed in Lauren's lovely apartment in Astoria, Queens for 10 days and was joined for a week of that time by my sister and two friends. With one bedroom and a pull-out sofa in the lounge-room we initially thought we might be a bit cramped but we actually didn't feel that way at all. Both the king-sized bed in the bedroom and the sofa in the lounge were extremely comfortable.
The apartment was in a great location, only a few minutes' walk from the subway, and there were great places to eat, including supermarkets close by. The balcony had a fabulous view towards Manhattan and altogether we felt very safe there.
I did bring a few small things to Lauren's attention, such as that the toaster oven stopped working and the fact that one small bathmat for 4 adults was not really adequate, and she assured me she would look into those things for the future. Thanks Lauren, we LOVED staying in your apartment!

It is not always that I feel right at home in an AirBNB. Not so in Lauren's apartment. There is something about it that made me feel comfortable instantly. It is a really nice space. Nicely maintained. Lots of charme.

Lauren’s place worked  great for our needs. Convenient location to the subway, safe neighborhood and lots of convenient shops and restaurants. Lauren’s restaurant recommendations in her guide book were awesome!

Lauren's place was absolutely lovely! The high ceilings and great lighting made it feel spacious and welcoming. The view was spectacular - a full cityscape view! We also appreciated the temporary unloading parking out front, which was a lifesaver since we had a car.
The living room was very large and comfortable, perfect for relaxing, and our cats adored sunbathing on the windowsills. While the kitchen is on the smaller side - which wasn’t an issue for us - it’s something to note for those planning to cook often. It is stocked with everything you need though. A highlight was the decent-sized bathtub, a rare find in NYC and perfect for a relaxing soak.
The location was fantastic, close to subway lines and surrounded by excellent food options. We felt safe and comfortable throughout our stay. If you're looking for a cozy, cat-friendly spot with great amenities and an amazing view, we highly recommend staying at Lauren's!
Lauren was great! Very easy to communicate with and quick to respond. The place is comfortable and in a great area!

Had a great time staying at Joy's. The apartment was clean and fully equiped everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Pleasent neighborhood and close to the subway. Joy provided excellent service, and was responded quickly on any question.


5 out of 5 would recommend.

The overall experience was very good! We love the apt and the location (only two blocks away from the subway). The apt is very nice and cosy, spacious and comfortable. Joy was very nice and helpful especially since we arrived one day later due to weather conditions. I would def recommend her place.
Joy Receive us and we had good time at the apartment. She was also always available to help and the apartment was exactly as described.  I would came back!

Joy was wonderful to work with, and while we didn't need any specific assistance, she responded to questions in a timely manner. The location was perfect for us and actually a much nicer neighborhood than we expected which was an immediate plus for us. We have hopes that Joy's place will be available the next time we're visiting NYC!
Great quiet neighborhood. Easy access to groceries, food, and bars. We stayed with our two kids and had plenty of room. Excellent.

The apartment is exactly like the pictures, very confortable and functional. The neighborhood is so beautiful and Joy was kind and friendly. We've spent a great time there and would not hesitate to return soon!!!

Great location. Joy was wonderful in letting me be able to check in early, I very much appreciated that. Very communicative. The place is very cute and comfortable. The pull out futon is super soft! Would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a New York stay.

This was our first time in NYC and we were very lucky to have had Brooklyn as a host. Her home is impeccable, absolutely the way it appears in photographs, is spotless (Brooklyn loves a clean and sparkling space) and has the warm, homey feel to it that you need when you are travelling. It is a lovely neighbourhood, 5 minutes away from the metro station. Brooklyn pays such keen attention that I was surprised when I found she had left strawberries, muffins, eggs, sausages and other treats for us in the fridge. She left bottled water, chocolates and specifically bought men's shower gel for my friends (how thoughtful). I would recommend her in a heartbeat. As a person, she is warm, funny, thoughtful and very organised. An ideal host in a big city. Thank you for the lovely time, Brooklyn.
Brooklyn was a great host! Her home was clean and she was very accommodating. Definitely would recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Harlem.

Host: Brooklyn was welcoming and stayed up to meet me even though I arrived in the dark hours of the morning. She had metrocards for use, a brief missive of good spots to eat around NYC and points of contact. No complaints.

Apartment: Precisely as pictured. So convenient to the train. Was cute, spacious and small, and suited my needs perfectly. The tenants in the building are really friendly as well. The only thing I would say to be aware of is that in the morning, the people in the neighbourhood are super energetic! Playing music at 8AM and ribbing each other. Totally harmless, but still could be disruptive if you don't like getting up early. I kind of liked waking up to good music and good humour. Harlem is a great neighbourhood as well. Lots of history and culture and safe. I encountered lots of friendly people and it's really unlike anything I've experienced.

Brooklyn was a good host. She was accommodating and ensured that we were comfortable in the apartment. The apartment itself was located in near good public transport and the residents of her building were nice. There are good facilities near her and good restuarnts. Anywhere in NYC is just a short train ride away.
The place was clean and as described in the apartments description. Any issues we had were resolved in a timely fashion.
Brooklyn also left juice, fruit, eggs, sausages, muffins and yoghurt in the fridge.
Thank you again for a great stay.
Brooklyn is a really nice person, she was always kind to us. Flat is big and clean. We've loved Harlem.

Brooklyn's apartment is actually bigger than my friend and me expected it to be - especially in NYC it was a big surprise. After Florida we came to NYC just late October and were happy that the place was very warm and welcoming - just as its host Brooklyn. The apartment is very close to the subway stations for the B, C as well as 2, 3 lines. So very well located to get anywhere in Manhattan and - if you have time - even to JFK airport. It was also no problem to leave our luggage at the apartment before our late flight. I would recommend to anyone to stay at this great apartment. Just bring ear plugs - you are first floor, bedroom window facing the street in a big city!

Brooklyn is a lovely host and person. Very welcoming and accommodating
She even waited up until 1am as our flight was delayed and we had no way of contacting her. We expected to arrive to a locked house or a furious host but brooklyn was there waiting and very understanding.
The place was very cosy and warm (which made it refreshing to walk into after a long day out in the cold), and was very big and spacious throughout. The close proximity to the subway was very helpful also.

The apartment was great. Great location, clean, tidy and homely. Brooklyn was very nice and helpful. We had some problems with the key which I am sure can be fixed. Any problem or query we had, Brooklyn made sure to help us out. Would stay here again.

Joy is a wonderful superb host and caring Airbnb spirit of hospitality especially we all feeling the same for her generosity and friendly. We live in her own house like our own home and warm welcome spirit of Harlem American. Definitely we look forward to comeback any times!
Anan

Our stay at Joy's was perfect. Our place was clean and and spacious for myself and 3 other guests. Joy was a great host and even provided a book of recommended local restaurants and things to do. We would definitely stay here again!

My first experience using airbnb and I was very pleased with how it turned out. Joy's place is very comfortable and had plenty of space for my group. It was great to have it as a resting place while my group toured New York.  And it was very helpful that Joy was receptive and had recommendations of things to check out.
Great location. Apartment was clean and nicely furnished. Easy access to several subway lines. Walking distance to many good restaurants.

Brooklyn is a great host.
The apartment was clean and in order and she has always been responsive to any questions. Furthermore, the apartment has all the comforts you need for a long period stay.
The area is maybe too much noisy at night and you can hear everything because the apartment is on the ground floor, but at the same time it is well-located to reach the subway, markets and restaurants.
Brooklyn also provided a list of tips to enjoy the neighborhood that was really helpful.
I personally recommend the place for a great experience in New York City.

I stayed at Joy’s Airbnb for a month and had a great experience. The neighborhood was peaceful, safe, and convenient—perfect for a longer stay. Joy was friendly, responsive, and made sure I had everything I needed throughout. I really appreciated her hospitality and would gladly stay here again!

I wanna thank Joy for the great place ( very clean, full equipped, and got all required utilities which helped a lot while my first visit to New York. It was close to everything I need ( grocery, restaurant and transportation)
Joy & her sister made me feel very comfortable and like I’m home with my family
When I decide to visit New York again definitely I’ll consider this apartment

The apartment is huge, very clean and in a silent street. Bus stop is in front of the house and train station only one block away. Pharmacies and supermarkets very close (one block). I strongly recommend this place. Priscilla is very polite and helpful!

Priscilla's apartment was absolutely perfect for our ten day stay in New York. The place was impeccably cleaned and wonderfully spacious. It is the perfect location to explore the surrounding area of Williamsburg, with Manhattan just one short subway ride away. Communication with Priscilla was easy and clear - she did all she could to make sure we had a comfortable stay. It would be my pleasure to stay here again on my next trip to NYC, and I'll be recommending it to friends. Thank you Priscilla!

Priscilla is a great host with a nice 2br close to Marcy Av. You can access what you need from this part of Williamsburg. No frills but clean. Wifi is fine! Laundry right around the corner.. Priscilla is the host you want her to be :)) Will return!

Priscilla's place was great! We felt right at home! Super clean and she is an absolutely lovely host! She was quick to reply, super respectful, great to chat to her and was extremely helpful and accomodating about our late check-out. Next time I'll come up to see your baby grand piano! :) Thank you so much for everything, Priscilla!

Priscilla’s apartment was absolutely perfect, highly recommend! The house itself is well equipped and very spacious. The location is amazing, situated down a one way street so it’s very peaceful which can be very hard to find in NY. Also only a 2 min walk to the JM line so really easy to get into the city. We stayed here over winter and the central heating was amazing. Priscilla was a delight to deal with and so helpful and attentive. This place is an absolute gem! Thanks so much for having us Priscilla ☺️

We had a nice trip at that appartement. The appartement was really clean and well decorated. It was also really calm. It felt like home. :) Really close to the subway and easy to get to New York City.

We LOVED this apartment.  It was located in a very nice neighborhood and we felt safe walking back to it after dark.  The apartment itself is very cozy and lacks nothing to make it feel like home.  Not all places in NYC have decent water pressure, but this apartment did - LOVED the shower!   Carsten was a gracious and attentive host.  We would not hesitate to stay there again on our next visit to Brooklyn.

This was the perfect space! It was extremely clean, in a lovely brownstone neighborhood, and ten minutes or less to the A/C train and G train. Carsten was a wonderful host who made sure to provide us with anything extra we needed, and even accommodated our early flight and late departure. I look forward to staying here again!

I highly recommend the place, the hosts and the neighbourhood.

The accommodation was perfect – well-sized, well-kitted, clean and cool.

We were very well looked after and felt very much at home. Were pointed in the direction of all the best places to eat and drink in the area. The hosts are extremely friendly and accommodating.

Bed-Stuy was probably the highlight of our NYC trip. Its full of little jewels: great restaurants, bars and just generally a cool vibe. We'll return to the exact same spot at our earliest next opportunity!

I've stayed in many AirBnb places and must say that this is now a favorite in Brooklyn as far as space and comfort were concerned.
It was a week of crazy, fluctuating weather; hazardous cold to snow to flooding rain to unseasonably warm weather. Our hosts were always conscientious of our comfort and went above and beyond to ensure we were safe and cozy.
Would definitely stay here again.
Joni was a great host. Very clear and communicative. I didn't personally stay at the apartment, but the person I booked it for was very please. Would absolutely book with her again.

We've just come back from a week staying at Joni's flat and we couldn't recommend it high enough. The place is spacious, clean, nicely decorated, modern, very well equiped and most of all quiet (which in New-York is a luxury), not to mention the most confortable bed ever!!! After a tiring day in the hussle and bussle of the Big Apple it was a very conforting thing to have :) Joni and her husband Carsten were very helpful from the beginning, quick to respond and very welcoming when we got there. They gave us lots of recommendations on where to eat in the area and were ready to assist us with anything.
They are 2 subway stations within walking distance and plenty of shops and restaurants in the neighbourhood.
If you're planning to stay in Brooklyn Joni and Carsten's place is a gem to book without hesitation!

The place was great and exactly as described in the listing. It was clean, spacious and only a 15 minute walk to the subway. The neighborhood was also great with a nice market/deli only a block away. We had our two teenage daughters with us and they absolutely loved it. We’ll be back for sure!

We had a great experience staying at Joni and Carlsten place. The apartment is very cosy, well equipped with all the things you might need during your stay.
I truly recommend staying on their apartment. The neighborhood is really safe and made us feel at home.
Walking distance, groceries shop, laundromat and train all available around.
They have also recommended a few restaurants to us and gave us some tips from New York. When we go back to NYC we are definitely staying there again.

Our stay was wonderful! The apartment was very clean, and true to the pictures provided. Joni left us many great recommendations and responded to our questions almost immediately. We would definitely request to stay here again!

Joni's house is amazing. I just felt in love with the decor, so cool and cozy! The house was completly clean and the bed is really confortable, we slept like babies. :) The wifi worked perfectly! The neighbourwood is very quiet, we allways felt safe. I really recommend Joni's house, it was our 2 time in NY and we enjoy much more staying in Brooklyn: this way we have a richer l experience of the city and it's really easy to get to Manhatan by subway.
We felt like home during all our stay and we hope to come back someday!
Joni and Carsten were very helpful in our requests and even checked in with us just before our arrival. Keeping our bags before our flight was extremely helpful!

The stay was great! I was concerned about parking but we found a spot about a block away. Be aware that they do clean the streets on certain days and you have to move your car. The house was very clean and quiet. We had excellent communication from the start and we checked in earlier than anticipated and it was no issue. The walk to the nearest subway was about 15 minutes and you pass several coffee shops and eateries. I recommend Clementines, especially if you have a gluten intolerance. Definitely an excellent place to stay if you're wanting to explore the city.
Joni was a great host. Check-in and check-out were seamless and I enjoyed the location and spaciousness of the apartment. I look forward to staying there again. Thanks again!
This was our best Airbnb experience, loved the decor and amenities. Great value for what you're getting. Highly recommended!

I enjoyed my vacation to the fullest in Joni's place.
Well-organized apartment, fully equipped kitchen (includes seasonings), and a comfortable bed which helps getting over your jetlag!
Netflix and Hulu were helpful when I couldn't sleep.
Easy to get subway station and bus stops on foot. I liked taking the bus to Borough hall and walking alongside of the east river with coffee.
I highly recommend the place for a long vacation and also a short trip, I'll definitely come back.

I had always wanted to experience Brooklyn and this was a great place in the "Bed-Stuy" area. It was easy walking distance to everything we needed, and the apartment was comfortable with a great kitchen for when we brought food to spend time relaxing. It wasn't far to catch subways when we ventured down to Coney Island or over to Manhattan. The hosts' suggestions were helpful and they were responsive whenever we needed anything. The cost made a week in New York affordable and staying there was great fun!

Joni's place was beautiful and clean. There were small amenities available (towels, hair dryer, utensils and coffee) and free street parking. I was traveling into Manhattan for work so the commute into the city wasn't very fast or easy. Didn't spend really any time in Bed-Stuy so can't say much about the neighborhood other than it appeared very eclectic and diverse.
Overall, good stay! Would be a great location if you were to stay in and around Brooklyn.

Joni's place was cozy and comfortable. It was a great jumping off point for exploring different neighborhoods of Brooklyn. Checking in/out was easy, and communication with her was clear and simple. We had a great trip!

I spent 1 week with my 10yrs son in this house. They kept our private that's what I wanted. Neighbors were also quiet and we had good sleep every night. Very convenient and easy to get stations. It was fun to walk seeing beautiful buildings to Williamsburg area which is really cool place in Brooklyn.
I could not have a chance to see Joni during our stay actually, but she is definitely nice and I felt totally safe during whole stay in NY! I highly recommend her house!

Neighbourhood was lovely, very safe and lots of places to eat and explore close by. Was also very picturesque. Communication was great and they were extremely helpful and friendly.
Overall my three friends and myself all had a great time staying here and would recommend it to anyone visiting Brooklyn.

Loction was good,
Bed was very comfortable ,
Apartment was very clean and with a lot of space,
Water was hot,
Style was very cool,
Jonny answered our mails ASAP and she helped us when needed
What a wonderful location and great hosts. Thanks so much for everything.  We will be back for sure.
Very nice place.  Good location.  The G train was down all weekend but the next closest station wasn't too far.  We loved the neighborhood.
Nice space, very cool decorating. Pretty close to public transport, and Joni was great at responding quickly to any questions I had.
Clean, trendy place with clear instructions, great local tips, and straightforward check-in process! I had a great stay with my family.

Comfortable, great spot in the heart of Brooklyn. Great communication with the host and appreciated how child-friendly the space was (my little nephew loved the toy kitchen that had been set up!). Thanks!!
Great location and very accommodating host. We never got to meet Joni as our flight was delayed, but it was very easy to check in with the lockbox.

We had a great time in the apartment. It was perfect for our little family, everything we needed. Check in was easy and allowing us to leave our bags until our evening flight was great.
I was a little hesitant about the area having read a previous review but I was so wrong!!! As we struggled to unload the taxi either a toddler in the late evening the neighbours were the first to help us with our luggage!
A wonderful stay, we only wish it could have been longer.

Joni and Carsten’s place was perfect for our stay in New York. It was spacious and had great decor and the bed was comfortable after long days sightseeing. We appreciated the portable charger too that we used since we were out exploring all day. We got everywhere using the subway which was easy to navigate from their place. They were very kind and responsive and I would definitely stay here again!

Joni and Carsten’s apartment is beautiful! It genuinely did feel like a home away from home and offered a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of NYC.
Joni is extremely responsive and offered some great tips to make our stay in NYC a wonderful experience

The apartment is in a great location, easy to get into the city but also to explore parts of Brooklyn. It was well equipped and a nice place to have a chilled night in too.
Joni was a great host and always responded quickly. And has also taken time to consider helpful items to aid anyone staying.
Would definitely recommend.

We loved staying at Joni’s! She was great and communicating and made the whole experience very easy and stress free. The place was super clean and in a convenient location. You can get just about anywhere within 30 minutes! The area was very safe. We definitely recommend her place to anyone going to New York!

Great, safe Bed Stuy location. Easy access to subway, stores, cafes, restaurants. Very clean. If you are ok with a queen bed you will be comfortable. Hosts can help with activity and restaurant suggestions.
We did hear a little 2AM walking around upstairs, but not a problem.

Although brief, do not take this review lightly. I cannot articulate how perfect this space was for me, and for my stay. The place is amongst a charming strip of brownstone homes, conveniently positioned near both the L and G lines. It comes equipped with a full kitchen, and AC. The bathroom was on the smaller side; however, was enough for my 6’ 2”, average frame. Oh, the height of the shower head could be adjusted, major bonus points!!
Overall, Joni is a very communicative host, and the place won’t disappoint.

I had a very comfortable long-term stay here. The neighborhood has everything nearby: grocery, laundry, restaurants, pharmacy, and subway (for an easy commute to Manhattan). The apartment is spacious, clean, and well furnished. Joni is an attentive host, and made sure that everything was in order during my stay.

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Close to all the best restaurants and bars in NYC. Easy to get around with two stations within 10min walk away. Close to the Hudson River for a run or leisurely walk. While the apartment is small, it is cosy with everything you need. Bed was extremely comfortable, as was the couch after a long day. Katie was friendly, professional and responsive.

I'm a former New Yorker and knew I wanted to stay in the West Village for my latest visit. Katie's place was perfect. It's a great location and her place was spotless on arrival. I didn't need anything in terms of advice, but Katie made herself available in case of any issues - which there were none. I highly recommend her place for 1-2 people looking to have a true NY experience.

The location is great: at the heart of West Village yet on a relatively quiet street far from noise. The apt is very cute and comfortable. Pictures reflect the apt correctly: You get what you see. And Katie is a great host: She is welcoming, accommodating and understanding. She made sure we are comfortable and had a good time. It was a great experience overall.

I loved the convenience of this apartment to where I was working. The Maintenance and leasing team were on top of anything I needed. Very responsive and great communication.
Would stay again.
Second time staying at this unit. Worth having to climb three flights of stairs. Comfortable apartment; well equipped; great location.

Great spot for anyone visiting New York. It’s close to the subway and near bars and restaurants. The host was always quick to respond to any questions or concerns, and the apartment was clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay there again.

Chester was very welcoming and friendly. My parents who were visiting from India lived with him for roughly a week. He had written directions to the subway and nearby groceries. He also helped move our bags to the second floor. The apartment is beautiful, very clean and comfortable. I would definitely recommend Chester's apartment to my friends and family again.

Chester was a gracious host and the apartment itself was beautiful. We had a lovely stay and felt very accommodated. Spacious, Wifi, kitchen, and A/C (which was a must in this intense New York heat. Would highly recommend.

My son and I really enjoyed our stay. The description of the home was accurate. The apartment was clean and tidy and close to the subway. I never met Chester, but his daughter was so helpful in showing me how to get around New York.

Chester was an excellent host. The apartment was really clean.
It was convenient to the nearest subway station. Pictures were exactly as it's shown in the pictures and my family always felt at home. I would definitely recommend Chester's apartment to my friends and family again.

Chester and his daughter made us feel extremely welcome.  The apartment is more beautiful than the beautiful pictures in the listing.  Chester responded immediately whenever we needed anything and provided a town car to take us  back to J F K which only took 10 minutes at 7:00 am for a good price. My experience here was wonderful. The apartment was spacious and very cozy. Felt so comfortable the moment I walked in. Chester was very easy to communicate with and very flexible. I would recommend this place to anyone who is planning on visiting the city. Hope to visit again. Thank you.

Great place, very clean and comfortable. Neighborhood is not the gentrified BK some people are accustomed to these days, but right next to a school and very safe. No problem coming back late night. My friend and I rented this apartment from Chester on July 2-4, 2016. It is a beautiful apartment, exactly as described and true to the photographs. Though we didn't spend much time in the apartment, we appreciated its amenities that afforded us the comforts of home: WiFi, Internet TV, hair dryer, soap, towels, sheets, iron & ironing board, pillows, etc.

I would definitely stay there again and I would recommend it to friends and family.

Ganga was a fabulous host, meeting me late at night on the day of my arrival and making sure I had everything I needed. The apartment was perfect for my needs, and in a great location with access to the best Chelsea has to offer. Look forward to visiting again!
Everything was great except uncomfortable couch and that in night it was really cold there. Chester is nice guy,took us to JFK and let us staying there longer.

The apartment of chester is cozy and central, and he is a very kind and attentive person, I recommend everything clean and nice it is like to feel at home, do not stop going all this near.con felicito chester ...

Chester was a wonderful host! He was very communicative and was a big help with good places he likes to eat and check out. The place is only about 4 blocks from the subway and its easy to get around from this place to the city. I'd stay there again when I visit. Thanks Cheater for the good time!

Great place! Chester was a great host. He great advice about the place and also the city.  The place is very spacious, clean, luxury and overall the stay was great! The neighborhood is in a great location as well.
Myself and my friends stayed at Chester's place while visiting NY. It was a really nice place and Chester was available for our every request. I definitely recommend.
Cool place to stay of you tend to hang out a lot. I say  this only bc i was there celebrating my bday and i stayed out a lot

Lovely place can get loud depending on what is going on in the neighborhood but it is NYC so that’s expected. Bed is small for two people and if you are over 6ft tall. But overall we did enjoy our stay and our host was great.

Great host, lovely apartment. Much better than we expected. Location isn't the greatest, but the price reflects this. Quiet apartment. Was grateful that my sister and I were able to book at the last minute. Chester was very polite and attentive to our needs. I would definently recommend to anyone looking for someplace to stay. Close to the train.  Also great Live TV, can watch shows from all over from other countries.

This spot was awesome! Great location, awesome host, and the apartment was exactly as described on the app.  Not to mention great value, being able to stay at such an awesome location made our first trip to NY so much easier.

Amazing host and apartment! We came with three children (ages 5, 8 and 13) and they all had a blast in NYC, partly because of the great experience at this AirBnB. Very friendly host, always fast to help with any questions. Great entertainment system (TV).
Walking distance to
-Nice playground: 1 min

We were able to check in early,  and Chester was very friendly and upbeat.  Not far from a subway station.

Perfect space, very comfortable and clean. He was super accessible and ready service when we had doubts and need support.
It's two blocks from the subway and in a quiet neighborhood. I came back many times the night on foot with my brother.
Market very close, plus several 'deli's' selling everything - Taste the bacon, egg and cheese from 'Tio's Deli' - the best I've eaten in my life.
We already wanna be back ;)
Chester is very welcoming.  The apartment is very clean and consistent with the photos.  The metro is not far which allows you to quickly reach the city center.  We had a great week.

Apartment is clean and accessible. Location might be an issue if you are walking or using subway, since stations are susceptible to closures over weekends. Uber and Lyft works great in this area. Several Corner stores around, very friendly and inexpensive. Avoid Broadway junction station overnight if Rockaway is closed. Step down at Utica and rideshare from there.

Chester's place was great! I worked from home some of the days and had no problem with the internet and finding everything I need. Chester was very communicative and a great host. Would love to stay again!
Super clean and organized place. A perfect sanctuary for its value and location to the trains. I would highly recommend staying here.

We are quite satisfied. Apartment was clean, warm and spacious. Chester is a great host. He is very professional and friendly. The subway/metro is exactly 10 minutes walking distance away. I highly recommend this place. Only downside is the tv is located way too high. That's it.
Nice place, clean and cozy. Subway is a short walk away. The neighborhood is quiet. Felt safe walking the area in the middle of the night. Chester is a great host, friendly and accommodating.

Clean! Clean! Clean! Chester is soooo friendly and available
We felt right at home, he makes sure to review everything with you and also points out what is available in the neighborhood
We were going back and forth to NYC and subway is about 10 minute walk
Overall great host great value for price and clean!!!

Chester's place was a great place to stay during my time in New York. Clean and quiet. The apartment is close to the C train, with easy transfers to elsewhere in Brooklyn or a short ride into Manhattan.
The neighborhood can be a little rough and rowdy, but I never had any real problems besides the occasional noise across the street.

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Lenny's. Lenny greeted us in person upon check-in, and gave us a brief introduction to the apartment. Lenny checked-in with us via message every few days. The location is 5min walk to Union Station, and one block from a smaller station. Great take-out food within one block. Apartment clean with great kitchen. No microwave or toaster. Stairs access only (~4th floor). Perfect authentic NYC experience!
We had a wonderful stay at Lenny's place! Great location, and a clean and convenient apartment that has everything you need. There is also a couch that does not appear in the photos. Recommended!

Great spot in the heart of the city. Everything one could need to hand and plenty nearby.
Lenny is a great host and I hope to stay with him again.
Highly recommend.
Such a great place that I'd rather not tell anyone about it because I want it to be free when I want to stay there again

Randall's apartment is fantastic. The place was beautiful, clean, in a great location, I MEAN GREAT LOCATION, and she was attentive of any question/need we had throughout the weekend. This is the place to stay in Brooklyn!

The apartment was absolutely perfect for our family group of 5 - huge and well equipped - it was all we could possibly have hoped for.  As others have said, the photos don't really do  the place justice and the views are breathtaking!  The location is great - close to the bustle of Bedford Avenue and quick and easy access to Manhattan, yet relatively quiet and peaceful.  We had a fantastic time and would not hesitate to recommend the place to others. We hope to return!
Randall is an excellent host with an incredible listing. Very accommodating and provided exactly the right setting for my trip. Would book again!
We had a great time at elin's and jabbath's place. It is really as beautiful as it looks on the pictures and we felt at home.
Beautiful, clean and spacious apartment in Flatbush. 20 minutes on the subway to Manhattan. Jabbath was a very helpful hostl and they had a great map of the neighbourhood with cool spots marked out.

Jabbath was a great host! The apartment was very clean and spacious! From the little details (sets of keys in leather pouches, cool neighborhood restaurant guides, and other amenities) to the big ones (great communication, very accommodating of our schedule, and made us feel right at home), Jabbath made our New York and AirBnB experience extremely positive!

Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful time at Elin's and Jabbath's place. It couldn't have been better for our first stay in Brooklyn. It's even bigger than it looks in the pictures, it was very clean and we felt really comfortable. We want to say thanks to Jabbath for being such a great and helpful host. It was an awesome experience and we would love to stay there again.

Super location, we fell in love with Brooklyn.  The accommodations were sparkling clean, well appointed, loved that we could sit outside after a long day.  Gwynn is super responsive, we had absolutely no issues while we were there for 5 days. We will definitely stay again.
This home is just lovely!!! The location is fabulous!! The outdoor space is such a bonus for early morning coffee,book reading or wine sharing!
The house is even more beautiful in person than in photos.  My family stayed there for a week-long visit to Brooklyn and loved the place, all rave reviews. Thanks Gwynn!

Very lovely place near Brooklyn bridge, perfect for travelers.
Florrie is very kind and accommodating. We arrived late and she was waiting for us. Her flat is perfect and Florrie us with a kindly gourmet basket.

Florrie was there to meet my Mom and me when we arrived, and even let us check in two hours early. She left a little basket of snacks, a bottle of wine, and some little things in the fridge. The apartment was absolutely lovely, very clean, and the best location I could ask for. Florrie was so kind and offered to help us with anything we needed while we were there. Couldn't be happier. Definitely recommend this place for a wonderful little home while you're in New York City!

The communication with Florie was amazing. Florrie and her Husband were both very friendly.  Florrie was very helpful and was there for us whenever we needed something. The Appartment was one of my best Airbnb experiences I ever had so far. The description was very accurate and the interior was beautiful. I was traveling with my mother  and she loved the apartment, too. I highly recommend this apartment. it is very well equipped and Public transport (Bus to Metro) is right around the corner. I will definetly try to get this apartment again on my next trip to New York.

Florrie was a lovely host with a very good apartment.
We (2 friends from Germany) stayed there for 4 nights.
The apartment is modern, beautiful and particularly clean! Florrie had lots of information about NYC and Brooklyn for us. Also there was a little welcome gift including some snacks and drinks - thanks for that again!
Only minus point at this apartment is the in our opinion quite long walk to the metro station, it takes a little less than 10 mins (in sum you need around 30 mins to get to Times Square)

Our NYC trip was awesome. And so was Florrie and her lovely apartment. She was super responsive and helpful whenever we messaged or talked to her. The apartment was really accommodating and just nice to come back to after a long day of walking around. Will definitely be coming back - maybe when the weather is a bit warmer ;)

Such a beautiful apartment, everything and more than we expected. Check in was super easy and Giles the cat was an added bonus on arrival (sadly he doesn't come with the apartment) easy to get about and some great local bars. Thank you so much for a wonderful first AirB&B experience!

Very clean and convenient with everything you need. Informative host. Some loud traffic outside but which you can excpect anywhere when staying in the city. Loved the nespresso machine. I would recommend.

Florrie’s place in Brooklyn is fantastic. Has everything you need in an apartment with a few very thoughtful touches. It’s in a great location to explore both Brooklyn & Manhattan. What’s makes the stay most homely is Florrie herself who is wonderfully accomodating, welcoming, friendly, easy going & considerate. Would highly recommend this as a place to base yourself.

The studio was great! Good location, very stylish, comfortable and well equipped. All the thoughtful bits and pieces were perfect (nice toiletries, great coffee and snacks). Florrie was lovely and very welcoming. Traffice noise can be heard in the studio but we wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place. You'll love it!

What a refreshing change from staying in Manhattan. Yet within 1/2 hour you can be at any sight you want to visit as it is a short walk to the subway. Clean and bright and lovely little touches. Thanks Florrie for the chocolate, espresso, wine and excellent bath products. This is a super place to stay- highly recommend!

The apartment is as lovely as pictured. Dumbo, Brooklyn Heights and Williamsburg are easily explored if not on foot than by a very short uber trip. And getting in to Manhattan is equally a breeze. Florrie was quick to respond to the few questions we had, and was flexible with check in / out. Having her in the building was a bonus. Ideal for two travelers. Highly recommend.
Florrie’s place was beautiful and she was an amazing host. You cannot go wrong with this lovely flat.

It was our first time in AirBnb and I can say all good things about this place. Florrie was amazing at every time, so worried about us way before we arrived, so gentle when we made it to the apartment and after all these days all I can say is that is like we had spent them with our favorite auntie ;)
Florrie's Airbnb was spacious, beautifully decorated, conveniently located, and Florrie herself was an excellent and super helpful host. One of the best Airbnb's I've seen :)

As a 1st time Airbnb participant I didn’t know what to expect!
Flori’s place exceeded my expectations!
It was perfect in every detail!

The space is even more gorgeous in person! Beautiful place, Dream location, and Florrie was a perfect host! I will not look at any other place next time I visit NYC because I know exactly where I want to stay!

Florrie’s place was perfect! Very open and lovely touches throughout the apartment. She was very welcoming, provided a bottle of wine and some snacks! The Nespresso was also a nice touch for our cold mornings. It’s in a great location, easy walk to Dumbo and plenty of restaurants. We will stay here again if we come back to NYC!

Brilliant place just as description

Really good location and the bed was amazing!!

You can expect a clean, welcoming and stylish apartment in a great location. Florrie adds thoughtful touches that make you feel at home right away and I would definitely recommend. 10/10

This Air BNB was amazing. Very clean and it looks exactly like the pictures. Florrie was very nice and made sure I was comfortable.
Florrie is truly the best Airbnb host. She really made me feel at home! Such a beautiful place to stay. Great location. You won’t be disappointed!
Loved my stay here. Florrie is an amazing host and goes above and beyond to make sure you're comfortable. The apartment was beautiful and clean. Zero complaints.

Fantastic stay at Florrie’s. The space was bright and airy, super clean, and even more beautiful in real life than in photos. Florrie and the Airbnb were great! She was very very responsive and even let me check in earlier than planned. The Airbnb itself is lovely. A cute little studio to come to after a day out in NYC.
Our stay was lovely and we felt right at home. Everything was clean and the feel was very modern and upscale.
This is such a cool studio and perfect for a weekend getaway. Location is an easy walk or ride to everywhere. And Florrie was so nice!

I loved my stay at Florrie’s guest suite. It’s in a great location, within walking distance to so many places. It is spacious and so comfortable. Florrie is a brilliant host, so lovely to talk to and gave me lots of recommendations. The perfect place to stay.

This place is beautiful and spacious, conveniently located between numerous subway stops to get you anywhere in New York City. Florrie was friendly, flexible and quick to respond. Thank you for the wonderful stay and local recommendations! Would stay again.

We had a great stay at Florrie’s! It was a beautiful, cosy and bright flat. All amenities we needed. Florrie was easy and fast to communicate with us, she kindly let us keep our bags in the flat after check-out. We were a 10 min walk from a few subway lines. We could walk to DUMBO and the Brooklyn bridge. We’re looking forward to staying again and would highly recommend staying here!

Florrie’s listing was so cozy and inviting. We felt right at home. Very close to any public transportation needs you may have, the location is perfect. The small details in the room are so appreciated. Would definitely book again !
Florrie’s place was great. Beautiful space, close to everything to get around NYC. I would highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in New York
This flat is gorgeous and has everything you need to feel at home. It’s a short walk to DUMBO, the promenade and of course Wegman’s!  I will definitely visit again.

Very clean, spacious studio apartment. Loved the small kitchen, comfy bed. Florrie left some nice goodies for us, for when we arrived...a very generous touch. Absolutely loved the space.
Location was 10-15 minute walk from restaurants, cafe, and subway. This wan't an issue for us (we love to walk) but something to keep in mind if walking is not easy for you.

My hostess was at the door when I arrived and greeted me warmly. She showed me around the apartment, pointing out features. She said I should feel free to ask her if I had any questions. The apartment and neighborhood are comfortable and very enjoyable!

It was a very greatful experience,Sylvia is so kind and for us she is like a family! She had a lot of details and take care of us and our confortability. I'm sure I made a new friend! Thanks for all Sylvia!!
Sylvia was very friendly and welcoming. The apartment it's a perfect choice for holiday in the NY.  The apartment is very cozy and comfortable.
We had a wonderful time. Great place, so close to everything. Very quite. It was a stellar trip and we can't wait to do it again.

Sylvia was very responsive and accessible, and the apartment was as advertised; neat, clean, and had everything needed for a comfortable stay. We had a wonderful stay at Sylvias place! She was ready to welcome us at the door when we arrived. The apartment was nice and have all what we needed! We can recommend Sylvia's apartment!

This is my second stay and it only gets better. This time it was a shorter trip and it feels like a second home a way from home.

The apartment was in a great location. Close to everything you need and a short walk to the train.

Apartment is a very clean and comfortable, near to the subway station(5-7 minutes). Sylvia is a very welcomed host, she answered very quickly on all questions and she was always in connection. There is everything in apartment for comfortable stay. there are a lot of cafes, stores very close to apartment.
Thanks a lot Sylvia for hospitality

Nice apartement in a safe and central location. Everything you need (supermarket, Subway, etc) was within walking distance. Sylvia was very hospitable and approached us at our Check-in/Check-out times.

Sylvia Apartment was clean, and had all the necessary amenities as described, she is a very cooperative lady and responded quickly to all our requests.

Eric and Shirley
Sylvia was so kind and the place was wonderful! A perfect place for a couple of people, close to transportation, and an amazing value!

Sylvia is a really good and helpful host :) Thank you for helping out and for perfect wedding/honeymoon time! With any visit in future for sure we will stay there again.
Great experience. No complaints here. Awesome location. You should try the bagel place down the street.

The experience in this flat has been really positive. Maria answered quickly to every our question before we arrived to NYC and, during our stay, we had all the comfort...Harlem is a very beautiful and safe place to stay...just a "little bit" noisy!
Absolutely I recommend this solution!

I was in a frenzy trying to find somewhere to stay in Harlem for an extended period of time. However, Maria's home put me at ease. She was an amazing host, constantly checking to make sure I had everything I needed! I totally recommend her place. Plus its in a convenient location by the 2/3 trains anddd in the best neighborhood in NYC! <3

First time staying in Brooklyn, location was a short walk to and from the metro! Shari was so kind and even left us with some food! We were delayed and she was flexible with meeting us with patience. Place was amazing, the softest sheets I have ever been with! Great experience of NY!

Shari was a fantastic host. My son (age 8) and I stayed for 6 weeks and the place was exactly as described: clean, spacious, etc...I was able to go on a daily run in prospect park and there was a playground a couple of blocks away for my little one. Shari's place was very welcoming! The house was perfect for the 3 months stay and Shari was so lovely and caring, but at the same time was almost transparent because the privacy always was perfect. Truly an amazing choice to enjoy New York for a longer period.

We enjoyed our stay at Shari's place in New York with Ravina. She and her husband are easily reachable, helpful And always available. The House is cozy And looks the same as in the pictures. It's a little bit far from the city (1hour from Manhattan).
Thank you For everything Shari and Ghyslin

Very good location and the house is super well-manager by Ivan! We had a great stay and will definitely be back if coming to NYC again! :)
The place is perfectly clean and well decorated with nice design. The host kind and helpful. Great location - walkable to lots of shops and places of interests. The bed is super comfortable.

We highly recommend Ivan's flat and like to say him: Thank you for making our stay so nice!

Ivan was the perfect host. He met us at his place and went through everything. His apartment was perfect. Very stylish and comfortable, it had everything we needed for a really great week in New York.

Great location! Great communication with Ivan! Very clean and cozy apartment. It worked out perfectly for our trip. There are so many different things to do in that area of town! We would definitely stay here again the next time we plan on visiting the Big Apple.

If you want to be in a trendy area and you don’t mind a little bit of noise during the weekend Ivan’s place is perfect. We were three friends who stayed for a week and enjoyed the place a lot!

Everything was perfect!!  Ivan was there when we arrived to greet us and let us know any information we needed he was ready to provide. We really loved Ivan's flat. It is quite small but perfectly formed and on one of the best streets in a really vibrant and hip part of town.
Ivan was keen to make sure we had everything we needed. I would recommend anyone stay here .

We had a wonderfull stay at Ivan's apartment. Everything excelled our expectations. Ivan was the best host we've ever had, caring and attentive throughout our whole stay. We had a wonderful time at Ivan's place. It was clean, comfortable, stylish, and in a great location. One of my travel companions was inspired to redecorate her own home! Ivan was extremely responsive and provided lots of great tips for places to check out around the neighborhood.
Ivan is definitely a super host. Great place and excellent location in the LES. Very tastefully decorated, comfortable beds and clean. Would recommend to stay.
Ivan is the consummate host and his apt is in the very heart of the action of the Lower East Side. Highly recommended.

Incredible space and location. Ivan’s place is in the middle of the lower east side, there are numerous restaurants bars and shopping in walking distance. The space is clean and cozy. I would recommend staying with him anytime you’re visiting the city!

Perfect host

I truly recommend Ian.

Host is a very kind and warm gentlemen, I was arriving very late then planned because traffic issue. But Ivan still wait for me and help for the luggages.

Amazing apartment in LES. Very cozy feel and wonderfully decorated. Ivan was very responsive and checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. Young and busy area with great nightlife. Surprisingly quiet inside the apartment for the location.

The apartment is in a very quiet area, despite being so conveniently located - we really appreciated this. Aircon was really effective, too.
Highly recommended. We loved our time here and can’t wait to return!
Very much enjoyed our stay.  Great location near lots of subway stops.  Good food in the neighborhood.  Would definitely stay here again.
A very spacious, quiet and private ground floor apartment hosted by a very responsive, pleasant house manager.

I can't say enough about how much I loved this place. For a real Brooklyn New York experience, this is ideal. It had everything you could need for a comfortable stay and more — washer, dryer, every single kitchen appliance and item you could think of, awesome bedding, so much space, and an office to work in. The style gorgeous, the building wonderful, the bathroom lovely and the water pressure dreamy. The hosts great... I can't fault it. I will definitely be seeking this place out when I visit again and hopefully, it will be available. A home away from home.

Very nice space, lots of room, very comfortable bed. It was also very quiet, I had been concerned because of a previous review but we didn’t hear anything from upstairs. With the curtains, shutters and airlock entry on the street side we heard very little traffic noise. Good location and one of the best rentals we’ve had.
