Charming, spacious, well-appointed apartment on a beautiful block in a prime  Brooklyn location.  Easy walk to restaurants, cafes, grocery stores and the subway. We loved our stay and have booked another, longer stay in a few months.  Marycatherine is a great host - friendly, responsive, attentive and very helpful.

Really nice apartment in a great location in Brooklyn. Everything was as advertised and the apartment was very clean! I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in Brooklyn!

This is a great place to stay in Brooklyn. Clean unit with everything you need, including a private outdoor space. The owners were super responsive and accommodating, even asking how many total beds we would like prepared for our arrival. Check in was easy, and their instructions were clear and helpful. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance. Great place to stay with my family for the Thanksgiving holiday. Highly recommend!

This was the perfect place for what I needed. I've stayed in other Brooklyn garden apartment airbnbs and this one was the absolute best hands down. Most feel like a basement someone dropped a bed in. This place felt very homey and incredibly spacious given the lower ceilings of a ground floor apartment. I would highly recommend, and will see if this place is available next time I head to New York.
We had a wonderful stay. It was a great location and very comfortable! We had no problem with parking. We hope to stay there again.

Family of four (with two teens) stayed for 5 nights. Located very close to subway lines and surrounded by great restaurants and a 5 min walk away from Barclay’s Centre. Easy ride over to Manhattan. Great outdoor patio space in the back. Would love to stay here again.

Very good large apartment. Comfortable bed, felt safe and secure.  Easy to find with clear instructions.  Only a few minutes walk to The Barclays Centre for a concert, large supermarket, 2 subways, and friendly bar.  A Great and much quieter alternative to staying in Down Town Manhattan.

A great place to stay in Brooklyn, close to the subway stations and local shops. We enjoying the outside space which was very relaxing after a day out in New York. Nice size kitchen for meal cooking and plenty of storage space.
The lounge chairs were not that comfortable to sit in, but otherwise all good.

This lovely Airbnb was located in a great walkable Brooklyn neighborhood which was central to other parts of Brooklyn and an easy train ride to Manhattan.  The rooms were spacious and designed to feel like home.  We had everything we needed to enjoy a lovely weekend in Brooklyn.  The kitchen was well equipped, the office space was great, and the outdoor patio with furnishings made it easy to relax and unwind.  We would highly recommend it and cannot wait to stay there again!
A fantastic apartment in a perfect location. Nice and quiet at night, everything you need nearby and a beautiful apartment with great amenities. highly recommend
Great stay in Brooklyn, walking distance to all major places around or a very easy subway ride onto Manhattan island or the surroundings. Easy check in and spacious place!
Great apartment, spacious, very comfortable and well appointed with everything you need including large, private backyard. Excellent location and access to restaurants and shops. Highly recommended.

Excellent accommodation in an authentic Brooklyn neighbourhood. The apartment is spacious and comfortable. The heritage bedroom, the modern living area, and the large private garden, are all extremely well appointed with every facility one could wish for. In fact, it's easily the best appointed Airbnb I have ever stayed at. The owner is very helpful and accommodated us with a late check-out.
If you are seeking luxurious accommodation while experiencing life in a Brooklyn neighbourhood, then I cannot recommend this accommodation highly enough.

Spent 4 days in this spacious apartment (not to mention the yard). Short distance from Prospect Park and to weekend activities (farmers market, pedestrian-only zone), which is a huge plus.
Generally, the apartment is very clean and well-equipped. However, there is no shower gel, shampoo, or coffee (a filter machine is available), so remember to bring these items, or you'll waste time doing some shopping.
We will definitely return to this apartment in the future, budget-permitting...

Overall Eran was a very helpful host/landlord and my stay in the apartment went smoothly. He replied quickly to messages and was good about sending people in to fix small problems. The apartment is in a great location and looks as pictured.

Spacious place for a long-term stay. Floors creak and walls are thin, so be prepared to "sleep through the noise" (and bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper). About a 15-minute walk to major metro hub, and a few blocks north of fantastic NYC dining. Bring your walking shoes! Host was communicative throughout my stay. Overall, I was satisfied with my experience here.

Great, stylish space, Julia and Domi very kind and welcoming. Good LES location - close to Brooklyn and easy access to everything in The City.
Definitely recommended!

Dominik's place is great- location is great and close to the subway and lots of good restaurants and bars. It's a very stylish apartment with lots of thoughtful touches like fresh fruit and everything you need to cook should you want to. Dominik was very friendly and communicative and made the whole stay very easy. Definitely recommend!

High ceilings, lots of light and nicely decorated- this stylish Lower East Side apartment was great for my husband and I and our two teenage sons. It was pretty quiet and in a very interesting part of NYC.
Great place to stay. Very cool, very clean and the host is easily accessible. Highly recommended.

Perfect place- great location, roomy, easy to check in and the host was always quick to respond. The place isn’t fancy, but feels homey ( but not too much like you are crashing someone else’s apartment) and has wonderful plants.

Dominik's place was lovely! Very nicely decorated and super organized. The location was very convenient - very close to SoHo, Little Easy, etc. We were even able to walk the bridge to Williamsburg. Dominik was incredibly responsive and a great host.
Perfect location on a quiet street with great food options just outside the door. Only 1/2 a block from getting into the action of East Village and LES.

Domi was a brilliant host, great communications at all times while totally non intrusive - just responsive.
The apartment is as pictured - charming cosy and cool (as in vibe - toasty warm in freezing November weather). The location is super - lower east side is full of character and so friendly once you get past the fact that it doesn’t look like the upper east side!
I’ll be back if I’m lucky enough

My husband and I enjoyed our stay at Dom’s apt in the LES. The apt is beautifully decorated (love the artwork), very clean, spacious, and located in a fun part of town.
Make sure you check out Essex Market nearby. Will definitely return.
We loved staying in Dominik's space.  The neighborhood is great, close to subway stops, wonderful restaurants.  We would stay there again.

Dominik’s place was stunning and so peaceful. As soon as we walked in there were big beautiful windows, plants and artwork everywhere. It felt calm and soothing. Beds, linens, and all the details were lovely.
I’ll be back again for sure!

The apartment is in a great location, close to so much to explore and enjoy but on a quiet block so once inside you don't have all the city noise at night. We really enjoyed the apartments relaxed feel and all the thoughtful touches. Highly recommend and hope to be back.

Dominik’s place was just like the pictures. The sunlight shines so beautifully and the curation of each room has a comforting charm. Dominik’s communication was almost immediate for any questions that came up and would highly recommend his place to anyone looking for a stay in the Lower East Side.
It was interesting to stay where people live rather than the hussle of time square or broadway hotels

Dominik’s place is very comfortable and relaxing with a cozy couch and good beds. The place is very well maintained, and the morning espresso in the kitchen was most welcome. It was easy enough to use the apartment as a base to enjoy the entirety of the city travelling by either subway or taxi, or of course by foot. Our exchanges with Dominik were very helpful, he’s a super host.

Dominik's lovely apartment was the perfect home away from home for my extended stay! The apartment was stocked well with everything that I needed, walking distance from grocery stores and restaurants and beautifully decorated! Dominik was extremely responsive whenever I messaged him. I will definitely be back!
Dominik is a very helpful, prompt, and accommodating host. 10/10 would stay again!

This space was like a dream. Dominik was so lovely, I suffer from severe anxiety, but he made sure to send detailed instructions that really helped with that anxiety. The apartment itself is so beautiful and inviting. I love how environmentally friendly this space is. Overall, this stay might easily be my favorite out of all of my trips.
Can’t thank Dominik enough for how lovely everything was.
very quiet and comfortable apartment. We appreciated the two beautiful vases of fresh flowers when we arrived. Will definitely come back.
As described, very friendly host. Great 24/7 Deli's across the road. Metro was walkable. Easy commute to tourist areas.

Position of apartment was handy to get to all parts of Manhattan and neighbouring Brooklyn.
It gives a local flavour to your experience and we had a wonderful time.
Lovely and extremely well run apartment. The space was just right for the 3 of us. The air conditioning (it was humid), coffee maker and screen entertainment were all excellent.
Dominik’s place was spotless, spacious and perfect for our stay in NYC! Dominik was very helpful and easy to reach for any questions we had. We would definitely stay here again! Thank you!

Dom's place was great! The apartment is beautifully designed with all the amenities you need, and looked exactly as advertised. The check in process was super simple and Dom was so helpful. The location was also very convenient and close to everything we wanted to do. You have to stay here!

Dominik was the most incredible host!! Staying in NYC can feel a bit overwhelming and he was so communicative and kind as we were preparing for our stay. The space inside was GORGEOUS! I truly felt like I was living a Manhattan dream. Highly recommend!!

We really enjoyed our stay at Dominik’s place. It was perfect to spend a few days around Thanksgiving in NYC. The apartment is as beautiful as on the pictures, everything works well and the interior is very elegant. The kitchen had everything we needed to prepare for dinner and the living place was spacious enough for everyone. We can highly recommend this place to explore the city, which is easy since the metro is quite close. The neighborhood is lively but not too loud and the apartment itself is looking towards the courtyard so it’s very quiet. We would love to come back!

10/10 would recommend. Obsessed with the creative apartment. Great location, walkable, subway accessible, and so much to do in the booming lower east side. The host, Domi, was incredibly responsive and helpful at all times. Would book again when in the city!
Dominik’s place was beautifully decorated with good use of the space. He had good amenities and comfy beds. Was clean and quiet, would highly recommend.

Domi’s spot is a hidden gem in a happening place. Very thoughtfully and beautifully appointed with exactly what you need and nothing more and nothing less.  For such a central location amongst all the buzz of the lower east side, the apartment was quiet and peaceful. Such a treat to come back to after taking in the high energy of the city. Lots of space too! We stayed with another couple and there was plenty of room for the both of us. Highly recommend for a getaway to the big apple. Would definitely stay again!
Dominik was wonderful to work with! So responsive! His apartment felt very cozy and it was a great retreat at the end of the day exploring New York.

Had a lovely stay at Dominik’s place. Lots of space for my adult daughter and I to relax after our exploring the city each day.
Location was nice for getting on the subway and Ubers were quick too.
Apartment was nicely equipped and furnished with anything someone might need.
The neighborhood was definitely diverse but no issues there! Was very quiet at night for sleeping/relaxing.
A/C units worked great to keep us cool.
Dominik was extremely communicative and helpful and made check in and out very smooth.
Overall would definitely stay again and thanks again for being so accommodating for my visit to NYC!
Jenn C

Superb space in an excellent location.  Roomy, comfortable, with a lot of charm.  It can be hard finding a quiet place in Manhattan - this is it.  Domi was a model host, perfect instructions a d quick to respond.

This is a wonderful apartment in a wonderful neighborhood in Brooklyn (Greenpoint)! It is secure, clean and spacious. It is beautifully decorated and has a wonderful view. It was cold when we were there but we could see that the deck looks lovely.

The host is so so wonderful!! Everything was very easy and we hope to stay there again.

Nice apartment, perfect place in Greenpoint. We directly felt at home.
We did not meet Margrethe in person, but the contact via email was uncomplicated and she provided us with helpful tips for nice spots in the neighborhood.
We would definitely come back.

The home is lovely and I loved the location.  It was very close to subway stop if you wanted to travel that way.  It was in a quiet neighborhood and the house was very clean and with updated features.  I hope to stay there again when I go back to Brooklyn.

Let’s start with the rooftop view of Manhattan, day or night, was spectacular. Local amenities bountiful. 3 minute walk to ferry stop was unexpected surprise. Margrethe is the super host of super hosts. Beautiful,clean, exceptionally functional living space, with modern appliances, spacious bath, and relaxing environment. Will not hesitate to stay again.

My boyfriend and I were thinking of staying in an AirBnB in Greenpoint, as we want to move there but had never spent extended amounts of time there. It was the best decision to stay at Margrethe’s apartment; it is cozy yet spacious, modern but without giving up charm.  If we could live in this apartment we would! The area, as well, is lively and quite European for NYC, which we loved. Lots of adorable local businesses and restaurants, and only a handful of blocks from Transmitter Park (which has some of the best views of Manhattan we’ve ever seen). We greatly appreciated that Margrethe was very communicative and always reachable. She also gave us many pages of information on things to check out in the neighborhood. We can’t wait to move to Greenpoint and try more of her recommendations :)

I had a lovely time staying at Margrethe’s place. Centrally located within walking distance to so many coffee shops, bakeries, grocery stores, restaurants and more. Super close to the G train as well, when you want to leave the wonderful Greenpoint neighborhood and explore more. The apartment itself was amazing. Beautifully decorated and filled with everything you need to make your short or long stay there really comfortable (stocked kitchen and amazing jacuzzi tub included). I absolutely adored the balcony, for when I wanted to get some fresh air but didn’t feel like stepping outside to the nearby waterfront. Margrethe was always super responsive and answered any questions I had about the apartment promptly! Overall, a cozy sanctuary in NYC that I would love to stay at again!

Margrethe’s place was absolutely clean and beautiful. I booked this place for my parents for a few days and they were thrilled.
The apartment is located in nice area close to cafe, restaurants and supermarkets. Also the subways is a block away.
The apartment has everything you need including a cute balcony !! Perfect for the summer.
The host is super friendly and very responsive. Thanks again Margrethe!

Great and clean apartment in a beautiful street in a hip area of Brooklyn. Drinking Coffee in the morning from the terrace looking on the skyline of Manhatten had a special feeling.
Apartment was very clean and had everything you need. Bed was very comfortable and the nights and mornings are quiet in this street.
Thank you! We had a great time!

Hands down one of my favorite airbnbs to date. Every detail felt intentional, and the space felt so incredibly inviting and comfortable.
The neighborhood has so many good restaurants, coffee shops, and local shops, and it’s super close to the subway station. The area itself is busy but the Airbnb was sooo quiet and peaceful, even with the windows and sliding doors open. I loved it.
On top of the Airbnb being awesome, the hosts (Margrethe and Stein) are so so kind and thoughtful. Thank you both!

I had a wonderful stay at Margrethe's beautiful apartment, which is located in the best part of Greenpoint - surrounded by amenities (multiple grocery stores less than 5 minutes away) and a huge variety of bars and restaurants. The subway (G train) is a 5 minute walk away. It is very quick to get into Manhattan and also convenient to travel south in Brooklyn.
The design of the apartment is minimalist but cosy - perfect for me. There is an outdoor terrace which is a nice place to sit outside and relax. The apartment faces out to the back and is quiet and peaceful
Margrethe was overseas when I visited but communicated with me to check that everything was to my liking and that I was comfortable. The neighbours in the building and surrounding buildings are very friendly.
Overall, one of my best experiences with Airbnb.
Great place to stay in NYC, clean,good location, exactly as the pictures, the neightborhood very quiet

Richard was a great, accomodating host, and I want to thank you again for making my stay, albeit short, very nice.

The apartment is actually much better in real than on the pictures. Richard explained that the pictures were taken when the apartment was not yet completely decorated. Richard you must update the site.

The apartment was spotlessly clean, which I appreciate very much.

In any case, I am frequently in NY for work and will use his listing again for sure.

Richard is a really good landlord! His apartment is really nice! He had prepared all necessary small details to make us feel like at home. Like the oil,tea,even the handcream in the kitchen. Besides, we really love the apple box, it is a really nice experience when we can stay at home to be couch potatoes. Richard 's house should be your first choice.
The householder is so nice and helpful. The apartment is decorated well, everything is there. The location is also good, easy to reach subway.

This was my 2nd four night stay at Richard's apartment. Everything is about location, location, location. This AirBnB 1 bedroom apartment is 3 blocks from my daughter, which is why I visit Harlem, and 1/2 block from the "main drag" making getting around very convenient by subway, bus or Uber.
Richard and or his wife are usually around and available for anything that may arise. My first visit I could not figure out how to work the TV, and as they live upstairs, someone came down almost immediately to assist. On my second visit, I arrived on a nasty rainy day. Richard reached out to me to see if I was on my way and was there to help me with my suitcase and get in to the apartment - even left an umbrella for me. He is flexible with "check-out" time and just an all around nice and accommodating host.
Richard was a great host. Though we didnt get a chance to see Richard. We had no problems, everything was in the rite place. Nice neighborhood and Times Square was 20 mins drive.
Excellent host. Honest and clean place. Much better than I expected. Even accommodated me when some of my plans fell through. Definitely will be staying here more often.

Richards place was fantastic. Central location, walking distance to great restaurants and in the heart of Harlem! Richard was an amazing host, accommodating, and communication was super easy. Definitely recommend this place!
This is my second stay at Richard’s place and everything was just as perfect as it was the first time! Thank you Richard for being so accommodating! A great host!
Richard was amazing. Very quick response and wonderful hospitality. Let me extend my trip and stay a couple hours because of my late flight!  Highly recommend this place and definitely coming back!
Richard was a fantastic host. Very responsive and very helpful. We had to move out late and he was a tremendous host. I highly recommend this place. Very helpful and great location.

Ir you're looking for a pice6of mind this is not the place to stay. He contacted me the whole 3 days I stayed there. Even knocked on the door very load one morning.  He's definitely not a fair guy either.
Gracious and attentive host..stylish space..good neighborhood...We enjoyed our stay and will definitely book again
Wonderful stay. Clean apartment, very handy washer and dryer. Richard is very kind and attentive. Felt very safe and Covid safe. 10/10

For my first stay in New York, I can’t say that I was let down by this apartment. It’s cozy and sleek, with great art on the walls and coffee table. Great tv in the living room and a strong wifi and THANK GOD for that AC. Shower bathroom and bedroom were all big and spacious, not what I expected so pleasantly surprised. Last but not least, the location, the location, the location! Right between 5th Ave and Lenox, you’re steps away from great New York experiences and people. I felt right at home and will definitely consider for the future! Thanks again Richard 👍🏾
Very nice space presented just as advertised. Located centrally in Harlem. Richard is very communicative and facilitated an easy check-in and check-out.

Richard is the perfect host, responding to any messages quickly and is helping with luggage to be stored, early check in etc. Flat is nice and clean, fully equipped kitchen, large Bathroom and bedroom to the rear so you don’t hear the street noises - we really liked it.
Best location, ride the train to time square, eat at very near by restaurants, beautiful home, warm neighborhood, lovely neighbors, clean clean clean clean! I learned better recycling!

My recent stay at this Airbnb was fantastic. Great location, beautifully furnished and spotless. The host was welcoming and helpful, with excellent local tips. Loved the amenities like fast Wi-Fi and a well-equipped kitchen. A perfect blend of comfort and convenience, highly recommended for anyone visiting this apartment!
Thanks, letting me stay at such amazing places. My I really enjoyed the place and the neighborhood were is located. Once’s again thx
Richard is a superhost and really helpful in accomodaties your stay in New York. The apartment is a recommendation.

Richard was a wonderful host, very responsive and accommodating to our needs. The place is sooooo cute and everything works the way it should. We loved our stay and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

Great apartment in loft style (one open space) at great location in Williamsburg. If you’re looking for a nice place in this cool area which feels like a home this is a great place to stay.
Good value for money, Lizzie was very responsive and we just loved to stay in Williamsburg. Close to Marcy subway station which takes you quickly into Manhattan or you can even take the ferry - just a 10min walk!

We loved our stay in Lillybeth & Crystal's apartment.
Everything is beautiful and comfty. the apartment is close to the subway and bus stations.
The studio has anything you might need for a pleasant visit at NYC.
The hostess are amazing and are very thoughtful. They left us even colombian coffee to enjoy. Everything was simply amazing!

I had a really excellent stay at Lilly´s house. She was very attentive, kind and always avaliable to help. The apartment is amazing, big, very clean.
Me and my wife had very good days at NYC.
I really recommend this place.

This was a perfect place. It was clean and very quiet. It has everything you'd need for a trip to NYC. Close to transit, a well equipped kitchenette, a clean bathroom, a cozy sitting area and a very comfortable bed. I would recommend this place to anyone.
The room is sooooo big!!it's clean and comfortable. Crystal is so nice, really would like to help you a lot. It's a wonderful travel !!!
The room was exactly as described, if not better. It is extremely spacious and comfortable. I would recommend anyone to stay here.

The private studio is so great! It's clean and cute.
My best point is host. Her hospitality is really nice and flexible. We could spend comfortable stays.
Very convenient, relatively quiet location. The host was very flexible and good with communications. The studio was nicely furnished and well equipped. Would stay again!

This was our first booking with Airbnb and we thoroughly enjoyed it. Everything worked very well from Lillybeth's detailed descriptions (which we received well ahead of our departure for New York) to picking up the keyes.
The studio is spacious, clean and facing a back garden, very quiet. The bed is wonderfully comfortable with a great mattress. We slept extremely well.
The next metro station is about 7 minutes away and we took the metro to get into downtown and see all the major sights. We walked most of the day anyway so didn't mind the short metro journey in the morning and evening.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would book here again.
Thanks for a great stay! Comfortable bed, handy kitchenette area and seating area.  Great base for our stay in New York City.

Great and big apartment with good equipment! We had everything we needed. The A.C. sometimes gets noisy.
The next subway is around 7-10 minutes to walk.

We had a wonderful stay in New York. The appartment had everything we needed: a good bed, nice shower, even extra towels. Lillybeth & Crystal responded fast to our messages and questions and we could leave our luggage for some time when we had to wait to leave for the airport. Thank you for your hospitality!

This is a great studio for a few nights in New York in a good location with easy access to Harlem and the rest of the city. The studio is really nicely decorated with a lot of attention to detail and was just as good as the photos. It was very easy to check in and out and Lillybeth and Crystal were available to address any questions that came up.

Very nice accommodation and amenities!  The book with details/menus of restaurants, etc was a great help.  Great location for Harlem, Columbia University and access to mass transit.  We will definitely want to stay here again if we come back to NYC.

Absolute stunning apartment with everything the (business) traveler could need: kitchen with all basic equipment present, iron, hairdryer and all very clean and well maintained. The location is close to public transport and walking distance to groceries and some fun restaurants and bars. It is Harlem so I do recommend to ensure you feel comfortable walking around in that neighborhood. The apartment is very quiet though and you don't hear any noise from the street. I had a great time and enjoyed getting to know this part of New York!

Being a native New Yorker, it felt good to be able to stay in the heart of Harlem. We happened to be in town for a wedding of a college friend. The wedding ended up being 6 mins from the Airbnb. That was an added bonus. While we didn’t indulge in many of the eateries around, there were tons of options. The apartment was spacious and just enough space for me and my husband. The bed was so comfortable, and we found ourselves being really impressed with the decor. Although we never met the host, she was very helpful and quick in her responses. If we ever need to be back in Harlem, this will be a go to.
I was pleasantly surprised with my stay here. The room was better than any hotel I have had and the host went the extra mile to make the stay comfortable.
a very good studio with a large room, nice located in a very quied environment and close to the subway, I can really recommend!!!

If I could rate this space 100 stars I would. It is beautiful, warm, clean, and comfortable. It is close to bus stops and subways and restaurants. Any questions we had were answered quickly and we were greeted at the door when we arrived. Wonderful experience! Will definitely return here the next time we come to NY.

We stayed for a whole week and had such a great time. The place is really clean, nice and comfortable.The metro and the super market are close too.
Even we didn’t had the pleasure to meet Lilly, she kept in touch with us.
The place is highly recommended for those who visit town.

The location can’t be beat and Lillybeth and Crystal are warm and wonderful people. The place was super clean and we walked everywhere. There were personal touches throughout that made everything so inviting. Their kindness shines ❤️❤️❤️

We loved the privacy of the studio, but also its location and all the amenities Lilly left, you really have everything you need in the kitchen and bathroom, and a tv. The location is pretty good considering the nearest train station is served by both local and express lines so you can get downtown very fast. I wish we could stay longer next time!

Very good location in Harlem close to the bus station and subway, not so far from Central Park.
The room is quite big with all amenities, on the side of the garden and you can enjoy the song of the birds.
I recommend very much...

Really enjoyed staying here! It was a short walk to Central Park and many other coffee shops, bagel shops, grocery stores and such. Air conditioning was great, cleanliness was on point. Would stay there again!
A great location near to the fast line subway and shops. Lilly is a very helpful host. You may find the air con a bit noisy. Spotlessly clean and terrific value.
Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful home! We would highly recommend your place!!

Great location, getting to and from the airport did not require much walking and there were bus stops within 5 minutes of the place. Also very close to many restaurants so if you do Uber eats the delivery is very cheap. Nice place and definitely worth the money.

Lovely little spot in a cute neighborhood. Located very close to subway stations and an easy trip to all the attractions downtown. The room was perfectly cleaned, beautifully decorated, and had plenty of amenities. Hosts were responsive and helpful. Would absolutely recommend for anyone looking for an affordable way to explore NYC.
Had a great Christmas in Lillybeth & Crystal’s place. Stylish comfortable stay and everything is just as advertised. Would recommend and would stay here again.

The space is lovely!! It was a pretty & cozy spot to take refuge for a few days during a snowstorm. I didn't meet them, but they were accommodating about storing luggage ahead of time and notifying me that the place was ready before check-in. There was a bit of an issue with the toilet not functioning well, but it was not at all the fault of the hosts & they were communicative over email/phone about it. Overall, it's a great neighborhood, great hosts, and a lovely space!
Nice location. Second time staying with Lilly. Accommodations were clean and comfy. Would stay here again in the future.
This is such an amazing place! Everything is super clean. It is located near so many shopping places and a 5 minute walk to the train station. The host was so accommodating and was always available.

Everything matched the pictures and description. I arrived at 2am and had an issue finding the key box (issue was on my end, not the host). Lillybeth and Crystal was so quick to assist, such a pleasant experience.

Excellent accommodations. What you see in the photos is actually what you get. Location is great walking distance to the subways to everywhere New York. I am from New York now living in Minnesota. This is as close as you can get to living like a New Yorker. Great value. Don’t miss out book it if you can.

An absolutely charming place to stay!   Lilllybeth was very helpful with questions about the area.  It is just as cozy and clean as the pictures show.  Check in and check out information is excellent.  The area is very nice and the people in the neighborhood were very friendly.  If your driving, parking on the street is all about luck.  We were lucky enough to get a spot directly across the street in front of the school because they were out for the weekend.
This place was so adorable!!! The place was roomy and comfortable!!! As a couple of girls we felt safe staying here!! Super close to subway and the little cafe down the street was amazing!
A really really nice space close to public transport and a host of great restaurants. Would absolutely recommend this AirBnB to anyone looking for a space to stay in NYC.

Pros: clean, big and spacious, easy to get to the train.
Cons: I couldn’t communicate with the owner I was waiting for some time for the keys. The place it’s in a gettho area it’s fine because I was with my bf but not okay if I was alone. The train was close but it’s like 30 min ride to Manhattan.

Lillybeth & Crystal were fabulous hosts! The location was close to the subway and lots of good food. They were super accommodating. The price was amazing and the apartment was very clean. They made sure we had what we needed and went above any beyond to make sure we had a great stay. 10/10 would recommend.

My stay was great. The space is located close to restaurants, services, and shops along Frederick Douglass Blvd and super close to many bus and train lines. 1/2 mile walk to Central Park.  The space itself was completely private, quiet and included lovely amenities to increase comfort level.
Location was pretty good and short walk to the subway station. We needed new towels and the hosts were able to accommodate.
Lillian was a great host, really helpful and accommodating.  The apartment was in a perfect location for easily accessing where we wanted to visit. Would thoroughly recommend it.

Great place to stay in New York, within walking distance to subway stations and shops. Studio is well furnished and quiet at night. Bathroom is functional, although the toilet would benefit from upgrading in the future. We enjoyed our stay.
Lovely place situated in nice residential neighbourhood, easy acces with subway at the corner of the street. The apartment was exactly as described and Marta was very flexible to arrange for keys.

Great location! Marta's apartment is next to both 96 St subway stations which gives you easy access to whole Manhattan, Central Park is just a 5-10 minutes walk (perfect for jogging) plus there are various grocery shops and a laundry place around the corner. The apartment looks like in the pictures, is very clean and has fast wifi. The communication with Marta was very easy and reliable. We had a great stay!

Marta's apartment is great. It's very well located near the 1,2,3 express trains station so it's very easy and quick to get around Manhattan. There are many stores and restaurants nearby her place.
Her apartment is very clean and quiet. Each room has a heater and you can regulate the temperature in each room, which was great for me. Her bedroom is lovely, quite with nice little sofa by the window and very comfortable bed.
She made a smaller closet with about 20 hangers available for me as well the dresser in the living room. She has an ironing board and iron as well, which was convenient.
She responded very fast to my last minute requests and I am really happy things worked out because I really enjoyed my stay.
Thank you

Marta's place is a fabulous choice for 1-2 people looking to visit Columbia or stay in the Upper West side. It's well accommodated, conveniently located, and fantastically accessible from public transit.

I don't want to rave so much that Marta's availability is impacted, because it would be a tragedy if I couldn't stay there again. It's perfect, more or less: safe and quiet (on the back of the building) but in a convenient (express subway on the corner, Whole Foods down the street) and happening neighborhood. Marta is a clean,  responsive and friendly host. As a "foodie", may I highly recommend the welcoming Ayurvedic Cafe on Amsterdam between 94th and 95th for a delicious and inexpensive lunch or dinner (plus you'll feel far from the madding crowd) and Columbus Natural Food on Columbus between 95th and 96th, a wonderful and unique gourmet food shop / juice bar / organic deli run by the charming and sincere Anne from France and her devoted, hard working Indian husband - top notch, 3 Michelin stars!
Marta was lovely - she accommodated my very early arrival time, and made that first day so much easier.
Everything was perfect, very nice apartment and very well located. We  recommend it if you travel to NYC.
Great place. Cozy, clean, very convenient location. Marta responses quickly to my questions. The only problem is that heating is a bit lower than expected.

Marta’s apartment was exactly as she described it.
It was impeccably clean and a great location !
Marta was a gracious host and responded almost immediately to my emails.
I strongly recommend her apartment and will return myself on future trips to NY.

Marta helped us with directions to the apartment and was very responsive with any questions we had. You really can’t beat the price for the location of the apartment right next to the subway station on the corner.

I love this apartment! It is very roomy for a one bedroom and really cute and homey. Marta’s place is set up with everything you would need. She is a wonderful host and is always quick to respond to any questions and happy to help. I have really enjoyed my longer term stay as well as Martas flexibility and highly recommend this apartment.
Amazing location, great subway links and right by Central Park. Also right by several grocery stores! Great apartment for a long stay.

Host was very accommodating, but this did not make up for the depressing effect
of an old building, view toward other buildings, gritty neighborhood and execrable
public transit. These are not her fault, but they colored my overall experience
negatively.
Very enjoyable stay. Only slight issue was with the hot water in the shower which was resolved quickly. Great location!
Nice quaint and clean studio. With excellent location.  Close to the subway.  Street parking is available and fairly easy to find.     Host is very responsive and helpful.  Excellent experience.
We had a lovely stay at Nancy's studio. It was cosy, clean, and close to the subway (Manhattan wasn't far off at all).  Nancy was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend.
Great position, close to subway. Host promptly reactive. Fair discounted price for longer than a week stays. A bit of noise upstairs, really not an issue.
This is a beautiful immaculate studio that is like a high end hotel room with small kitchenette in a perfect location. Outstanding. Would stay again when visiting our daughter who lives nearby.

Wonderful!
Nick was waiting for us.... Even though we arrived late! The place was spotless and exactly as it looked on the pictures.
Lots of space to put our stuff away and a beautiful huge tub!
Great neighborhood with a market open 24/7 on 7th avenue and a pizzeria open until 1:30am in case you arrive late as we did
Parking on the street can be tricky... Parking garage on 11th st/7th ave
The street is quiet and close to restaurants and subway station and the best part.... Very close to the park!!!
Thanks Nick! We had a great time and we would love to come back!

We stayed in a lovely block in park slope very close to prospect Park. We know the area well and thelication was perfect, very close to f train stop on 7th Avenue. The accommodation is a very nice garden studio with all the amenities. Nick arranged for the keys to be available when we got there and was pretty helpful at checkout. Would love to stay there again
We loved staying at Nick's place.  It was in a great location in Brooklyn, clean, cozy, and Nick was very helpful.  I would highly recommend staying here when coming to Brooklyn.

Nick was a great host, he met us at the apartment when we arrived and was very flexible to accommodate our travel schedule. The apartment was exactly as advertised-- very clean with plenty of space for my husband and I during our long-weekend stay. The bed was super comfortable and the bathroom was huge! We loved staying on the brownstone-lined street and felt like we got the authentic Brooklyn experience.  If you're looking for a nice, clean space that's convenient to everything-- this is the place for you!

The apartment is lovely, and looks exactly like the photo. It's at ground level on a quiet street only a half block away from Prospect Park, and a short walk from the Brooklyn Museum. There are a lot of very nice restaurants within a 5 minute walk, as well as from an F train subway stop.

Lovely property, very private snd safe. The host made it completely easy for me to obtain the key, and had even offered to have coffee ready for me upon my arrival! Love the Park Slope neighborhood with lots of places to eat and shop, snd so close to the park.
The location was great, just a few blocks away from Prospect Park, the subway and various restaurants. It was a nice, walkable neighborhood. We would stay there again.

This Park Slope apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as pictured in photos. Checking in and out was easy and Nick was flexible with us when our arrival time got delayed. We truly enjoyed "living" in Park Slope for the weekend and would definitely stay in this AirBnB again.

Nick's place in Park Slope was awesome.  Great neighborhood, cool little space.  The unit is located underneath the main house in the basement, with an entrance just below street level.  The bed, bathroom, and kitchen were the perfect size for a couple traveling through.  Next time I'm in Brooklyn I'd definitely rent from Nick again!

Nick's place was charming.  I really enjoyed staying at his beautiful, clean and quiet studio.  It was perfect for my needs, close to subway, restaurants, shopping and parks.  A true home away from home in a neighbor friendly block.  Nick was so accommodating when I had scheduling problems and worked with me to make things right.  I would stay at his place in a heartbeat next time I travel to NY.

Warm welcoming, great studio with spacious bathroom, fully equipped kitchen, spacious bedroom and a very clean atmosphere. Great location in Park Slope. Running in the Park, -Shopping, bars and restaurants are just a block wall away. We stayed for 6 days in Nick's studio and will come back for our next trips to the city!

We had a great stay; lovely apartment, good location for exploring New York. The listing was accurate and we felt very comfortable there.  We were made to feel very welcome, I would recommend this place. Great neighbourhood.
Loved this apartment! It was clean, comfortable and exactly as advertised. The neighborhood was beautiful, quiet and safe. Nick was a pleasure to work with. Would definitely recommend!
Nice Park Slope location within walking distance to transit and restaurants. Nick was a great host and he recommended some excellent choices for dining out and breakfast.

Nick's Place was very nice, clean, comfortable and quiet.  We could not have had a better location.  We were close to family, restaurants, Prospect Park, subway.  Communication was great!  We would definitely try to stay next trip to Brooklyn!
Nick replies within a couple of hours or less consistently when i sent questions. I didn't want to be THAT person asking every little question but was comforted by the fact that he was some amiable.

Our stay in Brooklyn in the studio apartment was so personal compared to a hotel.  I loved the area with the scenic streets and I felt comfortable going for early morning walks.  The subway was close and we used it everyday.  We dined at two of the recommendations Nick gave us and were very happy with both of them.  Would definitely stay here again.
This is a great apartment. Very conveniently located to everything in Park Slope and surrounding area. It was so cozy and very clean. Nick was a great host. I definitely recommend it!

Nick's place is a great Brooklyn/Park Slope apartment find. The place has been renovated & is clean, modern & comfortable. The large bathtub is also a great bonus (along with shower). I would come back & stay at this place. Thanks Nick!
A perfect place to stay in a beautiful park of Brooklyn for a touch of local life. Loved it.

Cute place! Great location, clean apartment, good AC, very safe and clean neighborhood ... Walking distance to a lot of shops and places to eat. A little smaller than I expected but the set up was so nice that it didn’t feel cramped. Also, we didn’t drive but street parking was busy, but their were a couple spots open here and there. I probably wouldn’t plan on driving any way. I would definitely stay again next year for CurlFest if it’s available.
The host was easily accessible, friendly and responds quickly too!

Nick's place is exactly like the picture, its very cozy with a touch of class.  The bed was very comfortable the room was equipped with toiletries their was even Netflix on the television, that was a plus for us. The subway and train stations was very close and tons of restaurant options. I fell in love with the healthy smoothie juice place that's only 2 blocks away.

Great location, easy walks to the park and to the subway.  Very welcoming neighborhood, everything is open really late.  Fantastic bathroom.  This is not necessarily a place you want to spend the day sitting in, but it is a great base for going out and seeing Brooklyn and NY in general.
Nick’s spot was lovely and cozy. He was super accommodating when we had to alter our reservation and was incredibly responsive and chill. All in all a great stay!
Great location - near Prospect Park and great shopping and dining places on 7th Avenue.  I really enjoyed the stay!

This unit has a great location, the entrance is under the stairs to the basement unit. (Not the upstairs unit as the photographs would have you believe). Very big bathtub if you need, and good cable package. It was satisfactory for a 2 night visit.
We travel to NYC quite frequently for business and Nick's place continues to be the first we check when we book. See some of our previous reviews for more info!

Nick was a fantastic host! The spacious bathroom was super clean and he made the extra effort by stocking the fridge with some great beers and the kitchenette with coffee, etc. He was extremely responsive to any needs that came up and was accommodating with check-in. Another huge bonus is being less than one block from the beautiful Prospect Park. Top marks all round.

What a lovely apartment Nick has!! My boyfriend and I had a great stay here. It is sparkling clean and nicely decorated, with a spacious bathroom (that is nice and warm because of a radiator), has a compact but full kitchen, and a nice big TV with cable and Netflix! It’s also in a really nice and safe neighborhood. We didn’t go in the park because it’s rather cold in NYC now but in the warmer weather (or with snow) that is a lovely resource. Nick was a great host- super fast with responses and very accommodating. Would definitely stay here again given the chance!
Another great stay with Nick. Hands down our most-booked Air BnB in NYC for work travel. Read our other reviews for more details. Couldn't be happier with our experience.

Nick is a wonderful host--accommodating and responsive. The apartment is stylish, sparkling clean and quiet. Location is excellent, convenient to subways and within walking distance of great restaurants, shops and attractions. Prospect Park is right there, too if you feel the need for some green space. We will definitely put it at the top of our list of places to stay in Brooklyn. We are ex Park Slopers ourselves, and this is a gem of a find!

Nick’s place is wonderful! It’s in a great location close to Prospect Park and the subway, in a beautiful neighbourhood. We really appreciated the cleanliness and convenience of the studio apartment, as well as Nick’s local recommendations and welcoming nature. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again or recommend it to others.
Nick’s place is stylish, clean, and comfortable. It is located near a lovely park and within walking distance of plenty of good coffee shops places to eat. Thanks for a comfortable stay in Brooklyn.
Nicks place was excellent! It was very clean and had really a comfortable bed! We will definitely stay here again. The neighborhood is great, easy access to the subway and parking was really easy.
Nicks place delivers as advertised every single time. We love staying here when we visit family because we know we can consistently count on a great experience in every aspect.
Lovely space in a great location! Had everything we needed for a weekend stay. Would definitely stay here again!
This is a charming studio apartment in the heart of Park Slope.  It was cozy and warm and surprisingly roomy.  I would recommend!
A wonderful, quiet and cozy place to stay in while in Brooklyn.  Highly recommend it.  Nick is a great, responsive and friendly host.
Had a great stay.  Clean and thoughtfully designed in a wonderful neighborhood. Nick was a gracious host and check in and out was seamless.  I would definitely stay again.

Super fresh and clean space with everything you need to be comfortable. Great location near the train and the park. Nick is super quick at responding to questions and is all around a great host! I highly recommend staying here.

This is a very nice space for the price. Nick is a great host and was extremely flexible with my needs. It feels like a perfect Brooklyn studio apartment. If you're looking for a unique Brooklyn apartment that is less than a block away from Prospect Park, then this is your spot!

I had a wonderful stay at Nick’s place! Even though it is just a studio, it feels really spacious. The kitchen is arranged in such a way that it makes the most of the space and works really well. The bathroom is huge for NYC and felt quite luxurious. The neighborhood is so nice! How special to be right across the street from Prospect Park! There are plenty of restaurants and coffee shops nearby, while also feeling very “homey.” Nick was a very gracious host and always responded to any communications right away. This was a lovely place to call home while I was visiting Brooklyn. I would love to return!

Wow!! I didn't know what to expect with my first trip on airbnb. Miouly's place was PERFECT for us. Situated steps away from Marcus Garvey park and on a private quiet street. Her place was very clean and orderly. Four room apt was very spacious and her communication was impeccable.
We weren't sure about staying in Harlem but we fell in love with this area. We love the varied ethnicities and ease of transportation. You are right in between two major subway and bus stations. Grocery store right around the corner and steps away from Jacob Soul Food-what a great experience. We never felt unsafe.
We enjoyed the full kitchen and good hot water in the bath. There is nice air flow from front to the back with screened windows.
We will recommend this place to others-thanks from Texas!

I felt comfortable in Miouly's place, though it did get warm on the hotter days. Her place sits near Marcus Garvey Park and the train, so I relaxed easily and moved easily. Miouly responded promptly to questions, including offering advice on pizza spots, and helped me set up the AC unit when the place heated up. Overall, I enjoyed my stay.

Great location in Harlem close to shops and the metro station to go anywhere! The appartment has a good urban old style touch and everything to cover basic needs. TV has not been available and heating ion cold days was a challenge. Thus the
comfort level was basic.

This is the second time my husband and I stayed here. The studio is well appointed. The space is more than adequate for two people. The location is perfect. There are lots of restaurants and coffee shops offering outdoor dining and curbside pickup. The studio is located very close to Prospect Park which is a great place to explore; especially on a beautiful fall weekend.

Nick’s place is great.  It is in the heart of Park Slope, near Prospect Park and lots of restaurants and shops.  The apartment was absolutely spotless.  The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was fabulous.  We hope to stay here again and would recommend it to everyone.
What a beautiful garden apartment in a lovely spot.  It was delightful to walk a little over a block for coffee and less than that to Prospect Park!  Nick was very helpful. I hope to be back soon. ❤️

PERFECT location — on a charming, tree-lined street close to the park, restaurants, and shops. Space itself was clean and cozy. Having two sinks helped if you’re a couple. Will definitely stay here again next time we’re in Brooklyn.

This is a great location, with the park just a block away and endless walking on brownstone and tree-lined streets. Shops and restaurants are plentiful. The apartment was clean and quiet and had everything we needed.

My friend and I really enjoyed our stay for the weekend. Nicks place had everything we needed and was so comfortable. We felt at home in the quiet neighborhood and found parking pretty easily 1 block away. We’d love to stay again in the future.

Nick space is in an excellent location. Easy walk to the train, places to eat, and prospect park! Its a quite street with lots of trees and very clean. The space has everything you need to enjoy a nice get away. Very clean with your own bath and shower and a kitchen if you want to store anything you are eating. We loved the location and space and Nick was very responsive if we needed anything or had questions. I would recommend this place to anyone that is looking for a place in Brooklyn or looking for a quick way into Manhattan. Thanks Nick for letting us stay!

This apartment has a great location.  It is near the subway, convenient stores, and restaurants.  It is located on a quiet residential tree lined street.  There is a bath tub plus a separate shower stall.  A full sized refrigerator, dishwasher, and gas stove are included in the kitchen.  It has a queen size bed and a good TV.  It is very easy to communicate with the host.

This is a fantastic and unique brownstone apartment. The subway is very close and there is a market just around the corner. As long as your up for traveling by subway it’s a great place. It’s a little bit of an Uber to get downtown or back everyday, but the subway is cheap and easy.
Beautiful space with much more room than is typical in NYC!  Lots of old-style charm but with modern amenities!
Mimi’s place has plenty of space, is close to all amenities and the subway line, and she is excellent at answering your questions.

Mimi is a great host. The communication was very easy and she responded the messages very quickly. The apartment is close to the subway, market and stores. It was a nice stay. It has nice amenities (mostly on bathroom and kitchen). It was a fun and pleasant stay.

Really Nice place! Mimi was great with all the support And information !
We really enjoyed It 😊

Very nice place and well located.
Elizabeth is always available and answer in a few minutes by email.

I had a very pleasant stay at Nick’s place. He was easy to communicate with. The place itself was very clean and bigger than expected. Perfect for a quick trip or even a longer stay. Great neighborhood with lots of bars and restaurants within walking distance. Would definitely stay again.

This is a beautifully renovated, immaculately clean English basement in Park Slope. Great location near restaurants and markets but on a quiet street. The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen was great. Check-in was easy. We hope to be back!

This was the perfect stay while we were in New York. The bed was comfortable, the location was fantastic, it was super easy to come and go with the private entrance, and the TUB!!! The bathroom and that tub especially was glorious. Would definitely recommend Nick’s place!

We enjoyed our short stay at Nick’s place. One of the biggest perks was location - right next to Prospect Park and a short walking distance to restaurants. We visited during summer and appreciated the AC which worked very well!
We love staying there because it’s down the street from our daughter’s apartment.  It is near Prospect Park,  the subway and restaurants are walkable.

Our stay at Mimi’s apartment couldn’t have been better. Although we didn’t get the chance to meet, she would get in touch frequently to make sure we had everything we needed and suggest places to visit. The location gave us walking access to Central Park, subway stations and the best restaurants and jazz clubs in Harlem. I recommend Mimi’s apartment and hosting experience without hesitation.

Mimi's place has everything you will need for your stay in New York. Very large brownstone apartment- felt like a true New Yorker! Close to the red line train to get downtown.
Mimi was a great communicator!
It is quite spacious space, but so far from downtown. But considering all the things including price, it is recommended to everyone.

The apartment is conveniently located on 5th Ave in Harlem, a very lively area, but an oasis of calm and quietness inside. The very large size by Manhattan standards surprised us most, but the cleanliness, the amenities, the effective communication with the host really made it feel like a home-away-from-home and living it large.
All in all, one of the best available accommodations in town... and that at an exceptional value for (little) money.
Highly recommended!

Great location. love Harlem! the space is large, very New Yorky vibes, old building which i love, very authentic. the host is fabulous and made sure we had everything we needed the whole stay. only thing I will say is there are two flights of stairs, so makes sure you're prepared for that.

This place was great. The communication was fantastic. When I had a problem with opening the door, as soon I called her, there was someone to help me immediately. Its in great location and the apartment is nice and spacious. Only issue was with the Wi-Fi, but I believe there was an outage so hopefully that was an aberration. Highly recommended!!

The stay here was AWESOME! Easy check/in and out very clean and spacious I felt like I was at home! Great location! Anyone would love to be able to book here.. I would give this place a 100 STARS if I could..
Cozy quaint apartment, third floor so be prepared to do stairs.   City noise did not seem to bother my sleep.
Nice place in an old building and apartment. Easy check in and check out. Had everything we needed for our two night stay.

Nick's place had all we needed for a wonderful Brooklyn getaway, including a super comfortable bed.  The space was clean, well laid out and its location can't be beat.  Easy walks to the park and Brooklyn Botanic Gardens, as well as great restaurants, cocktail bars and the main attractions, our daughter and her fiancé.

Close to family I was visiting so I again opted to stay at Nick's and all went smoothly. Comfortable bed , shower and a quiet location. I didn't need to use other amenities but if had more time I'm quite sure kitchen, TV and tub were of a high standard.  I will most probably return for a future visit.

Fantastic location and really cute studio in Park Slope. Was very convenient located right off of Prospect Park for a wedding we attended at the Boathouse. Nice neighborhood, super walkable, and easy to get around. The studio was very clean and we had a great stay. Highly recommend Nick's studio!

I liked the spacious appartment. I would definently recommend it.
Metro, restaurants, supermarkets nearby.

spacious and cosy flat on a very convenient location
as well for transport within the city as to the airport
The bus from Laguardia takes you basically to the street itself. All was clean check in easy and communication was great
This was my second stay and i hope to book it again

The apartment is spacious and has everything you need. The neighbourhood is lively and close to a lot of cool stuff to discover. Close to the subway and easy bus rides to other part of the city. Would stay here again!

I enjoyed my stay thoroughly, and Elizabeth was very communicative before and upon our arrival regarding the apartment, making it easy for my daughter and me to enjoy our time there. I would definitely stay there again and highly recommend it!

What a charming Harlem brownstone! No frills (as we like it) but everything you could need, and large for a New York rental. I loved the green view from the bedroom window. My son and I were very happy for our week at M. Elizabeth's place!
A very clean apartment in lower Harlem. Convenient to 125th street subway. Checkin was very easy and communication with owner was perfect. Recommend to any visitors to NYC for excellent value.
A secure and safe place right in the thick  of Harlem. Lots of activity in the city. Whole Foods a couple blocks away. Private top floor apartment all to ourselves. Just what we needed.

Quiet place, clean bathroom!
But the heater is slightly noisy in the morning.
Overall is really good, great place to stay!

Elizabeth is a very considerate and gracious host. She was very attentive to our requests and quick to respond, which we appreciated very much. The apartment is very spacious, quiet, and clean, and occupies the entire third floor. It is also conveniently located a couple of blocks from a subway station and is only a twenty-minute walk to Columbia University, which is a beautiful walk with plenty of cafés along the way.
We had a wonderful visit and would certainly return.
My stay was excellent and I highly recommend Elizabeth's place.  Thanks for having me and carrying my luggage upstairs and downstairs due to my pregnancy.
We had an amazing time in NYC. After a day of touring, coming back to Elizabeth’s place was like coming home. We loved the diversity and energy on the streets.

Pleasantly surprised with the host’s apartment. More spacious than photos lead us to anticipate. Bedroom mattress is moderately firm but provided the most comfortable sleeps for our 3 night stay. Nice and close to subway and transit, whole foods, and the park.

Eran and his team are great at their jobs!
Quick response, helpful, and polite.
But I don’t know why my Citibank account was blocked after paying online.
For the amount being paid, there are no amenities that make it worth the cost. It’s a great  location, but super noisy and busy street.

Our arrival was a bit rough, the place needed a bit of cleaning and the central heating was going bananas, the temperature inside the room was probably 100 degrees and we had to shut down some of the radiators (which made so much noise we couldn't hear one another speak). After that rough landing we really enjoyed the place, fantastic locations, looks as good as it does on the pictures. I'd recommend it.

The apartment was located in a great area, super easy to walk around and find something to eat. Michele was exceptionally nice when we could not figure out how to check in, and even when there was an issue with something he was incredibly prompt and eager to help us out. Overall, a great place, very comfortable and super cute!

Michele’s apartment is well located many restaurants, grocery stores, subways, parks at walkable distance.
Apartment is clean, peaceful, well equipped.
2 thumbs up,
I’ll definitely recommend it.
Best.
Stephanie was incredibly welcoming and helpful during my stay. The apartment is in a great location, and Stephanie was fully contactable before and during the 10 days I was there.

Stephanie is a great host, she treated us with a nice welcome gift and with a really nice and clean flat. We stayed over a week, had no issues whatsoever and Stephanie was always quick to reply to any queries we had. The flat is really unexpectedly large and nicely decorated. The location is amazing and close to a few underground stations and within walking distance to Central Park and the Guggenheim museum.  I 'd wholeheartedly recommend it.
Great host, Stephanie is very responsive and has a spacious apartment in a good location.  Would stay there again.

Dawn was an amazing host. She provided us with extra towels the night of arrival. The apartment is beautiful and very spacious and the kitchen is amazing. Also the shower is really cool. Definitely enjoyed it.

We stayed a week with Dawn. And she was absolutely a wonderful host. She was always available and very supportive with any question, even tips to places to visit which where special research for our personal interests. Thanks so much.

The apartment itself is exactly like in the pictures. The apartment is totally equipped and we didn’t missed a thing. The location is in the middle of Brooklyn, with easy access to the bus and subway stations. You’ll find directions to all the nearby places, like grocery and/or Laundry. It takes you about 45 minutes to reach downtown Manhattan, which was absolute perfect for us.

We felt save and at home, everything we asked for. Thanks again for the great time.

Mrs Dawn your apartment was so cozy, I had a great stay. The shower with the rocks on the floor was amazing and can't stop talking about the lights that come on when you turn on shower. The pictures that you see doesn't compare to what you see when you visit the apartment. Mrs. Dawn you out did yourself don't change anything. Mr. Leon is such a sweetheart. Peace

Dawn doesn't deserve 5 stars, She deserves 10! Dawn is the host that everyone should have their first time traveling. This lovely lady is so kind, patient and helpful. The apartment is absolutely amazing and top notch, the pictures definitely don't do the apartment any justice. My experience here was just amazing, came with a lot of "just in case" toiletries. I'm definitely coming back!!!!!

With no obligation whatsoever and purely out of her own desire, the host brought my companion and I around the neighbourhood so as to allow us to familiarise with the subway and transportation links. Besides that, she gave us her own tips on the time to arrive back or take certain public transportation from her own experience. Furthermore, when we requested for particular items, Dawn immediately provided them to us. For eg: trash bin and bathtub plug. Last but not least, due to an oversight, we accidentally left a personal possession at Dawn's place and Dawn was kind enough to ship over it to us with no additional cost. In short, it was an absolutely delightful stay for our first time in NYC.
Dawn was great. Her apartment is exactly like the pictures. My friend and I felt like we were home. Next time I am in Brooklyn I will definitely stay here if available!

Dawn is the best airbnb host that I've had thus far! Her and her husband went out of their way to make sure that we were comfortable and enjoyed our stay. I strongly recommend her. The apartment was also very clean and felt like home.

Dawns place is clean, bright and easy to get used to calling home. The hospitality both Dawn and her father display is genuine and kind. I will stay again if I need a home in Brooklyn.  There was food in the fridge when I arrived and some was even organic which I prefer to eat. The shower really is bit spa like with a skylight in the bathroom. The bed was very comfy and except for the occasional dog barking relatively quiet. I highly recommend staying at Dawns and will be back. Thank you Dawn and Leon.                                                                  Dawn (Dee)

WONDERFUL STAY! I put in all caps because Dawn is the true definition of a super host. She answered messages quickly, gave us so many amazing tips about how to get around and what to do. The space itself is just like the pictures. It was a perfect stay!

Awesome host!!! Another arrangement cancelled last minute on me and needed a place. Dawn accepted and got us in last minute which saved me a lot of time and money. Greatly appreciate the accommodations and hospitality!!!

Dawn is very hands on and responds to messages in a timely manner! She takes pride in her properties and her reputation in being a super host!! Her properties are very stylish, clean, and worth the cost!! It was easy to catch a cab and take a bus from there. Her father was also there, below the apartments, in case we needed him. For the most part we were fine with everything!! I would stay here permanently if I could afford it and both units looked exactly as they did in the photos!!! Checking in and out was very easy and she made us feel like we were at home away from home!!

Dawn was such a great host! She communicated with us very quickly. The place was such a cute place and she had local tips and maps for us to use. There is a subway nearby to get you to Manhattan to visit the tourists spots. I would stay here in future in I were to Visit New York. Thanks Dawn!

Leah's place had a lot of character. She made us feel at home right away and was always available to answer any questions or suggest interesting places to eat at. She has an enormous record collection that we were free to enjoy. There is a train station right around the corner and the neighborhood was very lively. Thank you Leah, we truly enjoyed your place!

My brother and I loved our stay in Leah's appartment, and Leah was a great host. Leah checked up on us a number of times during our 10 day stay, even though she was travelling herself, just to make sure everything was going well.
The appartment is exactly what we expected, in fact probably a little bigger than it looks in the photos, and with plenty of natural light. A comfortable place to place our heads after a long day of exploring Brooklyn or Manhattan.
Bushwick is such a great place to stay, with heaps of good restaurants and bars nearby and only about a 25 minute train ride into Manhattan. I spent way more time there than I thought I would.
Thanks Leah

Leah has a beautiful apartment. She was very flexible regarding handing off the keys and checked in with us to be sure we had no questions. It was a perfect location for us.

The only downside was loud neighbors one of the nights. Otherwise it was a very positive experience
Leah was great! Very accommodating and only a text away if we had any questions. Apartment was very cute and very clean. Loved the neighborhood. Would definitely recommend!

Leah was wonderful! She was very fast with responses and issues with our arrival time. She made sure we got the keys right at the door and showed us around.

Apartment was super cute, clean.

Lea was great! made me feel comfortable, always asked if i need something and everything is OK.
very nice apartment and neighborhood, very close to M train.
I had great time!
Absolutely LOVED our stay at Leah's place! She is an incredible host, and the apartment is so nice! Much bigger than we thought it was going to be, and we loved every minute of it :)

We had a pleasure of staying at Leah's apartment for 2 weeks! And though we didn't see Leah in person she was always in touch and asking how we were and if everything was ok! It was really nice! The apartment had a good location, it was clean and looked just as on the pictures. Our overall experience was great and we would totally recommend staying there!!

Very spacious 1br apartment that's very convenient to the train, a sizable grocery store, and only a few minutes walk from some very trendy night spots. Unbeatable for the price. And an extremely nice host!
I had a great stay at Leah’s place. Nice comfortable space, close to shops and transport. Leah was friendly and very helpful.

We had a great time at Alex's apartment. The home was perfect for us--each room was comfortable and offered complete privacy. Everything was clean and all necessary amenities in the bathroom and kitchen were provided. Audrey was a fantastic host and was always checking to make sure we were comfortable.

Perfect home , perfect area, perfect neighbors , and perfect host! Everything was super easy as far as checking in and checking out. Hospitality was awesome Alex texted to make sure everything was going well and if I needed anything. Would definitely recommend this place

We stayed for a week and it was a great little place to stay in.
If you're looking for something a bit outside of the city I highly recommend it. It's also very close to the subway and some 24h stores.

The place was great, well kept, excellent location and neighborhood. Just a short train ride from anywhere you wanted to go. I love the place and would definitely recommend it to anyone. If coming back I would definitely stay here again! Thank you so much

The place was cozy easy to get to. It was clean and spacious enough for my friends and I. Even we didn't use it much but the computer with internet access and printing was great. Quiet neighborhood, however, the parking was very difficult. We noticed that NY plates parked exactly where we parked more than 5 feet of the fire hydrant didn't get a ticket but once we parked there with our out of state plates we got $115 each (2 cars). Other than that, we will stay at this place again.
The place was really clean and well put together. I would defiantly stay there again. The host was very good with the communication and making sure everything was going well.
Great place to stay I’m reserving this place for my next trip to ny .Very clean and comfortable and the host was well mannered.

Convenient apartment in Brooklyn in a residential area with 3 rooms and a convenient kitchen, where you can have breakfast and lunch. Well located next to the subway A and J. A little bit far from Manhattan. Specific attentions for the guests. Good value for money.

We were fine on the house. It is well connected to the metro and it fits perfectly the need of 6 people.
Thank you Alex!

Everything perfect.. house was better than expected.. great Host!! Not so safe neighborhood.. we stayed 3 days.. 2 out of 3 days there was some kind of shooting and after that you could hear the police

This is a perfect getaway, very nice size and comfortable. The neighborhood is what it is, there are nice spots and not so nice spots, we didn’t ever feel threatened walking to the subway. Alex and his family were very helpful as we arrived earlier than check in and someone met us to let us freshen up before we took on Manhattan .
Enjoy
Appart exactly as  described. Easy access to the subway lines C & J. Very clean, host is very reactive and helped out when we were delayed.
Alex & his family’s place was very clean. They also let us check in our bags before check-in which made exploring the city significantly easier.   I would absolutely stay here again.

Alex and Family’s apartment is a large 3 bedroom with a bathroom and a kitchen/dining area. Each room has a tv which is nice. The apartment is spacious and was very clean and cozy.  The neighborhood is quiet and clean. Check in was a breeze. My family felt incredibly comfortable and cozy during their stair :)

This is a wonderful places to stay in NYC - I liked especially the patio, where I could relax after a day in the city, enjoying the warm summer evening. It is very quiet in the studio and on the patio, while the area around is very vibrant and offers good restaurants and interesting cultural centers like the Schomburg which is literally around the corner.
Highly recommended!
Very nice, clean studio apartment, was in a great area and very convenient to so many subway lines. Great corner fruit vendor for that nutritious breakfast. Would highly recommend Patricia’s place!

Very comfy place, we really enjoyed it a lot and if there is a next time we will look for the availability of this space. Patricia was very helpful and she responded quickly to our requests.
Thank you Patricia.

Did not enjoy my stay.
No parking available on site despite being advertised and it caused me to spent 160+USD to park in a lot. Unreliable street parking that has black out hours each day. Could not get anything reliable and felt my car was unsafe. Parking was the reason I chose this place and felt I was mislead unlike other properties in the area.
The entrance code change in the middle of my stay and I got locked out of the building at night!!!! I did not feel safe getting back into the building. New air bnb guests also burst in and tried to push past the doors when I tried leaving one morning.
Space was too small for four people. No cleaning supplies and excessive rules. Was not able to access to garbage area as directed within the end of stay instructions.
The place was not as advertised and I am very unhappy with my stay.
Very nice place in a quiet neighborhood, very near the subway station. It has a lovely garden and is nicely decorated.
Wonderful stay! It was very comfortable and the bamboo backyard is beautiful. The host communicated very well and the parking was free.

The neighborhood was perfect for us. Walking distance to cool bar, restaurants and patios.

The loft itself was ok for 4 people, however, we did not have any sheets on the beds when we first came in. We had to locate them and put them on ourselves. There also was a strong smell of cat urine in the corner of the loft. The tiny window did not get the smell away 3 days later...

The instruments were fun to have around.

Raviv was very accommodating for our party of three. He made sure we had an air bed for the third person, which was really comfortable. The apartment looks as it does in the photos, we were happy there and had a good time. Thanks.

The loft was absolutely fantastic. Really well located with some great bars nearby and a fantastic new coffee house directly across the road. A very short walk to the L train subway for easy access to the heart of Williamsburg and Manhattan.
Raviv's space is gorgeous and very comfortable - full of interesting books and art and instruments. Raviv was a great host, access to the apartment was simple and with wonderful instructions and reccommendations from Raviv about getting around and what's great in the area. Raviv was also really quick to respond to communication.
A wonderful place to stay and highly recommended.
super chill spot, easy to access and get in and out. Raviv was really easy and quick to communicate with and always got back to me really quickly.  i had everything i needed
I enjoyed my stay so much. Raviv was a great host, very attentive to my questions and concerns. The loft was awesome and the area was too cool!

Loved the neighborhood. The café shop RIGHT across the street is super convenient and their coffee is delicious. The location is very convenient to all the other NYC areas I needed to visit. I was in town for a music project my daughter is working on and had a lot of visitors coming and going all day (band members, production team, etc) -the loft never felt crowded, the space accommodated our needs.
