Raviv’s place was perfect for us in a industrial area in east Williamsburg loads of bars and food places nearby and a walk away from the river. Close to a metro we felt very well connected with the rest of NYC. Although a shock when sofas had replaced the second mattress this worked out well for us and provided more atmosphere in the room. Not too much privacy and a little stuffy in the heat due to a small window but we expected this in the NYC summer. We already want to return to NYC and definitely would stay at Raviv’s again!
Loved the space. Very central to many evening activities. Space was well equipped with everything needed for a couple of night stay.

Our family spent a couple days here on our way to Europe. Great stay. Enough space for the four of us, with the kids each on a couch. There is a lovely school playground just up the street that’s open when school isn’t in session. Really close to the L.
Perfect location and a lovely place to stay and nap. I hope I can find this place available again.

Absolutely loved this spot and would gladly stay again! The loft is super cozy and the couches are too. The building/location is great if you're an artist. There's a record store right across the street and a record player in the apartment, plus tons of books, artwork and instruments. Lots of great spots to walk too. Definitely recommend the Bee Sting pizza from Roberta's and DuckDuck for a drink!

Loved this space and sharing a building with a community of artists. My host was so kind and welcoming and the space was a creative’s dream. Loved having a piano. Great, chill neighborhood with lots to do and walk to! Great recommendations from the host!

Loved our stay here!  Was a perfect location and close to all the must have conveniences, food spots and subway to wherever you want to get to in NYC. This area of Brooklyn was really fun.  Would stay again!

Such a cool experience staying in this spacious and vibrant space. 5 minute walk or less to the subway, bars, restaurants - essentially anything you’d need. The hosts were very communicative as well and me and my group found the sleeping accommodations comfortable. Would def stay here again!

Olga's place is in a great neighbourhood, close to everything you could want including lots of great eateries and a nearby subway with an elevator so you don't have to struggle with luggage.It is just how it looks in the photos, the beds are comfy, it's clean and has everything you need. I was met promptly and shown how to use everything and then left to my own devices but I am sure if I had needed anything I could have easily asked. Great value!
Fantastic apartment in an amazing location.  We really enjoyed out time in New York and couldn't fault our accommodation or host they both made the trip perfect.

The apartment was excellent. Located in a great neighborhood with access to the entire city. The apartment was everything advertised, clean, and very comfortable. I don't know where you got that bedroom chandelier but it is exceptional.

Thanks!
J&J

Our stay at Olga's was great. The apartment is just like the pictures, absolutely lovely and couldn't have been in a better location. Really close to bars, restaurants and stores and near to a lot of subway stations. Olga was really nice and answered all of our questions online really quick. It was a great experience and can't wait to come back again. 100% recommended!

We had a great stay at Olga´s place, super location in Greenwich Village, very nice and cozy apartment and very good and responsive communication with Olga and Nir, no problem at all during the week - definitely recommendable!

Amazing location, so many restaurants and bars and yet the room is very quiet because it is in the back of the building. Easy access to subways. Room is typical of older buildings, but very well appointed with everything we needed. Definitely on our list for next trip.

What a great place to stay in NY! Their place is right in the middle of all the action, close to several different subway lines, and right next door to so many delicious restaurants. Their place was clean, spacious, and a perfect place to walk home to after a long day of touring the city. Thank you!

Olga's place made our dream of an extended stay in New York come true! When you are searching for the quintessential "real" experience of living in NYC, there is nothing better than this! We were warmly welcomed, and from the first moment in this studio, we felt at home. Not only is it ideally situated in the centre of cafes, restaurants and night life (if you want it), it is only a stroll to the amazing shops of SOHO and beyond. Each day you can walk in a 100 different directions, assured that you will return to a quiet, incredibly tastefully decorated, clean apartment, as secure and safe as an oasis. As hosts, Olga and Nir had exactly the right balance - always there if needed, checking in just in case - perfect communication. I cannot recommend Olga's place more highly. We were so sad to leave, and we are already dreaming of our next stay. Enjoy if you can!
Excellent choice for a delightful stay in New York City—the perfect location in Greenwich Village surrounded by historic buildings and delicious restaurants.
Best location!  Loved our stay and host was extremely kind and accommodating.  Great communication with prompt responses. Highly recommend this gem!

I was welcomed like Family and it truly felt like it. Come in, hang up your clothes and you’re already home. Everything looks just like the pictures. The apartment has everything you can think of and more. I stayed here for 6 weeks in winter and O and her Husband were always quick to help and always maintained such a loving, positive attitude. Many recommendations which I appreciated! Also, you’ll be in Greenwich village, you’ll never run out of things to do and places to explore. Despite being in such a lively location, the apartment itself is surprisingly quiet and private.
I wish I could Gatekeep this airbnb find but it’s too good not to share 💕💖
Genuinely the most welcoming and thoughtful host I've had on airbnb – couldn't reccomend more thoroughly. Very responsive and flexible. A great experience!

I stayed in this unit for one month. It's a great little spot in the heart of The Village - at the famous intersection of Bleecker and MacDougal.
My favorite things about this unit:
1) Location - it's literally right in the center of the action on Bleecker Street.
2) Exceptional quiet - despite being in the middle of a bustling neighborhood, the flat is located on the back side of the building, overlooking a completely silent courtyard. You cannot hear any noise from the city, or from the street. It's absolutely silent during every hour of the day. This is challenging to find in NYC!
3) Washer/dryer inside the unit - so amazing.
4) Very nice host! I met Nir multiple times, and he's a genuinely nice guy. He was super responsive to each text on What'sApp, usually replying immediately.

Simply wonderful month in this cozy and private apartment that is literally in the middle of everything. Easy walk to two central subway stations, parks and all of the wonderful restaurants and attractions that the West Village has to offer. Very responsive and kind hosts. Apartment is well equipped and  has everything for a comfortable stay.

This photo for this posting is very accurate and the bedroom/ensuite bathroom were very comfortable and spacious. The location exceeded my expectations as it was closer to Times Square than I had imagined however centered between TS and Hell's Kitchen which has excellent dining options and a vivid nightlife scene. The community kitchen was clean and modern. All of the facilities were clean and appeared to have been recently renovated. The wifi signal was weak and the television had what I think was basic cable however most of the channels were in different languages. Regardless, I didn't come to New York to watch television in my AirBnb. For the price, this place is worth it! Yasu and Akiko were very accommodating and easy to contact. If I come back to NYC I would most definitely return to this place!
Had a nice stay. The room was clean. Also, the surrounding area was not too noisy. It is louder on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights- but I was surprised by how quiet it was on other nights.

It was like on the pictures. I wasn't expecting a shower that big, it was nice. Towels changed every two days, perfect! When we arrived the appartement was realy clean. And the most important : the location is perfect!!!! Don't hesitate to book a room :-)
Very nice and quite place to stay. Very near time square. many restaurant around the place. No disturbance from owner. We did not even see them. very clean place . Good for family.

Very clean and convenience location.
Easy to enter and leave.
But I have had a little problem because of outside club sound.
I would like to recommend to you guys to bring your earphone for in case!
Thank you so much Yasu & Akiko for the hosting! Grace and I had a good time. The location is amazing. The cleaning lady is very nice, we appreciate her service. Happy holidays!!

The place is located at a busy street but is not overly noisy. Everything in the room is very clean and the sheets smell like newly washed. It was a very pleasant stay and I would recommend it to others!
The place has an excellent location, everything was excellent but the bed that was very noisy and uncomfortable.

Great accommodation with a perfect location to discover Manhattan.
If we ever come back to NYC, we are sure we will stay here.

Its a really neat and clean apartment, check in was seamless and convenient to leave your luggage after check out if your flight is still awhile later. Location was perfect too, short walk to Times Square, and many restaurants and eateries to check out in the vicinity. Shower heads might need an upgrade though, but all in all, my gf and I had a great stay! :)

Just several blocks away from Times Square, lots of nice restaurants/bars around the apartment.  Particularly appreciated the smooth check-in/out system (they had services that allows you to keep your luggage after checking out) Thanks for the amazing stay!

I felt safe inside your place. Every morning I could smell a nice scent coming from the laundry room:)
I also had no problems with the nosies this was probably because I stayed on the third floor. Your housekeeper was very nice. Lastly, your stairs is steeper than I expected..Lol. Overall, everything was great. Thank you!
Everything was perfect, clean and súper well location near The subway. I have always had feedback for all i asked and The house its really confortable. I will repite in The future!

John's place is a dream for anyone who wants a cool, light-filled apartment from which to reach Brooklyn and Manhattan with great ease. The space itself is cosy, bright and comfortable with a super-charming view of the NY skyline from the sun-trap balcony. The surrounding area is buzzing, visually spectacular and bristling with everything you'd want for a short stay. John was also really helpful and available for advice. Perfecto!
Stayed here for 5 weeks & found a home! Nice area, great host, stylish apartment, everything was just perfect! Will definitely stay here again next time I come to NYC! Thank you John & Javier!

As advertised and John is a good host. We had everything we needed and he was always quick to help us if we had a problem. For the price, we did well here... safe, quiet, relaxing stay, even during the pandemic.

We were staying at John's place for a month , very nice place for a couple. The apartment is very functional and well equipped, dish washer, washing machine ,comfy bed , amazing view and small balcony for morning coffee which is a big bonus. It's located in the Dumbo neighborhood , with a lot of cute bars , restaurants and 10 min walking from the ferry . It's one station apart from Manhattan by F train. John is an excellent host, very responsive and generous. Next time we come to New York we will be happy to stay in John's place again!

This Airbnb is super conveniently-located close to coffee shops, restaurants, and the river park, and it’s a quick ride into Manhattan. I was very comfortable in the place because its kitchen is well-appointed, there’s a good HVAC system, nice balcony, and good washing machine for laundry. John is a very communicative host and does all he can to make sure you have a great stay. I’d highly recommend this Airbnb!

Moe was a great host! He came promptly when I told him we arrived opened up and handed the keys over! The apartment was spacious and very clean. The beds were comfortable. My friends and I weren't really in the apartment much we went to the city and just came back for bed. Moe was very responsive with every and any questions I had. I would definitely stay there again and recommend my friend also.

Staying at moes place was nice! subway was right downy street like 3 house down I love Brooklyn and Manhattan was fun thank you moe for letting us stay at your place we are for sure coming again and staying there
LOVED IT!!!
Its a nice apartment, very clean and near the subway station. The host is nice too, We got the key, and lived, at the date for checkout, he checked the room and we left. very easy and convenience.

Moe's place was perfect for our group as it was close to the D line that took us straight into Manhattan and was large enough for our group of 5. Nothing fancy, just a clean, straightforward place for people who just need somewhere to rest at night. Moe was quick to response and we had a great stay.

Moe had good communication from the beginning. Although air conditioning at the time was not a service provided with the apartment, he brought a unit over without even having to request it. He installed it and made sure it was functioning properly prior to leaving. He was able to answer all questions we had about the local neighborhoods. There are two bedrooms, one has one queen bed the other has two queen beds. There is a living room with a futon. A long kitchen where there is a fridge, sink and stove for use. The bathroom functioned well, even with five people staying there. It was an extremely easy walk to the MTA and there is a Dunkin Donuts right on the corner near the entrance. The neighborhood was quiet at night and was kept tidy. Would stay here again when visiting NYC.

Arriving was smooth. A safe neighbourhood, mostly Asian families live in.
The apartment was not clean at all. However with the price you pay you should expect more.

Incredibly open to questions and communicates well. really nice and easy check in and check out. Three beds and two bedrooms with an open space centrally for tv and wifi. Kitchen is decent and 1 bathroom. Excellent value and right by the metro for the D line which is ~ 50 min to manhattan

Great little spot for the price, in a safe neighborhood. Moe was nice, albeit a bit late at check in though very apologetic. The place was a bit far, but was a bargain considering Brooklyn. Very close to the D line. Would stay again...thanks!

It was a homely place to stay. Good to experience life in Brooklyn. There's Dunkin donut and Chinese fast-food place nearby. Few houses away from the metro.
But place is 45mins away from Manhattan by metro. But for the price was a great deal.

Place was accurately described and hosted my friends, and I with no issues. Moe was promptly available when we needed him, otherwise gave us our space. I would recommend this place, and will look to staying here again.

Moe was a great host I made a request to him and in a matter of minutes he showed up very clean place however the bathroom needed to be remodel and the refrigerator wasn’t cooling too much great location only 40 min Manhattan and great delis around us
It seemed like a family friendly neighborhood. Moe was really easy to reach and we all appreciated how close the subway was!

Moe’s place is a simple and clean apartment about 45 mins to an hour train ride in the heart of Manhattan. Conveniently located just a block from the train. We enjoyed our weekend stay. Limited cooking utensils, best to consider ordering in dinner.
We had a great stay. Enjoyed our time spent there. The Apt. was clean and had everything we needed. Beds were super comfy. Will look to stay there again in the future.

Moe was a great host and the place was amazing. It accommodated my family perfectly. The place was spacious and very clean. Also the neighborhood was great (great food and parks were nearby for the kids). Overall it was a great stay. Will definitely book again.

It was a great place to stay, just near the subway and easy to travel along.
Definetily a good place to return back.
Only issue I had was to find the parking spot. But other than that I would recommend it.
The location could not be better, steps to so many great subway lines, shops, cute bars and restaurants. Located on a quiet street, the building is great. Benjamin is a great host.
Terrific cozy and clean spot but parking is really difficult around the building. Loved my stay nonetheless.

Great location and great communication with host. The biggest issue for us was that the bed was extremely uncomfortable and of poor quality and we had to sleep on the couch to not have a backache.  It would also be great if the host cleaned the apartment during our 2 months stay - not once was it offered that it would be cleaned for us.
Benjamin is great host , highly recommend it. Close to the subway , park and whole food. Lots of amazing restaurants walking distance.

Great place in a vibrant community. Very close to MTA and Ft Greene Park and great farmers market. Host is very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend for an authentic NYC neighborhood experience right out of a movie set.

Jenni's house was awesome! The location could not be better. We traveled to Jenni's house with our two very young daughters and our nanny and we all fit in the house very comfortably. My girls loved playing in the back yard. The only downside to the house if you are with young children is that there are a lot of ungated stairs - we had to get clever with using a pack-and-play to block the staircase.
The space felt open and bright and very bohemian chic. There are several great restaurants, bars, parks...you name it...right outside of your door. If you are coming with children, this is such a pleasant neighborhood to visit!
Jenni was a responsive and helpful host. She got back to me with any question I had promptly and helped me set up a cleaner while we were there.
This is a great place and I wouldn't hesitate to book immediately!

Jenni's house was perfect for our family vacation.  The house is lovely, with real character.  It has charming furnishings, lots of space, comfortable beds and good bathrooms. The location is fabulous, with easy walking to restaurants, cafes, bakeries and markets, including a Trader Joe's and Union Market, and there is fast access into Manhattan. Jenni was very nice and very easy to communicate with, which made the  booking process smooth and efficient, setting my mind at ease when booking our international family get-together.  We were all able to relax and enjoy the house and the neighborhood.   Only one suggestion, to provide a toaster and tea kettle to speed up breakfast prep!  I would thoroughly recommend Jenni's place to anyone and I hope we will be able to visit again.

Rachel was great to work with. Very responsive and pleasant. We were the first people to stay in the apartment so there were a few things missing and she very quickly responded to our requests and provided them. The apartment is gorgeous and well-kept. Highly highly recommend.

Rachel was great to work with. Very responsive and pleasant. We were the first people to stay in the apartment so there were a few things missing and she very quickly responded to our requests and provided them. The apartment is gorgeous and well-kept. Highly highly recommend.

This place has very good location.  10 minutes walk to Columbia University.  2 blocks away from subway line 1.  The Riverside park is a block away.  Lots of restaurants and stores around.  The host Rachel responses quickly every time I contact her.  I forgot a pair of glasses in the apartment and contacted Rachel.  She got it returned to me.  Appreciated.
Really great spacious place. The location is perfect with being close to a park and yet the city being very accessible with the subway near by. Super safe and peaceful neighborhood!

Our stay with Autumn was great. The apartment was exactly as pictures and perfect for a long weekend in the city. Upon arriving we met with Erik, Autumn's husband, and helped us up the 6 flights of stairs. He gave us a quick run through of the apartment and was even kind enough to take us on the roof and point out places nearby. The location is great and close to a lot of the bars of the LES and as compared to other places in the LES it's a lot more quieter considering. But I would definitely stay with Autumn and Erik again!! :)

Erik and Autumn welcomed us into their location with such gracious and thoughtful invitations. The apartment was exquisitely clean and appropriate for my mother! The roof appealed to our desire to see the lights. The neighborhood made it easy for metro travel.

Autumn was very helpful and quick to respond for the entire lead up to my visit and during my visit as well-- (even though she was on Shanghai time).  The studio was just as nicely put together as it looks in the pictures and felt like a steal for what I paid.  I will definitely think of Autumn and this studio the next time I need to visit NYC.

Autumn's studio is a really clean and homely place which has been furnished with great love and care. The place was well-stocked with linen, basic utensils and coffee, etc. It is a very short walk to subway stations, which was super convenient. My parents and I had a wonderful, very comfortable stay!

Autumn did a wonderful job of making sure we were comfortable and gave us some great tips on the area and getting settled. It is a six floor walk up, so you should be ready for a lot of stairs. You can hear the street noise, but it's New York City so that's pretty much a given. The couch folds into a bed that was petty comfortable. All in all, the location is really convenient to public transportation.

It is a really lively and hip area, perfect for going out and easy access to midtown manhattan, apartment has everything you need and the beds are comfy. The climb to the 6th floor wasn't as bad as we thought

This place is located near a lot of spots to have breakfast, grab coffee, and near subway, which is very convenient. Autumn was able to let us check in early since our flight got in pretty early. It was greatly appreciated! The flights of stairs were a good daily workout too. Everything was as expected and the place very clean :)
It's the perfect little room. It's got all the necessities for a good, cheap, stay.
Simple check in. Stairs are a real nuisance. Otherwise, it's a comfy place with everything including cookware provided. Would recommend if you want to be right in (IMO) the heart of the city.

Great LES location halfway between all you want to see in midtown and lower Manhattan. Plenty of good independent cafes/coffee houses nearby. Apartment is basic but all you need for a few nights, clean and as described. Autumn was a great host, very communicative and responsive, helped us with a few queries about activities during our stay and checked in to make sure we had settled in okay.  We had a great stay!

We enjoyed our Thanksgiving stay at Autumn’s cozy very-Manhattan studio in Chinatown. It had classy decorations, hot water, a good amount of kitchen supplies, though having sugar might be nice for coffee and tea, etc.  The space heater and extra blankets were very valuable, and we certainly got our daily workout on the stairs.  I slept on the futon and found it comfortable with a layer of blankets. There was easy key pickup/drop off at a location nearby. This was one of the easiest ways to enjoy Manhattan!

Autumn place was great. No problem locating the subway and walking distance to everything else   The studio was warm cozy and just right  Grocery stores all over to stock up on bkfst and snacks. We would stay at autumns again
The host is very nice, and responds to sudden problems really quickly. Def recommend this place to others.

The Autumn's apartment is a perfectly located well equipped studio. It's in Chinatown and just 15 min walk from SoHo. There are plenty of spots just around the corner: bars, coffee places, restaurants, groceries stores. The few metro stations are at 5-10 min walk and you can easily reach the touristic spots of NYC.
My friend and I had an amazing stay at Autumn's apartment and I recommend it 100%!

Autumns place was perfectly located. Grand st subway station was only two blocks away which made it extremely convenient to get to where we wanted to go. There were plenty of places to eat and drink walking distance. Autumn communicated well and over all we just enjoyed our stay through and through. Thanks again autumn!
Really nice apartment. Autumn was a very nice host, giving us a lot of recommendations and things to do and to see around.

Autumns apartment was awesome- clean, comfortable, stocked with basic amenities and in a great location. There’s plenty do within walking distance and subway stations nearby to get uptown or to Brooklyn easily. Checking in and out was easy and Autumn was very communicative. Her guide for around the neighborhood was helpful too! I would recommend a stay here, don’t let the flights of stairs scare you away ;)

Autumns place was great! It was exactly like the pictures she put up. It was a small studio but had everything we needed. Only con would be the flights of stairs you need to walk up. It was pretty noisy since there is always traffic outside and cars honking. So glad her place got an AC because it was pretty hot when we came to NY about 90 degrees everyday this past week. I would totally recommend autumn’s place to anyone whose coming to New York.

Our stay with Autumn was very convenient: great location, the pictures are accurate and the place is clean. Key pick up and drop off is super easy. It’s on a main road so you hear the city at night, but it’s New York so it’s expected. The 6 flights of stairs can be tedious, but it gave me a good workout while on vacation so it’s all good. Thank you for everything, Autumn.
We had a good time in Autumn’s tiny studio, though, as mentioned in previous posts, it is quite noisy due to the street and a window frame that needs some fixing. Don’t forget your earplugs !
Great neighborhood. Good location. About what we expected for the price, but six floors is a lot to climb if you're coming and going.
Excellent location and a very cozy apartment. Highly enjoyed my stay here and would definitely recommend to others!

The location was great and Autumn was very helpful in directing us to nearby restaurants, bars, etc. The key pickup and dropoff was super easy and convenient. The only thing is the stairs going up to the apartment are no joke, so able-bodied guests are a must. (seriously hit the stairstepper a few times before you go, or potentially be hit with a humbling dose of reality regarding your fitness)
Loved this adorable space! Made us feel like we had a true New York experience! It is a 6 floor walk-up so be prepared but it was not bad at all!
Autumn place is in a perfect location. We were close to public transit and in walking distance to NYU and many wonderful restaurants! I would definitely stay there again!
Communication was super and host was really flexible. Kitchen was great and apartment had everything as described. Place is really noisy, mainly due to traffic in the street.
Nice apartment 10 minutes walk from soho. Small and noisy at night but good value for money. Communication with Autumn is quick and easy.
This studio is perfect for a couple or solo traveler who will be out and about most of the day. Clean and great location for catching the subway.

The location is perfect for enjoying lower east side and soho area. While my first thing was to go Traderjoe's... And you can also get China town discount. If you are familiar with NYC old appartment, you would find nothing to complain as you can also use the roof top like your backyard. Autumn took care of my safe and convenient stay all the time. Everything perfect for me.
Great place, super cute and trendy! Great area and great guide to activities and places! Had an awesome stay!

Autumn’s apartment is conveniently located to explore NYC by subway. It’s between uptown, downtown and fairly close to Brooklyn Bridge.
The surrounding buildings look a bit off putting with shuttered stores but once inside it’s a regular studio apartment.

NYC is opening up after COVID lockdown so we spent almost all our time exploring the city rather than in the apartment.
Amber was out of town but responsive by message to help out when required.
Autumn’s airbnb is in the perfect location! Lots of great restaurants and bars near. Very close to the subway as well. Great communication and quick replies. Loved my stay!

Accommodating host and a very conveniently located Airbnb! The place was very clean, perfect size to rest for 2 to even 3 people (a friend crashed over one night with us 2 roommates). Located in and a walk away from so many amazing neighborhoods. Would definitely recommend this place and myself will be likely coming back to it in the future as well!

This is a great deal on a really good location. There are some stairs so if that is an issue for you look elsewhere but if that doesn’t bother you I recommend Autumn’s place for your stay on the lower east side.
Cute studio apartment in a great location!  Host was great with communication and gave great recs. Very easy check in and out process. Would definitely stay here again!

Autumn was a great host to her apartment in Lower East Side. She was easily accessible with any questions, and her guide book has a lot of good restaurant ideas to try local food and drinks.
The apartment was very clean, and organized, easily can have two people staying in there comfortably. A good spot to get the subway, or a taxi (whichever you prefer).
Thank you once again for sharing your space with us!
Good place! The apartment is nice and clean. The building is a bit messy and could be cleaner,  but it is very well located. Nice for visiting the city for a few days.
Good location. Close to everywhere. The atmosphere around is a bit stressful. Especially in the evening, but get use to it. The host was attentive

Nice little place in Chinatown. The flat was very clean and the view from the rooftop was just stunning! Sunrises from up there are just wow! There are some really nice places for cocktails and food in the area! :)

Nice studio, perfect for a few days in the city. The space feels like a hotel room with the bonus of a kitchen.
Space heater and extra blankets were perfect for chilly nights.
Some noise from the street and neighbors, also 6th walk up...but if you're familiar with city living it's no problem.
Autumn was fantastic! Extremely responsive and resourceful! Apartment is in a great location within walking distance to the metro, great restaurants and any number of things you may want to do!
Great place, conveniently located close to bars at Orchard St and several subway stations. Only downside was that the airco is a bit loud and not super powerful.
Autumn’s place was really nice, everything as described. The stairwell and the surrounding streets are a bit dirty.

My friend and I stayed at Fatu's home in Brooklyn. We spent 6 nights and our stay was thoroughly pleasant. Fatu and her family are welcoming and attentive. This was my first experience of Airbnb and I was not disappointed. The house is well
Located in Brooklyn and the street sits between two different subways, making access into Manhattan quick and easy. We felt very safe walking around the neighbourhood. There are some great places to eat. However, Fatu's home has a well equipped kitchen if you prefer to eat in.

My Dad stayed in Fatu's place on his first visit to NYC.  He was very happy with the room and the kitchen was very clean and well stocked.  He found Fatu very friendly and helpful and had a great stay.
It was a great place, convenient location near public transportation near stores and coffee shops. Fatu is very friendly and helpful.
Absolutely loooooooved my stay with Fatu and her family! They are amazingly warm and kind people!
It is a coasy room, clean and tidy. I'd stay there again that's for sure. Fatou is a great person and she is happy to help out and or give advice. I enjoyed my stay :3

Stayed here for one night on a Wednesday to attend an event at the Botanical Garden - it was such a nice midweek adventure! My friend and I were able to walk around the block to a nice Indian restaurant, and in the morning we tried a local coffee shop before getting on the subway to go to work.
Fatou's place is nice and cozy, and on a quiet street. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

Great airbnb! Good amenities, comfortable sleep. The location is excellent with cafes, restaurants and grocery stores nearby while the airbnb itself is on a quiet street. Very well connected to the city and airport with 7 subway lines in close vicinity. Smooth check in and checkout.
Fatou was accommodating and allowed me to drop my bags a bit early before check in. A nice stay for one night!
We enjoyed our stay. Fatou was welcoming and very helpful. Room was clean and we had good kitchen facilities. Allowed a late checkout .
The place was not described as how it was cameras inside no privacy and didn’t smell right it was uncomfortable do not recommend this Airbnb.
This place is exactly as advertised and was perfectly comfortable, private and clean.  Although I didn't use it, there is a complete kitchen.  I would stay here again for sure.

This was my first Airbnb experience and it was excellent. There is a private entrance which brings you right into a nice little kitchen. Ayman had a small basket of goodies on the counter including a few snacks, some water bottles, tea, sugar, toothpaste and other items. He was also kind enough to have a folder of local eateries available as well. I stayed with a friend who took the bed while I took the couch and we both slept well. The bathroom had some towels along with some shampoo and conditioner available to us. There is TV and WiFi available. My friend and I used Uber and had no issues getting from Ayman to the Staten Island Ferry. Overall I had an excellent experience and I would recommend Ayman for anyone looking to visit the city without paying city prices.
The basement apt was cute. I like that we were left to our own devices and that there was cable and Internet. I also really enjoyed the patio. Thanks for a pleasant stay!

We arrived tired to the apartment and meet a lot of peace and quiet was amazing.

Me Ayman, He was always present in everything we might need , it is a beautiful and unique place.

A unique atmosphere , great location, a 5 star service !!!

Thanks for the coffee , milk , tea, fruits, and in addition to all the amenities the apartment offers .

We recommend 100 %
Our host, Ayman, is quick to respond. Access to the house is pretty convenient and easy. The house was located in a nice neighborhood and was perfect. It had everything we needed.

Aymans place was exactly what we needed! It really it affordable
Luxury. Very clean, and welcoming. Nice neighborhood. We really enjoyed our stay! Thanks for having us Ayman!
Ayman's place was great, exactly as pictured. The studio decor was nice and we appreciated the extras like some cable channels, water, toothpaste, and fruit cups.
Will recommend this place to anyone! The apt was very clean and Ayman was very attentive. Enjoyed my stay.
Ayman’s place is very nice , everything you’d expect from a 5 star airbnb and more , looking forward to my next trip

Clean, cozy, well-appointed basement appartment in a nice neighborhood.
The Bus takes you to the Ferry Terminal in 20 to 30 minutes.
Ayman is a really nice host and answers questions very quickly.
The place was great! A lovely  and safe neighbourhood, great access to the city, a clean and cozy little pied-a-terre for a trip to the big apple 😁

The space was in a great location, parking was easy to find, and inside was just as advertised. The bed was a little short for two people over 6 feet tall but was comfy nonetheless. The kitchen was great and the bathroom provided all necessary amenities. I would highly recommend this space to anyone visiting SI.
Wonderful stay, exceeded my expectations. Ayman was available for any question I needed answered I don’t have a complaint. Thanks!

This place is in such a nice and quiet neighborhood, everything is very close by. The owner leaves out nice pamphlets for local food and places to sightsee nearby. Very clean and well kept and the extra amenities are a plus! 10/10
Outstanding accommodations! Extremely clean and very comfortable. Perfect location! I can't say enough. I will definitely return next time I'm in Staten Island.

Ayman's place was wonderful! The location was perfect. The buses run about a block up and takes you straight to the ferry. There is a park that was great for our morning jogs a block away. The space had everything we needed for our months stay. We felt safe and had an abundance of privacy. I strongly recommend this airbnb and would definitely stay again.

Ayman's unit is really close to the road with restaurants and cafes and just a bus ride away from the ferry terminal.  We were a little affected by the NY flooding during this time but Ayman was very responsive and personally saw that the place was cleaned and back to normal for us to spend the night.  We really appreciated the quick action by him.  We enjoyed our stay and recommend his place to anyone wishing to spend time away from NYC, or even if you wish to stay at Staten Island and go to NYC for the day.

Ayman is awesome!
What a cozy and great place. Bigger than pics show, and the kitchen had everything you could possibly need! Incredible deal.
I will be back when I work in Manhattan again.

The apartment is very clean and has everything, including paper towels, body wash, sponges, hand and dish soap, kitchen utensils, and spices. The bed was very comfortable. It is located in a quiet section of Staten Island, with lots of shopping and dining nearby. Parking is plentiful and nearby. Ayman is responsive and helpful. Overall my stay was pleasant. I gave my stay 4 stars rather than 5 because the heat could have been better.
Place was very clean and location was great. Ayman was a wonderful host, easy check in and easy to contact if need be. Lots of parking in the area.

We booked this place based on the reviews so I hope this one helps. It was our first time ever in NY. This place was 38 minutes from Times Square. 28 minutes to Battery Park where you board the ferry for the Statue of Liberty tour. We drove everywhere. Nothing was further than 35-40 minutes. The street is very quiet and the neighborhood seemed really safe. Safety is always our biggest concern when traveling. Ayman was more than accommodating and responsive. We asked for a later check out and he was able to extend our check out by an hour. The space is literally like a hotel room with a full kitchen it’s bigger than the picture makes it seem. The only thing is that there were no washcloths but plenty of towels. My husband had to drive to the nearby Target to grab wash (7minutes away). Overall we had a great 3 nights stay and our son loved it.
Right next to the bus! Clean, lots of beds, spacious, comfortable and he is very responsive. Great stay!

Spectacular offering that is as good as the pictures suggest!
The room is spacious and warm, the bathroom (water temp/pressure etc.) are all on point, and the kitchen is equipped for most anything you need.
The whole setup is very clean as well.
The rate is super affordable when compared to the competition of the city.
Ayman is an awesome, welcoming host who is super responsive.
Note I did not have a car on my trip.
The location in Staten Island is the only drag, and it takes a bus/ferry to get direct access to Manhattan, or another bus that skirts out of SI, through Brooklyn, into Manhattan. Be prepared to embark SUPER EARLY to commute to your engagements. Leaving the AirBNB two hours early blind, or timing the buses correctly, were the healthiest methods for me.

We were the first guests at Beverly's comfortable 3rd floor apartment! The apartment was just as described. It's clean, spacious for 2, with an extra bed in a side-bedroom next to master bedroom. Beverly took care of our needs promptly. The apartment is also not far from the subway station. There are many nice restaurants in the neighborhood that Beverly recommended to us. We would recommend this apartment for short stay in Brooklyn.
Beverly & Paul were wonderful hosts, excellent communication and the house was very convenient. We had a great stay and would recommend it.

We had a fantastic few days in New York. Bev's flat was perfect for us - very spacious and beautifully finished. We enjoyed to ride to Brooklyn - the subway was very easy to negotiate. Never and her family gave us a very warm welcome and were very helpful with practical recommendations for travel, groceries and eating out. Highly recommended!

We really loved this place! Nice sunny place in peacuful area of Brooklyn surrounded by many bars and restaurants. i really recommend Sunday service in church just across the street.
We really appreciated apartment during 2 rainy days.
Apartment is really well equiped and is really spacious for 2 people. It can even fit more people without a problem.
Beverly is very helpfull and around all the time.
Hopefully i will come back soon.

This is a lovely, roomy and airy third floor apartment in a beautiful brownstone on a quiet street in a great neighbourhood. Beverly was very welcoming and helpful with suggestions for places to eat and things to do in Brooklyn. It's a short walk to Utica metro station where you can catch the A train into Manhattan. Be sure to visit the great Brooklyn Museum, grab a coffee at the Sarghina Bakery (close to the apartment - they also have a very god restaurant), catch live music at LunaTico, and we recommend delicious Trini roti at Ali's on nearby Fulton.
Bev and Paul are really nice hosts. My parents and I love the place and the neighborhood.

Me and my friend stayed here for a month. We really enjoyed the warm welcome from Beverly. She is amazing host! Very friendly and helpful, and gave great tips to the neighborhood. We had everything we needed for a wonderful stay.
The place was super clean and cozy with tons of natural light. lt is located in one the beautiful brownstones in a charming green neighborhood.
Would definitely love to stay here again in the future!

Bev is a fantastic host, she made us feel at home and gave us great tips for the local area.
The apartment is large, clean and had everything we needed.
Thanks Bev!

Beverly was a very communicative host and was flexible with our check-in and check-out. She also had great local recommendations and thoughtful touches around the apartment for our arrival. The main bedroom is on a busy avenue so if you’re a light sleeper you’ll want a noise machine.

I stayed at Beverly’s place when I first moved to nyc and she was a phenomenal host throughout the entire stay! From before I even arrived, Beverly was incredibly responsive and provided lots of recommendations for the area. She made sure the place was well setup for me when I arrived late at night and helped with getting into the apartment. She was warm, welcoming and friendly and really went out of her way to make the place feel like home. I couldn’t recommend Beverly’s place more!

By far the best experience I have ever had on Airbnb. The apartment is in top shape, spacious and the view is awesome. It is close to everything: times square, delis, shops, museums, metro, etc. Salvatore, the host, was very helpful. Overall 10/10!

This was a great place to stay in New York. The apartment was perfect, very clean and fresh and just like the photos. Maribel lived downstairs so it was easy to get in touch with her and she sorted out anything we needed. The location was fantastic - very close to one subway line and pretty close to two others. The street was real Harlem - guys playing dice on the street at night or sitting out on their front steps. Everyone was very friendly; it felt completely safe at any time. Some great places to eat in the neighbourhood. When I come back to NYC, this is where I want to stay!

The place is so great and I'll never forget the good time I spent in New York! Maribel welcomed us with a bottle of fine wine and bagels and fruits! They are just delicious!! The place is in Harlem and very convenient to every must go places. We've been to the met twice and it worths that!! Overall, we love the place and it looks exactly the same in the pictures.

I stayed here for 5 nights as I was working on 29th street for the week. My wife Carol was supposed to come with me but could not at the last minute. Mirabel's place was immaculate and well appointed with everything a traveler needs. It's location is handy to the 2 and 3 trains to take you downtown in 20 mins, 6 stops to Penn Station at 34th. And it is only 9 short blocks to Central Park. There is a supermarket 2 blocks away. In a crowded city this apartment was felt spacious and well lit. The bedding was super comfortable and lux. It felt like the Ritz! There is a reason Mirabel's place is booked months ahead. I'd definitely stay here again.

Beautiful place to stay. If you forgot something, be sure they have it in the apartment: from the hairdryer to the shower gel. Everything is like at the hotel and better. Complimentary cream cheese and bagels made our mornings. In general, we've gotten more than we expected.

I really recommend Maribel 's place !very well located 2 min walking from the subway .Good neighbourhood .Matibel is very nice and helpful .She offered to keep our suitcases in her flat .When we arrived we had fresh drinks and foods to start our first night after a very long trip we really appreciated !If I come back in NYC this is the place I would like to come back.
really appreciate the awesome flat of Maribel, it was very clean, well equipped and cosy.  The food was excellent what she kept for us in the apartment and we had a great time there! Thank you!

Maribel house is situated in a living area of Haarlem. You reach the subway station of the 116th street within a 5 minutes walk. The eastern direction to 125th street is ok during day- in the evening we would not feel well in this area. The appartment is in the 3rd floor. A very nice place with enough space for a 3-4 persons family. We were wellcome very warmly: nice communication, good food waited for us, detailed information about supermarket, restaurants. ...Thank you very much Maribel

Great appartment with all amenities; spacious and very well equipped; absolutely clean; metro lines 2 and 3 just 5 minutes away, which bring you to Times Square in 20 minutes; several shops and restaurants in walking distance. Maribal is very friendly and helpful, and very quick to respond to any questions. All in all, we had an excellent stay and can recommend this appartment.

Amazing apartment. I stayed over from the UK and the place was huge compared to what i am used to over in London anyway. Bed was super comfy. Lovely kitchen and shower. Place was perfect for our week in NYC. Would definitely recommend :)

This is a very comfortable apartment with generous storage and tastefully decorated. Easy walk to Subway to get downtown. Plenty of info in the Apartment about what to do was really helpful for us first time New Yorkers. Thanks Maribel (and your husband) for being so helpful when our flights changed at short notice.

Maribel`s apartment is beautiful, we really enjoyed it! It`s very well equipped and nice decorated. The neighbourhood has everything you need including near trasnports that will get you everywhere. We had an amazing stay there!
Maribels place was amazing, clean, great location and she was an excellent host with the welcome package and super quick to respond to any queries we had. Would recommend to anyone visiting New York.

Our 1st time to NYC was a success with such a great relaxing space to return to on extremely hot days. Looked exactly like pictures. Good location and close to subway. Hosts went above and beyond with great snacks and essentials ( Milk,eggs) that helped us settle in without rushing to store after traveling . Would definitely recommend .

Was a great place. We didn’t spend much time in the condo as we were in the city for most of everyday. First time in the city so we weren’t sure what to expect but with an unlimited metro pass and a 5 minute walk to the subway during rush hour we made the most of our trip.
The best air bnb I have ever stayed at! Beautiful space, tons of amenities, and with a great host.

Maribel's apartment is a real gem in the newly-emerging Harlem.  The restoration of the brownstone is impeccable.  The unit is clean, thoughtfully furnished and well stocked.  Consideration to the true comfort of guests is clearly displayed.  The location places one close to all that Harlem has to offer as well as offering excellent proximity to public transportation for easy access to the rest of the city.  It was a great home away from home and we'd definitely consider booking again and also recommend the apartment to others.

Nice apartment at convenient street. Easy access to subways, grocery stores and coffee shops within walking distance. Good location to visit Columbia U.. Host is top responsive and the assistant lives in the 2nd floor probably.
No elevator to the 3rd floor. Ladies, olds need companies to move up the luggages if they are heavy.
Harlem area is not very clean yet safety is not an issue so far as I observed.
Maribel is a great hostess. The appartment is beautiful,very clean and has a great lication. Would definitely recommend staying here. We loved staying here.

This is an exceptional location. The apartment is well appointed and then design is great. Centrally located and within walking distance to many Harlem sites.If you are traveling by Uber , we waited no more than 3-5 minutes to take us to any location. In Manhattan. Maribel also has a great selection of maps, books, and guides to help you with your stay. It is a third floor walk up so be prepared to walk fights of stairs but you will be rewarded with a fantastic spacer.

Excellent all the way around. Great location in Harlem. Lovely neighborhood and friendly neighbors. Apartment is clean and has everything you need plus some:) Bed is super comfy, used the pull out bed one night and very comfortable. Loved the linens so I went and bought them for our vacation home. We have a rental car and once I learned the "alternate parking days" then even parking was a breeze! All around excellent!

Maribel was a great and thoughtful host. We enjoyed the local restaurants and the apartment was just a couple blocks from the subway, which we took everywhere! Such a convenient location and would definitely stay again!

This is a beautiful apartment in a really vibrant neighbourhood. The apartment itself is especially well equipped with lots of thoughtful touches such as toiletries, milk, butter and water in the fridge. The bed is amazing 🤩 Maribel even left us a really good bottle of wine and chocs . The location is fantastic a short walk to 116th subway stop and if you walk in the other direction to 125th there are some really fantastic bars. We loved The Corner Social and the Harlem Tavern.
Welcoming, stylish spot with thoughtful touches. Great place to stay in New York close to the subway and one of the best coffee shops and bagel spots. Highly recommend!

The unit is clean, stylish, spacious, and conveniently located near the subway. Maribel was an excellent hostess—she responded quickly to our few questions and allowed us to leave our bags onsite with her while we spent a few hours in the city between checkout and our flight. Highly recommend!

Gorgeous quintessential brownstone that is in flawless condition.  I was not disappointed.  Maribel was an amazing host who was well organized, friendly, and available.  I highly recommend this for your next trip!
Please stay here‼️ The BEST HOST EVER‼️‼️  Everything was beautiful and clean. Maribel and her husband went above and beyond. 💜

This place was everything our host, Maribel, said it would be -- and then some! Set in the heart of historic Mt. Morris Park in Harlem, the brownstone on the third floor is truly a gem. Cozy, comfortable, amazing decor and all of the accoutrements of home!
Maribel was the ultimate host. In addition to a wonderful space that my husband and I had the pleasure of enjoying for a week, she welcomed us with a bottle of Sauvignon Blanc, breakfast treats, fruits, information on the best places to eat and see in the area, and so much more.
I would recommend this home on any given day!
Great place to stay in Manhattan, I wouldn't hesitate to go back. Maribel is an excellent host.
This is one of the best Air BnBs we have ever stayed in. Everything was exactly as described and Maribel was a kind and responsive host. We will definitely stay here again!!

Great place to stay, clean and very nice.  Very close to the subway 2 and 3, thatll take you straight to timesquare (15-20 mins) or to pier 11, where you can take ferry.  Was able to take subway to yankee stadium (20 mins) to and from.   Also bus stops near by, if taking the metro.
Maribel was a very attentive host. The flat was very spacious, clean and well equipped. Perfect for a family stay in NY. Easy subway access to all the main sites in NY.

Maribels apartment was just perfect for our first visit to NYC. The apartment was clean, spacious and equipped with everything we needed.   The small details made our stay perfect. The croissantbread was delicious ;-) we would definitely book this apartment again for a future stay in the city. Thanks a lot!
We had a great time in NYC. The apartment was cozy, the kitchen great. The next subway is close by and there are plenty of restaurants in the area.
Great place, well situated, and close to multiple subway stations. Bobby was a great host and super accomodating. Would definitly stay here again.
Great hosts! 100% great value for money. Very comfortable and homely. No issues what so ever. Very easy going

My boyfriend and I had a great stay at Bobby's place.  Close to the subway and good restaurants in the area.  The bed was extremely comfortable and it was warm in the apartment (our stay was in December).
Bobby is a good host. The place is located next to the subway station and supermarket - it is a very residencial area in Brooklyn. The apartment is fine and the bed is very comfortable :)
Bobby was always at hand to help with any issues I had, great communication and all round good guy
No issues whatsoever and Bobby answered promptly to my questions. Good location near subway system and other supermarkets.
Bobby's apartment is in a nice Brooklyn neighborhood and is very spacious. The beds are very comfortable but the space is a little outdated. Thank you Bobby for having us!

What a great spot! The place was clean, comfortable and roomy. Full kitchen, new bathroom, and an extra bed if you need it! Bobby was an attentive host, answered all our questions immediately, and made our stay smooth and hassle-free. The location is really awesome. Beautiful tree-lined block in historic bed-stuy, with none of those crappy new condos that have infested the area - just the gorgeous old brownstones brooklyn is famous for. 5 minute walk to the G means you have access to williamsburg, green point, fort Greene within 15 minutes, and cobble hill, downtown BK, gowanus, and carroll gardens in 20. Union square is 30min door to door. Would definitely recommend if you are trying to experience brooklyn like a local.

Very good experience! Bobby always answered in between minutes and was always super helpfull!
Thank you for everything!

Grace's place is a place of grace and joy! We thoroughly enjoyed our time and her positive space. Immediately upon meeting Grace and stepping into her home, we felt very welcomed and warm, it's a vibe. The pictures you see of her place are real!! We very much recommend hitting the reservation button. Cheers!

Grace was fantastic! Her location is perfect near transportation and near good food! Overall, Grace was kind and super quick to respond to any questions we had. Her apartment is comfortable and clean. I would highly recommend Grace's to anyone that's looking to stay in New York city.
Grace's home is charming, in front of a pleasant park. Grace has been flexible about the check-in / check-out. It was for me a great opportunity to discover Spanish Harlem and its culture.

Grace's home fronts right on a very nice park. The street is nice. The apartment is also nice. Not too far from public transit and quite close to many CitiBike stations which makes travels easy.
Grace required meeting in person to check in and despite calls and texts ahead of time, was about 20 minutes late.
She was also unclear about the check-out procedure, including not having any information in the AirBnB description, and had an incredibly negative attitude when I did not do it correctly. I left the apartment unlocked, which was admittedly not the smartest thing, but I did not know to do otherwise.
Very nice area, lot of parks, grocerie stores, restaurants, malls.  Very near to the train stations.  Grace is very kind person, in fact we got at her place more than we were waiting for.
Bobby’s place was clean, spacious, hassle free ,excellent communication. Close to public transportation.

We had a great time staying Bobby's apartment and exploring New York. The apartment was clean, spacious with full kitchen, nice bathroom, and super comfy bed. Nice location, just 5 minutes walk to G-line subway and you can go to Manhattan and other NYC areas easily. Another bonus point is there were a lot of grocery stores and food deli around his place, just convenient.
We are very happy to be 5 Days at Bobbies. It is a great place to discover Manhatten and Brooklyn. Much Space, very clean and a cosy bed. We enjoyed!

Absolutely loved it - we highly recommend Bobby’s place. The neighborhood is cosy and quiet, the apartment has everything you need and we were very happy with our trip to New York. Thank you Bobby! We’ll come back!
This place is a true jewel. Clean, comfy, and convenient. Bobby was an exceptional host. I recommend this place highly.

Bobby’s place is spotlessly clean. The beds are really comfortable and made up with very nice linens.
He is a responsive host and makes checking in and out simple.
Great location including a fantastic coffee shop just 2 blocks away.
Thank you for such an enjoyable stay!
Apt location is pretty close to the LES and Union Square. The place was clean as promised and Chelsea was always available upon request. I recomend this place.
We had a great time visiting NY for a week thanks to Chelsea. Appartment is nicely situated and good value for money. The cat, Ziggy is awesome and Chelsea was a nice host.

Chelsea's place is super cute and cozy. Me and my friend really enjoyed coming back to the apartment after a long day. Also, Sig is one of the nicest cats I have ever met. You won't regret booking this apartment!!

Bobby’s apartment is a smart choice for anyone traveling to NYC! Reasonably priced, very close to two subway stops, extremely clean, surprisingly comfortable beds, and an efficient bathroom to boot. Bobby is a very responsive host and will take excellent care of you.

Bobby hosted my mother and brother while they were visiting my new baby. The beds are apparently as comfortable as all the reviews say, and the water pressure in the shower was worth remarking about. Bobby was very communicative through out their short stay and offered tons of advice about the neighborhood and Brooklyn in general. I would put them in Bobby's place again without a thought.

Bobby’s place was perfect for what I was looking for. It’s welcoming, clean, and has everything one needs for a comfortable stay in Brooklyn. On top of that, the price is great.
One of the best parts of this Airbnb is Bobby’s frequent and helpful communication. He was even available when I locked myself out of the apartment, and he took care of the situation instantly and with a smile. I Recommend Bobby’s place to anyone who wants a carefree trip to Brooklyn.

Bobby’s place was everything it said it would be. Clean, spacious and very accommodating. Bobby also gave a bunch of helpful tips. I would definitely recommend his place and will book with him again in the future.

Bobby’s hospitality was exceptional: extremely attentive with a strong attention to detail. He made sure I arrived safely and communicated well throughout my stay. Best of all, the apartment was immaculately clean, which really put me at ease during COVID-19. The space was super comfortable, especially the bed! Bonus: the apartment was pet-friendly, which delighted my cat Chiara who had to come along for the trip. Thank you, Bobby!

Spacious second floor flat with all the amenities a group of three or four would need to settle in. Beds are super comfy and space is quiet. Street parking available. Easy to get around. We were there to move a college student into the LES so didn’t have a lot of time to explore Bed Stuy but nearby cafes were plentiful (breakfast sandwich at Council Cafe was great), neighbors were friendly and it was a fun area to walk around. Neighborhood less congested than other places in Brooklyn I’ve stayed in. Bobby was easy to reach and helpful.
Great experience.  Everything was as explained up front.  The cat was fantastic.  A definite yes from me.
Nice place, responsive host and very good neighbourhood. If one is carrying heavy luggage it might get challenging as the apartment is on the first floor
Nice place in Brooklyn in a nice neighborhood. Perfect to discover the city or work . communication with Bobby is easy and check-in / checkout experience was flawless .

Bobby’s place was awesome. It was close to the subway and the neighborhood was so beautiful. The apartment was very spacious, even more-so than in the photos. There’s great AC units which are perfect for the hot summer. Just loved it!

Bobby’s place was perfect for our family. The apartment is spacious, well kept, sparkling clean, and the bed is ridiculously comfortable! We also loved the area: the block itself is great with a very friendly vibe, also there is a full super market at the end of the block, great cafes in every direction, and some delicious dinner options nearby. This is our favorite place to stay in brooklyn and we will be back!

Great rental for our family trip. The apartment was clean, beds were comfy, and the rooms are as they appear in the photos. Bobby, our host, provided local recommendations and was very proactive — checking in with us periodically to make sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely stay again!

Can't beat the location, walking distance (1-2 miles) to both ends of Manhattan. Place was clean and tidy, and resident cat was friendly with us :)
The apartment is on the lower level, which helped to beat the heat of summer NY, but if you prefer a lot of day light might not be the best choice.
Super relaxing and well designed place, so comfortable I almost didn’t go out! Seg the cat is gonna be one of the highlights of your trip
Great place for our trip to NYC. The location was perfect and easy to get around from. Siggy the cat was of course was very friendly and welcomed us each time we arrived back.
Second time staying, great place & great location. And of course Siggy the cat was the highlight once again :)

Jhovana was an amazing host to our family of three. Though we didn't spend lots of time together since Jhovana had to work most of the time, she made us feel very comfortable and welcomed. She is a very cool and easy going person who makes for a great host. Our 3.5 year old son had a great time playing with Jhovana's huge dog Ese, who was the friendliest animal. The building is in a great location in East Village with lots of fun around it and everything close by.

Where do I begin, from the first time I contacted Jo, she was one the most loveliest people I have ever talked too. She was kind and friendly and she was more than accommodating. In total I spent 3 weeks with Jo and her gorgeous dog Ese. Besides just providing a beautiful space for me to stay, she went above and beyond any expectation I had in terms of making sure I was comfortable, and at ease (considering this was my first solo trip away from home). I feel privileged to have met and stayed with such a beautiful soul.
All in all, the apartment is in a brilliant spot location wise. The room I had was beautiful and spacious with a super comfy bed and I don't think I can do justice to how much thanks and gratitude I have for my experience there. 10/10 and I can't wait to come back. Thank you again Jo, you're amazing! :)

If you are looking for an affordable room in a perfect location and a perfect host, then this listing is highly recommended. The area is pretty chilled out, which is perfect if you are looking for good cafes or restaurants and bars. All of the major attractions are very accessible by either subway or bus. To add to that, Jhovana is really helpful and is easily available at least over the phone if you need anything. In all, it helped in making my first experience in New York a great one.

This was such an awesome trip and Jhovana's lovely and welcoming persona made it even better, she is a fantastic host and a wonderful human being.
Plus, since the temperature during my stay didn't drop being 30 Celsius the entire time the AC in the room was probably the thing I will remember most #CherishedMemories :D
In all seriously this is great spot to be in, close to amazing bars/restaurants/pizza and walk able to almost anywhere in Manhattan. There is a supermarket across the road and a bars everywhere on that block.
Jhovana was very helpful with directions and shopping advice, and the room was so well presented it was like being in a hotel.
I would happily stay again when (fingers crossed) I make it back to NYC

The location of Jhovana place is great! Before I booked this place I was debating on staying in the Brooklyn area. If you're a "foodie" and visiting NYC to eat your way around town I recommend Jhovana's place! There's a bus stop right outside of her place and a 10 minute walk to the nearest train. The majority of my list of restaurants were all around a 15 minutes bus ride or walking distance. There's so much options for places to eat in each neighborhood that you could walk down another block and discover something new without a wait. I would definitely come back here again because of the location from Chinatown and all the other yummy restaurants.

Jhovana, you are the BEST Airbnb host we have ever stayed with. Great room in a beautiful apartment! Comfortable bed, a/c, everything you could ask for! Jhovana opened her home to us and treated us like family members! I can recommend Jhovana's place to anyone. There are so many great restaurants, bars and cafes in the neighbourhood too! We can't wait to come back to NYC and stay in Alphabet city again!

This was such a lovely room to stay in! The sheets were super soft, the bed was super comfy, and Jhovana left plenty of towels and toiletries for me to use if I forgot anything. The space was super clean. Jhovana was also super easy to communicate with. The only minor downside was that the building is on the older side so you can hear the pipes through the walls, but it's New York so earplugs are a must anyhow. In short, this is a great place to stay.

Jhovana and James were amazing hosts. Not only was the room great,  but the neighborhood was very hip and lively with lots of good bars and restaurants nearby.  They gave me lots of good tips on things to check out around the area. Also, the room was clean, private, and the mattress was comfy.

I would 100% recommend staying here. Excellent location, close to lots of great stuff and the subway. Laundry just next door, and Jhovana has thought of EVERYTHING, from extra towels to earplugs- not to mention having great recommendations for what to do in the area. Really great stay.
Jhovana was a great host, she was absolutely lovely. The room was perfect, clean and tidy. When I was sick she was helpful. Great experience, I would recommend staying with her.

Jhovanna is an utterly phenomenal host. From local thrift shop and restaurant recommendations to gifting me adorable dresses and generously accommodating an unexpected change of plans, she really was just such a fantastic comrade. She and Cachi will be missed!!

We had such a wonderful stay at Jhovana’s place and fell in love with Cachito instantly! The flat is super clean and in a great area with many things to do around. Jhovana has been so warm and welcoming, offering tips and greeting us with such a great energy every morning. We will definitely come back!

Jhovana and her home are true gems in Manhattan. The home is very clean; comfortable bed; adorable dog; good public transportation nearby. She is a wonderful host and i hope to be able to return sometimes in the future.
I would highly recommend her place to stay to everyone.

Couldn’t have asked for better! It allows you to be close enough to partake in fun activities and sightseeing whether you are on foot or taking transports without having to deal with the mess that is midtown. The apartment looks even prettier in real life and the dog, Catchy is adorable and very friendly. Jhovana is good at anticipating her guests' needs, she's the best host I've had, a ray of sunshine! Would recommend and book again!

Howard's place in Brooklyn is really special.  Stepping off the busy city streets into a quiet, very nicely decorated row house was exactly what I needed.  The living room is beautiful and relaxing with tons of great art on the walls and interesting books to peruse.  The kitchen is small but has everything you need (I never cook when I am around so much food variety anyways) and the small back garden is also a plus.  Two bedrooms and a day bed provided plenty of room to sleep.  This rental is best for quiet couples or friends as there is a family upstairs.  Howard was super helpful and attentive and my experience was a great one.
The host was was great! Very easy and quick communication and everything was set on the day, no problems whatsoever. The house is very beautiful and clean! Definitely a great place to stay at.
George's home is a magical place. If you appreciate history and art you are in for a treat! The room is spacious and homey. The neighborhood is great. Easy access to subway and park.

Absolutely wonderful! George was wonderful, very kind and had plenty of great tips about the area. The room was a fantastic size, with a nice bathroom and kitchen area, and absolutely amazing art and wall decorating. Could not recommend more!
Beautiful place and a wonderful location! The host is very helpful and the artwork gives the place a very nice feel. Great for exploring the city!
George is fantastic host. He welcomed us  very nicely on the day of check in. Then we were so busy so we did not have a chance to see him again. He promptly respond to all our queries.

We had a wonderful four weeks here. The apartment was ideal - beautiful morning light, comfortable and varied furniture, and plenty of storage space. The location too: a remarkable set of historic streets and right next to the subway. George was a perfect host - kind, knowledgable, generous without being imposing, and custodian of a remarkable set of objects and paintings, which decorate the entire building.

George was a amazing host, his knowledge and experiences that he shared with me is something to keep forever.
The room is big and comfortable and has everything you need to live and also to cook.
There is a near subway station (2min by foot). This was very helpful.

This was the best place I’ve stayed at in NYC. Walking distance from beautiful cafes. The train is minutes away making it easy to get anywhere! George is an artist so if you appreciate art you will be in nirvana here. The best part was the windows. It’s beautiful to wake up to natural light coming from those big windows. I rate this 10/10 and will be my go to spot every time I come visit NYC.
The space, the decor, the host, the location and the atmosphere of the house...it was all one of the best experiences I had in NYC.

Howard is a lovely guy and very charming!
However his house needs some repairs!
New door locks to secure the place are a start!
Flies in kitchen needs a clean!
The local area is a little rough!
If u want not so cheap and cheerful this is it!
Ninell's place is spacious and conveniently located to the subway across the street. She was very hospitable and made us feel comfortable during our stay.

We were really happy with this apartment, which is perfectly located for anyone who wants to discover New York City. Over all, Sabia is an amazing host. Even if we did not meet, she gave us advices before and through our stay. She is really nice, and greatly helped making our stay a lot more enjoyable.

My friend and I stayed two nights in Sabias apartment in October. We had problems with our luggage at the airport, and showed up two hours later at the apartment than we had agreed with Sabia. She was very helpful and communicating with her was easy. The apartment was as described, and actually bigger than the pictures show. The apartment was clean with clean towels and sheets. The apartment is located uptown, but very easy to get downtown near all the famous locations with the subway that is nearby. Would definetly recommend staying with Sabia if you are going to NYC :)

My girlfriend and I had a great experience staying at Sabia's!

The space is clean (spotless!) and comfortable, the neighbors are friendly, and you can't beat the location. We ate and drank at some fantastic spots. Red Rooster and Astor Row Cafe were our two favorites I think, though Harlem Shake is way up there too. And you're 5 minutes from the 2/3 subway line - we scooted down to midtown and lower Manhattan in no time at all whenever we wanted to.

Sabia's arrival instructions, information about the space, and suggestions for the local activities were all spot on. We felt welcomed and comfortable. Everything we needed for a great long weekend in New York City.

Highly recommend. Thank you, Sabia!

Sabia was kind and helpful from the beginning to the end and her place was great for our weekend trip to New York! The place was clean, comfortable, and actually bigger than we had expected. Her directions on how to get into the apartment made things a breeze. The neighborhood might seem intimidating to those unfamiliar with the area but we never felt uncomfortable walking back from the subway even late at night. Also the neighbors were very friendly and the community felt safe. Overall we had a great time and would definitely recommend the place!
Everything was great, without any proplems. Flat is clean and comfortable, very closed to underground station. I didnt see Sabia, but she was on-line every time! I liked everything. Thank you, Sabia!

The place is up near Harlem but its a short train ride away from Times Square and Central Park! It is a little loud but she offers ear plugs for the night! I really enjoyed my first air bnb experience overall!! Thanks so much Sabia
Ninell is one great host. She made sure I was settled in okay and welcomed my gentle giant of a dog. Highly recommend.
The building is old and a bit creepy but the house is clean. It's well communicated with Q metro line and the neighborhood is nice.
Ninell's room is fabulous! Very clean and close to the station. Host is so kind. I highly recommend this room!

Nice place! Home away from home - we traveled all over Manhattan / Brooklyn / Bronx from here using public transit and walking. Accommodations are comfortable here, a very nice spot to get R&R for your stay in NY.
Sabia's place is a great alternative in order to not pay too much to stay in NYC.

We booked Sabias place for our stay in New York. After the long flight we hand no problems with finding the apartment because we got a lot of detailed information for our vacation in advance. The apartment was bigger than expected and it was close to the subway station (and everything else you may need). Perfect for 2 persons! Of course New York is a little bit noisy but it is everywhere, so don’t forget to bring some earplugs :)
This place is perfect--from the space itself to its location do a lot of great restaurants and bars.  You won't find a better place for the price.  Will def stay here again.
This is one of the best vacation experience I've ever had. The staff was exceptional as were the amenities and lodging area.
Great hotel. Easy walk to the train and lots of good restaurants. Clean and stylish rooms with a comfortable bed.
I loved my stay here! I had an amazing time. Everyone was so helpful and accommodating. They have a shuttle that was very convenient. I will definitely stay here on my next trip to Brooklyn!
This is the third time my family has stayed here while visiting us and, as always, they enjoyed their time there.

The accomodations were very nice and above expectations. Clean, wonderful bedding and I loved the soaps and shampoos provided. We loved the location with easy access to trains and restaurants. We will definitely be returning on our next stay.
Our stay at Maurice's accommodation was great! Clean/modern apartment, very good location near restaurants and subways, and located in a safe neighborhood. Would definitely recommend.
Close to subway (downtown in 15 minutes with A train). Big space for NY standards. Cleaning could improve. We did not meet Maurice but this was no problem as he answered to our questions
Maurice was an exceptional host! He was very flexible with our check in and check out times. The apartment was very spacious and cozy. I plan to book with him again the next time I come back to NYC.

Great host and great apartment - absolutely recommended! It spacious with comfortable beds, just like in the pics. We enjoyed a lot cooking in the kitchen. Maurice helped us to rent bikes and organize other things. Thanks a lot for everything!!!

Great value place. Getting to Manhattan takes 30 minutes but is relatively easy. The neighborhood is Brooklyn so this is not Manhattan. Coming late can be bit uncomfortable but is safe. Please note this is Brooklyn and very very high value place and I would recommend it any day. Good comfortable place and very quiet. We had good time and Maurice was an excellent host - responsive and available.

The apartment is spacious, very clean and well fitted out. Maurice & Neisha were great host and responded to any queries instantly. Maurice's local recommendations were great. The apartment is easy to get to on the subway, 20 mins from Manhattan
