We highly recommend Maurice apartment. We have been there as comfortable as in our own house.  It has all the necessary staff to make the stay really comfortable. The bath and bed clothes are really clean.  Everything is as showed in the pictures.  The place has a good location to move around NY and Maurice has been really kind and make our holidays easier and greater. When we will be back in NY it will be in this apartment for sure.

This was an ideal place for our visit to New York.  The apartment was clean, spacious, convenient and quiet.  The location was perfect for our needs.  A short walk to all the places we planned to visit in the area and especially only a 7 minute walk to the train.  Maurice is a most pleasant and attentive host. 5 stars!  I plan to stay here again.

We stayed at Maurice's apartment for a week. The apartment is the whole second floor and looks like the photos. The apartment was very clean, spacious and quiet. To get to downtown Manhattan, it is quick walk to the Norstrand Ave. subway station and 20 minute subway ride. Maurice included some nice touches including a fresh bowl of apples, bottled water and some pantry items. Thank you Maurice, for a memorable stay.
Ray's place was everything as advertised. Close to public transportation to make it easy to get anywhere in the city. Extremely affordable and a great place

Ray's place was a great place to stay in Hamilton Heights. Very convenient and easy to access. He was very timely and kind in replying to my inquires. Check in and check out was easy. We loved the privacy, the back patio area, and being able to comfortably hang out with our family after busy, active days in NYC.

This area of Manhattan is a place to enjoy for its ethnic diversity, nearby park and college, place between two rivers and tree-lined streets. The apartment’s living room/extra bedroom harkens back to an NYC when Boss Tweed was around. My wife and I enjoyed our dinner on the patio one night. Take the time to enjoy the place and the community.

My family and I absolutely loved our stay in NY. The apartment was super big by NY hotel standards and had all the amenities. Super quiet! My personal favorite was the GREAT Restaurants literally 5 minutes from Ray's place.
We had everything we needed and everything one might expect.
Ray was very responsive to our texts and emails.
Fantastique !!
Good location, few blocks away from subway station. Very spacious and clean. Ray is a great host.

Love Hamilton Hieghts! Everything about the trip went smoothly and there were no complications. On a map it may look far from lower Manhatten but the subway way is more than sufficient. Would 10/10 recommend this location, it's super affordable, close to the subway and in a historical district and a nice quiet break after a full day in the city

Perfect place for a group of 4 adults to stay for a weekend in the city. Could have had another 2 and still had plenty of room. Easy walk to subway, parking garage nearby, all the amenities of being in a home.  Will definitely be back!
Great location for peace and quiet, fun bars & restaurants close by, nearby subway stations, attentive to all our needs. We had a great stay wit Ray!

Ray’s place is fantastic. It’s a beautiful location and convenient to public transportation. Very clean, comfortable and spacious. There are also nice restaurants nearby (we recommend the Clove restaurant) and Ray provides a handy binder with tips about the area and other useful information. He is quick to reply to questions and check in and check out was easy.

Ray and Harriet's Place is perfect! Close to shops, restaurants and the subway. It was a great place to rest after each long day of exploring the city. Ray and Harriet were very hospitable. They had great recommendations for us to enjoy.
Definitely recommend this great find!
We had an amazing time at rays place while we were in the city seeing some concerts. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in Harlem! Ray was a great host.

This apartment is in a great neighborhood with the awesome Grange Restaurant literally 75 feet away!   Cute period style interior, very private and quiet.  Checking in and out was a breeze with great communication by the hosts as needed.

Very nice and communicative couple. So easy to coordinate with and the location to this spot accessible to train stations to get to the city. I loved how accommodating Harriet was to our needs and caring about making our stay as comfortable as possible

Ray and Harriet are excellent hosts!  They respond to any requests or concerns very quickly.  The location, amenities and space are very convenient and comfortable for  a lengthy stay with a large group.

You need a place to stay in New York? LOOK NO FURTHER. This Airbnb is perfect. Nestled in a neighborhood that makes you feel like a local, surrounded by deli's, restaurants and a 6-7 minute walk to the nearest subway station, this place was the best home base during our stay. The place is clean, comfortable and classy. 11/10 recommend.
Harriet and Ray were great hosts. Communicated well, very helpful with questions. Definitely would stay there again.

The accommodation is good if you consider the price to the value it offers. But I found the washroom to be a bit small and there is no exhaust fan because of which the washroom smells really bad after using it for a day. The bedrooms are good and clean.
Nice place in a great location. We notified host of a problem with the TV and it was fixed promptly.

We were so happy with the wonderful stay at this tranquil, tree-lined spot in Hamilton Heights. The apartment was spacious and comfortable. We so appreciated the washer/dryer and the high chair and crib for our little one. And having a private back patio was a dream! This place is just a short walk from the subway and mere steps from Hamilton Grange and park and the beautiful City College of New York campus. A 20-minute walk put us in the heart of Harlem with spots like Red Rooster and Sylvia's. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

We had a nice time in NYC. We liked the terrace. It was not too far from the supermarkets and the subway. We encounter something electrical issues to use the lights on the terrace but the owners helped and provided some lights with batteries.

Harriet was very responsive to our questions and needs. Great to work with. Had a plumbing issue the first day and this was responded to very quickly with no further problems. Restaurant recommendations were very good.

Cannot recommend enough! We did not want to leave ! Ray & Harriet’s place was amazing. Location was perfect for travel anywhere in NYC, we stopped home a couple of times through the day for changes/food etc and was super easy to hop back on the nearby 145th station and explore. Hosts are super responsive and beyond welcoming, it really made our stay even more perfect than we’d expected.
Super cozy, clean and homey. We loved getting back to chill here after hours of exploring.
Have stayed in many cities around Europe etc, and this host tops them all. Thank you so much again, have already recommended to colleagues and family. Cant wait to see you again soon!
Thank you for making our NYC trip more amazing than we could have expected C + T.

Great location--not only for getting to other places in Mahattan, but also for all the area affords by way of culture and history.  Harriet and Ray were extremely responsive and helpful with all sorts of tips.

This place was within a 5-minute walk to the major subway lines. I visited from small town Colorado and had no issues navigating the subway system. Maps literally told you every step of the way and which transfers/subway lines to get on. Ray's place felt safe, was quiet, for what I expected out of NYC. The kitchen was fully equipped with whatever one might need and the blue book of instructions and helpful information was certainly appreciated! I would definitely recommend staying here and would certainly consider it again if I were to be in the area.

We felt so at home at Ray and Harriets. Harriet was super responsive. The space was extremely well thought out, a well appointed kitchen with everything that we needed - we were there for two weeks so that is saying something. We had our 14 year old with us and she felt safe being home alone while we headed out now and then.
Thank you for having us, highly recommend
My siblings and I were absolutely satisfied with this space! Harriet was so sweet & genuine and was willing to accommodate our needs. We'll be reserving with them again!

where we stayed was walking distance to the tube station, which was great as we were near most of the popular attractions and it's a nice spot to stay, found the people very helpful while we travelled. BTW we travelled the tube every day it's the best way to get around.

Thank you Ray and Harriet for a great stay. Lovely quiet location and the outdoor area was great. Plenty of space for the kids and nice and close to 2 different Subway lines. Communication was great too. Many thanks

This was our third visit to Polina's place and as ever we felt very welcomed and very much at home. Polina is wonderful, the place is wonderful. As we were leaving we turned around and looked back in with a feeling of nostalgia, as if leaving home. Very much looking forward to returning!

It was a great experience!! Everything was just like in the pictures. Our host, Polina, was always available and took good care of us. She made sure everything was ready when we arrived. The location is excellent, just 2 blocks from the metro station, and 3 blocks from Prospect Park. The neighborhood is very nice, clean and safe to walk around. I totally recommend it!

We had a lovely stay at Polina's Brooklyn Brownstone in a lovely neighbourhood but still in easy reach of Manhattan. The apartment was very contemporary and stylishly furnished and we would thoroughly recommend it to anyone visiting New York.

What a wonderful place to stay! We used this beautiful apartment as a meeting place for my bridal party and family, and it was the most perfect setting to take photos while getting ready. The space was immaculate.

I highly recommend this apartment to anyone traveling to Brooklyn and feel this accommodation deserves a 5 star rating:)

The dwelling was beautifully appointed and in a terrific location.

The host provided quick responsive answers to any questions that arose and recommended outstanding dining options that were enjoyed immensely.

We only had a slight problem with a door knob and the host arrived to assist with the issue and resolved it within minutes!
Polina made us feel welcomed and we loved the neighborhood; safe and beautiful ; we found parking easily too on the street.  The place was comfortable and beautiful!

Polina was a terrific host. At our arrival she was present and gave us many tips for activities and restaurants in the area.The apartment is exactly as describede. The neighborhood is very quiet and clean. Subway Station ist just a few minutes away.

Staying at Polina's apartment was just superb. From the polite, informative and quick response/communication to the excellent stay. The best host you can imagine. The apartment was very clean, nice and with modern appliances. Fell in love with the dryer, clothes were dry in 25 min. Stayed here with 3 kids. Thank you! Loved it!

Lovely place and suitable for family of 6. The neighborhood is safe and there are many restaurants and grocery shops within walking distance. Most importantly, Polina (our host) is very friendly. Overall, it is a 👍👍 experience!
Great place and centrally located. Clean and very comfortable! Polina did a great job setting the place up and it was a perfect stay! Close to a bunch of shops and an easy train ride to everything!

We had a wonderful stay here, the apartment was perfect and exactly as shown in the pictures. The area was great, lots of shops and bars while still quite and quaint. We would highly recommend staying here for a fantastic Brooklyn experience!

Thanks for a great vacation. The apartment was exactly as advertised. Great location, well maintained, clean,  comfortable and decorated with style.   My daughter liked the AirBnB experience saying "It was nice to have a place to live not just a place to sleep."  We arrived by car and were concerned about parking. We parked right out front of the apartment at zero cost. Easy subway ride or Uber into Manhattan. Communication, check in, layout of the apartment and surrounding neighborhood and check out were a breeze. Thanks again for a wonderful vacation.

Lovely apartement, spacious and very nice furnished. Nice neighbourhood where we felt at home right away. Metro, food stores and several restaurants within a few minutes. We arrived late but could easily pick up the keys from a lockbox at the entrance. Polina and her family made us feel very velcome and we would love to go back some day! And we would definitely recommend this beautiful and comfortable apartement!

Awesome location, lovely clean and spacious apartment.
Very helpful and prompt communication.
We had a wonderful stay and would certainly return if we ever return to Brooklyn
Accommodation was exactly as described. Beds were a little uncomfortable however. Shower and bathroom very good. Close to subway supermarket and best bagel cafe ever.

This amazing apartment was in a superb location! Modern and beautiful special touches throughout. Very close to the beautiful Prospect Park and so close to the subway.
Polina answered our messages quickly and she was a wonderful host.
I hope to return soon!

Polina has created a wonderfully stylish basement apartment in a part of Brooklyn that is undergoing a rejuvenation - nearby are lots of great cafes and restaurants, a high quality mini supermarket, Brooklyn Museum, Prospect Park and four subway lines to Manhattan. We would definitely stay here again on our next trip to New York. Thank you.

Polina's apartment is very spacious, stylish and clean.  It's got a great location near the museum, park and botanical gardens and there are plenty of stores and restaurants nearby.  The size and layout of the apartment make it perfect for a family.  Check-in is easy and Polina was great at keeping in touch during my stay.  A great place!

This apartment is very comfortable, super clean, stylishly appointed and very convenient if you want to be close to Prospect Park, Brooklyn Museum, Brooklyn Botanical Garden, and in a great Brooklyn neighborhood. It's not cheap, but you get what you pay for, especially if you have multiple family members coming to visit and you want them together in one place.

Polina’s place is just as pictured. Her place is immaculate! We loved the proximity to great neighborhood restaurants and to the subway. I’d recommend staying here and would love to stay here again for our next visit to the NYC area.
Great place to stay with kids. Apartment was very clean and nice and was a wonderful place to come back to at the end of the day to recharge.

We love visiting Brooklyn and love staying at Polina's house. It is located in wonderful Prospect Heights, with on street parking, good restaurants. It is near a playground, food stores, Prospect Park and even a bookstore!

Polina’s place was an excellent and stylish place that was conveniently located near the subway and airport. She was an excellent hostess and very thorough with explaining everything. The apartment was very clean and felt like home. The beds were comfortable and she even had HBO so we didn’t miss the premier of last season Game of Thrones:). We enjoyed our stay very much and appreciate having a nice place for our family. Thank you Polina!!!

Polina's place was just what we needed! There were 6 of us and we were worried about feeling crowded, but it was perfect. The place was spotless and Polina left thoughtful touches for us, like having towels for all 6 of us out and already having the sofa bed made. She also had a super helpful book on the coffee table with local recommendations and a map. The location was great, just a short walk to a grocery and the subway. Overall, we had a great time and would definitely stay there again!

Polina's place is a truly wonderful spot in Prospect Heights. Wonderful restaurants (Olmsted), book store (Unnameable), close to two MTA lines, the Brooklyn Museum and Prospect Park. She is a great hostess.

The apartment lived up to all our expectations. Lovely and clean and tidy with the bonus of being in a great location . Any questions we had to Polina were very quickly answered. Honestly we could not fault our stay in any way and we simply loved it .
Would definitely stay again without hesitation.
I had a great stay here. The apartment is perfect, exactly as advertised. Really well appointed kitchen and a great market walking distance. And the park is close, if it's a nice sunny day.
A wonderful place in Prospect Heights located near restaurants, the subway, Prospect Park, a playground etc. The space is roomy and stylish, and Polina is great to work with.

Polina’s apartment is beautiful. Spacious and stylish and very comfortable. Every detail was so nice. We felt at home (but a luxurious home!) and would not change a thing. The location in Prospect Heights is perfect. Perfect Brooklyn block with easy access to Vanderbilt, Washington, Franklin - anywhere you want to go! - as well as Prospect Park and the Museum.

We loved staying at Polina’s place. We were visiting family and basically ended up back at her flat every night for cooking and hanging out. We had our 7 month old and she had the pack n play all setup in the second bedroom. Not to mention the washer/dryer saved us so much hassle with an infant. While we didn’t utilize, the subway is only two blocks away as well, along with several grocery stores. Everything was very clean and we felt comfortable the whole time during these Covid times. Can say with confidence we will use Polina’s place as we continue to visit family in Brooklyn.

Everything about our stay was perfect.  The check in process was super easy.  The home is beautiful and comfy.  They have everything you need in the kitchen and we enjoyed the outdoor space for our family lunch on that one day when the weather was warm.  Polina was quick to respond with any questions we had.  The block is awesome.
Charming little apartment.  Well equipped and fabulous location. The upstairs neighbors were a tad bit noisy. We enjoyed our stay.

Great location, very clean and very comfortable.  The main mattress in the larger bedroom should be replaced as it tilts off on both sides and is particularly uncomfortable.  But that wan't enough to damage a great stay in a very nice apartment.

We had a great stay at Polina’s place. It was perfect for a family. It’s very conveniently located near buses and subways, as well as loads of cool restaurants, bars, and ice cream shops! Having laundry and a full kitchen was a plus. Would highly recommend!
Lovely apartment- great location & Polina was extremely responsive.   I hope to stay again when I get back to Brooklyn!

My family and I stayed at Polina’s while our nearby home was under construction. It was the perfect oasis of cleanliness and tranquility we needed. Immaculate upon arrival, there were instructions about the apartment laid out in a beautiful book, it was comfortable, spacious, tastefully decorated and it sits on a beautiful block in one of the best BK neighborhoods. A close second to being in our own home ;)
This is a great place with plenty of space and an excellent location.  We will definitely stay here again next time out.

Stay here if you can! The beds were comfortable (the queen is on the firm side which is what we prefer). The apt was super clean, and everything you might need was provided. The block was quiet, it is an easy walk to the subway, various other cafes and restaurants, the Brooklyn Art Museum, Brooklyn Botanic Gardens, etc. We really hope Polina's apt is available next time we come to Brooklyn, it is the BEST place we've found.

This location can’t be beat, with brownstone Brooklyn charm, and abundant parks, playgrounds, restaurants and markets just a short walk away. I live nearby in a smaller apartment, and had booked this place for my family to stay while in town. Comfortable beds, clean home, plenty of space to relax, cook, etc. will definitely book here again in the future. Thanks!

The home felt like a home as soon as I stepped inside. It was so cozy just a homey feeling weather the heat was up or the temperature was cool. It has everything you need. The washer and dryer were very convenient. Multiple comfy spots aside from the pull out bed and beds in other rooms. There are outlets everywhere which was the bomb and I love that you could change the light settings all over the house. Definitely would recommend and definitely would stay again !!!

We had a terrific time staying at Polina's place. The location was ideal for everything - the subway, the park, the bagel place on Vanderbilt. The place was very nicely appointed - fantastic kitchen. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.

This brownstone is perfect for anyone visiting NYC. Easy walk to the subway, and many great restaurants in the area.
The apartment is fresh and new with a great kitchen and bathroom.
We had a great time staying here. Five stars!
Beautiful, clean, and well appointed. All the creature comforts included.  We 100% would (and plan to) stay here again.

Lovely unit - even better than the photos.  Extremely clean, spacious, and lots of restaurants, grocery stores, cafes, etc. a short walk away. It was nice to stay in Brooklyn in a quiet neighbourhood, just a short subway ride from very busy Manhattan.  We would highly recommend this Airbnb!

My family and I confirm all of the positive reviews that this apartment has received! It is so nice and comfortable that we wished we could have stayed longer. The neighborhood is charming and subway stops are just a few blocks away.
Polina is a fabulous host -- attentive and responsive. The apartment is beautiful and calm in a fabulous part of Brooklyn.

This ABNB surpassed our hopes. It was a perfect family retreat for our daughter's wedding weekend. It slept 2 couples and 1 single comfortably and allowed for 8 for breakfast or a late night dessert! It is beautifully appointed and has a sweet garden entrance and small terrace in the back. The kitchen was large allowing us to easily put together buffets of take-out, cook eggs and make tea, coffee and serve wine. We felt very secure with the beautiful old security gate and lovely wooden door. The entry hall was a bonus for shoes, bags, umbrellas etc. We didn't use the washer and dryer, but having it was a great safety net. Plenty of extra linens at hand also. It had nice light coming from both the front and back of the flat.
This was a great stay in a wonderful location.  Our host was responsive and helpful with everything we needed. Will absolutely stay here again when back in the city.

Poling was a very kind and helpful host. Her pictures look exactly how her place looks. She was very very helpful with great suggestions about restaurants and places to go. Her welcome book was also very helpful. We loved her neighborhood and the classic look of a Brooklyn brownstone. I would say that our family does agree with other reviewers about the lack of comfort of the living room furniture. We all felt it was ver uncomfortable. Also, the noise from upstairs was at times very loud, although that would not deter us from visiting again. Overall, our stay in Brooklyn at Polina’s was full of memories and joy for our family. Pomona was a fantastic host.
This is my family’s go-to airbnb when they come to town. It’s in an amazing location, super clean, comfortable and very well stocked. Polina couldn’t be a more communicative or kind host as well.
It was great to stay in this apartment. The living room was huge and suitable for small family. I would recommend to stay here. Thanks Jennifer for being a good host.

Very nice neighborhood you have a laundry shop and supermarket near to the building. High speed internet connection never cutting off. Overall it's a good apartment. Only problem the apartment needs more care with the painting, floor and the sofa.

Beautiful apartment...Perfect location..lots of room..great building..
You will never want to leave!

Simple clean Apt in a great location, very comfortable bed and space. Super easy to get around with subway close by and any & all shopping amenities just out your front door. Safe / clean neighborhood
I would definitely stay again and recommend. Two Thumbs up!

This place have an amazing location.
Its quiet.its nice. It looks like new. Everything is clean and on points.u got everything here. I stayed for 1 month and i wish i could extend it

Really good experience in NY. Andre is very helpful and answers rapidly for everything !
Location is 5 minuts away from the metro and 20-25 minuts from Manhattan. The balcony is nice and the appartment is really pretty and convenient in a good area.

Andre's flat is very cosy, perfectly clean and in a quiet neighborhood. It is indeed a bit far from Manhattan but the subway station is very close and the express trains are running quite often. So if you're ok with 20 to 30 minutes by train, Andre's place is a perfect location. Andre is very helpful and always very quick to answer your question. It was very nice to find a lot of water in the fridge when we arrived.

Andre's place was fantastic! Great location in a very diverse and multicultural neighborhood of Brooklyn and close to trains and buses, excellent amenities ranging from fresh linens to a very spacious balcony, and excellent communication when I was having trouble with WiFi. I highly recommend this location if you want a well-immersed New York experience.

This is one of my favorite places to stay while visiting the area! A short walk to a super cute coffee shop and the subway. Also very close to several grocery stores in an up and coming residential neighborhood. I've stayed here once before this visit and would stay here again for sure!

Andre's apartment was exactly as described, very clean, and had everything we needed. Communication with Andre before and during our stay was very good. Checking in was extremely easy with the keypads and no need to carry keys, which was both helpful and convenient. We loved the neighborhood and the short walk to the metro as well. We would definitely stay here again.

Abdre's place was perfect location for my husband and I. It is close to grocery stores and places to eat. Located in friendly and quiet neighborhood. Bed was very comfy we slept well. We will definitely stay here again when we visit Brooklyn.
great place, super modern. Only downfall is that is is hard to get around to other parts of the city that aren't in brooklyn
Great find in Brooklyn! Exceeded my expectations, very accommodating host. Would definitely stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay in Andre's neat and well equipped apartment, especially the large porch is a great plus. The keypads make everything very easy. The location is perfect due to the proximity of a subway station (Newkirk Plaza), grocery stores, restaurants and a nice café just around the corner (Milk and Honey).
Andre's responses were always prompt and accurate. He is a very friendly and attentive, but non-intrusive host.
All in all, very strong recommendation.

This is my second time staying at Andre’s and it was just as good as the first. The apartment is spotless, the bed is comfortable, access via keypads is very convenient, and Andre responds immediately to all questions. He has thoughtful amenities such as coffee and creamer making that first morning smooth and easy.  We will be back!

The photos don't do justice to the stylish reality of Andre's place--also, the apartment was designed to make use of every square foot. Yes, the apartment is only 300 square feet, but nicely appointed, sparkling clean, and in a safe area. Parking did become an issue, though, so be aware: the apt. is on the same block as a school, and you must not park within two blocks during the school day or you will be ticketed. As travelers from Upstate NY the week school began in NYC, we did not know that! Thankfully, Andre remembered to tell us the night before and we moved our car in the early a.m. Great area, though, and Andre was responsive to all of my questions!
the place is very quiet, the apartment very cozy and comfortable! and Andres if he was in contact!
Andre’s apartment was great for our visit to NYC. with the Metro close and easy access. Also, Andre had quick reponse to any question and keeps the apartment in perfect shape.

A well-placed apartment that makes the most of its space. A little small if you like to chill out in your lodgings, but most people are going to be exploring New York anyhow.
Andre was always prompt and helpful with responses, which is something we greatly appreciate. Thanks for letting us stay!
The couch is a little uncomfortable and next time we’ll bring are pillows. The space work well. The outside porch is really nice if it wasn’t so hot in July 😁 Thanks Andre

Had the best, cosiest stay here. Small, clean, smart apartment a 5min walk away from the subway station and close to cafes and stores. Andre was a fantastic host who responded very quickly. An efficient system to check in, out and lock the doors is already set up. The amenities like bottled water, soap etc were a great touch. Would definitely stay here again!
Clean, quiet and comfortable...location has some excellent restaurants near by...would definitely stay there again and Andre was an excellent communicator.
Andre’s space was wonderful! Amazing amenities and thoughtful touches I did not expect. I would definitely stay here again!
Everything was amazing, and just as advertised. Smooth check in, & easy parking within a block or two every time. Book this place, you will not be disappointed!

The place was great. It is small but has everything you need as long as you don’t plan on cooking. Andre shared all the details before our stay and was a good host.
Andre left us extra water bottles which was a very nice touch. There were disinfectant wipes so I was able to clean everything when I first arrived. The place was clean and had extra toiletries in the bathroom. The balcony was also nice to sit and eat at.
It’s a keyless entry which makes check in simple. You do have to go up a flight of stairs to get to the place. This was not an issue for me.
I would book this place again.
Andre was a great host, you can tell he really put thought into this cozy place. it everything we needed, including a very well stocked kitchenette. The balcony was a real plus! thanks again Andre!
We loved it! It was so clean and cute! Andre was a great host l! Everything was there from local foods and groceries and stores! 10/10
Really clean, compact and classy place. I did not miss the cooking stove because there are a bunch of great places to pick up food.  Good mattress too.
My stay was great Andre had wonderful communication and the place was very clean. Looking forward to stay again
Great little place, super duper clean, and Andre is very hospitable! Will definitely stay there again.

Very clean and comfortable place for one or two guests, convenient location, very close to metro. Andre was quick, responsive and accommodating. I felt safe and welcomed! Thank you for a wonderful stay, Andre!
The apartment is impeccably clean and is very conveniently located. Communication with the host was great: I received replies very quickly and the host was very accomodating. Highly recommended!

Andre's place is fit for any discerning travellers.
Clean, good use of the space
Very responsive and helpful to my multiple requests.
I had a very comfortable stay in Brooklyn and will come back!

We stayed here 5 nights.  I absolutely loved the accommodations.  Granted, the space is indeed small but it is clean as a whistle and we felt very safe in the neighborhood.  The unit is an easy 5 minute walk from the Newkirk  subway station that will whisk you anywhere in New York.  Highly recommended.
My mother stayed at Andre's place for the second time while visiting our family, and she was very comfortable. Great clean and efficient space!

Andres place gave everything that needed to be given. It was Clean, walkable, and generally quiet. You can tell the area is full of different cultures and families. There are many businesses and food literally turn the corner and you're in the thick of the park and eateries. I enjoyed my time in NYC with the help of Andre's space.

I had a fantastic stay at Andre's place. He was incredibly responsive and accommodating throughout my stay. The neighborhood was lovely—quiet, safe, and conveniently located near subway. Overall, I had a great experience. Highly recommend!
I had a great stay here.  It's quite spacious and very sunny, nicely decorated, in a perfect location.  Ashley was very helpful.  Highly recommend!

Ashley is a wonderful host, great with communication and very generous in nature. The apartment is so comfortable and is in an amazing location. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it highly!!

Jamiliya was able to accommodate us the day of our visit and was incredibly helpful throughout the process. Her place was super comfortable, convenient, and spacious. She was kind enough to rush home from work and take care of tidying up and laundry before our arrival. She even left a stack of chocolate for us to munch on during our stay. Would highly recommend her place to anyone making their way into Brooklyn as it's only a couple blocks from the subway as well. Thanks again for the lovely hospitality Jamiliya!
The listing was accurate, and the host was very sweet and accomadating. Enjoyed the stay very much!

I loved this place. It was in a neighborhood that reminded me of home and she was very accommodating. I asked her maybe 2 questions a day and she responded quickly and was always ready to help. I will definitely be back at her place. There is also a television in the bedroom that is supper important to me since I'm a tv watcher. She is also located on the first floor. It  was a lovely stay with a very helpful house owner I definitely recommend staying here!

My stay here was great. Jamilya was so helpful for when I had my partner come visit and she made the whole process very easy. It's a lovely flat very close to the metro. Thanks again for a wonderful stay

Jamilya's place was perfect for my needs. I was looking for a clean, comfortable & centrally located listing in BK & her place delivered. I found it easy to get around via public transportation, but also found parking a couple blocks from her building. It was a win-win situation. I'll defiantly look to see of her place was available on my next trip to Brooklyn. Highly recommend.

Jamilya's place was super clean and the perfect home away from home. Jamilya was very quick responding to my questions. Her place is on a quiet street and only a short walk to the nearest subway station.  The place is about a 15- 20 minute walk to Crown Heights's eateries and bars.  Perfect for a family with little ones.
Jamilya is a very responsive and accommodating host! The apartment’s nice and convenient to get to the 2/3/4/5.
I loved Jamilya’s place . It was very nice and cozy. I loved her tv and the bed was super comfty. Checked up on us to make sure all was good. Totally would recommend
Jamilya was a wonderful host! It was a great, cleanly stay. I loved her smart TV, and she was very very friendly and accommodating! Definitely will consider booking again when I visit New York again!

Pleasant stay and appartement as described.  If you are a light sleeper, bring some earplugs as you can hear most noise from the street. Fortunately, the neighborhood is calm.  Good proximity to subway.

Definitely a nice cozy spot was able to have a nice weekend. Location is good for the area very quiet at night and nypd patrol in area. Not the greatest place but in Brooklyn it was definitely not bad.
She was very accommodating and easy to get in touch with! A great stay thanks so much!!👌🏾🙌🏾☺️

The place was well cleaned before I checked in, the bed, the towels, the room itself, etc were very cleaned. I felt very comfortable staying there. Jamilya was very kind, nice and easy to communicate and she was always prompt to reply to the messages.  Thank you so much, Jamilya!

Jamilya is awesome!! She went above and beyond accommodating to our needs! Her place is super cute, the pictures do not do it justice. The bed is king size and super comfortable!! We had such a great stay in Brooklyn!
Great place. Jamilah is very quick at communicating and professional. Apartment is very spacious. Close to several subway stops. I would stay there again.

This was our first trip to Brooklyn and did not know what to expect.  Being from the Midwest I was a little concerned about the bars on windows but the neighborhood was unexpectedly quite.  The apartment is as described and there is plenty of corner stores for snacks and restaurants within walking distance.  I strongly recommend checking out The Food Sermon restaurant just a couple blocks away!

This is a great place to stay. It's super clean, spacious, has a very comfortable bed and a shower with plenty of hot water.  Check-in and check out were very easy.  There is a grocery store and a Metro stop within a block. We would be very happy to stay here again.

Jamilya place was exactly as it appeared in the photos. The location was great which facilitated easy commute into other surrounding boroughs to include just a 15-minute train ride into Manhattan. There are also local shops, restaurants and groceries within walking distance. I would definitely recommend Jamilya place to family and friends on a visit to NYC.

I loved this place for my stay in NY. Has everything you need for a longer stay. Missed the fact that utilities comes in addition to the air BnB fee, which I find a bit strange, but else than that everything was perfect.

Nina and team were responsive, communicated effectively, and easy to work with. The apartment met all expectations, was well located, and pleasant. We would book again (or rent another apartment) for long-term stay with Nina. Thank you!

Nina was a great host who was always on top of any issue that we had. I was there for 4 months and she never bothered us. She was also very quick to respond and seemed very organized as far as giving us all the information up front.
Nina was always responsive with any issue that we had. The apt was for interns who were there for most of the summer. She was also very organized with check in and any required information up front.

Jennifer is a great host. The agency is super, they are available for every problem and will provide the solution. The building is very nice and the position is perfect. You can take metro for all the places and Manhattan is easy to explore walking. In my future I will choose for sure that solution.

We stayed here for the three nights following our Brooklyn wedding. It is a beautiful, spacious, quiet, and private space, with extremely comfortable beds, and every amenity you can think of, from plentiful toiletries to a fully stocked kitchen. Anna and her husband are lovely, thoughtful hosts who responded promptly to our every question and have clearly put a lot of work and love into decorating this space.  The pictures really don't do it justice, with beautiful details in every peaceful, sun-drenched room. The rooftop terrace was lovely  for evening meals, and the big kitchen was perfect for cooking. It's also in Ditmas Park, the nicest neighborhood in Brooklyn, with lovely restaurants and all the conveniences of the city in a beautiful tree lined neighborhood. If we ever need a place to stay in Brooklyn, this is it.

My parents and sister spent 19 days at Anna's apartment. Anna was super helpful, responsive to any issues and so warm and welcoming. The apartment was lovely ,clean and comfortable and came with everything needed, the location is amazing.  I sincerely recommend Anna's place! Many thanks for your kind hospitality :)

My parents stayed with Anna for a week as I live in the neighborhood. She was wonderful and made them feel very welcome with snacks and supplies. When my mom hurt her foot Anna's husband drove her to the doctor and was very helpful

Everything was perfect!  The space was just as described in the listing, and more.  Anna was a wonderful host.  The neighborhood is beautiful and very well located for great restaurants, lovely walks, and the subway to the rest of New York City.  There were two of us, good friends, and we each had plenty of room for privacy as well as comfortable space to spend time together, talking for hours.  We wished we could have stayed longer!

Not only was Anna a fantastic hostess, but the accommodations were beautiful, well kept, and clean. We had everything we needed (extra towels, soap etc) and more (snacks, coffee and beers in the fridge). The rooftop deck was a really nice place to enjoy a sunny breakfast on and the beds were very comfortable! This AirBNB should be at the top of anyone list who is looking to stay in Brooklyn!

Fantastic apartment for the four of us. Really good ;-) Anna and husband were waiting for us on our arrival. All in the apartment was so very clean and had a modern coziness. Easy to get to Manhattan or stay in the Brooklyn area. Highly recommend it - especially if you want to see and experience authentic New Yorkers. Felt 100% safe at all times.
The house was amazing! Perfect location for what we were looking for and Anna was so nice and helpful. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone looking to visit nyc
Anna was a wonderful host, and the stay was exactly what we were hoping for, a very nice neighborhood in Brooklyn

We absolutely had a blast staying at Anna's place! The apartment was so roomy, comfortable, and relaxed, you literally felt right at home. The subway lines were close too. Just a short walk to the stations and in 25 minutes you were in Manhattan. Anna was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and accommodating! She even scheduled a car service to take us to the airport for our return trip home. When I'm headed back to NYC, I'd love to stay with you again Anna. :-)

Anna's place is beautiful! You really get a great experience of living in a tree-lined, single family homes in Brooklyn.
I've stayed at several places in NYC, and this was, by far, the best prepared with snacks, kitchen supplies, toiletries, and umbrellas. Definitely made my stay that much nicer!
Anna's extremely thoughtful, quick to respond, and I'd definitely recommend a stay in Ditmas Park.

Anna’s place is absolutely gorgeous. A very lovely open design with a full kitchen and a little terrace! The Apartment is so cute and stocked with anything you could need. Anna was very helpful and accommodating with our check in and quick to respond to any questions, would highly recommend anyone stay here that gets the opportunity!

We had a great weeks stay in the apt (2adults 2 kids). Spotlessly clean, well equipped with welcome food... just as the photos. Bed v comfy with new mattress. Was a quiet haven from the bustle of Manhattan. 10 mins walk from a couple of subway lines... 20 mins into Manhattan or 50 to Central Park area. Liked Brooklyn with some good eating places and supermarkets next to subway within 5-10 mins walk. Hosts were great and v good communication. Would stay again.

THE PERFECT AIRBNB!
We,without a doubt, loved Anna’s apartment! It’s was our BEST EXPERIENCE with Airbnb so far!
Super CLEAN, BEAUTIFUL, just LIKE THE PICTURES, very ORGANIZED, with literally everything you could possibly imagine needing in a house!
The neighborhood it’s beautiful and very safe! Close from markets and drugstores.
Anna is the PERFECT HOSTESS! She’s a sweet heart! So helpful and always answer her phone! My mother-in-law went sick and she went there to check on her while we’re in the city.
No words to described it! I would always stay there while in NYC.

Extremely beautiful, well-designed apartment! Everything we wanted, plus thoughtful extras like sparkling water and beer in the fridge and a ton of food, coffee, condiments, etc. in the pantry. Anna was very responsive and helpful from booking to check-in to check-out. The location is great, just a few minutes walk from the Cortelyou Rd. subway station, and safe parking on the property. Tons of room for our two young kids, lovely bedding, great furniture and books - we really loved this place!

A HOME AWAY FROM HOME
I stayed at Anna's place with my mom and grandma for 10 days. And we had an amazing time :)
The appartment is absolutely gorgeous and really comfortable. The kitchen has all you need and more, the living room is inviting you to have a chill movie night to rest from the busy city and the beds are extremly comfy.
The appartment is also located in a gorgeous, worth to look around neighborhood. Even it might seem a bit far from Manhattan, you are only an hour away from the great spotlights by subway.
SO, the perfect place to be if you plan to stay in NYC <3

Expertly hosted space! Anna accommodated my late check in due to my flight schedule, made sure there were beers in the fridge and sent a message checking in on me when the weather dropped below freezing suddenly. Would absolutely stay here again!
Anna’s place is excellent. Very clean and homey loft space. Larger than we expected. Anna is super hospital and was easy to communicate with. We would stay again if we are ever in the area.

Anna’s place is absolutely breathtaking and you can tell she is a true artist. The whole apartment has luxurious tall ceilings that you feel like you could breathe in! Anna was more than willing to work with us considering this was my birthday weekend and I had a couple guests stop by  LATE during the rain but the location made hopping around to different rooftops very easy. This place was extremely comfy supplied with everything you would ever need! I made the mistake of bringing everything— So trust in Anna that she’ll have you guys covered! The balcony was truly SO cute and I think I’ll see this apartment in my dreams until I have one of my own. ❤️ This place is worth every penny if not MORE

Anna hosted my boyfriend and I for a month of WFH in NYC and had a wonderful stay! The apartment had everything we needed and much more. Wifi was strong enough for both of us to work without a problem, bed was very comfortable, and was very convenient to grocery, metro, restaurants, etc. Communication with Anna was very prompt and easy.

We absolutely loved our stay in Ditmas Park. The house is beautiful, spacious, filled with light, and well-equipped. We are moving to the neighborhood and stayed here the first month to get oriented. It was the perfect place to land! The apartment is close to two train stations and within walking distance to shops and restaurants. Anna and Mauro are incredibly helpful and responsive, but also give you your own space. The house is also very child-friendly. Highly recommended!

The loft is amazing. Ohad was flexible on meeting me to get keys to the unit and provided a short, complete intro to using the space. The loft was clean, comfortable, and perfect our weekend needs. It is located in a great area, close to transportation, and lots of local shops and restaurants. Outdoor space was great too. Would definitely return on my next trip to NYC.

Ohad was an extremely gracious host and made extra efforts to make our stay comfortable. Since we were running in a half marathon that weekend we needed a place that was comfortable and close to our start, Ohad's loft was above and beyond what we were expecting. We felt very much at home!

We had a great stay! We were greeted promptly and the host did everything to make us feel welcome including neighborhood food and drink recommendations. There was plenty of space and everything was as described. Great location also

Ohad's place was excellent; the location is top-notch, next to everything and close to two subway lines. The space is unique, vast, warm and welcoming. I would definitely stay there again without hesitating.

It is indeed a very large and unique space! Very clean, and had everything we needed and expected. It was also a very stylishly decorated space, with musical equipment and instruments. If I were paying more, I would have expected higher quality mattresses, but these mattresses were just fine and as expected. No problems whatsoever.
We had a wonderful time at Ohad’s spot, even stayed a night longer than expected. The space was beautiful, and the location was perfect.

We had a wonderful time at Ohad's home. Questions were answered promptly, a small issue with the heater and a portable heater was delivered a short while later. Very spacious and in a perfect neighborhood. Deep wonderful tub and great shower. Lovely backyard. Would love to stay there again.
We loved the area - loads of places to eat and easy transport options. The close proximity to the park was also great for kids. Really well equipped kitchen, laundry etc.

Ohad's apartment is so charming and homey! The kitchen was incredibly well equipped but it's also close to amazing restaurants on Vanderbilt Ave. Our cat loved the loft bed and taking a walk in the back yard.
Classic Brooklyn loft - would definitely stay again when visiting NYC.  Close to phenomenal restaurants and Prospect Park - we thoroughly enjoyed our time!

Great location with lots of restaurants near.  It is on a commercial street at ground level so no surprise that car and foot traffic are right outside the window. At the same time all those amenities are convenient and  accessible. We would stay again!
A great location, a really unique and large space, and great communication made this a fantastic stay. Would stay here again.

Had a fantastic stay at Ohad’s place. Really loved the entire vibe and setup. I found it to be a calm and creative oasis in the heart of Prospect Heights. Didn’t take long for it to feel like home and only wish I could have made it a longer trip.
Even though Ohad was away on his own trip, he was very responsive and made sure I had all the details before arriving. Hope to be back in the future, and even if it’s not for a stay, then to at least support the performances of SEEDS.

My friend Gwen and I had a wonderful stay! The apartment layout was perfect for both of us to be able to work remotely in our separate spaces (living room and bedroom) without hearing each other's meetings. The kitchen was well equipped and a nice space to connect throughout our day and we enjoyed some time on the back patio as well. The washer/dryer was very convenient. The neighborhood is vibrant, safe, and close to everything! We enjoyed walks to Prospect Park and the Brooklyn Botanic Garden and it was a quick ride to meet with friends in the City. Communication was excellent with Ohad and his neighbor who gave us the keys and was very kind. We would definitely stay at Ohad's again and recommend the place to others.
Nice place.  Everything as advertised.  Great location.   Love the open street vibe on the weekends, no cars.  WooHoo 🎉

Ohad's loft is located in the heart of Prospect Heights, which is one of the best neighborhoods in Brooklyn.  On the wekeend, the street outside the apartment is closed off and there are dozens of options for outdoor dining, drinking and there was even free live music on the street. The apartment has a great kitchen -- clearly the host loves to cook.  The vibe is very warm and welcoming.  It's hard to imagine a better airbnb option in the area.  The space is perfect for a couple, and can accommodate 4 people comfortably (maybe more if beds are shared). The loft was clean and the Ohad and his upstairs neighbor who helped out were both very responsive, even at 6:30am when we accidentally locked ourselves out.  We highly recommend this space.

Dear Khatia,
your appartement was very clean and we had everything we needed for cooking, fresh sheeds and towels were available.
Your welcome was warm and loving and we felt like home.
Thank you so much! We come again!
Greetings from Sabine, Jochen, Basti and Eva

I used Khatia’s place to spend a week with my kids seeing the sights in Manhattan. It was perfect for that purpose. It was a hot week but the A/C units worked great and we had no problems sleeping and relaxing in the space.

Kristina was a great host and we had a wonderful time in New York. The apartment was clean and just as advertised. It is located in the center of Williamsburg, so bars, restaurants, groceries, subway and ferry are all available by a few minutes of walking. The bar downstairs was no problem at all.

We enjoyed the apartment's amazing location and did not have any trouble with the bar downstairs. We could hear it but it never bothered us when trying to sleep. Check-in was flexible which we greatly appreciated!
The appartement is really confortable and the area is very nice. We enjoy our stay in Berford avenue. kristina is very communicative, smiling and friendly.
We mostly booked this apartment for its location and we weren't disappointed. There are plenty of bars, restaurants, and shops nearby and the L train into Manhattan is only a couple blocks down.

This place was an excellent place to stay. Central to everything and only one subway stop away from Manhattan. Only noticed the noise from the bar one night but otherwise quiet and lovely area. Heaps of cool things to do around North Williamsburg. Great host and easy to talk to.

All as described in the info- great space for 2, fantastic location, nice place to chill out after a day of sightseeing/shopping. Bar noise didn’t bother us but then i’m not particularly noise sensitive. Host very easy to contact and left us a bottle of wine which was a really nice touch.

Great place for an amazing price. Sure it’s a little noisy but it’s New York. The apartment is roomy, bed comfortable and the location ideal for both exploring Brooklyn or catching a subway to Manhattan. Kristina was easy to communicate with as well.

Kristina was an amazing hostess! Flexible and communicative, and even allowed us to check in early. The space was beautiful and comfortable and in a great location. 10/10 would recommend staying here. Thank you, Kristina!

We absolutely loved Kristina’s place. Check-in was smooth, the place was very clean & as pictured! The location was the best part as it was close to amazing food, bars and several metro stations. I highly recommend this place if you’re looking to stay in Brooklyn. I would love to come back!! Thanks Kristina!

Great apartment in a great neighborhood.
Kristina is friendly and easy to communicate with. Would definitly recomend to stay here!

Fab location right in the heart of Williamsburg, 5 minute walk to the L train and lots of places to eat and drink nearby! The flat itself is charming - 3 of us had plenty of room for a week. Kristina was a great host, replied really quickly to messages and shared loads of local tips - fixed a very minor problem straight away. Would definitely stay here again!
Place was PERFECT. Bagel shop next door. The most amazing sheets we ever slept on, so we ALL literally ordered them personally as soon as we got back home. Would def stay again!
Great location and excellent value for money. Nice little touches such as toiletries and plenty of towels. Sofa bed is very comfy and spacious.  Thank you for a great stay Kristina.

Kristina was an excellent host who answered all questions fast and was really sweet during all your conversations. The place is perfectly located in Williamsburg and the Subway towards Manhattan is located nearby. The apartment had everything we expected therefore we really enjoyed our stay. Check in ran smooth and Kristina was very flexible during our check out.
A great location within Williamsburg close to loads of bars and restaurants. Pretty easy access to the subway to explore other places in the city, too
Kristina has a beautiful place in a great Brooklyn location. It is not far from from the train station and it is a reasonable ride away into Manhattan.
Great location with a lot to do. Perfect place to experience Williamsburg. Comfortable bed and great shower. Enjoyed our stay and will do so again when in the area.
We love this part of Brooklyn and were pleased to be able to stay at Kristina's during our visit! Thanks Kristina!

Dawn was an amazing host! She was super accommodating and flexible.  Her home was not only beautifully decorated, it was clean, kid friendly and in a very central location.  As a frequent visitor to  Brooklyn, I will definitely stay with Dawn again!

Our stay at Remsen Village II was lovely. Dawn was so welcoming and helpful, and provided ample information regarding things to do, places to eat, and getting in and out of Manhattan. The place was just as pictured - nice finishings on an older building. Very comfortable, with A/C and some essentials in the fridge. The only issue was parking. While we did eventually gain access to the gated driveway, there were some issues leading up to it that delayed us for a short while. But other than this, everything went great! Would definitely recommend and stay again if in area.
It’s a cute little place! The inside of the home is so adorable just as shown in the pictures. Dawn is great at responding when needed.

Dawn’s place was great! Better than what the pictures show. Her and her father were soo nice . Home was clean, and she even had food in the fridge for us! Definitely recommend if you are staying in the New York area!

Nice place to stay! It's clean, comfortable and has a backyard to sit outside. A metro station is around the corner. Karen was friendly & helpful and provided lots of snacks & cool beverages, which was much appreciated on a very hot day.

This a great place to stay in a lively neighborhood. There's plenty to do within walking distance. The home was very comfortable and spacious with plenty of room for hanging out, sharing meals, and sleeping for our group of three. The host went out of her way to make us feel welcome.
Karen's place is in an excellent location and is a is a great value. The space was clean and comfortable. Would gladly stay again in the further.

Karen's Air B n B is lovely! It is super comfortable, and very clean & tidy! It's located in a great neighbourhood close to many fabulous restaurants, and cafes! Communication with Karen is great ~ she responds right away.

Karen's description and photos are very accurate, but upon arrival we realized that the apartment definitely exceeded our expectations!  It's a very large and comfortable space with all the amenities that made us feel immediately at home.  There is a full kitchen with lots of room and equipment to prepare your own meals, if so desired.  The three of us felt that we had plenty of privacy with the sleeping arrangements as well as the bathroom and shower.  And if the apartment itself isn't enough, there is a wonderful backyard patio complete with an umbrella table and chairs.  In addition, the location could not have been better.  We walked to a number of excellent restaurants and bars (Three's Brewing was particularly good) as well as Prospect Park and the Brooklyn Museum for the Bowie exhibit.  I guess that the best thing we can say overall, is that we wanted to stay for much longer than the weekend and we will be back!
Karen isn’t a super host for nothing. Her home is well appointed, perfectly located for our purposes, easy to access, and she responds in a heartbeat. A great place to stay.
It was the perfect price, location and size for what we needed on our sightseeing trip in NYC. And Karen was a great host - responsive and kind. Everything about our stay was no-fuss and easy.

Very clean. Modern bathroom. Thoughtful welcome basket with treats. Plus anything you forgot at home, it's probably there in the apartment. Karen also let us leave our bags after check-out as we had an evening flight. Would definitely recommend!

Karen's place is truly a gem! She has thoughtful touches throughout the space that make you feel at home. The location could not be better. So close to so many wonderful shops and multiple Subway lines. Such a wonderful experience! Thanks so much Karen!!

The apartement was lovely, everything was clean and Karen provided folders with useful information and always responded quickly to any questions asked.
Thanks a lot Karen!

The studio is exactly as described. Small but works for one or two people. There are small children that live in the building. They weren’t particularly loud or anything, but if you are a light sleeper you will here them. Great location with multiple subway stations a few minutes walk and nearby cafes, bars and restaurants.
Dawn was a great host and we really enjoyed the amenities provided. Overall a good value for nice stay in Brooklyn!

We were extremely happy with our stay. It was central to everything, had all the amenities needed for a family and it was clean. Our friends that stopped by were also pleasantly surprised. The only downside was that the bedroom tv wasn't working, but it wasn't a big deal as we were gone everyday if our stay. Mr. Leon was super sweet and helpful. He made syre to let our guest know when it was time to move her car due to alternate street parking and he didn't rush us to leave while we waited for our ride. We are making another trip in a few months and hope to book again!
FYI - for out of towners, this host has provided lots of literature on traveling the city, things to see, places to eat, etc. We are from Brooklyn so we knew our way around but had we been tourists, we would have been good to go.
Great place and Karen was very helpful.  Only downside was for my wife, who has a bad hip, the stairs were difficult.
Karen’s studio is accurate to the photos and situated in a great neighborhood. She communicated very well throughout my stay.
Perfect crash pad to shower and sleep while working long hours! Very conveniently located right in the heart of Park Slope.

This studio is in an amazing location, and as a former Brooklynite I can attest. Near great restaurants, bars, parks, subways. The space itself is small (of course, its NYC) but we’ll arranged to be comfortable with all the little touches you need. Highly recommend, I’d love to stay again on future visits!

The apartment was clean and in a great location. Quiet enough to get a good sleep and rest but walkable distance to busy hubs like times square and central park. Electronic entry via key codes was a nice touch as it meant I didn't have to get keys out of my pocket when returning home.
I encountered a few problems with internet but the staff were more than helpful and always resolved any issues within the hour, even way out of office hours. I'd definitely stay here again based on customer service alone.
The location is really good. You have points of interest and two lines of subway in a walking distance. The building is very well maintained and the studio has everything you need.

Excellent location! We loved being able to walk 10 minutes to Times Square/most of the theatres and the subway station. The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable.
We would highly recommend and we’d definitely stay again!

Karen’s cozy apartment served our needs perfectly. Great location to explore Park Slope and beyond. Karen was super attentive and very accommodating after we needed to adjust our dates. We would not hesitate to stay there again.
Ideal location! Perfect for a solo traveler - easy check-in, very safe, comfy bed. Karen was responsive and accommodating.

Fabulous place! Just as listed - so clean and so cozy! The building is in a fantastic location, just off 5th with loads of restaurants and shops and close to subway, but so quiet at night, I slept better than I ever would at a hotel! Karen has thought of everything - all a traveler would need is provided! I can't wait to visit Brooklyn and Karen's terrific studio again in the near future!

This is a great place for a one person or a couple. It's a little squashy for two people not sharing a bed -- but still very doable. The size definitely contributes to a real New York experience! It was clean and comfortable.
The location can't be beat, and I love that things are really nicely set up if you're coming into Brooklyn for, say, a wedding or other event (there's a place to hang your clothes and a little ironing board).
It's pretty much within walking distance of anything you might possibly need -- including a museum, library, and lovely botanical garden!
Fantastic! This space was perfect. Cozy and had everything I needed. Central to so much in Park Slope and just a few blocks to the R train. Make this your home away from home when you visit NYC.
Great location. Neighborhood is super-nice to walk around and only a couple of blocks from a metro station.   We enjoyed our stay in this small, cozy spot.
Karen was a wonderful host and very communicative. The room was exactly as described and was clean and neat and just what we needed.

We were pleased with our stay at Karen's place. It was small, but clean, located in a nice area, and was quiet at night. It was clear from the added touches like the snacks, coffee, and toiletries that Karen had our comfort in mind. We would definitely return again if staying in Brooklyn.
Great clean, comfy, and centralized place. Would love to come stay here for a weekend and explore the neighborhood.

The room is small, as advertised, but very comfortable, and with every amenity the space will allow. Location is excellent!  Karen is thorough in providing helpful information, and quick to respond to comments or questions. I recommend highly!
Great place, great location,  nice touches like a white noise machine and apple charger. Would stay again!

Great location - minutes walk to restaurants and Barclay Center. I was worried about parking but was able to find street parking within 10 minutes. Small space but has everything you need to a night or two stay.

My wife and I stayed at Karen's rental in order to attend a concert at Barclay's. The accommodations were clean, nicely furnished, and cozy. The area is packed with restaurants, bars, and shopping, so there is so much to do.
Karen was responsive and provided clear instructions and helpful advice. Would highly recommend!

Karen's place was perfect for our first visit to New York! The area in Park Slope Brooklyn was an adorable neighborhood and an excellent home base to explore the city from! 5 minutes from the subway, surrounded by tons of good restaurants, bars, and shopping! I loved the High Dive, Babas Pierogis, and The Ripped Bodice nearby! In addition, the space was cozy, comfortable, and exactly as expected! Karen was an excellent host and thought of everything. would love to stay again :)

We have family in Park Slope and have stayed at Karen’s place many times since 2021.  We love it and don’t want to stay anywhere else.  We actually plan our trip dates around when it’s available. In particular the bed is very comfortable and Karen is the nicest and most accommodating host we’ve experienced. We highly recommend Karen’s place.

Just book this already. Perfect location one block away from the subway. Comfy bed, nice and clean private bathroom, a fridge, microwave, electric kettles, a TV… it’s perfect for a couple on a trip to NYC.
Karen is also an extremely kind and understanding host. We have nothing but gratitude for her!
It was a great place to stay while we were in NYC! Very clean, small but everything what you need, as we were only there to sleep:)

Karen was a great host. We were able to stay in a lovely neighborhood, and she hosted a great place-- the room was clean and organized, tastefully decorated, and extremely comfortable. We felt right at home
Karen's place was very comfortable and in a great location.  Not a far walk to the subway and lots of restaurants nearby.  The room was as described - clean & comfortable.  Will definitely come back.
Great location near many restaurants.  The ceiling fan was helpful for temperature control and the white noise sound machine was very useful, as well.
We had a fantastic stay here! The location and space is perfect for a trip to NYC. Everything we could have needed was provided. Highly recommend!
Great location, the space is exactly as described, and Karen is great to work with. Would book again!

Stayed at Karen's place while visiting family in Brooklyn and seeing a concert at the Barclay Center. Was in a great location and perfectly described in listing. Host was flexible with checking in/out and responded quickly to any inquires I made. aThanks so much!
The location was outstanding. Good restaurants, concerts, interesting shops and a pleasant atmosphere. Karen's house is comfortable and has character.

Enjoyed my too-brief stay at Karen's place in quiet Park Slope. Great for a solo traveler, with a comfortable bed and nice bathroom. I appreciated the sound machine as well. It is a second floor walkup so probably not great for anyone with heavy luggage or mobility issues. The space is small but you aren't in Brooklyn to stay inside all day. Easy to access via public transit and close to a lot of good restaurants. Hope I can stay again during my next trip to the city

Our stay was great and Karen was wonderful with accommodations and communicating with us quickly and efficiently. Would definitely recommend this place for people visiting for a couple days - great food, coffee, drinks etc within a 10 minute walk.

Karen was always helpful and responsive. Her place was very clean and tidy, not far from the subway and with Citybikes in front of the door. After our stay in Manhattan, we loved spending the final few days of our trip in this cosy neighbourhood. Thank you for having us!

Susan was a great host and a really helpful woman. Her apartment is located in a lively area of Williamsburg were you can find lots of cool places to eat and have a drink. The apartment was really nice and we had such a nice time in NYC! We would definitely stay there again!

Wonderful apartment in Williamsburg.
Location: perfect location in heart of Williamsburg. Quiet street just off the main thoroughfare of Bedford. 1 minute walk to subway station.
Apartment: beautiful apartment. Very, very clean. Charming with exposed brick and beams. High quality linens and towels. Great bed. Great shower. Kitchen with all appliances and tools. Private deck to enjoy as well.
Host: Susan was very responsive and prompt. Very courteous in our exchanges. Very knowledgeable about the area.
Overall, A+++. Hope to return.

It has been a great stay at Susan's home, everything clean and perfect in the apartment and she was very kind at any moment. We would like to get back soon.
All the Best,
Our stay was fantastic, the apartment was beautiful and the location was perfect. Both the bed and sleeper sofa appeared to be more firm than I typically like but we're very comfortable.

I have been staying in NY b+bs once or twice a year for over 20 years and I have to say that Susan's place ranks at the top of the pile.  She is attentive with her communication, has a great location and the apartment is huge for NYC.  We had friends stop by for dinner and ordered out from Qi just across the street -- killer thai food in 15 minutes!  The walk in shower is superb, there is a pull out sofa bed in case you need to accommodate more people and the back deck is there for good weather.  Street parking was easy to find and the street is super quite even though you are in the heart of now crowded Williamsburg.  The L is only 2 blocks away too.  Three thumbs up!

I grew up in the NYC area and travel there 2-3x per year. Williamsburg Brooklyn is a wonderful neighborhood with many good restaurants within walking distance. Travel into the city is quick and easy on the L train. I much prefer staying in a loft such as this one (versus hotel) and highly recommend it.

I would highly recommend Susan's apartment. Everything went very smoothly. Very close to the L Train and Williamsburg is full of restaurants, bars love.y shops and quiet streets. The apartment is exactly as described with lovely touches to make your stay very comfortable.

I have stayed at Susan's loft several times this winter in between permanent housing. It's the perfect location in Williamsburg near shops, restaurants and the subway. The apartment is large, very clean and well appointed. Susan is very friendly and easy to communicate with about the details, and I would definitely love to stay here again.

We loved our short stay here! Such a large space and so open that you almost forget you're surrounded by the city. Very little traffic, even just people walking by, so you feel very private. The apartment itself is beautiful with an incredible shower, exposed brick and beams, and a balcony that we hope to enjoy on a return visit. Susan was wonderful even well before we arrived, answering questions and giving recommendations. The process could not have been easier and that is a wonderful thing in and of itself!

I used Susan’s place to get ready for my wedding and I use to live in Williamsburg before. If you decide to leave this gorgeous apartment you will literally walk out to all the interesting restaurants, bars and shops.

Fantastic apartment in an excellent location. Very clean with excellent amenities. Susan was an excellent host who communicated very promptly at all times; making our stay very comfortable and smooth. Would recommend this apartment highly

Susan’s place was awesome.  The location was perfect - two short blocks to subway (L Train) and one stop from Manhattan.  The place was huge, clean and very comfortable.  Susan was very accommodating to allow us to drop off our stuff early and leave it after we checked out until we had to leave for airport.

The flat is so well located, just 30mn to the cool places in Manhattan, with a lot of walking option nearby in Williamsburg.
And the best: it is so quiet, you can actually hear birds singing while you drink your coffee in the sun on the balcony. We definitely recommend this flat to all travellers coming to see the big apple. Great hosts too!

Susan's loft is amazing. Perfect location, super quiet, huge space by NYC standards, loved the outdoor patio. Communication was excellent and I loved the added touches such as  having toothpaste and shaving cream in the bathroom, and an umbrella by the door (although I didn't have to use it). I would love to stay here again. Thanks Susan!

Susan's apartment is great! She has thought of everything that makes your stay convenient and she responded within a few minutes whenever I had a question. The apartment is located in a lovely, vibrant area and perfectly located for visits to Manhattan: the metro station is just around the corner. All just perfect! I would love to go there again, so would absolutely recommend to book this  place!

My sister and I had a short getaway in NY over Labor Day weekend and the loft was absolutely the perfect base while we ventured out to our favorite places in NYC.  This is the first time I have stayed in NY where I have not taken the subway.   The loft is an easy walk to the ferry, which was a nice change of scene in transit to get to Manhattan from Brooklyn.    It was very easy to access the apartment and communication was very easy with Susan and she was very quick to respond to any questions.  Would definitely stay there again.

We spent 3 nights in Susan's apartment in Brooklyn. It was exactly as described. The apartment was huge and we enjoyed the outside space too. Really close to public transport and local amenities. We thoroughly enjoyed our time in Brooklyn and will hopefully be back.
The apartment is in an amazing location, minutes from the subway and surrounded by great shops and restaurants. It's also so spacious and bright. I had a great stay.

We stayed at Susan's apartment in mid-March and were amazed at how clean and spacious it is. The pictures really do not do it justice and we immediately felt right at home there.
The location is perfect - between Bedford and Driggs Avenues with all the restaurants, bars and funky shops that Williamsburg has to offer.
If you are looking for a quirky area from which to explore Brooklyn and NYC this is the place to be.
Large, clean, stylish and functional.  Ideal location.  Perfect host.  This choice will not disappoint you.  Highly recommended.
Great apartment in one of the coolest parts of New York, literally everything you need right on your doorstep. Coffee shops, great bars, cafes restaurants and the subway.

The apartment was even better than the photos! Lovely atmosphere, spacious, art on the walls, perfect kitchen, great shower and bathroom, lovely terrace and a guestbook to get you started in Williamsburg. The area is just wonderful. Susan also answered all of our questions promptly and she was super helpful. Goes right into my top airb'n'b experiences!

One of my best AirBnb experiences to date – Susan's home is huge, perfectly located in the heart of Williamsburg, and is extremely clean. Susan was timely, accurate, and accommodating with all communication. We were very lucky to get to stay here!
Susan was an amazing host! She was incredibly response and gave us a great list of places to check out in the area! Would highly recommend!

The apartment is just perfect for 1 or 2 people, and in the heart of No. Williamsburg. If you're interested in exploring Williamsburg, this is the perfect spot. Absolutely no complaints, and Susan provided a beautiful apartment to stay and visit with my family.

Space reserved for a wedding weekend. Very stylish loft, much bigger than the pictures made it look. Skylights, big open living space, lots of exposed brick and aged wood, and outdoor patio made for great getting ready pictures and had plenty of room! Would definitely recommend for nearby myMoon or Winery weddings - walking distance to both.
Very spacious, very clean, well appointed, private outdoor space is a plus. Host was very responsive and great communication. Easy check in and check out and would highly recommend

The art was inspiring, the sun lighting that came through the sun roof was beautiful and our overall experience in that area was great as well. Susan was extremely accommodating and responsive. No complaints from my partner and I.
For future guests just know there isnt an elevator so be mindful when shopping lol.

As people who live in the neighborhood and needed a temporary place to stay, Susan's place is terrific. Located on a great block in Williamsburg, the apartment is a very large one bedroom with an outdoor terrace. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed - we are definitely planning on coming back soon!

A truly special and inspiring place to stay. The outside deck is
Such a treat to enjoy. Great space for Yoga, cooking for loved ones, chilling, and for Brooklyn it is very quiet. Great communication with the host. It is pretty much the perfect pad, and spacious!

Susan was so kind and so responsive - her place is in a great and fun location. The balcony area is the highlight - large and pretty! The only upgrade I think would make it even better is the bedroom tv ( needs a smart tv - currently only cable but we had our projector with us for movies) other then that wonderful - thanks !
