Fantastic Apartment, with everything you could ever need. Susan and John were generous and showed us great communication and flexibility during our stay. Neighbors are also very kind and friendly. We stayed here for 6+ months and I would absolutely recommend Susan's home to anyone.

It was superb to stay at Susan’s place, right in the heart of Williamsburg. A very spacious apartment with everything you need for either a short or longer stay in New York City. Susan was extremely helpful and responsive,  and although it was January I still managed to enjoy the beautiful balcony. I highly recommend this place to anyone that is looking for a clean, quiet and beautiful apartment in a vibrant and exciting area!

Susan is a gracious host with a lovely place. The location is perfect--right off the Bedford Ave L stop--and there's a lot to do right in the neighborhood. Susan is responsive and helpful. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!

We had a great experience at Dennis's and Sen's place. They were very thorough about all the amenities in the apartment and very informative about the neighborhood and accommodating to our needs. Please note that their facilities are great, but they are older, but with some consideration and care, you should have no problem and will enjoy your stay in the apartment.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Susan's place.  The apartment is spacious and comfortable. Susan was extremely responsive and friendly. The apartment is in a great location with easy access to public transportation, but so much is available within walking distance that you may not need it :-)

We really enjoyed our stay.  The apartment is spacious and well equipped.  It is very peaceful and the bed's comfortable, the heating was effective, and it had a good bathroom, a functional kitchen and good living space.  We enjoyed being near good shops, the L subway, ferry and bus routes, and often went on a nice local walk south through parks on the East River bank with great views of Manhatten.

Dennis is a very comprehensive and helpful host. We informed him that there is one more people in the last days before the reservation and he has been very comprehensive and help us to feel like if we were at home. The apartment is very clean and near a metro station, it is the perfect place for people who want to visit New York like us. That was a wonderful stay! Thanks again, greetings from France!
This is a perfect spot if you want to avoid city noise while enjoying the liveliness of NYC. It's just minutes from Central Park with shops & restaurants all around.

The studio is exactly as pictured and is well equipped with everything that you might need during a short stay. The apartment AC works very well and the windows are facing away from the street so it is very quiet. Inna is very responsive and was a great host!

Ashley was an awesome host. We had to check in a day late because of travel plans that didn't go as expected and she was more than accommodating. Her place is huge compared to other places we have stayed at in NYC and is super funky. The bed is great and kitchen top notch. My husband and I had a fabulous time  and really loved the neighborhood way more than we expected! Some great restaurants are nearby and overall just a wonderful experience. Thank you so much for having us!

We stayed at Ashley’s place for a month. The place is spacious for 2. It is easy to get to the Subway. Yummy food near by. Quiet neighbors and Ashley was great at answering any questions we had during our stay. It is a nice place to stay that is far enough from Midtown for some quiet, but easy to hop on the 1 and be there in 25mins.

Rebekah is so wonderful and kind.  We really enjoyed meeting her.  She was so helpful about the area and knows a lot about how to see the sights we wanted to see.  The home was comfortable and clean and quiet and close enough to Pratt where our daughter was finishing up her PreCollege program.  We would definitely recommend this place!

Awesome, is the good word. I'm French and my English is not very good so Rebekah was a very good host she helped me a lot. Your apartment was perfect for me and my family. The sofas-bed are good for few nights and bed very comfortable. The neighbourhood are like you said "a little bit dirty but very safe" but we was really enjoyed it. Keep going to offer a good service, thanks again. All the best.
Benjamin's family

Our stay at Rebekah's place was perfect for our time in NYC! It is a very short walk to the subway, making it easy to traverse the city. Rebekah had every question a guest might possibly have all typed out and readily available, but was also prompt to answer any questions we might have. We loved our stay here and would definitely return if we come back to the city!

Rebekah is a wonderful host, very attentive and always with quick answers.
The apartment was very clean and good located, just next to a local subway directly connected with Manhattan.

Fantastic hosts and place
Near public transport and market
We strongly recommend Rebekah’s apartment
She polited, friendly and allways available
We are very happy with our choice
Magda and Leao, from Brazil September 2017

I would highly recommend Rebekah’s apartment! It is clean, comfortable, and its proximity to the subway make getting around NYC extremely easy. On top of all of that, Rebekah is a thoughtful and very responsive host!
Rebekah house is perfect for a family stay. All her recommendations are perfect for a NY vist

Rebekah was very lovely, ready to help and responsive from start to end and her apartment is perfect. Also the sofas are very comfortable to sleep in so it should not stop you from renting it out. I highly recommend her apartment to everyone.
Great host and perfect communication. The apartment was really Clean and we enjoyed to stay at the place.

Rebekah was an awesome host and had great communication! the location was perfect, very close to the mta and to the bus. the airbnb was cozy and comfortable, clean, and had privacy. i will definitely be coming back to Rebekah’s place when i visit nyc in december! thank you for welcoming me into your home! :)

Everything was as described in the very detailed welcome pack Rebekah provides future guests. We were very happy with the facilities. We slept well throughout our stay in this relatively quiet neighbourhood. It's in a good location, close to a subway station, direct to Manhattan. I would highly recommend it!

Rebekah is a wonderful host. The apartment is close to the subway to manhattan as described; at most an hour to get to the city including walking to your destination etc. Amenities provided were also complete.
The guide given prior to check in was also helpful to give a you an insight of what to expect.

Rebekah is a wonderful and helpful host and provides a very nice apartment, very clean and with everything available in the kitchen, easy access to Manhattan and many supermarkets and restaurants in the nearby neighbourhood. The main bed is super comfortable and everything is exactly as described in the description of the apartment. We had a wonderful stay and felt very safe in the neighbourhood.

We had a fabulous stay at Rebekah's - the apartment was exactly as described, very well stocked, clean and comfortable. We particularly loved the private courtyard! It was a short walk from the subway in a great neighbourhood. Rebekah herself was extremely helpful - responsive, friendly, and provided clear instructions and recommendations. I'd recommend Rebekah's place to anyone looking for great accommodation in Brooklyn!

June was available and answered all my requests, although everything was very well explained in emails she sent and in the apartment itself. I will go back.
Great location in a quiet neighborhood. Only 5 minutes walk from the subway. Some really nice local pubs/restaurants also nice shopping Centre.
Easy check in and check out, it was wonderful to stay in a beautiful, quiet neighborhood that was 2.5 blocks from the Subway after long days of walking around Manhattan.
June is so great at responding and answering any questions. The space is quaint and cozy. My boyfriend and I had a wonderful stay.
This was a great place to stay! Location-wise about ten minute walk to the subway which was convenient for exploring nyc. June was very communicative and accommodating. We had a great trip :)

Everything about this place is exactly as described, and the check in process is efficient and clearly explained. It was cold and snowy but the loft was really cozy - I feel the cold a lot so this was much appreciated!
June was away the weekend we were there, but responded to questions very promptly.
There was a forecast of 10” of snow, so, knowing LGA, we were concerned our flight would be delayed/cancelled and we would need to stay an extra night. June was willing to let us do this, and happy to change her cleaner’s schedule to accommodate us. In the event we didn’t need to stay, and June was ok with this too!
I really recommend June’s place and will certainly be back

Lovely apartment in beautiful green district. We enjoyed the quiet there after long days in town. June and her husband Steve are lovely people and helped anytime with everything. We would love to come back! Thanks a lot!
This place is situated in  beautiful, treed residential area, but just 3 blocks from bustling Queens Blvd and the 7 train. The apt. is well-appointed. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

June's place is so lovely
and a soothing space to retreat to after a long day in the city.
June offers many excellent touches, it felt like she really thought about what would make a guest most comfortable and then provided it. I would definitely stay there again.
Simply furnished but having everything needed for a comfortable stay, this very conveniently located unit in a good neighborhood is a great base from which to explore New York City.
June is a wonderful host; personable, responsive, hospitable. The space is well designed and very clean.  Great stay!

I had a great stay! June is a wonderful host who was very welcoming and easy going. Check in instructions were clear and simple. Everything was clean and supplies were full. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

Clean, awesome space in an awesome NYC neighborhood with GREAT accessibility along the 7 Train to everything you need to get to.  Host instructions were easy to follow and 100% accurate.  Would definitely rent from again.
My parents stayed here for a month and they enjoyed it. The location is very convenient. June is super friendly and responsive.  Overall a great stay with a wonderful host!

Anna's place was great -- perfect spot on the East Side!  Nice and clean, well maintained, and Anna was really responsive with anything needed.  Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great spot in New York!

Inna's place was perfect for my needs, and responsiveness was absolutely perfect.  This is an ideal location on the UES -- close to travel, food, and fun.  The apartment feels spacious for a New York apartment, and the windows get plenty of sun.  Inna was a perfect host and responded immediately on the rare occasion when I had a question.  I would highly recommend this apartment!
A perfect place; centrally located on Upper East side and quiet. Pictures are accurate (bed is very comfy!) - I had a great 3 month stay. Inna was extremely helpful.

Jenny was very responsive to messages. She greeted us with a warm welcome, even when we arrived close to midnight. The apartment looked even better in person! Very spacious and nice upgrades. I would stay here again!

This apartment was absolutely perfect for us - modern and stylish as well as roomy and comfortable, in a vibrant neighbourhood where everyone was incredibly friendly. Bit of a walk to subway and the nearest large grocery store, but only 10 mins in each case, as advertised. Would always want to stay here again if re-visiting NYC. Thanks Jenny and Scott!
Beautiful stylish apartment. Jenny was kind and thoughtful and I enjoy staying at her place. I would definitely stay there again!!
the place is a gem! a very rare find. the location is perfect and the apartment is nice and cozy.  jenny was great and attentive to everything. I really enjoyed my stayed. thanks jenny!
This stay made my trip to NY 10X better. Jenny made our stay so easy and the apartment was so stylish and spacious. I fell in love with this place.

Although we never met in person I felt looked after! One feels at home straight away. She’s available & helpful whilst at the same time giving you the space one needs when traveling.
Lovely place - would stay again - a bargain!
Thank you Jenny!

Very clean and cosy Appartement. Quiet area, everything was there, nice garden, breakfast was there,.......
Recommendable for everybody. Jenny was a perfect Host (helpful and friendly).

If you love being in the heart of a neighborhood like Weeksville which has such a rich Black cultural history in Brooklyn, in a home with modern touches, a backyard oasis and an impressive collection of vinyl, Jenny's is the place for you! I traveled for work and needed a break from my co-workers and this was the perfect oasis for me. You're close to public transportation on either Eastern Parkway or Atlantic Ave., the Weeksville Community Heritage Center is just a few steps down at the end of the block. In addition to the convenience and the stunning updates to the space, there's a beautiful garden with a hammock outside. I loved Jenny's place so much and will definitely be back when I'm in Brooklyn again.
Great spot! The garden was awesome, and it’s a short walk to anything you need. Jenny was super welcoming and she thought of everything. Would recommend staying with her to anyone!

We had a lovely time in this beautiful apartment! we were with a family of four and we had plenty of space.
The garden is a nice place to sit down on warm evenings.
The train is on walking distance.
Jenny is a nice host she gave us a warm welcome!

Good value for money!
Nice apartment for two people with a nice garden.
15 minute walk to subway stations, but there are buses frequently running to the subway stations Utica Avenue (3, 4, 5) and Utica Avenue (A, C) as well.
When we were there (May 2022) a lot of restaurants in the neighbourhood were still closed. NY is still recovering from Covid!

Jenny is a perfect host. She responded quickly to our questions. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment as you can find everything you need and it is very spacious. We would definitely come back to the apartment again.

From the moment I arrived, I felt right at home. Jennifer truly goes above and beyond to have everything ready and prepared, anticipating anything you might need. The place is very spacious, extremely comfortable, and also very quiet. I genuinely had a great time.
The walk to the subway takes a few blocks, but it’s totally worth it because it’s a station where two major lines meet, and if you hop on the A Line express train, the connection to Manhattan is incredibly fast. Plus, getting there from JFK was super smooth — I simply rode the subway and walked to the apartment with my luggage from the station.
The kitchen and bathroom are very well equipped, and Jennifer is always ready to guide you or answer any questions you may have. On top of that, there’s an amazing bonus: a great sound system, a turntable, and a fascinating vinyl collection you can enjoy — something that, as a vinyl lover, I found simply priceless.

My stay at Jennifer’s AirB&B was excellent. I was amazed by how spacious and clean the space was (especially for NY standards). Jennifer has really thought of everything for her guests you may not want to leave the vibrant neighborhood either!
Michelle is an excellent host! If you doubt whether to book this place or not - definitely yes! You won't regret it!
Michelle’s place was very clean and comfortable. I loved the bed, it was very comfortable! Also it was quiet at night and I was able to get good sleep. It was very pleasant stay. I highly recommend!

This is my second time to stay at Chez Michelle's and it's my go to spot when I need to come to NYC for research work. The place is peaceful, clean, with always friendly and respectful other guests. Michelle is a great hostess, responsive, thoughtful, and engaging. The location itself is in the heart of Harlem and so much history, with ease of access to subway, multiple bus lines, restaurants, and a Whole Foods where I can easily pick up healthy food to eat. The location is also well populated with decent amounts of foot traffic so I don't feel isolated coming and going later at night, but not crowded so it feels just really peaceful walking "home" after a long day of work. Highly recommend.
The mahogany suite is the perfect place to stay in Brooklyn. . and Demitria is a very lovely , helpful and wonderful person .

Our stay at The Mahogany Suite was delightful. The space felt like our our private apartment. The space is clean and everything works well . The host is pleasant and was always reachable. There were timely responses to inquiries and questions. We stayed there for 31 days and everyday was delightful. We would definitely book this space again in the future.
Brinton was an awesome host! It was a super easy check in. The place was beautiful and like 100m close to public transit. The airbnb had everything you need for an awesome stay.

First thing to note is how clean the apartment was, a lot of effort is put into the upkeep of this place which is clear to see when you first step through the door.
The apartment itself is exactly as described - very modern look and feel, great size and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Location is great, it really is in the heart of Harlem and you get a real sense of the community from staying here. Also steps from the subway which can take you direct into Midtown Manhattan (Times Sq etc) and walkable to Central Park.
Brinton was really easy to communicate with, kept us up to date with everything and was a very accommodating host - can't recommend highly enough.
Thanks Brinton

Great location. Home looks just like the pictures. Good location to enjoy New York in its entirety. We enjoyed our stay in this home and it made our trip much more enjoyable. Brinton responded quickly to any questions we needed to ask. The home was clean and had all the necessary amenities for a great stay.

Loved staying here. Amazing location and super modern and stylish decor. The pros are: location, cleanliness, decor, great communication and super easy check in. As others have pointed out, the only considerations are the stairs (3rd floor walk-up with no elevator and old/dirty carpeting: when you first walk in, the stairs take you by surprise but when you get into the apartment, it’s “wow, this is so nice!”), and the street noise (the apartment is street facing and I’m a light sleeper so I had trouble sleeping - welcome to NYC! - if you’re a light sleeper like me turn on your white noise app or bring earplugs). Overall: I’d definitely stay there again and highly recommend it! Brinton was great and did a really nice job.

Brinton’s place was clean and quaint. Had a lovely stay and it was really easy for all of my friends who were local to meet me there for us to go out for drinks and nightlife. A block up, you have a bank, a CVS, whole foods and the train station. There are several hidden gems in the area and the building was very quiet at night. Guest access is easy and user friendly. Keep in mind there is no elevator though and the unit is on the third floor, but I didn’t mind! I can’t rave enough about the neighborhood which is lively and full of culture and away from most of the midtown bustle (ideal for me.) Thank you Brinton! I’ll definitely be visiting again.

This is the place to be to discover Manhattan: close to the metro, central park, cvs and wholefood! The aparment is chic and well equipped for a comfortable stay!  Communication with Brinton was 10/10! This place is a true gem!!

This place was very stylish, had plenty of amenities to help accommodate my stay. Only thing i was disappointed about was the pressure of the sink was extremely low which harbored me being able to cook or utilize that sink at all during my stay. But everything else was great.
great location, clean apartment, and very professional host! would definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in Harlem.

Great place to stay with easy accessibility to subway. We stayed for 3 months without any major issues and Brinton was very communicative in solving any minor issues. Modern apartment with everything you need for long term stays. Neighbors were quiet and easy to live near.

Martha's house was very close from the subway, nice and quiet neighborhood, the hosts was very welcoming and answer quickly when we was in need. It was a little small for 6 people. The kitchen was equipped, shops at 5-10 minutes walks. The subway serves a lot of famous place of Manhattan (not necessary to change stations).

Very nice place. It is not big but was enough for 4 adults and 2 kids. The house was very clean and well equipped with everything you need. Bathroom and kitchen are new and have everything you need for a nice stay. Pictures are very accurate and you see exactly how the house looks. Martha and her husband are great, communication was very easy and got good recommendations for food and shopping around the house. The location is also very good. We drove couple of times to Manhatten and took us around 30 to 40 minutes but was on Sunday and Memorial Day. JFK is also close, just 15 minutes drive so was perfect for us. We will definitely go back to this place next time when we will be in NY.
This is a very neat and comfortable house. Martha and Michael are very friendly hosts. It's easy to take the subway and find the place to park the car. Good place to stay.

Martha was such a great host. The home itself was perfect. It had everything we could have needed and more! The home was recently renovated and is super clean. Martha was extremely flexible with our travel schedule which really helped us out.
There are markets and food options nearby. We were really impressed with El Ray’s- it was delicious!!
The subway station is about .5 mile from the house & it takes about 40 minutes to get into midtown Manhattan.
We absolutely loved Martha's place. Spacious, clean and with all the amenities a family of four needs for a stay in Queens. We will be back for sure.
Martha is sooo sweet!  We appreciated her warm welcome!  She provided just the right amount of assistance regarding the local transportation and eatery recommendations.  We are fans!
Very clean very cute place! My kids loved her attention to detail! She left us water and juice , her hospitality was amazing ! Wished we could have stayed longer 💕

Martha and her husband were extremely nice people. Her husband was very helpful with local tips. Parking is a bit of a hassle as you have to move your vehicle off the street at certain times or else you will get ticketed. It happened to me but this was my error for not reading the street signs. It is a bit of a walk to the subway trains, but not all that bad as long as you are in decent shape.  I highly recommend this place as it is spotless when you arrive. And I felt very safe in this neighborhood. I would stay here again!

Very clean, comfortable, and stylish home in a wonderful area! The host provided everything we needed and more including take-out menus, water, coffee/tea, and juice. Location is about 3 blocks from the subway and shopping area

Marta and her husband are very friendly and nice persons, they took care about everything while we stayed in their apartment. The apartment is perfect, very clean, beautiful and comfortable. You can find there everything you will need. The neighborhood is beautiful too, quite and safe. It is close to the bus stop and train to Manhattan. We enjoy staying here and can recommend this place 100% to others clients.

Martha and her husband are amazing hosts. The house is fantastic, very clean, functional and modern. The beds and the sofa-bed are very comfortable. we didn't cook but the kitchen has everything you need if you want to.
The neighborhood is safe and public transportation is just a few blocks away. There are tons of options for restaurants on the surrounding areas. Totally worth it.
Excellent place in an excellent location. Totally worth it. Would love to stay again if I visit NYC.
Cozy spot! about half mile from the (R) subway and very close to lots of reataurants and shopping centers! Martha was an excellent hostess! I would definitely recommend this location!

The space was amazing! Had all the necessities including bar soap, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner! It was super CLEAN and newly renovated. It felt like a safe location. Really felt like home with the orange juice, bottled water, and milk.

Martha’s place was perfect for us. House is immaculate, had all the necessities, walking distance to the subway station and close to most shops. Quiet and safe neighborhood. One thing that stands out is the owner’s hospitality. We checked in really late, they were there to personally check us in and even offered to pick us up when we returned our rental car. Highly recommended. We know where to stay when we travel back to NYC!
Nice flat in a fully renovated house in Queens, near to metro station. Good place to visit Queens and Manhattan. Recommended.

Martha’s location is the PERFECT location to stay! We were close enough via public transportation, Ubering to/from La Guardia Airport, and close to great places to eat/shop!
This location is located in a very safe and quiet neighborhood. We commuted on the metro at night and felt very comfortable. Easy trip to nearby metro stations. Great food (GREAT bagels and smear at the Bagelette) nearby, Costco/Aldi’s within walking distance, shopping mall nearby, and lots more.
Martha’s locations has all things that’s absolutely modern! Beautiful kitchen, open space living room concept, GREAT BATHROOM -> there’s a waterfall shower head!!!!
I would ABSOLUTELY recommend that you book Martha’s location if you’re looking to stay near the city but not in the city!

With Marta and Michael, you will never be disappointed !
Good location (next to bus and metro station), very clean apartment, and very friendly and available hosts.
Thanks again for everything and hope to see you again !
Samantha

I stayed at Martha's place for few during business trip to NY. For work I had to travel to Manhattan, and found it very easy to walk < 10 minutes to the train station and take direct train to heart of Manhattan.
The place itself is totally private, sparking clean, with huge refrigerator, usable kitchen and nice stylish touches.
Second time here. The best place to stay. Clean, fresh, quiet, well-located. Hosts are very kind and friendly. I will choose this place again and again.
Great space, close to everything! It is a very clean, comfortable place to stay in. My family and I will definitely be back

Martha's place is wonderful -- beautifully decorated, clean, and perfect for the five of us who stayed there. The beds were so comfortable, it was quiet, convenient to Manhattan via public transportation and a great value. We would be happy to go back!

Michael and Martha were wonderful Superhosts.  Their place was very clean and you can tell that they take pride in the upkeep of their home.  We were greeted and treated like friends.  Communication was excellent.  I will definitely be back over the years while our daughter is attending school there.  Thank you and I enjoyed our stay!
The description of this place is 100% accurate. Martha was always available to answer any questions or concerns during  my 1 month stay.

Loved staying here. The place was exactly as advertised. It was perfect for our family of 4. About a 10-12 minute walk to the subway and busses right outside the house. Hosts were extremely helpful and hospitable. Would highly recommend staying here!

the best airbnb I've stayed in.. excellent location lovely neighborhood very safe.. the host are both very friendly nice caring ppl. perfect home and very clean everything you need for a stay and tour NYC!! thousand times better than a hotel..Martha and her husband make you feel a home ..did not want to leave... most definitely will be staying again...
thank you Martha for a great experience and making me and my family feel a home..

Really enjoyed our time here. Perfect location for a few days at US Open and a bit of time in the city. Quiet, safe, friendly neighborhood with easy access to Open or to other areas in city. Highly recommend and will book again when back in the city.

Very neat space in a walkable and safe area. Super grateful for how proactive she was with reaching out prior to check in, plus all her restaurant and travel recommendations were spot on. Absolutely wonderful experience!

This was a great, affordable place to stay while visiting NyC. It was Close to the subways to get to manhattan and all the tourist attractions.  It was also Close to familiar grocery stores and shops if you needed them. We always felt safe when walking to and from the trains no matter what time of day.

This apartment is perfect if you want to visit New York. Martha and her husband, Mike, are the sweetest person. They made us many GOOD recommendations that were very helpful during our trip.
The apartment is cosy and functional. Perfect for 4 persons.
Just be aware that there are stairs to access to the flat.
There is many bus and subway next to it (bus right across the street and subway at 15min walk).
The apartment is 40min from Manhattan, perfect if you want to visit.
Thank you again to Martha and Mike !

My wife and I really enjoyed your place to stay a week in Queens. Flexible check-in, felt right at home, clear instructions, responsive host, easy to find and easy to get inside. The whole place was very clean. She listed amenities and services and local recommendations. The neighborhood was walkable, lots to do, peaceful, great restaurants and great shopping. 5 star rating.

Martha‘s apartment is really nice, with everything one could want, very nicely furnished, well equipped and extremely clean.
The neighborhood in Forest Hills is very nice, with a good public connection to the city and all one needs in walkable distance.
One thing one should consider is that there is no complete separation of living and sleeping room as the wall is open at the ceiling.
The hosts are very nice and responsive.
Thank you very much, Martha and Dylan!
We will be back.
Clean, extremely helpful, safe and affordable. Would and have already recommended others to stay here on their next vacation!

Warning to potential guests: If, on the day you are going to travel to this Air Bnb,  and you have to rush to the ER because you are sick, and the doctor writes you a note restricting travel, don't expect any kind of refund from these hosts.

A lovely place, spotlessly clean and very comfortable. The only downside was that the kitchen could have been better equipped, though I imagine most guests don't cook as much as we do. We loved our stay and would highly recommend.

Martha's place was perfect for our family. The neighborhood was very safe and the Airbnb was so nice and clean. Martha and her Husband made checking in very easy and were very helpful with recommendations around the city. we will definitely stay here again!!

Great location. Clean space. Room is as advertised. FYI This is a hotel which has plus and minuses - plus: you can get room service and  any extra linens etc you want.  Minus: checkin can get crowded if you arrive at check in time

I cannot say enough good things about this place; from the seamless check in process, to the nicest and most helpful staff, to the spotless room with incredible comfy beds to the location. The location. This place is literally in the heart of everything. It is just blocks from everything. We will definitely be back.

The host was very responsive which was nice.  The apartment was large by NYC standards.  There is a grocery store nearby so you can cook "at home." The bed was firm but turned out to be very comfortable.  There is wifi but no cable so prepare for that.  Hopefully you will be so busy exploring you won't miss it.  There is a small park nearby and access to Riverside Park from 125th St. Central Park is a quick ride on the train.  You can easily access most of the island from the A train which is right around the corner.
I enjoyed my say at Esi's place. The metro is a short walk from the airbnb. The bed was firm (which I liked) and I brought ear plugs to deal with city noise. I slept well each night I was there.
I really recommend this place. Very nice and clean. Close to the subway. I had a good time to stay at Elsi’s place. First time doing Airbnb but really did not regret it.
Great place and great location. Super easy to access and Esi was responsive and helpful. Highly recommend.
Great location, a little loud at night but that’s expected in the city. Lots of tasty restaurants and grocery stores within walking distance.

Esi’s place is very well located, it has many supermarkets and a subway station nearby. The check-in was easy. Unfortunately, the apartment is not well cared. Firstly, it seems that they use it to storage old stuff, as every drawer was full of things and you have no place to put anything. Secondly, although the apartment is cleaned or organized between guests, it needs a deeper cleaning because it has accumulated dust in some spots. Lastly, BUT VERY IMPORTANT, there are some things in the apartment that don’t work properly; one in the tv which is supposed to be a SmartTV but you cannot use any application; and the HEATING doesn’t work for heating up the apartment so it could be very very cold inside.
Additionally, I tried to contact Esi to ask for help with the heating (when the temperature outside reached -10 C and we were freezing inside the apartment) but she ignored my message.

We really enjoyed as he's place! The building is very good, clean, with the sweet outdoor patio. Convenient location with access to the subways. The apartment has great light, is very spacious, nice firm bed and great water pressure in the shower. Really easy to communicate the management company. Thanks for a great stay!
Esi’s Place was great. It wasn’t too far away from the main NYC attractions. We enjoyed our stay and hope to come back to NYC sometime in the future

I loved my stay here! I stayed for a month while I was in NYC working in the Bronx. This place was easy to get to the 2 train and very convenient to get to the B,C. The apt is located in such a cute area of Harlem. Everything I needed was close by, grocery store, laundry mat, gym, restaurants etc. I stayed there myself and felt very comfortable in the neighborhood. I have zero complaints!  Esi's instructions were very well thought out and clear that I never had any questions. Her place is very tidy and has all long term amenities. She is a great host and I am thankful for my stay.

You really cannot beat the price for this location. The room is unassuming, but perfect for my husband and I to do a quick trip to NY. We had an issue with the water heater and we spoke to JP after already checking out. He offered us a beer and said he will look into it. We would stay here again.

Jp's apt is located in a good area.  It is close to Union Square, the subway,  and shops.  The apt is exactly what the pictures show.  It has everything you need - heating, warm water, TV...apt big enough for two people.

Great location! Really simple place, if you just need a place to sleep while in the city. Loved the bar downstairs and the people in it, everyone was super friendly. Only issue was our shower never would warm up, hopefully that will be fixed for future visitors. Thanks for a fun time in NYC!

With literally NOTHING else available on such a short notice, I pre-booked with JP based on the location and availability on a hope and a prayer that it would be
a clean and safe spot. I was VERY LUCKY. The check in process was simple and easy. JP was available to answer any questions. The accommodations were humble, clean and absolutely perfect for my one night, last minute trip to NYC. I was only a few easily walkable blocks from my appointment. I was surprised by how comfortable the bed was and although it was abit cold in NY that night, there was an extra blanket in the second drawer of the dresser which worked great! The bar below stays open late. If you are a light sleeper, ear plugs will solve that for you.

Lovely place to stay when you need a rest. We arrived late in the morning and we were able to get our keys and check in no problem! Great communication, place very cleanly. It is over a bar which patrons can get loud, but the ac drowns it out. Would definitely stay again!
Last minute reservation, Jp was responsive; easy check in & check out. What you see is what you get, be aware of music from bar downstairs, did not bother me. Excellent food at Cafe Mono nearby.
Clean small place.  A bit loud from the bar downstairs up until like 2-3 am

Ideal for anyone travelling on a budget.. location is best thing on this apartment! Apartment is over a bar, so this is definitely for someone with light sleeping, we did fine! We had an issue with WI-Fi, it did not work the whole stay... Besides that everything was good

Pictures are accurate, I wasn’t expecting much but upon arrival there was a cockroach in the shower. Everything else seemed clean. The a/c unit is right behind the bed and blows on your head and doesn’t cool the room off that well. After a shower it would be hot and humid for awhile. TV is a joke it’s so small you can’t even see it from the bed and only gets about 5 channels. Also, the blinds don’t close all the way so sunshine would wake me up every morning at 7:00 am.
The location is great but honestly the price needs to be even cheaper for what you get. I would have rather paid an extra $50/night for a nice hotel.
Very clean. Well located and host very responsive that’s much appreciated. All you need for a short NYC stay.
We very much enjoyed our stay! Everything was exactly as described in the listing, and the room was clean and tidy. It was just what we needed, and the location was perfect. JP was an excellent host!
Is as advertised, great location and very affordable. Right above a bar though so it can be a little loud but we slept through it fine.
Easy check-in, great location close to Union Park but can be loud if live band is playing in pub downstairs.

I love this airbnb! very close to the metro 4min walk, coffeeshops and a park to hang out. the only thing was there is no fridg which was very sad but we knew it before we booked the place so it was ok. but with a mini fridg this place would be perfect for a stay during the weekend

Great location. Clean room. Can hear the pub downstairs all night, but I kind of dug that. A fan for some air circulation would be great. The bed left a lot to be desired. But for a long weekend trip, was doable. Would recommend. Would use again.
Perfect location! Easy check in. Air worked great even in 95 degree weather. Perfect for a quick stay

Jp’s location was easy to find and his instructions were clear. Jp was very responsive and helpful. My only complaint is that the room was very cold. Besides that, the room was affordable and I recommend this location for a quick stay.

I will not recommend this room during the week end if you planned to sleep : loud music coming from the bar at the first floor and people shouting until 4am. However, if you planned to party until 4am, it’s ok

A nice little place, very well located. JP was very responsive and we had everything we needed for our short stay. I do recommend bringing some earplugs for the place is just above a bar which is really loud, really late.

The apartment is extremely well-appointed and in a great central place in Williamsburg. There are also Subway stations pretty close by to get to Manhattan if that's your thing. Honestly one of the best Airbnb experiences you could hope for. I highly recommend Gala's apartment for your next trip.
Fantastic place to stay in Brooklyn! Gala was super helpful and communicative, and the apartment couldn't have been better, or more convenient. Will definitely be staying again.

The apartment was perfect for my couple of nights in NYC for work. It was clean and very comfortable! Gala was quick to respond and made sure I had everything I needed. Also, there's a great grocery store on the corner that was perfect for getting snacks!
Very clean apartment very close to the train and some restaurants. Gala was very easy to deal with. Checking in and out was seamless. More Bushwick than Williamsburg but would recommend.

Everything is as described in Gala's description of her apartment. Location is great for public transport and we enjoyed the local amenities of Williamsberg with great restaurants/bars/coffee shops in walking distance. It's very cosy and comfortable and was a welcome chill zone for us after taking in the many attractions of wonderful New York.

Gala's flat is perfect for a couples holiday to New York. Extremely close to the local subway which takes you straight to Manhattan. Really stylish with a beautiful bathroom. Only 15 minute walk to all the built up hipster area's of Brooklyn. Amazing restaurants only 7 minutes away. Really nice balcony and a private washing machine which is rare for New York! Modern and safe building in a really safe feeling area. I couldn't recommend more!

Very good value for money in a practical location to get around and avoid manhattan prices while being very close and quick to be in town . The place was clean and well equipped , including a washing machine which is rare in New York.  The bed was very comfortable and Gala was very accommodating and responsive .  I would go back .
Gala’s place was adorable and close to a few subway stops! She was very responsive as well. Great place.
Clean apartment.  Couple blocks from subway.  Quiet complex with beautiful view from rooftop on backside of building.

Absolutely loved my stay in Galas apartment, it was incredibly well located for all our travelling needs with many train stations within an easy 5-10 minute walk (and then only 20-30 mins into Manhattan) walking to the more ‘central’ parts of Williamsburg only took about 20 minutes too - where you will find lots of bars and restaurants. The road and area felt safe and homely and we enjoyed watching the many baseball games in the park from Galas balcony. Very good experience and cannot recommend this place enough!
The apartment is light-filled, clean, and spacious. So easy to communicate with the host. We absolutely loved our time here.

Great stay in Harlem which was close to Lenox where all the restaurants and action was. Also once you get to Lenox you can easily take the train everyone - no need to stay in central Manhattan! One comment is that since there is a unit and hallway just behind us, I was able to hear everything which was not the most favourable since I am a light sleeper. Otherwise, we really enjoyed our stay and time in NYC!

We arrived to NY for a bussiness trip, but thanks to Chito we really enjoyed the time we spent in the city. The flat was cosy, 100% clean and prepared for any unexpected events. Area was friendly and less busy than the city centre, so it provided great relief after all day spent on Manhattan. Plus the subway was very close and easy to get to. When the rain started pouring down, we found an umrella waiting for us in a closet... Also the  kitchen and fridge came in handy, because we could cook ourselves a small dish when we were not in the mood for going out... All these small details really matter and make you feel great, I would not change for any hotel :)

This Harlem Location is PERFECT! Chito and Xavier’s place was quaint, nice and clean. Great for younger guest, but Baby-boomer age not so much. I only say that because of the very narrow spiral staircase that you’ve gotta maneuver from the below level bedroom if you’re in a hurry to use the restroom that’s upstairs!! AND it’s best to be in good shape and not overweight or exceptionally tall!!
Other than THAT PART, the host and apartment was great!!!
Lovely place in the very heart of Harlem.  Chito and Xavier were very delightful hosts.

Nice place conveniently located just above Central Park. Clean, enough space for probably 4 people, well equipped. Chito was vey responsive and addressed any messages within minutes.
Recommended!

Chito and Xavier’s place is great for visitors wanting home comforts in a stylish environment.
When my friend & I stayed, she had the bedroom & I slept on the sofa bed which was very comfortable.
The place is very clean & has everything you need, including a hairdryer & iron.
The walk to 125th Street Station is an easy 10 mins.
Chito & Xavier are perfect hosts and nothing is too much trouble for them.

A great place to stay during a NYC visit. The apartment offers everything you need, is clean and located near to public transport. From there, you can reach all spots in Manhattan. The host(s) were very communicative and answered our questions in a very short time. I definitely recommend this place!!!
The apartment was extremely neat, clean, and close to the metro. Hosts were very kind and quick to respond. We had an amazing stay and would definitely come back again!

The place was sparkling clean and located in the heart of Harlem.  There are numerous eateries close by and I was able to walk to Central Park.  You literally can't beat the location.  Chito and Xavier were very responsive and gracious hosts.

Charming space. Very close to public transportation and restaurants. More spacious than many NYC apartments are. Be cautious of the staircase that leads down to the bedroom, it was narrower than I expected. Overall nice space for the price. Hosts are very friendly and quick to respond.
Loved the space ! It’s soo convenient to everything ! Definitely recommend it to anyone going to Harlem. I would definitely stay here again !

Spacious apartment with living room/bathroom/kitchen on the ground floor and separate bedroom below. Only gripe's with the narrow spiral staircase down to the bedroom. However, hosts were communicative and provided easy self-check in instructions

Chito And Xavier are very accomodating hosts. The apartment is clean and cozy and has a convenient location with easy access to the public transportation system. It's only a few stations from the world-class museums Metropolitan and Guggenheim and only one mile away from Central Park.  So you can enjoy a morning run in Central Park.
Chito and Xavier’s space is marvelous! Super clean, quiet location. They gave me great check-in directions and were flexible with my check-in. I highly recommend their listing.
It was so fun to stay in an authentic brownstone and have all of the comforts of home. The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, and secure. The hosts are very responsive, friendly and helpful!
What an absolute find! This is a gorgeous place in a beautiful area! Absolutely would stay here over and over again!
A great summer guest apartment, with an afforable Manhattan location. The rooms were extremely clean with a wide range of amenities the owners maintain good upkeep.

An absolutely beautiful AirBnB! Bedroom was very comfortable and the apartment had all the amenities you would need - including extra bedding & plenty of pillows. A completely accurate description and would gladly stay there again!

Great location and neighborhood and meticulously maintained property. Check in was easy and Chito and Xavier were very communicative and helpful. The only thing to note is that the spiral stair to the sleeping area is a bit tight and steep and may not be easy to manage for some folks.

Such a great and clean Apartment.
We had such a nice week there.
The communication is very good. If you have any questions they answering you so fast.
You can find the next Subway just some streets away and arrive Central Park and the whole „City“ in a few minutes.
The Check-in and Check-out was so uncomplicated.
If we come back to New York we will book again!
Really recommend this place! It’s absolutely perfect as a base to explore NYC. Short walk to the subway and located on a quiet road so slept soundly. Great host communication, thanks for having us!

Lovely private apartment in Harlem, 10 mins walk to the subway to go into Manhattan. Total 45 min trip one way into central Manhattan. Apartment has everything you need! Especially love that we could make our own breakfast each morning before adventuring out into town. The spiral staircase was extra nyc special but I wouldn’t recommend it for any elderly as it’s steep! Everything was just as described, super easy check in/check out and the hosts are very responsive! Thank you so much Chito and Xavier, hope to return one day soon.

The place is great, really clean, with every basics and well connected.
Chito and Xavier were very clear with the arriving instructions and responded immediately when I had doubts.

Good and safe location. We found the sleeping downstairs with the narrow staircase connecting to the bathroom upstairs not very practical. Also the bed is quite narrow, even though there would be space for a wider bed. The shower is very unpractical. It basically forces you to wash your hair every time, because the hair gets wet automatically. This should be changed, better solutions do exist. The light in the external corridor is switched on 24/7, which is very irritating for energy conscious people. Otherwise fully equipped flat for an authentic stay and a host, who answers immediately.
Cannons is a super host ! He rent above and beyond to cater to all my needs, I definitely  recommend cannons place !

Cannon's place is charming, with ample space and amenities. I loved the sparkling wood floors! And the location is perfect for anyone who wants to really feel the nature of Greenwich Village. Cannon himself is kind and very accommodating. I will happy to have the chance to stay there again on my next trip.

Cannon's was a very gracious host to both my wife and myself. Literally the day before our arrival in New York our prior reservation was cancelled. In our situation, Cannon was extremely accommodative. He quickly responded to all of our inquiries, and met us at the location upon our arrival. The space was clean, and most importantly warm! The weather during our stay was especially chilly, but the apartment was always a great reprieve from the cold. The neighborhood was beautiful, quiet, and everything we had hoped for. I would highly recommend staying at Cannon's location.
The location of this place was amazing. Walking distance to so many great restaurants and shops. Cannon was also a fantastic host and very responsive.

Cannon's place is a perfect base for exploring the city, based right off of Greenwich Avenue with plenty of amazing restaurants and bars at your doorstep. The apartment is nice and cool even during the heatwave and a perfect relaxing space to come home to. Cannon is a lovely host with great communication, quick replies and happy to recommend places to go! Would stay again next time I come to the city!

Everything about the stay was great. The location is prime. The unit is perfect for a long stay. Cannon was a superb host — extremely helpful and accessible whenever I needed him. Couldn’t ask for a better Manhattan experience. Can’t wait to return!

Great host! The space was clean and ready for us to inhabit. Communication was great and we were able to check in and out with no problems! Very convenient distance from the subway in addition to the great place!
Good place to stay, room is comfortable, although a little bit noise on air conditioning, but can use fan in room instead.

It may say this in the listing but there is no  kitchen.  At this price and locale I would have expected that.  Other than that close to subway, it was also clean.  I’m a fan of electronic keypad for entry as it reduces the need for having someone meet you.  in this case I was met at the door but you have to coordinate that.

Such an amazing location. So many things that I’m used to being able to find were within reach. No following crazy directions to get to simple places such as Target. It’s so close. And there are a lot of things that were open late.

The place is very clean. Its a bit far from the tourist spots of New York but is located very near to the Subway, so its easy for you to commute. Many restaurants nearby and safe neighbourhood. Satisfied!

Amazing little place in the Bronx! My friends and I had a very comfortable stay and enjoyed all the amenities and tips provided by the host. We'll definitely come back to this place next time we're visiting. 10/10 would reccomend!
Very closed to metro station.  Easy to access anywhere.  Flat is clean and comfortable.   Very responsive

This was our first AirBnB experience so we didn’t know what to expect. We found a wonderfully clean place, that was thoughtfully accessorized to suit the needs of a family of 5. They had umbrellas and phone chargers and board games that all made such a difference and enhanced our experience. Wouldn’t stay anywhere else when we go back to New York.

Our host Stephanie gave us a super nice and informative meeting upon our arrival. Both about the living and the area. We hung out mostly in Manhattan, therefore it was highly appreciated that the subway was so close to the apartment.
We really liked this place. Surroundings were fine, host gave accurate instructions about check in and the housing was nice.

The stay at this AirBnB was pleasant and included all that is needed to be comfortable for the weeks stay - even without a full kitchen. The unit was stocked with plenty of linens, complimentary slippers, snacks, teas and coffee. Oh yeah, and WiFi too!! I loved that the location was very close to the graduation venue @ Yankee Stadium, a 6-7 block walk.  We felt very safe walking in the neighborhood and parking the car. Seana is very responsive, and I appreciate she was able to accommodate us for an extra day. I would definitely consider staying at this AirBnB location again. Thank you Seana!!!

Deborah was the most caring and welcoming host ever! We had a wonderful time in her home like Apt. in the most amazing neighborhood in Manhattan. Because we travelled as a family with our baby daughter we had quite a few extra requests all of which she promptly fulfilled. The Apt. is fully equipped with everything you need. There are many excellent food opportunities, grocery stores and a laundry in walking distance.
From the very first day - when we arrived after a 5 hour flight, and Deborah provided us with breakfast including home made blueberry jam - to the very last day, she and her husband were truly fantastic hosts. If we ever have the chance to come back to New York, we will definitely stay at Deborah´s place! We could not have felt more at home.

Deborah´s place has an awesome location. Silent street, next to supermarkets, restaurants, drugstores, bakeries, playgrounds, parks, subway. Everything is just a few minutes walking. The size is perfect for a 4 people family. Me and wife had a queen size bed in a room and our baby a full bed on the other room. Both rooms were comfy and had air conditioning. Kitchen is well equipped to cook meals and to store your goods. Excellent hot shower/tub. The big screen tv was used only to watch the world cup final match.
Deborah was extremely kind at check in time/procedure. Her tips about the city gave us a lot of fun and helped us save good money! If airbnb is home away from home, Deborah is undoubtedly the big sister! She really took care of us! The perfect host! Whenever we come back to NY, Deborah is the host! We surely recommend!
A great value apartment that has what you need in a good location. Perfect for 2 people. The weekly included maid service was a wonderful addition!

My partner and I visited NYC for 6 weeks and stayed at Deborah's place. She was very inviting and easy to communicate with - anytime we needed anything she would make sure to accommodate as quickly as possible.
The place itself is in an amazing location - most nights I ended up walking back home because of how central it was to everything. It's nice and quiet and has access to lots of restaurants around.
The space is tiny, but does the job well. 2 bedrooms and a convertible sofa allowed for 3 of our guests to fit over a weekend. I'd highly recommend a stay at Deborah's place.

Really cute little place, good for a couple. Private parking garage is great to have and definitely some restaurants and little bodegas in walking distance, and a short ride from some more restaurants. Uber eats also available, just heed reviews to nearby places! No tv, wifi was fine with our own laptops.
One of my favorites..pocky sticks! mmMm
Would stay again, great value.

Ivanna's apartment was very clean and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay.  Communication was very easy and prompt. Parking spot on the basement and secured.  I felt very safe in the neighborhood.

It’s a clean and well organized studio. The parking space was real nice for me. The location is convenient. But a lot of noise was from the street . But we had a good night sleep nevertheless. Highly Recommend
Great place to stay! It was described accurately and exceeded our expectations. Ivanna was great, always available and quick with responses. Would definitely stay again :)
Best Airbnb experience so far thanks to Ivanna and her very cozy studio. The place is just as pictured and described. Don’t hesitate and just book now! Will definitely be back.

This was my first time using AirbNb, and My stay with my family was better than I expected , my family and I are very thankful for all the attention. Great host. I am recommending this host for anyone.

Ivanna's place was wonderful! There were great homey touches, it was very clean. It takes about an hour to get into Midtown, but Ivanna's directions are detailed and precise. Ivanna was great at keeping in contact, and accommodating about check in times.
Ivanna's' home was perfect ! Don't hesitate to rent this place  ! Thank you very much !
Ivanna is a great host. The room is exactly as shown in the picture. The building is brand new and the parking is very convenient. Ivanna is very considerate. We enjoyed our stay in her place.

Thank you for your studio, Ivanna! It made us feel comfortable and warm. Everything were prepared and practical, so it was convenient for us to live here. And the location of the house is great, the bus stop and the supermarket is around. You were a nice, kind and helpful host! We wanna come back again!!!
Ivanna’s place was adorably decorated. It had everything we needed. She was very accommodating and a great host!
Ivanna was a wonderful host! Not only was her place absolutely perfect, Ivanna was responsive and helpful, offering tips about the area! I highly recommend Ivanna’s place to anyone looking!

Ivanna is a wonderful a d communicative host. She was so accommodating when my reservation was extended and a pleasure to rent from. Her place was just what I needed. Very clean, cozy and comfortable. It’s a little noisy I’d you’re not used to the city, but closing the window and using ear plugs will do just the trick. The garage was a luxury in Queens. Could not have asked for a better situation. I would rent from Ivanna anytime and would highly recommend her and her place.

Ivanna was super host! From check-in to check-out fabulous communication. Ivanna’s response time to any questions or issues were promptly answered or handled. Very safe location and safe parking. Don’t hesitate in booking with her!

Ivanna explained everything in detail， place is exactly the same as picture，the closet for bed are so soft and comfortable. location is good，walking distance to park and good restaurants. safe and clean，will definetly return when back to NY.

Our group of 6 + 1 infant had everything we needed for a weekend vacation in New York. The check in process was quick and easy. The unit was in a central location near plenty of restaurants and cafes. Even during the hottest days of summer, we stayed cool with provided air conditioning.
If you rent the unit, we highly recommend getting pizza at Grimaldi's which is less than a block away! The unit is just steps away from the waterfront and great views of Manhattan.
Would highly recommend and definitely stay again!

Nazila' place is AMAZING!
Description and pictures are accurate.
This lovely apartment is very spacious clean and comfortable for 6-8.
Right smack in the heart of Dumbo and close to so many cool shops and 2 of the best pizza places in Brooklyn.
We were in NY for our sons wedding and we were so happy to find this gem for the end of our stay.
I can positively say this is one of my top Airbnb places in USA!
E Urcadez

After a couple of glitches, which Nazila was quick to remedy, we really enjoyed our time at the apartment.
It is in a great location. We loved being able to walk out the door and have the best view of the Brooklyn bridge and Manhattan. DUMBO offers so much for a visitor. Awesome pizza next door and great little grocery store down the street.

The apartment was large and wonderful the location was magnificent this was my first trip to New York and Nazila made it such a pleasant memory for myself and my family. The kitchen was large and modern. She has ceilings fans in every room. The apartment is very very close to the Brooklyn Bridge. Water taxi is  a block away. I would most definitely stay here again.
Overall this was a great experience. Other than the check in procedure it was great. Excellent location. Great restaurants on the same street.

If you have a big group looking for an Airbnb experience in NYC, look no further than Nazila's apartment. Very spacious and easily accommodates 8, as long as you have some 2 people willing to sleep on couches. Location though is clearly the best part, as you are steps to beautiful views and quality restaurants. While busy and touristy during the day, the area quiets down at night and is not at all an issue for sleeping. Only issue is the bathroom could be cleaner, but overall this was a star experience and well priced. Highly recommend!

This was a GREAT LOCATION!  7 ladies on a girls trip & this met our needs. Safe neighborhood with lots of restaurants & close subway stations access. Clean  moderatly but essentially equiped with necessities. Host was quick to respond with questions & advise. I'd stay here again, we enjoyed it & the location! However, I do not believe this place would sleep 8 comfortably without one of them being a child.

LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION!!
This place is perfectly centered around amazing restaurants, subway stations, parking garages, and so much to do in Brooklyn!! It would take us generally around 30 min to get from our place to Manhattan via the subway, we loved it!! Would definitely stay here again just for that!!
Perfect place to stay, right near the brooklyn Bridge and quiet inside the apartment. So much space, we loved it. Would definitely stay here again.

The location of this apartment is amazing, right in the heart of dumbo with easy access to many public transportation options. The apartment itself is a bit unfinished, but for the price and location it is a fantastic deal. There were a couple of issues during my stay but the host was extremely attentive and quick to resolve them for us. Thanks for the great stay!

Perhaps the best located AirBnB I have ever stayed in. Whilst the property was spacious with nice seating in the living area, it was in desperate need of maintenance and renovation. Windows had been patched up with cardboard, bin bags and polystyrene. The kitchen was in a state of disrepair and a lot of the light switches had problems.
The soft furnishings had stains and the beds were incredibly noisy and not very comfortable.
However, the host was very responsive and allowed an early check in.
I’d only stay here if you planned to spend minimum time here and needed a well located base, ignoring uncomfortable beds, patched up windows and stained towels.
Comfortable and very clean space. Great bathroom. Hosts were communicative and responsive. Would not hesitate to book again. Incredible location and very comfy bed. We'll be back😎

Such a wonderful retreat only blocks away from the commercial section of Brooklyn Heights. Warm and welcoming atmosphere complete with a personal note from Linda and Bruce along with a bottle of wine. Lots of room to move around, including the well-appointed bathroom. Furnished with fascinating  artifacts, artwork and furniture from around the world. A real find! We'll be back.
Linda’s place is in a great location and is very large and comfortable. Linda and her staff are very attentive and easy to communicate with.  We would stay here again in a heartbeat!
We had a great time while we here.  The Linda and Kirk were great and very responsive and you can not beat the location!

Fantastic find! Great location and Linda and co. are wonderful hosts. We felt welcome right from the start and Linda and her assistant, Kirk, were in constant communication with us before and during our stay. There were some exterior renovations happening during our stay but we were told in advance and honestly it had no impact on our stay. Would highly recommend.
Linda’s place was as advertised. Beautiful place and neighborhood, and incredibly responsive hosts. Easy recommendation from me. Thanks!
So, so easy to work with Linda. Always very quick to respond and the place was exactly as advertised. I would be happy staying here again.

Linda’s cozy apartment is in a fantastic location, close to many restaurants and places to eat, and also convenient to several subway stops. I was warmly welcomed on arrival. Linda and team were always quick to respond. I would be happy to stay again the next time I am in the area.

My daughter, her boyfriend and I had the best time staying in Linda's space in Brooklyn Heights. It was quiet and clean, plus the comfy beds made for a great resting spot after long days of exploring. The location is ideal for enjoying the charm of BK Heights while still being close to the subway to get into the city. We'll definitely be staying here again!
Highly recommend to stay here. Perfect location close to lots of places. Owners are super friendly and very are nice!

We loved our stay at Linda’s place in Brooklyn Heights! It was conveniently located, exceptionally clean and just the perfect size for a couple. Linda provided us with a thoughtful welcome basket, and she was also very helpful with check in and check out. I highly recommend her place!

Linda’s apartment was just great for our stay in Brooklyn Heights.  It was spotlessly clean, very quiet, and in a great location.  Check in and communication was easy.  The neighborhood is just beautiful and we highly recommend this apartment.
This was my 2nd time staying here and we had a fantastic time. The location is fantastic and the space is cozy and welcoming. If you're looking for a place to stay in the heights, this is it!

Linda's home is AMAZING!! this bottom floor guest suite is clean, quiet and very spacious for NYC! neighborhood is fantastic. Linda and her team are so hospitable, accommodating, and thoughtfuul. can't wait to be back!!

Linda was a great host! She met me at the door when I arrived late in the evening and showed me around the apartment. The location was perfect, lots of places to walk to and many great restaurants to enjoy. It's a short walk to the promenade and Brooklyn bridge which is a must!
The space is ample and the amenities were plentiful. Had a great stay and I highly recommend this spot for anyone staying in Brooklyn.

Our stay at the apartment was fantastic! The apartment is in a great location, perfectly central to multiple subway stops, restaurants, shopping, and our favorite…Brooklyn Promenade!  The apartment itself was immaculate and the little touches from Linda and our hosts made our stay that much more special. Big & clean bathroom, comfortable bed, available extra linens…it was first class everywhere we looked and with every detail. We would absolutely stay here again and hope to do so in the very near future!

Beautiful place in an excellent location in Brooklyn close to the Brooklyn Bridge, great restaurants and shopping. We were welcomed by our host with an excellent bottle of wine and a hand written card.
I highly recommend staying in this beautiful home.

Linda was the perfect host!
The unit was exactly as described as in the pictures! It is a quiet, clean and cosy place!
Lovely little shops, bars and cafes are in short walking distance!
Thank you very much for this unforgettable experience. We did enjoy every single moment of it!
Highly recommended 🙌🏻✨

Such a lovely apartment, very clean and plenty of space. The hosts were very kind and friendly  and nothing was too much trouble. The apartment is in a great location, easily walkable to the waterfront and its bars and restaurants and also just a couple of blocks to the subway with direct access to Wall St right up to Times Square and beyond, perfect.

I came across Linda's listing while hunting for a reasonable place for my parents to stay while they were visiting NYC. I immediately booked it because not only did the place look charming but the location was more than ideal.
My parents loved it! They had a great time wandering the historical blocks with a coffee, strolling the promenade, walking into Manhattan over the Brooklyn Bridge, and just soaking up that NYC in fall feeling. They even got a few celebrity sightings.
The apartment itself was great too, cozy with a comfy bed and all the accommodations they could need. The bottle of complimentary wine was particularly appreciated! They were welcomed by Megan, who was so kind and made sure they had everything.
Overall, I couldn't have asked for a better spot for them. Thanks Linda!
This apt is perfectly appointed and welcoming. We spent 3 days here and were able to easily explore Brooklyn and Manhattan. We will gladly stay here again and strongly recommend it for others.

Great little place! Super comfortable for our stay! It was a little bit of a walk to an area with lots of restaurants and shops. But great location if you have a car to drive around! It was close enough to transit that we could leave our vehicle and get around on the Subway.
Host was very easy about check-in, and flexibility when we'd said a certain time but was caught up in Manhattan!
Very happy

The hosts worked with my personal "electronic communications issues" and when I asked how to turn up the heat in the apartment, they left a portable heater for me while I was out.  That was a pleasant and thoughtful surprise to come home to!
We had a great week in NYC and were glad to have this nice place to start our trips from.

Perfect spot to rest after a long day of visit in New York! The apartment is really cozy and in a peaceful area. The interior is well-decorated and you will find every house appliance that you need. I recommend this host!

The apartment was perfect!
My husband an I stayed 4 nights and it was a nice space to come home to after touring the city? It was nice to stay in a neighborhood and away from all the traffic.

We wanted to stay for 7 days here but we unfortunately realised after the arrival that we don't want to stay.  The apartment is very stylish but draughty. The windows let the cool air into the apartment and also the noise of the street. The weather was cold outside so it was important for us that after a long day we can relax in a warm and cosy apartment. In addition the shower wasn't clean. So we left the place and looked for an other place to stay.
Had a great weekend stay at Tal & Amarelle’s apartment! It was clean and very cozy. We had a great time exploring the area and relaxing at the apartment in the evenings.

We liked a lot the apartment. Enough space for two. Very clean. Close to the subway station. You can be in Downtown Manhattan just in about 15 min. The Owner was very kind and  available for everything. Good position if you want to visit NY in one week
There was bed bugs here, and the place was not hosted by the same person it says in the profile

Ilan is a nice and friendly host. I rented the apartment for a long-term stay of over a month and he was responsive and helpful all throughout. The apartment is cozy and neatly decorated. You'll find most of the things you'd need for a longer stay. The neighborhood is fun and super welcoming; bars, restaurants, and grocery stores just a few blocks away. A/C trains get you to Manhattan within 30 mins.
Charming place in Brooklyn. Conveniently located to subway and stores. Tal was a great host.

Pros: this place is in a great location close to the subway and to some cool local spots in Brooklyn. The hosts were very responsive and friendly.
Cons: there were a few things broken in the place, such as a broken chair and very loose toilet seat. The bed wasn’t very comfy, as there was no top sheet and we often woke up with spring marks on our backs.
Overall: a good place for hardy sleepers who want to experience what it’s like to live in Brooklyn and experience the city

I loved it, looks exactly like the photos! Nice area I felt safe no issues at all, close to the train, good food spots & bars. it was a beautiful place, very clean! loved everything about it would stay again thanx for having me!

We absolutely loved this stay. My partner and I stayed for 10 days total and we still weren’t ready to leave by the end! The neighborhood is beautiful and walkable, and the a/c train is less than a 10 minute walk away. The apartment itself is beautiful and it had everything we needed for our stay. Very clean and comfortable. Lots of great restaurants nearby- I recommend miss bagel for a quick and delicious breakfast! Tal and Amarelle were very clear and polite in their communication, so we had no confusion or issues. We would definitely stay again if we had the good fortune.

Was the perfect place to explore Brooklyn and the whole city. The apartment had everything we needed and felt very homey, really felt like a home away from home. Was very useful to have access to a washer/dryer and all the appliances etc worked great. Really nice neighbourhood with great bars, restaurants and coffee places nearby. Really close to the subway for exploring the rest of the city.
Great location, didn't take long to get into Manhatten as close to train station and a coffee shop along the way 😉 would recommend
Absolutely loved our stay, amazing area with lovely people& neighbours. Amarelle was very helpful with recommendations and extremely responsive. Will definitely be coming back! X

Clean, close to the ferry, and near lots of dining and shopping options. Gladys and her daughter Krystal were responsive and respectful of my needs and I enjoyed the level of privacy I received by staying here.
It was a great stay! For RUMC students on rotations, this is the perfect spot (2 min walk). Host is also very friendly and always there to help.

Oscar's place is in the best location - a block from the train & park, and near so many great restaurants and bars. It's an old building and the walls are thin, though, so you have to be very quiet in the kitchen area or you'll get a message from the next door neighbor. It wasn't a major issue, but good to note if you're an early riser or night owl.

Great apartment tastefully decorated..Very convenient to a lovely neighborhood.
Easy access to subway and various bus routs .
Will hope I could stay again if I come back to Brooklyn.
Chia was great answering all my questions !  Location was amazing and the space was big !  Great experience !

This was great! Very clean, and host was very responsive. The only thing I would say is that the description of the parking situation was a little misleading. If you’re driving I would just plan to park your car in one of the garages nearby. Otherwise, this is a great place to stay!

This is a wonderful place to stay right in the heart of things and close to many restaurants and the fabulous Amish Market general store and very close to Broadway and the theatre district. Having the washing machine and dryer in the apartment is a great plus for a longer stay. My only criticism is that it has too many personal items and it feels quite cluttered. It's a pity the weather wasn't warmer because the roof terrace of amazing. Chia was always quick to reply to questions and a very good host.

We’ve got everything we need in this room, perfect place to stay close to Time Square with walking distance. Cozy and cleanliness. All facilities and equipments provided made us experienced like New Yorker, staying home in NYC. Sure that we would come back here again if we can.

Location is great, close to several subway lines and also walking distance to 5th Ave/Theater District/Columbus Circle etc. The apartment is super clean with several amenities and Chia was very responsive whenever I had any questions or concerns. Overall a very comfortable stay and I would definitely consider staying at Chia’s when I’m back in the city next time.

Think of this place as your friends home who is gone for vacation and you have this place for yourself. According to NY standards it’s big and has good amenities for kitchen . Chia’s place is close to almost all the major attractions ( walkable ) to Central Park and Times Square and also many good restaurants near by .

This was the first time I used this kind of lodging arrangement other than traditional hotel . My friend also joined me from London , she wanted to cook so she wanted a kitchenette with lodging place . So kitchen was full fledged and she cooked lot of foods . We both looked the place .
Interior was clean and uncluttered with plenty of refill if of supplies .
We will visit again this place when we come to NYC next time .
Host’s instructions were clear and unambiguous .
Blown away by Carrie and Fernando’s hospitality and by their beautiful home! Can’t recommend strong enough!

Sami's apartment is in a great location inside a lovely neighborhood. There was plenty of space and he and his wife went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable. This is a lovely place to stay and in a great neighborhood. Stayed for several days and it had everything I needed. Would recommend to anyone!

Sami’s place was very cozy and conveniently located. A few blocks near the 7 train, which was very reliable, and only took us 25 minutes to midtown. Would definitely recommend to anyone and will try to stay here again on our next visit.

Absolutely stunning home! Even more beautiful in person, and check in was seamless. I would stay again in a heartbeat. Thank you for hosting me!

household essentials including fresh coffee with coffee grinder and French press provided! my favorite way to make coffee. overall it was a great stay.

Sami's place was perfection. I currently live in Jackson Heights and my family (parents and sister/brother in law) needed a place to stay close by so it was the perfect situation. great air b/b in Queens, NY!  it's as pictured from the listing and we enjoyed the self check-in and the shops and stores that were around.  we were able to use the subway/take ubers/lyfts with no issue into manhattan/brooklyn etc.  tons of places to eat and shop.
