big, simple and clean apartmen. comfortable bed and big sofa with big smart tv.

Diane’s place was perfect! She was very nice and responsive.The apartment was clean and comfy and was stocked with everything. I will definitely stay here again in the future!

You want to be in NYC, don’t want to spend a lot and are using the room to take naps between all the NYC adventures? This is your place.
Khalid is super responsive and he makes sure that you are comfortable. The location is also great; one train and you are in Manhattan. I would definitely recommend it
Overall was a good stay. Affordable and easily accessible by transit. Midtown is 25 mins & downtown is 40 mins from the location!

I had an awesome stay and would highly recommend. Khalid is very personable and makes his guests very comfortable - it was a home away from home! Very easy access to the city from his location and I appreciated being only a few subway stops from midtown.

Definitely worth all the 5 stars. Everything was exactly as shown in the pictures, the place was very clean, Khalid was so nice all the time, easy to communicate with him about the check-in and for all the time spent there. Would recommend anytime!

Khalid was an excellent host! He is very nice, friendly and trustworthy guy, super helpful with everything and easy to communicate. The place was very clean and the location was great, it took less than 5 mins to walk to the subway that takes you to Manhattan. Also he recommended a great breakfast cafeteria and a restaurant nearby that were awesome. It was November when we visited so it was cold outside, but he had a heater in the room, so we could adjust the temperature as we liked. The surroundings was quiet and peaceful. Thank you Khalid, I was very happy to stay at your place!

Khalid is a nice person that recommend nice restaurants for us and immediately solve the problems. And, the place is only 4 minutes away from the marta station, it’s convenient for travelers to choose this place!
thanks for Khalid’s consideration, truly have a great experience
Linda's apt is beautiful and spacious. The location is very convenient and very close to the park. We had a great stay!
Fabulous chic apartment in a great UWS location. Great communication with host throughout our stay. A perfect spot to chill and plan out your strategy for taking Manhattan!
Linda's place was beautiful, in a great location, and she was responsive and accommodating. I definitely would recommend!

Gorgeous space in the best part of New York.  Even better than photos portray.  We stayed for a week and hated to leave!  Communications with Linda were excellent and this apartment comes with our highest recommendation.

Linda’s place is amazing. I stayed there with my 16 year old daughter for a week. The place was clean, the bed super comfy, the shower fabulous, and the location was wonderful . We cooked several meals there and felt right at home. The doormen were super friendly. We’d stay again in a heartbeat! It was hard to leave!
The location was perfect for our trip.  The place was fantastic and very comfortable for the two of us. Linda our host was great!

The apartment was great, pictures do not do it justice.  The location was incredible.  Building was nice and the people, especially the doormen, very kind.  Linda was a delight to work with, quick to respond and very considerate.  Overall, we had a terrific month and enjoyed staying there.

We couldn’t have asked for more.
Linda was an excellent host. We felt right at home. Everything was perfect.
The location was wonderful!

perfect space for a week in NYC. Centrally located, in a safe area, close to subway and morning walls in central park. We could find anything we wanted just a short walk away. Linda responded quickly any time I had a question. The bed is so comfortable. Linda's place checks all the boxes!

Perfect, perfect location! Clean, comfortable beds, minimal, tasteful decor makes it seem larger. Host responsive and allowed me to check in earlier. I will never stay  anywhere else! The cafe across the street has awesome smoothies.  1 stop to times square, 15 mins. To Brooklyn. Easy  check in.

Eli’s apartment is perfect for a trip to Manhattan. The subway is just across the street and a great deli, mini market shop, liquor store, all just outside. Very useful.
Eli is a great host and was very helpful and accommodating which is always a plus.
Absolutely recommend this apartment if you are visiting this area.
Thanks Eli.

Eli’s place was the perfect place for our stay in New York. It is across the subway. It was very clean. The apartment was pretty large for New York standards. We really enjoyed our stay here and would not hesitated to stay there for our next visit. Thanks again!!

Thank you Eil for the warm hospitality and accommodation. The location is excellent. There is a subway station leading to Manhattan. There are restaurants and supermarkets nearby, which is very convenient. Definitely recommend anyone coming to New York to stay here.

Very clean and cute! Good size place for a quick trip. We only stayed for one night, so it was perfect for that. However, finding parking was difficult, and the rooms were very hot and stuffy. One fan was provided, but it needed more. Overall not bad!

This is a two-bedroom apartment at the top floor in a great location in Brooklyn, close to the park and subway stations. Claudia and her husband Alex were amazing and went above and beyond to help us.

The place was very clean, appreciated the air conditioning. The only thing is that we had a problem with the wifi. Other than that I loved the place, the area is quiet, there is nice restaurants in the area and it’s a 10 min walk to the subway.

The place is pretty clean, I would suggest bringing your own towels. Location is awesome, 10 minute walk to the subway and about the same or less to a market, bars, restaurants, coffee shop, etc. It's actually a fairly quiet area considering it's on a main road. Please be aware that most New York apartments don't have central heat/air so don't be surprised about the window unit and fans (that's a normal thing). There are no directions within the house rules on how to check in or what is required for check out, you'll need to contact the host directly.

If you are looking for a comfortable, attractive, convenient apartment with a easy-to-reach host, this is a great place to consider! Close to a ton of great restaurants and two lovely green spaces, this space is also quiet and very very comfortable (and has some really attractive touches around the apartment). Highly recommended!

Great location in South Park Slope, easy access by car, and the neighborhood had plenty of parking.   We only stayed for one night, but we found a ton of great restaurants and bars. We had a blast, enjoyed the local vibe.
Great place for a getaway in a very nice location. Loved the cozy and fun style of the apartment. Would highly recommend!

Great location! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Walked to a great brewery and ramen place about 25 min away. Claudia and Sharon were responsive until day of when we had no instructions and ended up sitting outside the apt waiting to hear back from them after the check in time. As other reviews stated: try and get instructions from them ahead of time.
Airbnb is as advertised. Great local Italian restaurants only a few blocks away. Good value for price.

Clean, comfortable and simple. Hassle free check in and clear communication. Bonus view of the Statue of Liberty down Prospect Ave.  Terrific location. Lots of great restaurants around the corner on 5th ave and cozy Biergarten just steps away on Prospect Ave. Subway just a few blocks down. Perfect base from which to take on NYC. Tremendous value.

Room was nice and clean, but had issues with check in. Despite messaging host numerous times hours before check in, we were given no info on how to check in. Had to wait on the street until a man arrived with no explanation of who he was saying he would unlock key. Room was more of an attic in the house not as private as listing said.
This was pretty much as expected, except that the heater kept making extremely loud noises while we were trying to sleep.

Great location in Manhattan, but this unit had some serious cleanliness issues— hair in the bed, dead bug in the bathtub, grime on the floor. And the mattresses were very uncomfortable! We all awoke every morning with a backache. I have stayed with this group before, but this was not their best.

Studioplus was great! The location was perfect, checking in and out was easy and they accommodated our late arrival without any hiccups. They also held our luggage after check out which was very convenient. Would definitely Stay here again
10/10 it was a great stay, close to everything and willing to check us in earlier than scheduled!
Clean. As advertised for sure. Very loud radiator kept us up all night. Also in a very busy loud at night area. But not bad for 3 people at all.

This apartment was really clean and had full time security. There is only one towel for a bed and no coffee filters or silverware. The beds were very comfortable and the building is really quiet for NYC.

Claudia’s place was great! She was helpful, easy to reach as she lives just downstairs, and the apartment was very clean. It’s a good location to spend some time in New York, close to the park and the cemetery.
Very clean, cozy, and conveniently located. Nice area with lots of friendly people and dog walkers.

This is a great location close to many great areas, restaurants, parks, shopping.  The apartment is as described and is comfortable.  Claudia was always very quick to respond to questions.  We would definitely stay here again.

This apartment is extremely tired, none of the windows can be opened due to over-painting, some of the radiators cannot be turned off as the control nobs are missing and the numerous dents and scuffs from 20 or 30 years of hard use have simply been painted over. Essentially the entire accommodation needs to be overhauled.
This could have been overlooked if communication with the host was effective. The two numbers on the web site and another one which we were given later are "no longer in service". After travelling for 16 hours we waited for 30 minutes in the cold and rain ringing the doorbell as instructed on the web site as well as knocking on the door and windows. We were eventually let in. Avoid this accommodation unless you are absolutely desperate but be prepared to camp outside.

Do not stay here! This unit has no deadbolt or chain on the inside and the complex will come inside during your stay. They came in and went through our bags and left construction dust from the hallway all over our stuff. It's also very loud. The host was not concerned that someone entered our unit.

Marina's apartment is nestled in Greenwich Village. It is a wonderful location with access to so much! the subway station is steps away, and Bleecker street with shops and lots of food options is down the street! The apartment was sparkling clean upon arrival with several amenities to use. It was well air conditioned and had lots of towels and toiletries that you could use in case you forgot something. I would stay here again! Thanks Marina!
Excellent location in the middle of everything in West Village, and still relatively quiet. Apartment worked perfectly for us!

Marina's place is on a great location. There are lots of shops and nice restaurants nearby. The apartment is very nice and clean. Everything there you need. Marina was answering always very fast and checkin and checkout worked perfect. I'd come back anytime.

Great location. The apartment really nails the basics: comfortable bed, high-pressure shower that heats up fast, and a working AC. it was very clean. A great spot to call home base while exploring all that the West Village has to offer.

Overall a really nice place to stay in the West Village area in Manhattan. The building complex was in a reasonably quiet area. The place was small, but had all the cleaning and cooking amenities needed for us to comfortably live there for a month + well functioning AC. Really cool selection of movie DVDs too. The host was extremely responsive and accommodating to our stay changes and answering any questions we had.  Would highly recommend!
Great location and has everything you need for a longer stay. Marina was very communicative and accommodating to my early arrival.
Me and my girlfriend stayed for 5 months at Marina’s place (🤯)! It was everything we were looking for - great location and big enough for the occasional work from home. Would recommend.

Location Location!!! Close to great restaurants and the subway steps away. On a side street so no local traffic noise.
Lots of linens and towels for a longer stay. Huge closet to hang clothes. AC worked great.
Marina was extremely responsive to any questions we had.
We would highly recommend.
Really good location with clean beds. The bathtub didn’t drain well but overall would stay again! Thank you!

This is a very great place to stay as it is in the middle of the city. It is walkable to the station, ample of restaurants and grocery store. Studioplus is also very responsive and nice to our family. Thank you

Great location! We utilized the bag check before (free) and after our stay (fee). Very convenient. Wish there was a fan because it got a little stuffy. Other than that, we loved it and would stay again.

Robert is an outstanding host!  He is warm and friendly and very responsive!  My daughter and I stayed a week in his charming apartment after she had knee surgery.  He was very flexible regarding our request to arrive a little early.   Thoughtful touches in the way of fresh flowers and a scented candle, stylish decor, wonderful bed linens, great pillows, a well-equipped kitchen, TV and WiFi to stream movies provided a relaxing week for us both.  I was able to explore the neighborhood which is full of great restaurants, a variety of grocers and shops.  Transportation and a beautiful park are both very close.  Robert's place is a real gem and I would love to stay again next time I am in Brooklyn!

Rob's place is indeed on one of the best blocks in New York. I lived in both Manhattan and Brooklyn for the better part of 8 years and think his block is tops! First of all, it looks like it is straight out of a movie set in Brooklyn including gorgeous well-maintained brownstowns, stunning trees, and diverse, friendly neighbors. There's such great energy there and access to places to eat, shop and be entertained. It's so incredibly convenient to excellent restaurants, cafes, and culture (BAM is just down a few blocks) and subway/easy transport into Manhattan (one at the end of the same half-block). I miss being there already!
Rob is so friendly and responsive. He was a delight to coordinate our visit with and super helpful with recommendations for restaurants and other local places to enjoy during our visit. I would definitely stay there again when next in New York.

We loved staying at Robert's place while were visiting family in Brooklyn. It’s a lovely apartment in a great location and has many stylish features. We were there in particularly hot weather but it stayed beautifully cool and peaceful. Robert was really responsive to our queries and makes a fantastic host.

This apartment is in a gem of a location, right in the heart of Fort Greene. It was clean and tidy and was the perfect place for us to base ourselves for 4 days. Rob was a fantastic host and responded super quickly to any questions, check in was easy and he also sent lots of helpful suggestions and tips before we arrived. Overall a great stay.

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. The room was spacious, clean, and well equipped. I felt so comfortable and at home. This Brooklyn neighborhood offers just about everything you're probably looking for in Manhattan, great food, great bars, unique shops, and unbeatable New York culture. If you are compelled to spend time in Manhattan (as I was), the C train is a 3 min walk away and can have you at  the W 42nd St. station in less than 30 min.  As far as the host goes, you will not find one more courteous, charming, or accommodating than Rob.  If you have the chance, chat him up.

Robert’s place is lovely, perfectly located, in Fort Greene, Brooklyn,  easy access to Manhattan and surrounded by all the greatness that Fort Greene has to offer. Robert is a kind, attentive, accommodating and responsive host. Recommending this place, highly.

Second time at Rob’s place. Beautiful tree lined street in terrific neighborhood in Brooklyn. So many easy places within a short walk. In our case, kids and grandkids a 12 minute walk. You feel like you live in Brooklyn, not a tourist.
Rob is very responsive to guest’s needs. Will stay again.

This was my second stay at Rob's place, and I still highly recommend it.  A beautiful, clean apartment in one of the best spots in Brooklyn.  Rob was a delightful host.  I'm looking forward to returning again.

The apartment is tidy and comfortable, extremely well located, quiet.
Robert is very friendly and made it very easy.
Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a real Brooklyn stay!
Rob is an INCREDIBLE host and the place is beautiful! Amazing location, spacious, and clean. Highly recommend on all fronts!

What a find- a beautifully furnished spacious apartment ( complete with yoga room) in the best street and neighbourhood in Brooklyn. Rob communicated promptly and was super helpful with local advice. So close to so many great restaurants and bars  and Ft Greene Park. I have already booked my return stay! Thanks Rob

This place was great! We stayed for 2 weeks+ (mom+dad+3-year-old) and it couldn't have been better. Very easy, user-friendly for grown-ups and kid. Incredible location extremely close to a bunch of subways + easy walk to a lot of great restaurants, parks, and activities. Robert was a terrific host, could not have asked for more out of this experience.

Great rental on a BEAUTIFUL street. Close to parks, a wide variety of restaurants and bars, great entertainment options, and easy access to the subway to get to Manhattan. Rob was so kind and welcoming and went out of his way to ensure we had a nice stay. We took a number of his local restaurant suggestions and they were spot on!  So much to see and do… wishing we could’ve stayed longer!

We had an awesome stay at Rob’s place. The neighborhood is beautiful, so close to Fort Greene park, a bunch of restaurants and subway stations.
The place is spacious and Rob made the stay very easy for us. Would love to stay here again!

A wonderful place to stay on a quiet safe street. Plenty of very nice restaurants in walking distance. The nearby park was a delight to walk through.
Robert had great communication before the visit.

We upgraded to Robert's place after two night's in a local Brooklyn hotel, even though the overall price was much less! The home is roomy, well appointed and  perfectly located for us, given our daughter and her family live near Fort Green park. Robert kindly walked me through the neighborhood upon my arrival, and showed me his favorite coffee houses, restaurants and grocery stores. He also leant me some additional kitchen utensils so I could make my daughters favorite granola! We like having space and a kitchen, so for us, it was perfect. We will definitely stay there again.

Robert’s lovely apartment is a peaceful and beautiful oasis in a fantastic neighborhood. Walk out the door in either direction and there are great restaurants and shops and Fort Greene Park is essentially in your backyard. The apartment is pristine and well stocked. Robert is easy to reach and couldn’t be more flexible or helpful.. I can’t wait to come visit my nearby family again very soon!

We had the best time in Robert's brownstown. The apartment itself is very spacious and well equipped for a couple, we were both able to work and take calls without interfering with each other. The location is also perfect to quickly get around Brooklyn or to Manhattan on the subway, plus their is tons to do right on the block, restaurants, cafes, parks, etc. Robert (and Cowboy!) were the best hosts as well, we really felt at home and like we were living in Brooklyn. Couldn't ask for a better host, we'll definitely be back!
Clean and well-furnished; the walls are thin enough that you can hear your next door neighbors loud and clear.
Beautiful studio, exactly as pictured and described. My daughter and I stayed a week while exploring NYC and we were very comfortable.

Could have been way cleaner. Not worth at all such a high cleaning fee. Could of stayed at a hotel with less anxiety about mishaps and cleanliness. Nice space, nice location, close to train, not identical to photos but close, hmmm thats all.
Convenient location, clean space. A single room with small bathroom and tall ceilings. Neighborhood was loud but there were many Halloween celebrations that night!
James and Laureta’s place was a great home away from home while exploring NYC. Would definitely stay here again.

I really didn’t like this place you had to be real quite or be charged a fee then there is no tv the host really freaked me out how she kept whispering when she talked to me very uncomfortable I sat in my truck most of the time to listen to music since their is no tv when my days were over I was very happy to leave felt like prison

Beautiful space and a great price. The mattress was very uncomfortable and felt cheap but like I said, for an affordable place in Brooklyn I wasn’t expecting anything more. I was able to check in early and always got a quick response when I messaged them! Would stay again.
Great location convenient to trains and buses. I needed to check in early and they were quick to respond. Would definitely stay again when in New York.

This place is somewhere you can sleep comfortably and not have to think about are my sheets clean or is the bathroom clean, was almost like a studio hotel, neighborhood is good and so are the host. Both beds are comfortable and just a great place to stay, definitely will stay there again.
Great experience! For those who need to know the super market does not carry everything you need. There is a Walgreens close by for anything else.
James and Laureta have a great spot in Bedstuy with plenty of space for 2-3 people. There is no kitchen set up but they are close to a handful of great dining experiences.

Great place to stay overall in a convenient location. Very simple to check in and find the building. On the downside, the space was relatively small and lacked a bit of privacy which was not readily apparent to me from the photos when booking our trip. There was also nowhere to hang or unpack clothing so keep that in mind if you are bringing something that needs a place to hang.

The apartment was lovely and just what I needed for my trip. One thing I do want to mention: it appears that there are multiple units for rent in this building and sound careens right through the walls, so if you're a light sleeper, bring earplugs.
Great location, nice basic flat: but more of a hostel situation with guests coming and going  at all hours: and no sound dampening. With 7 airbnb flats in the building it is more like a hotel...
Gorgeously designed studio in Brooklyn at great value!!! I loved the artist studio. all lovely.

Great location! Perfect unit for what I needed. Enjoyed the access to the subway and the Senegalese restaurant not too far away.
Overslept one morning and took my first call from the unit. Wi-Fi was great!
Would recommend.

This studio apartment in Brooklyn is very convenient if you’re planning to visit places in New York City. The subway is very close by and lot of options for food and coffee nearby.  The neighborhood was very safe, would definitely come back to this stay whenever I visit New York.

Place is cozy and easy to find. There is more than enough place for 2 people. The internet is horrible. It should be fixed. If you are looking for a place where you can work remotely, unfortunately this is not the place.
We had a very nice stay.  Good location, free street parking, easy access to public transportation.  Would stay again.
Thank you for the nice stay! It was a really comfy and private retreat from the busy noise of NY!

Stayed here for a weekend with my family and it was very spacious for the three of us. It would fit 4 comfortably as well if necessary. It felt very clean and the lighting that poured into the space was phenomenal!

This place was very cute, this pics don’t do it justice tbh! As someone who has lived in NYC, I found the place to be incredibly peaceful and perfect amount of space. It is simple, quiet and clean. Good food options and grocery nearby. Walkable to the bus and train. Will def stay here again.
Great place to stay for a quick trip. The room and building was clean and safe. The check-in/check-out process was very straightforward and they gave great instructions.

I loved my stay. First time in NYC and I am glad this place made my experience great. Very walkable and close to a lot of restaurants, bus stops, train stations, etc. Super easy to check in & out. I’ll definitely be recommending this place to others.
Thank you soo much your place felt like home  💪🏾💪🏾💪🏾 yall should host more properties
Perfect location for where we needed in Brooklyn.  We loved the Brownstone walk up entry and the decor in the hallways for the Christmas holiday.

This space is great for a couple with a child. Slightly less comfortable for three adults. Easy walk to restaurants and the subway. The building is a little noisy at night, but earplugs were a quick fix.

The apartment was very clean, super bright well-equipped for making quick meals, and located on a quiet street which is important as studio is on street side. You're a bit far from Manhattan, but the A, C, and G subway lines are a 10-minute walk away. The only downside is that the walls are paper-thin, so you can hear everything happening next door or upstairs, including when other Airbnb guests are packing their bags at 5 am or coming home late at night. Aside from that, our stay was very nice. It was lovely to discover this neighborhood in Brooklyn and its beautiful Brownstones!"
Prompt, responsive communication from host. Apartment was very clean. Walkable location in Bed-Stuy neighborhood.

Fantastic first stay in NYC!! Very reasonably priced given the privacy and amenities offered at the apartment. My cousin and I stayed in late July and were pretty worried about the heat, but the AC blew cold and it was a very comfortable stay! Would 11/10 stay here again and had a wonderful time checking out Brooklyn. Great neighborhood to boot!
Perfect location. Beautiful, clean and airy apartment. Communication with Marissa was clear - never needed to contact her as we had everything we needed. We loved staying at her apartment!
Marissa is a thoughtful and responsive host. Her apartment is lovely and in a perfect location for enjoying Brooklyn and Prospect Park.

Marissa’s apartment is sparkling clean, stylish and convenient. Marissa was always quick to respond and very helpful. Loved how there were additional space heaters and even a heated blanket as I am always cold 🥶. The toiletries and chocolate were unexpected and much appreciated! We would definitely stay here again.
Great place, really liked the area. Marissa was a thoughtful host,  and provided details to make the trip go really smoothly.
Beautiful home and absolutely wonderful neighborhood. Lots of natural light in the space and so much good food in the area! Highly recommend.

Good place with excellent location steps away from Prospect Park and in prime North Park Slope. There's lots of great restaurants and cafe's close by, as well as not too far from public transit. Was enough space for my partner and I. Washer and Dryer worked well and so did the TV and Netflix. We did find it noisy at times with quite a bit of sound coming from both the street and the radiator (clanking during winter) at all hours. Communication was good with Marissa being responsive to all questions.

It was a great space, lots of light. The building has so much character. It was an easy walk to multiple subway lines and lots of bars and restaurants. I'm a runner and it was nice to be able to run in the park. I would definitely stay there again!

I was in town for two months and used Marissa’s space as my home base. Of course, the location couldn’t be better right next to Propsect Park, Park Slope, Prospect Heights, and many subway lines. Marissa’s space was a wonderful place to call home. It’s rather spacious and bright, so was a great WFH office. I also spent a good amount of time cooking in the kitchen, which has great new appliances and counter space. (PST, the Grand Army Plaza Farmers Market on Saturdays 2mins away is 👌). Also, many coffee making options with TWO French presses, a drip filter, and a pod machine for when you’re particularly lazy 😀. And the living room was a great place to open up a bottle of wine, watch some movies on the TV, or just chill and relax. Melissa was also super responsive whenever I needed anything and wanted to make sure my stay was going alright. Would recommend!
I had a great stay in here. Julie was very kindly and the location is very easy to go to station. thank u

I stayed for a month with Julie and her family for a month and had a fantastic experience.  Julie is very kind and helpful as well as flexible.  She was readily available to answer questions and assist with local tips for travel.  Would highly recommend!
Julie was really welcoming and gave me a lot of useful advice during my trip ! Her apartment was also very quiet and clean. I recommend staying at her apartment!

The place is easy access to favorite places.
And host is so friendly.
Thank you Julie!!

This was a great and spacious Apt for NYC. Beautifully decorated and looks just like the pictures. We’re traveling during the winter so the mini fireplace heater was a lovely touch. We felt safe and Lynette is very responsive with communication. We had a car so it was great to have street parking right out front! Best of all was the security camera screen that looks out to the street to keep an eye on the vehicle. Overall a cozy stay.
Very cute place!! The apartment was wonderfully decorated and very clean. I will definitely arrange another stay when I’m headed back to NY!
Lynette’s place was really lovely and clean. We enjoyed our stay at her place and would recommend it to anyone who is looking a quiet place for a getaway.

Very good space , Clean, Host was responsive, Easy parking access outside, and Furnishings were all clean & modern. Would recommend for 1 - 2 people who need basic, quality amenities & will spend more time with one another than accessing things in the space alone.

Lynette was very attentive and accommodating. She responded promptly to all messages. The space was clean and comfortable. She was clear with her rules which were extremely easy to follow. Would definitely recommend

- Extremely clean house
- TV
- Camera ( what is going on outside the house )
- Nice bedroom and bathroom
- Clean towels
The place exceeded my expectations and the host was super communicative, awesome stay and I would love to be back again!

Lynette’s place surpassed my expectations! Extremely clean, spacious, stylish yet homely touch. Lynette was very easy to communicate with and was always available for questions or concerns. I definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a pleasant, quiet Airbnb. Will definitely book again.

Lynette was extremely helpful and communication was amazing, always replied very fast. The place was clean and beautiful, I felt very safe, comfortable and at home. The neighborhood was nice and lots of local places to eat as well as chain restaurants, will be staying here again!
The pictures of the unit definitely doesn’t show how absolutely beautiful this place is. Very clean, great location, and very  comfortable. Will look forward to using this unit again.

Lynette's place was beautifully decorated, modern and spotless. The location was close to everything we needed. Anytime I reached out to Lynette she responded immediately (always very pleasant). I would absolutely stay here again and I would recommend anyone visiting Brooklyn to check out the Luxe.

It was very nice definitely very clean! There are tons of food places near by within walking distance some alittle further just depends on you and how far you will walk but there are also many that are so close! Will definitely stay again for sure!!!
Great stay me and my friend loved it here! Only downside is the street parking is very hard to find. Not a lot of spots around, they usually are filled up.

I love her so much her place is amazing she’s such a good person I had a good time she’s very understanding she’s very talkative she’s very commutative She’s such a wonderful person in her place is amazing please treat it with respect
Best for budget! Super cleann and new! Host is so nice i was asking too much questions but shes still really nice!!!

The place was immaculate, stylish, romantic, and comfy… great communication with host… had a sudden change in my arrival and reached out to host and the host was extremely understanding and accommodating! Convenient location! Can easily rip through Brooklyn and make it to Manhattan in no time! Queens was also right behind us, a couple of neighborhoods over! Quiet location!

Our stay was great! Inside the Airbnb was clean and had everything we needed. The only issues we ran into were the neighborhood is a little sketchy and the Airbnb smelled slightly like weed throughout our trip.
beautiful stay for it to be a basement. very clean. great communication with the host. the bed wasn't as comfortable but for an overnight stay it did the job.   I would stay again
Exceeded expectations and the host was in constant communication with me during the stay. We had no issues and enjoyed our stay and highly recommend.
The stay was great! Great communication. Easy check in and check out. Will definitely book again!
Great small place that’s comfortable,near stores and transportation. Host responded quickly to any questions I had before hand
Your home is cozy and very neat. There’s something there for everyone and your communication is really good.
Loved my stay. Host was responsive , allowed us to play music and the place was very clean. I highly recommend!!
Beautiful place! The TV only has Netflix which was the only thing that was a little disappointing but everything else was above and beyond!
Lynette’s townhome was great. Comfortable, spacious, private, conveniently located right by the subway, and Lynette was a wonderful host. Very accommodating and helpful. Stay here! Don’t hesitate!
Loved the place, Lynette was so helpful and always a message away. Subway was 1 minute walk which made our day-out easy and quick.
House was very nicely decorated and nicely furnished. It’s was very cleaned and smelled nice & Lynette was very nice would definitely book again

This place is a gem in Brooklyn. We were in town for the US Open and got a place near the airport.
If you're looking for a romantic and quiet getaway, the Luxe is the perfect choice.
Location-wise, Luxe is incredibly convenient, just a 2-minute walk from the bus and subway station.
Lynette is an amazing host and we will definitely be coming back next year.

Ms. Lynette was so kind to my fiancé and I. She treated us like family and made us feel comfortable. The Luxe was beautiful and looked exactly like the picture. Overall 10/10 and would love to come back and stay again!
Loved the place! Host was so friendly and responded super quickly. It was super close to the train, and the area was pretty quiet! Had an overall great stay!
Janice’s place was wonderful! It was the perfect space and the location is easily accessible. Janice was very communicative and helpful, and the stay was great
The apartment is spacious, clean, well kept. My only problem staying there on the weekend before Halloween was the music and party noise until 2:00 am in the environs.

This is a beautiful practical private apartment. It is very clean and modern. I felt safe, the area is very nice, restaurants and shopping are close by as well as subway.  Especially loved open window with fresh air,  large overhead fan, AC, etc. The bed is outstanding. Hostess answered my questions in a short time.
Sophie’s place was awesome! Stayed with my mother and both beds were very comfortable. Bright, beautiful & very clean space, located in a great area. We will be back!

Sophie’s place was beautiful. I loved the easy access off the street. There were many subway stops nearby, so we were able to get to Manhattan and anywhere in Brooklyn easily. I loved the little cafes close by. The neighborhood is lovely. The only downside was a little street noise.

We loved our stay in Boerum Hill! The carriage house is beautifully decorated and so cozy. We felt like we were right at home and basically considered moving right in. We were super close to great restaurants, coffee, and dessert. Some of our favorites were Taiki, Ghenet, and Dot & Line. Don’t miss getting ice cream at Van Leeuwen; their vegan flavors are to die for. We would absolutely stay at this Airbnb again!!

We booked this due to the location and being walking distance to family.
It’s really the perfect spot to stay in a safe and bustling area of Brooklyn. My husband and I did not have a use for the loft and 2nd bed but that would convenient for larger groups.
The place has tons of room in the closet and bathroom area so you don’t have to live out of your suitcase the whole time.
There is plenty of street/city noises, but there was a sound machine available for sleep. If you’re very sensitive I would recommend ear plugs, and don’t let that deter you from booking!
The bed and linens provided were very comfortable and clean. The Pendleton items were a nice touch. :)
Definitely a great stay and nice alternative to a hotel!
Sophie's place was clean, well-appointed and in a great area, easily accessible by various subway lines. It covered everything I needed for my week-long stay.

A beautiful spot, with lovely design and attention to detail. Great shower and great bed. I personally had a very hard time with the street noise as the space is located right on the street with a thin window between the bed area and the street. Otherwise, really lovely and recommended

A perfect centralized space to enjoy Brooklyn, Covid safe freestanding ‘tiny house.’ Great design incorporates a little hippy, and a little vintage in a bright sunny space. Pillow piled window bench was my favorite spot to chill. There’s even a loft to bring out your inner kid. Basically everything you need including amazing water pressure and HOT water.
Sofie knows all the good eats and is an attentive host. We didn’t expect such a small space to feel so big and enjoyed hanging out in the space more than expected.

We loved staying at this location while visiting family in Brooklyn. Very comfortable, perfect location and the host was very responsive with all questions. Would definitely stay again on our next visit!
Sophie's place is a real find. Super charming, great location and Sophie is a thoughtful and attentive host. Highly recommend!

Such a great find! Sophie is a very responsive host, and we appreciated the thoughtful amenities like the white noise machine. Perfect location to walk to Cobble Hill and several other neighborhoods, plus easy access to multiple subways lines. Highly recommend!
Sophie's place is great! Cozy and clean and right in the middle of everything. An oasis!

Sophie’s carriage house offers a calm, relaxing space to rest & recharge during your stay in NYC. It is beautifully decorated, has everything you need and nothing you don’t! Sophie is great with communication and a very accommodating host. We look forward to many more visits to come!
Excellent location and a unique apartment  in Brooklyn - reviewed by a fellow Brooklynite! The bed was so comfy and the shower was well stocked with Aesop products!
Excellent location, space is compact but enough for 1-2 people and precisely as advertised. Very unique former storefront location with tall ceiling and excellent lighting. Great AirBnB!
Sophie's place is great. Amazing location, great space, plenty of room, clean, everything I needed. Sophie was very communicative, check in was easy, I would stay again.

We had such a great stay at Sophie's guest house! It's in a quaint and quiet neighborhood, which can be so hard to find in the city, and only ~20 minutes from Manhattan! Sophie was communicative and the house was so clean and beautifully decorated.

This place was awesome, the location was very convenient to a lot of subway stations as well as food, coffee, shopping and more! The place was the perfect size for my husband and I as well as clean. Check-in was super easy and Sophie communicated everything very promptly. Awesome place overall, would recommend to anyone traveling to NY.
We loved staying here. Super cozy with all the right details. Very comfortable bed and fantastic shower. Gorgeous neighborhood within walking distance of everywhere we wanted to be.

We had a wonderful stay in this light, bright and beautifully appointed carriage house - perfectly located in the center of Boerum Hill, with great subway access only a few blocks away. There are terrific shops and restaurants right in the neighborhood - but it's also an easy walk to the waterfront and Brooklyn Bridge, or a quick trip on the metro into Manhattan.
Sophie was a delightful and super accommodating host, and quick to respond to our queries.
We look forward to returning to this charming little house on our next trip to NYC.
Thank you, Sophie!
(One note about "street noise": while the house is located at ground level on a well traveled neighborhood street, we were completely unbothered by the sounds of "life" passing by our door. This is a quiet and leafy residential neighborhood - but it is in a city!)

What a wonderful little place.  Perfect for our stay.  Convenient location -- close to restaurants, shopping, the subway, things to do and see.  And we found a parking space right out front and never had to move.  Sophie was there when we had a question.

The apartmen was great and the location to subway stops and Manhattan was very good. Everything was very clean and tidy when we arrived. We intended on using the loft for 1 person to sleep, but unfortunately were not able to as the ladder is difficult to climb. The rungs are very thin and made of metal so is quite hard on the feet. The main bed is a queen so we had enough room to share, and the main bed is very comfy. The shower head offers great water pressure which provided a great way to unwind after walking 10+ miles in the city all day. Sophie was a great host and checked in with us throughout our stay.

We had a great week at Sophie’s apartment. It’s in a beautiful neighbourhood which felt safe, and we enjoyed exploring the surrounding area and restaurants as well as using the good subway links into Manhattan. Although the door is onto the street, it was quiet overnight and the bed was very comfy so we slept well. Communication with Sophie was very smooth and she let us check out an hour later, which was appreciated. Would recommend this to others as a base for exploring the city.
Cozy little place in a great part of town. The noise outside the door varies with the passersby, but that's to be expected for a ground floor room in the city, so no surprise.

We really enjoyed our stay at Sophie's. Very convenient location. Can be a little bit loud at times due to the door opens directly onto the street with two restaurants next door, but it is NYC.. Will stay at Sophie's again.
Such a cute place!  Super clean and comfortable.  Bathroom space is roomy and updated.  Sophie was very accessible and attentive.  Close to everything- will definitely be back!

Sophie was an amazing host. Very communicative, and available to answer questions. The Brooklyn Carriage House was perfect for two people for a couple days. Spacious, tall ceilings, comfortable bed, nice shower. Also, great location that was close to multiple subway lines. We hope to stay here again in the future.

What a wonderful home! I love the fact that its an individual “house” sitting in the best area of Boreum hill.  Tastefully decorated and so warm and welcoming. Best lunch spot is right next door. Host Sophie is super attentive when things r needed. Thumbs up and we definitely will come back during family visits

Had a great time staying here! Great location and value, and super cute place. The restaurant next door (Rice & Miso) is perfect for lunch, which was super convenient. Sophie was a great host, very communicative whenever I had questions about anything. Thanks for a great stay!
Sophie's place was  wonderful.  Perfect location and perfect size for my daughter and I. We were lucky to meet Sophie when we checked in, we hope to stay there again soon.

We had a great stay at Sophie’s. She is very responsive and sent a lot of recommendations for local restaurants and things to do! She was quick to answer any questions. The place is decorated really nicely. There is street noise in the evenings but Sophie provides a white noise machine which worked great.

Great retreat from the NY streets- clean, cozy and comfortable. Relaxing environment stocked with everything you’d need to feel at home. High wood beamed ceiling made it feel spacious, and it felt private and quiet despite being at street level. Host was  available for questions and local recs. Quick walk to train and good coffee less than a block away.
Great location, it’s a carriage house. The only drawback was that the entry was on the sidewalk so you’d hear a lot of foot and vehicle traffic.

We had a wonderful stay: the place was both tastefully decorated, clean and well equipped. Spotless shower and bathroom, enough provisions in the kitchen to make a simple meal. Sophie was very friendly and helpful. We chose the area on purpose, bonus was that the apartment was on walking distance from fun streets with good shops, restaurants and coffee places. When it turned out I had forgotten something important, Sophie immediately offered to send it to my home country.

We had a fantastic stay and really loved the neighborhood. Sophie was responsive to all our needs, making us feel welcomed and taken care of throughout our stay. Thank goodness for the AC during a heat wave! Comfy bed was a huge plus as well.
This place is a charming spot in Brooklyn. It was highly walkable and I was able to find easy street parking around the unit.
Nice and walkable neighbourhood. It was a bit loud but the white noise machine drowned out pretty much all the sound from outside.

Sophie’s place is in my favorite location that I’ve ever stayed in Brooklyn. The neighborhood is quiet and cute, with lots of young families. The coffee place nearby (Blank Street) is really good and there’s many great restaurants and shops nearby. The place is small, but perfect for an affordable stay in one of BK’s best neighborhoods
This home is STUNNING. So chic and classic-I felt inspired just being in the space.

We had an amazing stay! It was even better than expected. Great for multiple couples. We would definitely recommend the place to others and would be happy to return. You’ll never want to leave the upstairs deck.
James and Siobhan were lovely and welcoming hosts.

James was a wonderful host. We hosted a bachelorette party here this past weekend and the place was even better than expected. We were greeted upon arrival and given a helpful tour as well as a detailed itinerary and two bottles of champagne to celebrate.
We had 10 guests and we all fit comfortably. We utilized Uber for most of our getting around, but it is a quick ride to a lot of nice areas. I would highly recommend James and Siobhan’s place for larger groups traveling to NYC and looking for a beautiful place with plenty of space.

James & Siobhan were great hosts!  We met them upon arrival to be shown the home and we were given a neighborhood guide which was awesome.  The home is very stylish and was designed by James & Siobhan.  Our family had plenty of space during the visit.  The neighborhood is awesome too, try to visit some of the local restaurants and bars.

Although it was a short stay, it was by far one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had. Not only is the space beautiful, it was spotless and thoughtfully stocked with everything you could possibly need. If you have a car, street parking here is a breeze. The hosts are even lovelier than the place; Easy to communicate with and gave us great recommendations for food and drinks in the neighborhood. I look forward to staying again.
The house was great for a big group of friends. It was spacious and funky! The rooftop was fun for group meals.

This is the most stunning place I've ever stayed in! The style and vibe of the place is beautiful, James's communication was perfect and we were provided with delicious treats to eat and drink as well as ample neighbourhood recommendations. I cannot recommend this Airbnb enough ... Such a wonderful place to stay!

James and Siobhan not only have a gorgeous home but they are the best hosts I’ve ever interacted with. They were responsive, helpful and couldn’t have made it easier to start or end our trip. The house was also immaculate and beautiful. Couldn’t recommend more.
If you are looking at this space book it now you won’t be disappointed !!! They were amazing and the space is to die for !!!!
Highly recommend this place. It’s very nicely set up, clean, and they are such amazing hosts!
James and Siobhan were quick to respond to all questions and were wonderful hosts. The space was beautiful, clean and spacious. Would absolutely book again.

Home was absolutely amazing “lots of stairs to go up” so it was hard to bring our luggage up.
Neighborhood was pretty cool, the home was very clean and the host are very nice wonderful people.
I would absolutely stay here again.

This brownstone was beautiful, in a great location and had everything you could want/need and more for a fabulous stay in NYC. James and Siobhan are lovely hosts and got back immediately with answers to my questions, and I had quite a few :) I highly recommend staying here.

James and Siobhan could not have been more accommodating and thoughtful for our weekend.  The home was perfect for our group with everything you could need.  There was constant communication and James went as far as to rent extra chairs to accommodate our dinner party.  Could not recommend this home more and will be booking with them again in the future!

James and Siobhan's place is awesome! Beautifully decorated, clean, fully equipped kitchen, lovely bathrooms, and comfortable beds. Would definitely recommend their place. James and Siobhan are very responsive and were fantastic hosts. There was some very minor construction happening next door (which was hardly an issue), but they still sent us a bottle of champagne for the inconvenience. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The rooftop was awesome, too!

James & Siobhan were the most amazing hostess, they have a BEAUTIFUL brownstone located in a great and convenient  neighborhood in Brooklyn. The train is like a 8 minute walk and a 30 minute drive to the city. Everything you see and read is exactly what you will get but the pictures don’t do this place justice. My guest and I had an amazing time and felt extremely comfortable in their home. We’ve already been plotting our return. I had an amazing time and I’ll recommend this place for larger groups or just a quick weekend getaway.

The place was amazing, everything was amazing. The beds were comfortable, the living room spacious, the kitchen was nice, even the lighting from the skylights. I don’t think we ever turned the lights on during the day because there was just so much natural light.

Me and our group had a terrific time staying at this lovely home. There was plenty of room and everything we needed for the day to day items. Any requests I had they fulfilled them immediately.  Thank you for hosting me and my family for my Birthday.

James and Siobhan were amazing hosts. I live in NYC and hosted some visiting family for a few days, and it was so nice to all stay under the same (chic, thoughtfully designed, comfortable) roof for a couple nights. Mattresses and bed linens are top notch. Oh and the AC is killer, so appreciated during the hottest part of NYC August. Thank you James and Siobhan!

Absolutely amazing experience. The apartment is gorgeous, (the features and decor are actually nice and not just things that photograph well like a lot of listings) and James and Siobhan are such lovely and accommodating hosts. Everyone in our group had a blast and it was unanimous that this was the best Airbnb experience they've ever had.
James and Siobhan were such incredible hosts! The place is stunning and they were very friendly and gracious.
This spacious stay is well worth the short subway ride. James & Siobhan were lovely hosts and we had everything we needed and more.

This home suited our needs perfectly! We had a large crew and many children and we adored it! Hospitality was excellent! Cleanliness was excellent! Kindness, communication and graciousness was superb.  Great coffee in walking distance.  Subway not too far.  Very quiet neighborhood.  HIGHLY recommend.

Our family had a great holiday in this beautiful home. The location was quiet and conveniently located to get anywhere in the city. Our hosts were very accommodating and kind. There was enough space for our family to spread out with comfort.
Wonderful hosts, very accommodating and friendly. They made our family holiday at their place enjoyable and special
Excellent home base for our group. Would highly recommend! James and Siobhan were very patient and accommodating. Beautiful spot and a fun and interesting location.

Absolutely wonderful place within walking distance of amazing restaurants in an authentic Brooklyn neighborhood! The outdoor patio is fantastic for evening dinner/card games after a long day of NYC tourist activities. The five bedrooms and large living room area gave us tons of space to relax when we were there. The host was super helpful and beyond nice. Just an amazing place!

James and Siobhan’s place lives up to the hype and then some. It was the perfect landing spot for our friends/family for our wedding in New York. Clean, spacious, well designed, very thoughtful space and every creature comfort you could think of is provided. 10 stars if I could!

Our stay set the bar very high for Airbnb experiences. James and Siobhan's place was clean, roomy, and beautifully decorated. From stocking the fridge with local groceries to leaving us a bottle of wine and ample towels, this Airbnb put hotels to shame. We had a great time, and I would highly recommend staying at their place.
Adorable apartment, perfect place for a nice girls weekend in Brooklyn, in  quiet neighborhood but very conveniently located for a quick Uber ride to bars and restaurants
We had a lovely stay. The hosts were super helpful and extremely accommodating. the apartment is beautiful. Would highly recommend!

James and Siobhan were beyond accommodating and helpful! Their place is clean and inviting and they themselves made our stay very easy and relaxing for our family gathering over Thanksgiving. Highly recommend.

We had 5 amazing days in Brooklyn.
Neighbourhood was very local and with a good vibe. Plenty of good coffee places just around the corner. Chicky is the best!! Also for bread, cheese etc.
Brooklyn and Williamsburg are within walking distance. Easy access to Manhattan by subway - 10 minutes walk to nearest Subway station
The apartment was as good as expected. Nice decorated rooms and very welcoming. This is a place where you can rest and enjoy.
The host was 2nd to none. Friendly and with good taste.
Absolutely a place to recommend
Incredible and cozy property that was stocked with lots of tasty treats on arrival. This is a gem of a brownstone with great design touches made for hosting.

Great location. Beautiful home. Perfect for our girl's trip. Loved that they had some basic groceries waiting for us and  makeup remover in the bedrooms - it's the little touches. Only thing I would add is one full length mirror upstairs for us girls lol ;)
What a comfortable, peaceful and well decorated place! We loved our stay there. A perfect place to stay with a larger group. Great extra amenities!
Beautiful home, and it was perfect for our extended family. The beds were so comfortable. James and Siobhan were very responsive to our every need.

Keith & Masa are wonderful hosts with a great place. Great space with more than enough room for 2. Lovely private outdoor space, full kitchen, and everything was well stocked.
The bed is super comfortable and the bedroom was deliciously dark for a great night sleep. The house is near a hospital but you’d never know. SO quiet. Hard to tell you are even in a bustling neighborhood.
Tons of great restaurants, etc. in the area.
Highly recommended!
The best hosts and air bnb. Super close to subway and has everything you need. Kieth and masa were lovely and so helpful. Couldn’t recommend more. ❤️❤️
Nice apartment.  Close to amenities and transport I needed. Being in a brown stone in Brooklyn is fun.  Host quick to respond and was helpful. Would stay again.

This place was perfect for my week-long stay.  Great location next to the main drag of 7th ave.  The apartment is well decorated and cozy, even though there is not a ton of natural light.  The hosts were very easy to communicate with, and they were very accommodating.  I was there during a cold spell, and they turned the heat up immediately when I requested it.  Nothing like staying in a nice old Brooklyn brownstone!
We really enjoyed our stay at Keith & Masa’s place. The best location in Park Slope which was the perfect place to retreat to after a busy day running around NYC. Love the decorations too!

We felt right at home from the moment we crossed the gate. The place is just as described, or even better - it was equipped with anything one may need.
Communication with them was always great, and Park Slope is beautiful.

We just a had a blast at Keith & Masa's gorgeous place. It is in an amazing spot in Brooklyn, close to everything even amazing Park Slope and the subway (easy to get anywhere). We wanted a typical Brooklyn Brownstone experience and it went beyond our expectations. Keith was always so responsive and we had the best of stays. We felt so at home with lots of space and a backyard....a luxury in New York. Well worth the stay.

Keith and Masa are probably the best hosts I've encountered in years of being in Airbnb! They were generous, caring, friendly, and very respectful. They met all of our needs in the time we spent in their amazing brownstone. Their space is a hidden gem in one of the most beautiful places in Brooklyn: clean, spacious, well-connected,  and beautiful. Highly recommend!

My parents stayed there when they visited New York. They really enjoyed stay there :) It's very quiet and peaceful place. Keith and Masa responded quickly whenever we asked questions about the place and they tried to make sure our parents feel comfortable there!
The location is perfect - two very short blocks to the F train!  Park Slope is, of course, fabulous and walkable and safe.  Bed and pillows comfortable.  Hosts responsive.
We had a nice stay at Keith and Masa’s apartment and would recommend it to others looking to stay in Park Slope.

Sky was an incredible host. Super friendly, responsive, and flexible with allowing us to leave our luggage. The location was great with a lot of activities and restaurants within walking distance, which is extra amazing by NYC standards.

James and Laureta were extremely welcoming and nice people. Unfortunately we were slightly disappointed as the Appartement was really basic for the price. No cupboards, no bigger pots so you couldn’t actually cook. WiFi didn’t work properly most of the times (bad signal) as well as very loud neighbors (other bnb guests?) and a lot of street work in the mornings. Appartement itself was nice and cozy but lacks in details.
This place is in a great location. Good coffee shops and the train were all a short walk away. The host keep this place super tidy and were quick to respond to any messages.
This air bnb was loud. There’s a lot going on in the area. We didn’t feel very comfortable and left within a few hours of our stay. This is a room within someone’s house, not its own space.

Nice condo with every basic You’ll need during the stay. Check-in and communication with the host was very easy.
The only point of critism was that the heating didn‘t work completely. The windows were a little bit leak, so ist was sometimes kind of cold.
Honestly it was not that big problem and not very unpleasant, so it is just one thing that can be improvable.
We loved the Brownstonehouse and the way to subway is not far. All in all we can recommend the condo for your NYC trip.
Elias and Caro
Nice space, very clean and comfortable. Some issues with noisy neighbors, but otherwise pleased with our stay.
Great location for those who want to explore Brooklyn and have easy and fast access to the city. The apartment is perfect for two people. Thank you!

This space was so nice! James and Laureta we’re so understanding! We really appreciated the fast responses. The space doesn’t have a microwave but it does have two hot plates and a mini fridge that holds a lot! The bathroom is a little tight, but it is super clean. Overall the space is very comfortable and good for two people.

We had a great stay at the Charming Studio. This place was very clean with a lot of natural light. There are a lot of great stores and restaurants nearby. It had everything we needed for our stay and it just felt really homey. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely be trying to book this place.
Lovely, practical and very convenient place if you need to stay in BedStuy or anywhere along the C line. The setup is very efficient and the place is well mantained.
This brownstone is in walking distance to the subway and also a couple of really good restaurants. Real New York feel. I highly suggest booking!

Excellent place to stay in a beautiful Brooklyn brownstone. It was extremely clean, and had everything needed (towels, toiletries, and kitchen utensils). Highly recommended if you're staying in Bed Stuy.
All the things you need in this stay! The soap in the shower smelled fantastic! I also really appreciate coming into an already air conditioned room!

A great little stay, perfect if you’re looking for a chilled space during an NYC stay. Close to some great restaurants like Harts, as well as coffee shops just a few minutes walk away. The studio itself was bigger than I expected, great for one person. Nice and clean on arrival, honestly would recommend for anyone who’s looking for a chill and comfortable stay!
Nice place. Good location close to local restaurants and coffee houses. The stairs is a bit challenging but certainly manageable.

The location was great. Pretty street! Walkable to many places or an Uber for farther places.
The description was accurate. Great for 2 people only as a studio apartment.
I was only at this property for 4 days but it was an amazing stay! I'd definitely comeback as well as recommend it to anyone coming to visit New York.
Place smelled like a rat died somewhere in the apartment near the window area. I made complaint but was never tented to even when I gave them access to check the apartment while I wasn’t there
Sherry is really a great host. The apartment is very clean, quiet and has everything one needs. The location is excellent, close to the subway. Highly recommended

I would like to thank to Sherry for her great hospitality. She behaved so  friendly that I felt  comfortable as if I was at my own house. That was my first experience in New York  and whenever I asked, she always responded my questions patiently. In addition, her flat is in a safe and nice area which is close to subway by walking. You can arrive in Manhattan by subway within 20 minutes as well. You can stay at her flat without hesitating.

The apartment is full of Cockroaches, been a big big fumigation before they rented to someone else is pretty disgusting. Have not natural light only in the bedroom.
Internet doesn’t work properly. Neither the inter-phone to open for delivery you need to go down every time and there is not elevator.
The apartment was dirty when was giving to me.
This is a very far good deal I pay almost 6k for a month and even 2k would be pretty expensive for this place.
I told the people who rented me the place was full cockroaches and no one did anything about it.

I spent 8 days at Yehudit private room, kitchen and bathroom place me and my husband we enjoyed our stay there. The place is quiet “suitable for studying “, clean, private. Yehudit has a great sense of hospitality, she replies very quickly, she made everything comfortable in ur stay. Boro Park is a safe place in the middle of Brooklyn, near all transportations 5 Mins to F train “reaches Manhattan in 40 mins”.

I had a beautiful experience in the place of Yehudit! So nice and clean studio, and the borough was very quiet and safe. People very nice and friendly. Yehudit and his family were great and always available for any help or questions!
Thank you for the hospitality at your place!!🙏🏻🙏🏻

I recently spent a month in an apartment and I must say, it was an excellent experience. The apartment was always kept clean and tidy, which was very impressive. Additionally, the landlord was always available and easy to communicate with, which made the stay even more enjoyable.
One of the best features of the apartment was the on-site laundry facilities. Having access to a laundry room within the building was incredibly convenient and made my stay more comfortable.
Overall, I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and stress-free stay. The cleanliness, responsive landlord, and convenient amenities make this a top choice for any traveler.
Large private studio, quiet, cozy and filled with natural light in a super location in Brooklyn, easy access to subway. Highly recommend for NYC travelers. And the hosts could not have been nicer.
Hosts were great and willing to accommodate when unexpected circumstances delayed our checkout. Overall great experience, wouldn't change a thing!

Lee and Teri are very helpful and great hosts! My wife and I came for our anniversary to hang out in New York. We spent almost all of our time in Manhattan. This place is in Brooklyn, but is RIGHT next to a subway which was extremely convenient. Lee and Teri has very helpful hints for us on how to navigate the city.
Would definitely recommend.

This was a wonderful find for us. Our daughter lives in Brooklyn and this home was perfect for a visit. The neighborhood is fun. Really good restaurants. And pretty easy access to the city. The room was clean, well equipped, safe, comfortable and easy to get to. Lee and Terri are great hosts. We’ll be going back for sure. Thanks so much!!
This was a great and cute little place to say!! Such easy access to places to eat and the train and some really great ice cream!! Definitely recommend!!!

This is a great room for a single traveler or a couple. It is an intimate space but well-designed with a well-stocked kitchen area. The location is steps away from Delis, restaurants, an organic grocery, and a subway station. The surrounding neighborhood features tree lined streets and lovely Victorian homes. Very nice!
Lee and Teri's place is exceptionally clean, they were very responsive to all requests/communication, and the location is superb. Easy self check-in. Would absolutely book with them again!
Very clean and comfortable apartment located in a wonderful neighborhood with lots of shops and stores close to the train station. We highly recommend Lee and Teri‘s apartment to other guests!

A lovely, immaculate, and very comfortable studio in a vibrant neighborhood steps from transportation, coffee shops and small restaurants.  Hosts Lee and Teri are welcoming and solicitous without being in the least bit intrusive, and they’ve taken the trouble to make check-in smooth and uncomplicated..  I’ve just left their place and have already confirmed another stay.
had an amazing stay! exactly as described with detailed check-in instructions, hosts were extremely responsive :) loved being able to leave our luggage even on checkout day, super convenient
It was a good experience to stay at Lee and Teri's place. It is appreciated that they came over and resolved the problem.
Great value, super close to the subway. The place was exactly as described and will definitely book here in the future

Just as advertised. Nice and private. Didn’t include a tv, but I had my laptop and the wifi was strong so it was fine. Nice touches like tea and coffee. Cute little thoughtful upgrades. Great value for the price. Would stay again.

My wife and I had a great stay at Lee and Teri’s. The Subway being so close makes this the perfect base. We started everyday with a short trip on the subway into Manhattan to do all the things we wanted to do. Highly recommended.

Lee’s place was great! I stayed there for 5 weeks while searching for an apartment, as I had just moved from out of state. This was one of three studios in the basement of his beautiful Victorian house, and it was very convenient for this period of time. So close to the Cortelyou Q stop, 15-minutes walking to Prospect Park, a ln organic co-op around the corner, and cute restaurants and coffee shops. The laundry was also a key factor for me, and Lee provided his own detergent! Fragrance free - so important.
Highly recommend!

Sandee Victoria’s place is really amazing!  It has everything you need to make you feel at home.  I will be staying here again!  Great for people who are looking for the comforts of home during a business trip.

place was great, very clean and stylish. and super convenient to everything for the wedding. Also nice to have a queen bed in a studio apartment...Close to all the relevant subways and super easy to get into Manhattan. Thanks also for the message before we arrived. Everything was super easy and smooth.

This is a VERY lovely place to stay at.  Designed with lots of natural light and style, they maximized the space and created lovely accommodations for the traveller with everything needed to be comfortable. The hosts are very quick and helpful responding  to any questions you have and in providing as much help as they can. I will return!

I had just stayed 5 nights in Sandee & Victoria's place in Brooklyn.
The studio is clean, comfortable and well-lighted. Its location is wonderful, with a number of metro stations within walking distance, making it really easy to go to most places, including Manhattan, other parts of Brooklyn and also Coney Island.
There are also plenty of cafes and restaurants around the studio, with pharmacy and grocery shops nearby.
I really felt like a local living in this space and exploring around the neighbourhood.

Safe, convenient and full of great restaurants, bars and shops. Great spot for a weekend in the city. The apartment is close to the MTA, making travel into and out of Manhattan very easy. Neighborhood was safe and quiet, and we loved dining at Rucola - a suggestion from our host!

Sandee's apartment is a quiet and charming oasis in a lovely Brooklyn neighborhood. If you are looking for a great place and price, good location and super host, this is the place for you.  My husband and I attended the ACC tournament and we found Sandee’s place charming and had everything we needed. She is quick to respond and helpful with suggestions.
This cute Brooklyn Studio Apartment is an amazing place to stay! The overall experience staying here was great as well as the location was excellent! I would recommend staying here to anyone!

We had a lovely time, the room is clean and it was totally fine for 4 people!

Sandee’s place was fantastic we enjoyed everything about, the apartment was as described clean with everything you may need. Neighbourhood was beautiful and easy to walk to every thing. Our host was extremely helpful and the nicest person.  Both people that greeted us have been amazing! Can’t say it enough. Communication is great and super helpful. Peaceful place to stay. Would definitely stay there again!
Would definitely stay again, was clean and in a great area. Quick responses and very kind. Thanks ken!

Great stay if you want something nice, clean and quiet. I enjoyed staying here and it’s accurate in the listing. AC works wonderfully and the bed is pretty comfortable. I would def stay here again.
Our stay at Kens was perfect. It’s conveniently located by the subway and very walkable with lots of restaurants nearby. It was clean, private, and just as described. I would love to come back again.

Great place, a second time staying with a third time this coming September. Parking is hard to find, but other than that, it is worth the stay.
thank you, Ken. I appreciate you making it easy and comfortable.

Ken's place was excellent!  Bay Bridge is such a nice, towny area of Brooklyn, and my spouse and I felt completely safe.

Raymond’s place is conveniently located close to NYC. He was great at communicating and provided a cozy home for us to stay.

Sami was easy to reach and checked in to make sure we were comfortable. Our family of 9 had a wonderful week at her townhome. It was spacious, and close to Central Park and the subway. Street noise is unavoidable (it’s New York, after all) but the neighborhood is safe and clean.
Liked the location and was walkable to a lot of places. Place was clean. Sami was very attentive making sure everything was good.

Sami’s place was just as described and shown in the pictures. There was plenty of space for our group of 10 and the number of bathrooms was huge deal and worked greatly in our favor. We had some slight pluming issues but Sami was very responsive and quick to fix. The nearest subway station was almost a mile walk so that was not fun and there were also no ironing boards in the home so a bit challenging to iron. Other than those few things, our stay was a great experience.

Such a great place to stay! My party of 5 had plenty of space. Comfortable beds and plenty of linens made us feel right at home. Close to so many restaurants and a market across the street to grab last minute things. Great communication too. Highly recommend staying at Sami’s place!

This place was just as advertised. Beautiful accommodations in a Perfect location. Within 1 mile from Central Park. Within 2 miles from times square. Great restaurants and basic needs shopping all around. 24 hour diner right in the corner. It's well worth it.
To top it off, Sami was awesome. Very responsive, proactive, and caring. Great Host.

Justin’s apartment is gorgeous - a stylish, spacious, clean, and comfortable space from which to explore the city. All necessities were provided - the kitchen is fully stocked! - and Justin even greeted us with a complimentary bottle of wine - a very nice touch!
The apartment’s location in Bed-Stuy is great. Justin left several great bar and food recommendations, which we happily checked out. It’s very close to the G line, and for folks interested in getting into Manhattan, a 8 min walk or so from the C-line, and a short train ride into lower Manhattan.
Finally: Justin was communicative throughout our stay. A great experience all around! We hope to return.

Justin's place checks all the boxes & then some. Can't recommend enough - the apartment is ideally located, spacious, stylish, accommodated our family of four perfectly. One of the nicest air bnb's we've had the pleasure to stay in, don't hesitate to book.

An absolutely phenomenal place in a wonderful area and a host that goes well above the normal call of duty to take care of me and my family. Justin's place is a no brainer for anyone wanting to explore the city and also be in a chic and upcoming area. The terrace is magnificent, and the place is green and full of color and soul. A huge thanks for sharing your place with us on short notice and for your wonderful humanity!
Amazing place in great location. Ann was such a wonderful, thoughtful, and communicative host too!

Ann’s place was very warm and welcoming. It was even bigger than expected and very cozy. We enjoyed the neighborhood and all of the eateries close by. The fact that there was a washer and dryer was really handy. It basically felt like we were home away from home. Thank you so much Ann for allowing us to share your special home. We had a wonderful time.

This is a great apartment. Spacious and easy to relax in. Brilliant location with great bars (Wayland, ABC, etc) and coffee shops nearby. It is also very quiet too! The rooftop is a fantastic addition but worth noting that the stairs up could be a challenging for those with vertigo. Highly recommend.
Fantastic trip at New York in a beautiful flat. Good adress for holidays and to visit the city. Ideal location near the subway and very calm place without noise. We will come back without problem.
I spent 7 nights there, it was exactly what I was looking for. Great place, decorated with care. All was perfect!
This was our second stay and it was just as lovely as our first. Definitely recommend and will absolutely return!

All I have to say is, simply amazing.
Joe was such an amazing host and was quick to respond to any questions we had during our two week stay. His guidebook was very well put together and very useful. The location was great and the apartment was very private and an excellent place to return to after a long day. I highly recommend Joe’s place to anyone looking for a great host to make their stay as comfortable as possible. The rooms were clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated. The bathroom was just perfect and the sensor on the toilet was a great addition especially for someone like myself, who is sort of a germaphobe. The apartment was spacious, the kitchen was well equipped and the complimentary wine and toiletries were a plus. If you are on your way to New York, I would definitely recommend staying at Joe’s home.
Apartment is beautiful, super clean, modern, looks brand new. Joe is a great host. Highly recommend staying here!
We very much enjoyed this beautiful home. We loved our stay and would definitely return. We were extremely comfortable.

This was my second time back and I would love to say I would highly recommend this place. Joe was very kind and was always responding so quickly. The place was super clean and cozy and I will definitely be back again. Pictures just don’t do this place any justice. This home is beautiful and my family and I enjoyed every part of our stay. Thanks again
Amazing stay, it was cozy and the host was very attentive. I would recommend this bnb. 5 stars !!!
Communication skills was a1! Nice clean spot, great location, food and store places was walking distance. Not too far from Manhattan! I recommend:)
A+++ Great place to stay very clean and comfortable place is bigger in person and looks exactly like the pictures.
