Ann’s place was just fantastic. Absolutely loved the vibe inside! Everything was as expected or better. What a great location - I would definitely be happy staying here again - highly recommended.!

First off let me start off by saying. My entire experience at Joe’s was far more than amazing. It was way more than I expected. His professionalism and quick response to me was; over the top. Whenever I come to Queens, NY this will be the only place I would stay. Thanks for everything Joe -Crystal
I was very please with my stay . Overall everything was great , parking very simple and easy. Apartment was very nice , appliances were readily available. Host was very kind, would highly recommend.

Clean, well furnished and conveniently located.  Communication with the host, Joe was effortless and punctual.  The surrounding neighborhood has much to offer as well - especially, when it comes to culinary options.

We really loved our stay at the milestone! Very conveniently located close (2 mins walk) to restaurants and bodegas. A private parking spot is actually located on the premises which is a huge win on its own. The milestone is beautifully decorated and has everything you would need for a very comfortable stay in Queens at a great price! Joe and Fabiola were very quick to reply for any questions or concerns we had, I would definitely recommend and stay again!
Location was great for us while we visited the US Merchant Marine Academy. And getting into the city was easy too. Hosts are very communicative and the apartment exceeded our expectations.

The place is great and perfect location. Only downside was a noisy neighbor above. Joe was quick to respond to my communicationand contact the neighbor but repeated both nights. That aside, loved the place and location.
Very nice clean affordable home he even gave us complimentary drinks and snacks lol . Great value for the price and the owner was very nice Ty once again
I truly enjoyed my time here while in New York. The hosts are responsive and helpful plus the house was comfortable and easily accessible. I definitely would stay here again.
Great home in a nice secluded area. 10/10 experience I just want to inform you that it gets hot in the wee hours but the A/C units will cool it down
We had an amazing stay at this beautiful home! They were very friendly and very helpful! Will definitely stay here again when my family and I visit New York again.

Joe and Fibiola were the perfect superhost. They have a wonderful place and very clean. We arrived early and they were super accommodating with letting us check in earlier than 4pm.  Everything is updated and looks just like the pictures. This place succeeded our expectations. And they even have some beverages for us in the fridge.  The beds were super comfortable and the place overall felt like home. Some people live upstairs and at times can be heard. But that didn't bother us much.  My boyfriend and I visit Queens often and look forward to booking the Milestone many more times!
The place was amazing and loved it there… I would definitely come back and recommend this place. I loved it. Great communication with the owners and appreciated that they were flexible with check in.
Very great place to stay. 2 bedrooms,  1 bathroom,  nice kitchen,  worked perfectly for our family of 3. Joe and Fabiola were great hosts, definitely would stay at there place again.

Joe's place was exactly as described, immaculately clean and very comfortable.  Joe and Fabiola are outstanding hosts.  They checked in during our stay and responded promptly and graciously when we had an issue.  We appreciated the hospitality and comfort while apartment hunting in Queens.

Excellent place, well located, super clean, well furnished. Stayed for a month and it was extremely convenient. Close to 3 subway lines, markets, drug stores, clothes stores and less than a minute to central park entrance.
The two bedrooms with office chairs and desks were excellent for working remotely as me and my wife were able to use each one as an "office" and be on meetings simultaneously.
Having a washer/drier on the apartment was extremely helpful.
The contactless check-in/out also is a relief during social distance times.

This listing was a pleasant place to stay, especially for an extended amount time. The host was very responsive and helpful if any issues had arrived and it was easy to get help when needed. The location is peaceful in the upper west side and right next to central park, offering a great escape to nature.
Nice place, newly renovated and clean, there is also a nice lounge on the top floor, location is not great but the value for midtown is excellent

Very clean building and well-maintained definitely as described within walking distance to everything you needed ￼ great host, and very responsive. Will look to them again for my long-term rentals when in New York. ￼
Everyone working at Paradise Suites was friendly and accommodating.  There were upgrades being made while I was there but it was all very quiet. We felt safe and our needs were met.

Very comfortable and spacious apartment.  Has a full sized kitchen with all the kitchen ware that you need. Apartment was clean and well stocked. The host was very responsive. Overall it was a great experience.

I stayed at Catherine's for a few months and felt right at home.  The apartment was exactly as pictured and described, the kitchen was well stocked with all the appliances and tools needed (I cook a lot) and Catherine was very responsive from check-in through checkout.  It's a bit of a walk to the nearest subway (~5 blocks/10 minutes), but the neighborhood is walkable and there are a lot of restaurants, laundry, services, etc. within a block or two.  Thoroughly enjoyed my stay.  Thanks.

Barbi is a wonderful lady and one could not aks for a better host. The place was clean and comfortable. I had one problem and that is that the place is dark and never gets any sunshine. But guests who are tourists will not mind since they will be out all day. We stayed at Barbi's place while searching for a new permanent home in NYC and had to transform it into a home office. The location is also very good since it is close to an express subway stop and there are many stores and restaurants in the neighborhood.

Thank you Barbi for providing the great place for us. We had a spectacular time there. The place comes with a bedroom, kitchen bathroom, and living room. Everything is private. The place is close to the subway line 2 and 3. It is very convenient to go to anywhere in the city. Barbi is a very, sweet, warm and friendly host. She lives downstairs and responded every request we had. She also teaches us how to do recycling in NYC with patience.
We cannot think of many improvements as the place is almost perfect. One tiny thing is just the ACs are loud and we didn’t find the heat, but it’s ok for September.
Only complaint is the ceiling leaks sometimes when the people above you take a shower lol… other than that, fab!
The place was in an amazing location and the building amenities were great. Thank you for a wonderful stay! Would definitely stay here again.

My two roommates and I stayed in this apartment for two full months. It is located in a good accessible area with Trader Joes downstairs as well as walking distances to the bus and subway stops, which we found extremely convenient living in the city. The hosts were understanding and responsive when we would need help with apartment related concerns. Apartment building provided its guests with a work space on the top floor, as well as a gym and shared laundry area. The views from the rooftop were amazing, directly facing the Queens bridge. Worth it for the NYC experience.

The place was conveniently located near the train and within walking distance of many shops, restaurants, and convenience stores. The neighborhood also felt really safe.
The place was very clean and comfortable. Sumeira was a very thoughtful, responsive host and even left breakfast foods in the room for us.
Would love to stay here again!

Excellent place to stay for one or two persons. Located at a safe and convenient neighborhood for traveling to and from Manhattan. The host is easy to communicate with and quite hospitable. Will definitely consider coming back if we are in the neighborhood.

Very nice place, just as shown on pictures, great location and very nice and safe neighborhood. A lot of coffee and good restaurants near, walking distance to the train and bus station. Sumeira’s response to any question or request is immediate and is very flexible. I would go back to her place any time!
This place was wonderful for our weekend trip! Very clean and easy to locate. The neighborhood felt very safe. It was a short walk to the metro which made it easy to get around.

The place was great and just how I expected it to be. It was perfect for my boyfriend and I, a cozy and comfy place to stay the night near NYC! It was a 7min short walk to the subway and a perfect stay for the 2 of us. Would definitely stay here again.
Nice place. Far from civilization unless you have a car but ubers not so bad going to city

Sumeira's apartment is fantastic--she keeps a beautifully clean and stylish apartment that's conveniently located near restaurants and the N/W trains. Sumeira is a great host, and we are so grateful that she opened up her home to us.
Place was very clean and host responded super quick. Place is a bit small but area is very convenient definitely would book again.
Thank you! Very responsive host, let me check in a bit early. Poor WiFi connection and limited cell service.

Host was great with communicating and the space was really nice. Less than a ten minute walk from the train, and lots of small businesses and parks nearby. Overall a great place to stay during a visit to the city!
Great place! The interior design is well thought out and very modern looking. Great lighting, and some minutes away from a train station. Good pick if you’re thinking about staying in Queens area!

Sumeira’s place has a private entrance which is great for those who seek privacy. It’s small and cozy, has everything you would need to make your stay comfortable. There’s even thoughtful touches like teas, coffee, water and oatmeal. The place looks just like the pictures and isn’t so far from the train station. Astoria park is just a couple blocks away so if you want to watch sunset or sunrise with a great view, it’s definitely something worth doing. Definitely would book again!
This was a great place for a night. It’s small but very welcoming, clean, and comfortable for a short stay.
Great place for a place to sleep. I was visiting friends in the area and needed a place to sleep for the night. The air bnb was clean and the bed/sheets were very comfortable

This suite was excellent for its price. It was absolutely clean, the bed and pillows were so comfortable for a good nights sleep, and I appreciated the privacy at this place. Sumeira was extremely responsive and helpful in any concerns I had, and I would definitely choose this over any hotel stay because it had a “home away from home” feeling!
great studio in residential area of Queens. nice, clean and quiet. we enjoyed our stay very much
The studio is in a quiet part of Astoria, surrounded by great restaurants and close to the subway. The bed was super comfortable. I would definitely stay here against
Really great place, price, and location. Was able to park right in front and walk around Astoria. Very clean and had everything we needed!
Great place that was in a great area. Great communication and would definitely stay there again. We enjoyed our stay and thank you for everything!
This place was great! Sumeira was great help and quick to respond! Very close to the subway and great distance from the city!
What a wonderful place to stay, super close to everything and in a quiet neighborhood. I would love to stay here again!!

We really liked this place! It was so comfortable. Great cozy bed, awesome shower, and it’s cute! The location was fantastic. Super easy walk to the N/W line to get into Manhattan. Also, conveniently close to the airport! We would totally stay again!
Great place to stay for a trip to New York City! It was in a great neighborhood and looked just like the pictures, and it was so easy to communicate!
Very clean. the neighborhood seemed very safe. If you need to stay in the Astoria area, Sumeira has a great space.
This place is amazing! Great place and is in a nice neighborhood. There is easy and free street parking and the host was very accommodating. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.
Great value for the area and Sumeira was communicative and helpful. Easy to get to and from Manhattan and walking distance from so much that Astoria has to offer!
Do not think about twice!! It is very worth it for a short trip. Very safe neighborhood and comfortable room 😊
nice place , has a Netflix account,  ac, bed is very comfortable and sheets and towels are clean. train station is near (9 min walk)
Sumeira was very kind and her hospitality was on point! The place was nice and cozy! Sumeria response time was great and she was always willing to help! Thank you
Great spot and close to a lot of cool places. Hosts were great and very accommodating. Would stay here again.
Such a great host and a cute Airbnb! Sumeira was a great host and responded quickly!
Sumeira was an amazing host, super communicative and accommodating! The apartment was also perfect, had all the necessary utilities (and some!) and was clean.
The place is in an amazing location. Quiet from street noice but a 7 min walk to the subway. Also close to deli’s, shops, and bars. Perfect getaway for a couple.

Sumeira's space is clean and stylish. It's located in a nice tree-lined block in Astoria within walking distance of a plethora of local shops and eateries.
The room is tastefully furnished and stocked with snacks and drink mixes.

We had a great visit staying at Sumeira's place!  It was very clean and conveniently located off of the Astoria Blvd subway stop.  The bed was extremely comfortable and the neighborhood was quiet and clean.  The communication was great and check-in/out was easy.  We had an earlier flight and she worked to have the place ready for us too!  Thanks for making our NYC stay so wonderful!!

Quaint, cozy and relaxing location. He checked in with me to see how things were via the messenger and when I raised the an issue that the toilet wasn't working (these things happen) he acted and rectified the problem. I had a great time!
Yup. This is how Airbnb should work. Everything was easy and the place was a great little spot to stay. Close to Manhattan, quiet street but still close to train. Would stay again for sure!
The accommodation is as advertised. Close to the subway for easy access to Manhattan. It's well kept with all the amenities that's needed for a short-term stay. Would stay here again.
Great basement studio. Very efficient and safe.  I had no problems. The host was very helpful.
Sumeira and her husband were always responsive and nice. If issue came up it was fixed quickly. 👍
Great location and a reasonable price. Sometimes there was a lack of communication between the staff and front desk.
If you’re looking for a nice, affordable, stylish, and peaceful place to stay this is it! Millie is very helpful and responds super quick. Loved the place and will definitely be back!

Millie’s home was very comfortable and cozy. The home is quiet , The actual block is ok. I was able to check in with no problem. I was able to go in and out privately. Backyard has a nice sitting area to get some air. Home provided pots and pans, forks and knives, cups and wine cups and more.
Thank you Millie for letting us stay in your home and I do recommend !
Great value, the place was exactly as described/in photos.  Millie was a very responsive host!  Highly recommended!
Millies place is comfortable and beautiful. Close to transportation and with many amenities.  I highly recommend Millies place.

Millie has a truly nice place. It was clean, spacious, had all the amenities necessary, and it was most convenient to many things - stores, subway, and bus services.  It may be a little noisy, but this comes with the territory - you're in NYC.  I will certainly recommend it to others.

Spent a week at Millie’s place while visiting family.  Place was nicely decorated, clean and well stocked.  Parking was surprisingly easily available.  Never further than half a block from apartment.  Plenty of stores close by and Walgreens was open til 11PM for last minute items.  AC works well in bedrooms and TV had lots of options for finding something to watch.  Highly recommend and would visit again.

Great location for the Bronx and an accurate description and pictures of what you get if you stay with Millie! My two friends and I stayed while going to a concert and it was just easy check in and out. Also, there was a MTA nearby. Overall, a good stay!
Enjoy staying at Rodney's place.  It's a wonderful apartment!  It's very close to public transportation and grocery stores.

Rodney’s place is a comfortable and stylish space. The bedroom and kitchen are huge and the sky lights let in great light. We lived here for two months and the internet was very strong for work from home. The subway is fairly close and it’s easy to take the J train into Manhattan. Would definitely stay here again!
Very clean, updated space. Looks exactly like photos. Great location with easy check in process. Kitchen is small, but not too bad for shorter stays. Quiet, safe street and building.
Apartment is as as you see in the pictures. Clean and newly renovated.  Communication with management is very easy and fast.
Listing is quite accurate and the hosts are prompt responders. Great neighborhood and the apartment comes with the basics you beed
The location is perfect. Jess and her team were extremely accommodating and communicative. There are tons of restaurants nearby as well as public transportation. I would definitely stay here again.

Jess was a wonderful host. She had prompt responses to our questions and provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The unit was clean and spacious. It’s also conveniently located to many shops, restaurants, and the L subway line for a quick commute into Manhattan.
We had an amazing stay in one of the best parts of Brooklyn. Easy check in. Lovely apartment with everything you need and welcome pack on arrival is a great touch. Would stay anytime I’m in the area!
Jess was a lovely host and very prompt with responding to any questions. The apartment is a lovely studio and perfect for seeing Manhattan or Brooklyn. Thanks Jess!

This apartment’s location can’t be beat: one block from the Bedford stop, it made getting in and out if Manhattan quick and easy (and the L train connects to basically every line in the city). Not to mention being in the heart of Williamsburg, surrounded by excellent restaurants, hip bars and fun shopping. The apartment was simple, functional and clean and had everything we needed — we loved the welcome basket and quarters for the laundry! We would definitely stay with Jess again!
Jess is a wonderful host and the apartment is exactly as advertised—clean. It is also comfortable and well situated in central Williamsburg, just a short distance to the Bedford subway station.

My husband and I went to Brooklyn for a wedding at The Brooklyn Winery. Jess’s place was the perfect location. We had a great time exploring the area. Besides location the apartment was clean and had all the basic essentials. The bed was super comfortable. We will for sure come back again.

Jess's property is wonderful!  Check in was super easy. The location is perfect. It is steps away from Bedford and all the shopping and also steps away from the subway and thus the rest of NYC. A short walk to McCarren Park. The apartment is super clean and the amenities are wonderful. The linens are top notch. The personal touches such as coffee, snacks were greatly appreciated.  I hope to stay there again!

Jess is always welcoming, she sends a note ahead of our stay giving all the directions need to access the apartment, she checks after a few days to see if everything is okay or if anything is needed, and before you leave sends a note.  The apartment is very clean and well appointed.  It is in a great location for access to restaurants, stores, and the subway. But, really, the best part of this is the human touch.  Thank you, Jess, Delvis, and Anne Marie.

While not large, Jess's place was really carefully and thoughtfully laid out which made it feel much bigger. Lots of closet space to hang clothes, a well-stocked kitchen and many helpful details (like post-it notes and a stapler on the desk). We enjoyed having our coffee on the back patio. Jess was very responsive and provided detailed instructions on how to get inside (with photos!). Great central N Wiliamsburg location walkable to the park, ferry stop and a block from the L train.

Jess and her apartment should be the template for all Airbnb owners.
We stayed at Jess’s apartment three times and each time we were thankful that we had chosen to stay there.
The communication with Jess and her co-host Delvis was excellent. The instructions for the apartment were detailed and easy to follow.
The flat itself is very well equipped, stylish and comfortable. The thoughtful and practical “extras” were much appreciated and added to our enjoyment of the flat. Having a courtyard was a real bonus. It was lovely to sit outside and enjoy our evening meal. The location is also great - right in the heart of Williamsburg and around the corner from the L line.
Thank you Jess for helping to make our stay in Brooklyn such a great one.

My wife is a clean freak and she was impressed! Loved the patio and the shower was great pressure and hot! Every little touch was great, phone chargers on nightstand, comfortable bed, noise machine, treats, coffee, even umbrellas! Hope to visit and stay again.

We loved this place! Excellent location. Fun area. We would wake up and go running in McCarren park and then get a breakfast burrito from the place next door.  It was all really perfect. We’d stay again.

Great NYC experience. Everything in the apartment was spotless and well thought out. The overall apartment has a really nice aesthetic to it, it made the experience much more special.Every single thing in apartment; as it advertised,brand new!! Both queen size and sofa bed are super comfortable,  the neighborhood is quite and safe so we slept well during our stay. Also because the apartment is on the street level, it’s so much easier to go in and out especially with the luggages. The location is very convenient with buses and train options, easy commute to Manhattan. On top of everything, the private garage that they have and access to the backyard are great!!The hosts were also very welcoming and hospitable,and they were very responsive. I will definitely go back again.”

I honestly can’t complain about my stay! Really loved everything about the style of the home and in some cases it felt like home away from home. Parking is a bit of a hassle but if you a train and bus type of person then you don’t have anything to worry about. They are super nice people and i actually connect with EKA because we both share the same passion.
Nita and Eka were lovely hosts. Their newly-renovated space is absolutely gorgeous and conveniently located near the subway and some great restaurants. We'd stay again in a heartbeat!

Beautiful and extremely clean place!
Peaceful atmosphere, but near a lot of stores and night life.
The host is very nice, so attentive and helpful.
Easy check in by yourself.
5/5 👍

My girlfriend and I had an amazing stay at Nita & Eka’s place. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures.. They take pride in their place, it was spotless.
They were great hosts, even went as far as to send us a list of local places to try. They were available to us if we had an questions but also respected our privacy. We hope to be back again.

Check in and check out were both incredibly smooth. I got in super late the day i landed but Ampere was here to welcome me properly and show me around. During the whole month the communication was on point and a cleaning person was here every week, which is good. However the overall cleanliness lowkey depends on your other roommates at the time of your stay. I was pretty lucky though. The location was also very convenient: 30min to Soho with the M train, and then of course a little longer if you’re looking to go uptown.
Overall, great Airbnb the room was super comfortable and clean upon arrival and the natural light coming in was just fantastic. The kitchen also has everything you need to cook like an everyday person would.
Really recommend this Airbnb for long stays!! I would absolute go back
great place, with the entire second floor to yourself. great location, restaurants and bars are walkable, and the subway is very close! very happy with our host and airbnb!!

Getting in touch with Ian was easy peasy. The place looked really nice and was within walking distances of everywhere I needed to go. So that was perfect. It always felt clean even when sharing with other guests. 10/10 would stay again.

The location is very convenient and the host is very supportive! She allowed us leaving our bags even after check out while visiting other places in NYC. The room was very small And there was no room at all to keep something in the fridge....however, it was clean and the location and price was good

Nice place to stay for the price.  Room is a decent size for NYC.  Shared bathroom but had no issues with using.  Location is really easy to get to.  There is street noise late at night due to the area so if you have trouble sleeping through the noise of NYC, you might consider another location.
A small but private room perfect for traveling light. Stayed for two days and had no problems or any issues.

SUCH a great deal for the price and location! Shared bathroom was never a problem. The room itself is smaller than expected, but it’s all you really need to keep luggage during the day and sleep at night. Would stay here again!
Host is really welcoming and the location was perfect. It is a shared space with private bedrooms but everything was clean and we had no issues
Great location but not a lot of space in the room. Also shared bathroom and shower is with many others. So this is more hostel style.

The location of the room is excellent !
Unfortunately, it was always cold in the room, because the windows are very leaky. I was given an extra blanket on request and there was a fan heater.
The mattress was unfortunately not so comfortable, because it was about only 3cm high. Also the room was really tiny, you could actually only lie down.
I was very pleased with the cleanliness of the room. It was vacuumed daily and in the sink I could not even see drops of water.
All in all I was satisfied, but it was much too expensive for what was offered.

It is very central, and you feel safe to go out in the evening for a walk or some food.
The hoste is great, and the facilities are clean and fresh!
The room is a little cold, but the heater does a very good job!
Just be aware that it is very noisy, even though you have earplugs in, so if you are a light sleeper, i wish you good luck 😊
Great location in New York for a good price. Easy self check-in and no problem with the bedroom or shared bathroom they were both clean.
Ms.Kristine is super nice and helpful. Had no problems dropping my bags off early and leaving them late. Clean and good location. Rooms are tiny but worth it.

The place is very near Korean town, train station and is easy to find. The room is smaller than I expected but you get what you paid for. They provided enough necessities and got some snacks too. The people during the stay were nice and quite. Three hosts are very responsive and one of them also be there during your stay if you need help. Highly recommended! :)
Very clean, central location. Host is on-site and so responsive. Just about the whole of south of Central Park Manhattan is in walking distance, so convenient!!
Great place to stay if you’re after a central location! The room is small but not a big problem. We had some problems with our key but was sorted quickly.

Is important to know that it is a small room and consider this if you are expecting a normal sized one because it’s not like that. The place works perfectly fine if you are going to be mostly out from the room (which I think is the idea) the location of it couldn’t be more perfect, is literally a few steps away from the Empire State Building, subway, food stores, restaurants, etc. It worked perfectly for my friend and I.

This place is simply amazing!! It is like a sanctuary, a little oasis in the middle of the concrete jungle. It is where many brave, adventurous, curious and even tired souls can come and find temporary respite from the hustle and bustle of the big city. It is located in the heart ♥ of the city which would explain why I fell in love with it.
My host Kris was super amazing, supportive and very attentive. When called upon, she would respond promptly and made sure everything was taken care of.
So yes! It is definitely worth the stay here.

Saskia has one of the most wonderfully delightful apartments in Brooklyn. It’s spacious and set up perfectly so you immediately feel at home — it’s so much more cozy, well-appointed, and personal than the usual airbnb!
I spent a bit over two months at Saskia’s Park Slope apartment and enjoyed every minute. The location is perfect, it’s on a quiet, safe, tree lined street, less than a block from the restaurants and bustle of 5th Ave.
There’s space to work, and the living room is also lovely to have a friend over in the evening. The kitchen is a rare find in the area: it’s full sized and well equipped for regular cooking. I can’t imagine finding a more perfect place to spend fall in Brooklyn.

I've stayed in a number of Airbnbs over the years, and Saskia has been the best Airbnb host I've ever had. She was incredibly responsive, flexible, kind, and helpful. Whenever we had questions, she responded within a few minutes, she provided additional utensils we needed right away, and was just lovely to communicate with. She provided a personal touch -- knowing our situation, having welcomed a newborn in the family -- and went above and beyond with flowers, small gifts, and snacks/drinks that the whole family could enjoy. Thank you for an amazing stay, Saskia! We feel so lucky to have found this gem in prime Park Slope.

Saskia’s apartment is beautiful, comfortable, and very well equipped. We live nearby and booked it for a month for family to stay after we had a baby and it worked out perfectly. Saskia was so helpful and communicative and made sure everyone had everything they needed. We would book Saskia’s apartment again in a heartbeat.

Richard's place is perfectly situated right by everything you need. LIRR has one-step trains to Bayside in the evening that drop you off 50yds from home, there's a post office, bank, cafe/sandwich shop with nice espresso and juices just downstairs, and we'll over a dozen restaurants within 2-3 blocks. Richard was very responsive and helpful - great experience, would definitely come back again.

Edythe is simply the best! A kind, communicative host who was always ready to offer help or assistance in any way we needed. We stayed in Edythe's lovely apartment for just about two months. Even though it is a studio apartment, there was plenty of room for my friend and I to live and work together from home in the space. The location is stellar as you can basically walk anywhere downtown, and the apartment is decorated in such a fun, charming way! I would not hesitate to book Edythe's apartment again for a future stay. Thank you for everything Edythe! :-)

An amazing location for a lovely apartment, but most of all an incredibly welcoming host ! Edythe was THE best airbnb host I've ever had to deal with: dropping more equipment to the flat, toilet paper, always finding solutions and being accommodating. We had a wonderful stay, I highly recommend :)
Thank you so much Edythe!

Edythe is a great host. She was helpful with her instructions and always very prompt. I was comfortable throughout my stay. The only downside of the place is that it is in a really old building. It’s not a fancy apartment if you’re looking for one.
Great location! It was everything we needed - three beds, a bathroom, and a kitchenette.  A little loud in the mornings starting at 7 am with construction but we were up and out regardless.
Great location, the room was very clean and the amenities were great! Super great location and the walking was close to all the cool attractions. Great communication!
Oscar and Rossanna were very communicative and helpful before and throughout our stay. The apartment was perfect for our needs, affordable, and in a great location. Would stay again!

Oscar and Rossanna’s place was perfect for my four friends and I. It was clean, the beds were very comfortable, the temperature of the room was perfect— it was described perfectly. I 100% recommend this place to anyone looking to be close to some of the best things NYC has to offer!!
Perfect location for a getaway to NYC if you are young and with Friends. It is a small studio, I would not recommend to more than 4 people to stay there.
Fantastic location for getting around. Right next to the Herald Sq stop on the subway and only a couple blocks from the Empire State Building. My family and I had a great time staying here!
We had a great stay! Our hosts were quick to respond and loved the space. The location cannot be beat!

Location was perfect. Near times square. It was clean. They were nice at the reception and helped us with the check in since our flight got delayed and we were a day late. They also provide luggage storage for a small fee which helped us since we were leaving around night. Good spot for a good price.

I stayed here with a few of my friends for the summer and this apartment worked perfectly!  Host was very accommodating for our dates, as opposed to other options we found.  Bedrooms were great sizes and kitchen had everything we needed to cook.  Also enjoyed the onsite laundry and upstairs lounge area!  Building is very safe and quiet and in a great neighborhood (just a few blocks off of the subway lines too).  Would definitely stay here again if I'm in the city and would recommend to anyone looking for a long term stay!
The place was very easy to find, clean, fairly priced, and close to all the things we wanted to see. I would definitely stay here again, Oscar and Rossanna are excellent hosts.
The place is perfect for vacationing close to downtown Manhattan. This place is perfect if you’re just looking for a place to sleep and be exploring  during the day. Host is responsive. Clean place.

I loved my stay at Saras place. It was exactly as described and the neighbourhood is quiet and peaceful. Sara was very responsive and was flexible with baggage drop off which I really appreciated. The place is clean, well maintained, beautiful and has everything you need. Thanks Sara for a wonderful stay!

My 14 year old daughter and I enjoyed this great neighborhood vibe of  Brooklyn apartment located on the bottom floor, underneath the main house. Totally private entrance and secure apartment. There are 3 separate lock doors to go through. We had trouble with the first gate but eventually figured it out. The linens and decor are simple and stylish. Laundry washer and dryer is a big bonus. We appreciated they left detergent for us too. It was easy to take the bus or subway to anywhere we wanted to go. We visited Brighton Beach, Manhattan, Dumbo and Williamsburg the 4 days we stayed. You really never need to leave with amazing restaurants, cafes and grocery right around the corner. I definitely recommend this listing.

Great listing! The place was incredible, exactly as advertised. Came full of essentials and the location is unparalleled. The entire process was easy and we felt secure staying there for the duration of our trip. We definitely stay here again!!

Comfortable unit in a convenient location on a lovely brownstone and tree lined street. The block is rather magical. The place is well equipped with many items that make travel easier, like two real coffee makers along with coffee and tea, a well equipped kitchen, a washer & dryer and solid internet. The unit is spacious and has good natural light. It was a pleasure to stay here away from the New York bustle.

My friend and I had a great stay. Photos were accurate, check-in instructions were clear. The location was perfect for us. Really only two small things- it would have been helpful to have a full-length mirror and a box of tissues.

We had a lovely time at Sara’s place! It’s very well equipped, super clean and the bed had one of the best mattresses I’ve ever slept on!
In the beginning there was some trouble with the heating but Sara and Kate were super responsive and helpful all the time and immediately sent someone to fix it. Communication was always great as well.
Thanks for hosting us - We’d definitely come back!

Lovely and stylish appartement that was very clean and uncluttered . Easy to get to subway and shops and restaurants nearby. Looks better in real life than on the pictures. Host communicated very well with us, we didn’t see her but that was fine. All in all a hidden gem if you look for a comfortable place at travel distance from down- town. NYC.
Lovely apartment! Felt right at home with everything I needed. Would stay here again - thanks so much!

The apartment was spacious, warm, clean and comfortable. It had everything we needed for our stay and was well equipped. It is about 10 mins walk to the subway. There were a few very welcoming cafes and bakeries nearby and a great jazz club. Definitely recommend for a stay in Bed-Sty/ Brooklyn.

Cozy and comfortable! The perfect place to stay for a 2 night trip. I had a concert to go to so this was convenient for me since it was near the area! Plus wasn’t too far from the airport. Will definitely be back in the future!
Immaculate and cozy home. Host provided fresh flowers which was a nice touch. We highly recommend this home.
It was truly amazing.  We would stay there again.  Loved the neighborhood. Great restaurants. Cutest place  and Sara was fast in responding to all my questions. Highly recommend
Sara’s place was in a great location with walkable cafes, restaurants and a walkable distance to public transportation. The space was very comfortable for two with everything you’d need.

This is a beautiful place, very spacious, prime location, and very clean. It was perfect for my family of 6, 4 adults and 2 children, staying in NYC for a month. We had more than enough amenities, towels, and kitchen and shower essentials for our entire stay. Rick was very responsive and helpful with any information we needed. Check in and check out was a breeze. The location was awesome, right next to Central Park and 5th avenue, plenty of shopping and places to eat within walking distance. The subway is on the same block and the supermarket is a 5 minute walk. Would definitely recommend for anyone staying in NYC, would stay again ourselves.
Nice neighborhood and lots of places nearby to eat at and visit. Rick is easy to reach , very responsive and makes you feel right at home.

I stayed in Cristina’s airbnb for two months during my internship and as a person in need of something cheaper, but practical, it was a perfect place to stay. It felt really cosy and comfortable. The bed was awesome!!!! Also close to bus stops, so no problem with getting anywhere. Highly recommend! Cristina was answering really fast whenever I needed anything and was very helpful.

Great location, quiet street near the train station. Spacious,  clean, well stocked apartment. Host is very attentive and responds quickly. Provides excellent advice on local amenities.  Excellent overall first experience!

Mathieu's place had a great location, was super clean and had all amenities we needed. Mathieu was very helpful and responsive, he answered all our messages immediately and was always looking for us to feel good. He is the best host I've had since I have used Airbnb.

Mathieu’s apartment was a perfect place to stay. The space was cozy, child-proof for my 3 year old and he was always close by to help, while still giving us total privacy. I will definitely be checking on his space when I visit Carroll Gardens again.

Mathieu was probably the best host I’ve ever had through  Airbnb (which says a lot because I’ve had some great ones)! He was  super attentive, communicative and thorough, but also respectful of privacy and space. The apartment was great and equipped with everything you’d need for a short or extended stay. Carroll Gardens is a wonderful neighborhood and the apartment is a short walk from everything you’d need and more. Highly recommend all around. Thank you for everything, Mathieu!
This is the place! Great location, beautiful neighborhood and wonderful host. Mathieu and his place were awesome. We will be staying here again any chance we get!
Mathieu's place is comfortable, clean, and in a wonderful, lovely location that is convenient to just about everything! Would not hesitate to book again next time we are in Brooklyn.

This apartment is in a quiet lovely community. The place is spotless and organized well. All instructions from owner were easy to follow and no problems encountered. Great place to stay  - we will be back when visiting family.

Incredible location for walking and living in Brooklyn. Mathieu is quick to respond and very helpful.
Very quiet neighborhood and that is hard to find!
A Brooklyn gem.

Me and my colleagues had a great stay at Ben's apartment. The apartment is bright and beautiful with 3 bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a comfortable living room with a free Netflix and Prime Video access. The flat had everything you need for a longer stay.
The location was truly great, so were the restaurants and bars tips Ben and Alexis provided us with. There is a plenty of cafes and restaurants just around the corner and the subway station (L-line) is just 4-minutes footwork away, straight to Manhattan. A big grocery store is one block away. Everytime we needed some additional information, we reached out to Ben and he got back to us super quickly.
One of the reasons we enjoyed our stay in NYC so much was because we lived in this great apartment that immediately felt like home.
Thank you for having us!
We had a great stay at Ben's place, for a little over a month. The place was very clean and quiet, and in a great location. Thanks Ben!

We stayed a week here in April. The apartment is large by NYC standards and pretty well stocked. The place has many windows so great light and cross breezes when warm out. Unfortunately that also means it can be pretty noisy but we got used to it after a couple nights. The location is amazing, so close to the L and G trains so easy access to Manhattan and Brooklyn neighborhoods. There is everything you need within walking distance: bars, groceries, coffee, restaurants, bodegas, etc. communication with the owner was easy and quick as was getting the key from a local business. Very happy with our stay.

This is a fun place to stay for getting to know Brooklyn better, or quickly and easily visiting Manhattan.  It reminded me of apartments I had in college, but none of them had a fabulous roofdeck like this!  The beds were comfortable, the kitchen well-equipped, the WiFi strong and stable, the tv easy to use.  Having a coffee shop right downstairs is an added bonus.  We found parking in the neighborhood easy. Ben responded quickly to all our questions and was a great host!
I enjoyed my stay here. Central location, close to many restaurants and shopping. Easy check in and check out process.
Great location for transport into Manhatten if you don't want to pay the earth for accommodation.

I was very pleased on how comfortable and clean this Air Bnb was. Super easy to get around places especially if your day is filled with activities around the city. I would definitely try to book again if I decide to visit NY again.

Martin is a great host! Always available and responsive. We had a problem with the WiFi but Martin came and installed a new router for us. The bathroom is a bit dated but the location is great (two blocks away from the busier streets of Williamsburg) and you really can’t beat the price for NYC.

This Airbnb is in a great location, very accessible to the subway and ferry. Martin and his brother were very responsive. The door knob is a little tricky and doesn’t open easily, once you get used to it, it’ll be fine! One of our packages got stolen in this apartment although the neighborhood felt very safe. We stayed there for a month and we felt that the kitchen had less utensils for a long stay. Martin and his brother are very friendly people and always ready to help!

Great location for stay in Williamsburg. Short walk to ferry and subway made getting around easy. WiFi was very good and bed comfortable. Apartment is on ground floor with windows opening onto side alley where bins are. It was generally v quiet but location makes rooms very dark most of the day.  As other reviews bathroom needs an upgrade and some general TLC.
The apartment is in a great location and has a well-stocked kitchen. Ben was very responsive and helpful at every step. We would definitely stay there again.

Nice hotel in great location. Unit we got was much smaller and without an L couch and only a small round table with seating for two instead of the pictures larger table. Living room was a little dark and bathroom is very small but everything was very clean and the staff is very nice and helpful. Definitely a great deal for the price.
The walls were very thin , you could hear everyone who comes and goes up the hall. The stay was very central and the apartment was clean. Easy check in and out.

Mould on the shower walls. Informed Air BnB and they said this was normal for air bnb. Could not believe this response. Human hair abundant but nothing done when reported. Absolutely the tiniest of a bathroom. You could brush your teeth while sitting on the toilet. TV not working and no help from owner.
In bad need of upgrades for the price and Air BnB absolutely no help despite sending pictures and video
As advertised. Small, but very good price/ quality value proposition. Would recommend to friends and family.

It’s a perfect place to stay in when exploring the city. It has everything we needed and it was in a great location. Bathroom is very small ( not a bad thing) but just FYI because you cannot move around
If you are a bigger person.
Loved it and would recommend.
Host was very communicative. Easy check-in/checkout. Great price for the location. Worked perfect for our groups one night stay.
Good location. Appreciated them holding bags. Towels were musty smelling but other then that it worked well for our needs.
Great host! Great apartment...checking was smooth and the host was ready to help if we needed something

Our stay at William’s place was quite comfortable. The apartment had everything we needed and was clean. Check-in and check-out were a breeze & communication with William was good. The location was good, if a bit noisy in the morning.

Amazing place! Great location! Walking distance to Empire State Building and many subway stations and great restaurants. Host was very responsive and attentive. Was even able to store my luggage for a few hours after checkout as our plane left in the afternoon. Great service

Awful area to stay if you are a solo traveler, becareful in the building, it is not too safe. The appartment is Ok, bedding clothes are soft and comfortable, but the kitchen is not so clean.
I appreciate the wiew over the corner, it is a 9th floor.
The airbnb is close to everything, the room was clean and included all the kitchen services.  It was super fast to find the place.
Perfect location for a short NY stay.  In the heart of Ktown and close to subway.  Host and staff was very friendly and responsive.
Great stay for our group! Easy to get to and wonderful to work with. Loved being able to drop off our bags before check in.

Loud corridors and single pane windows , it’s  a New York experience but if you are looking for peace and quiet this is not your place , overall good place to book if you you are just looking for a place to sleep
This was a great place and even better location. Very clean. The only issue we had was lack of storage. There is no where to put anything in the bathroom.
Excellent stay. A bit confusing to find the office and get helped to check in but overall no issues.
Great place and walking distance to everything! We took the train into the city and didn’t want to walk far with luggage, this was perfect!

Will was a communicative and gracious host. He was extremely prompt in responding to our questions and things that came up during our stay. He checked in throughout the stay and provided immediate solutions. Very spacious Airbnb! Clean and a really nice shower with lots of hot water!
Great location. Great kitchen.  .Very responsive to a maintenance issue we had and corrected the problem quickly.   Definitely Recommend!
We had an incredible time. Perfect place to stay if you are new to NYC. Will definitely come back

The place is good to stay , very clean , and William always answer you . The only thing I recommend is get a train , don’t rent cars because the park on the street is confused about the plaques and signs and is very full too !
But I recommend this place :)

Beyond convenient location: close to Herald Square station, Penn Station, MSG all walking distance--- incredible food all around in Korea Town-- Couldn't have been a more perfect location for my family of five to stay with tweens!
We arrived a bit early and the staff was very accommodating to hold on to our luggage

Great place to stay if you’re looking for somewhere in the city. We stayed for two nights, it’s right in Koreatown and easy walk to Times Square. We didn’t need any extra amenities, if needed we knew they would be very accommodating. Beds and linens were clean, maybe extra cleaning under the beds but we didn’t mind it too much given that we only stayed for two nights and explored the city more than staying at the room. Overall great place with lots of places near by!
excellent place and tremendous service. the host always ready to answer your questions and help. This is my second time staying at the place and I would definitely visit again.
Great Location, very clean and great host.  Greg accommodated my check in and check out times and was available if needed to be! Definitely would book again!
Thanks Greg! Nice area to stay and big space for BX.  I would stay again! :)
Highly pleased with the owner's treatment and communication. The apt has all the possible comforts to make you feel comfortable. This is my fourth time visiting them. Excellent work .
We had a good stay at Gregory’s space. It was clean, the check - in process was easy and it was in a convenient location.

Gregory was a wonderful host! We love the location being so close to Yankee Stadium, the subway and other entertaining parts of the city. It was clean and just the right accommodations for our stay. Having the host on the premises and meeting us was a plus. We will be sure to use this again as our home away from away in NYC.
Great place, great host. The apartment is very comfortable and clean. Gregory was friendly and accommodating. We had an excellent stay and would happily stay here again.

Loved my stay in the Bronx at Greg's place. Everything was just as described and very convenient. Bus and train were nearby making it easy to get to other parts of the city. Also easily accessible to/from LGA airport. Lots of food places and bodegas in the area.
Greg and his brother were very friendly and accommodating! Will definitely keep this listing around for my next trip to the city :)
This is a great place to stay for 2 people.  Clean, comfortable, very easy to get around, especially by subway to midtown. A perfect place to explore Harlem but also all of NYC.
The area was in a great location and the place was very clean! Jeniffer was a great host and everything went smoothly.
Such a lovely spot. Very clean, bright, and comfortable. Great location to explore the city from and relax in at night. We would definitely stay here again!

It was a beautiful room with the view on the green trees of the backyard and I really enjoyed staying there , it was relaxing , clean and the location is very good too! I would definitely come back here! Also , the rooftop view is very spectacular!
Really great stay. Had some issues with AC that took a few days to get sorted. That being said, please is exactly as described and had a very nice stay.
Such a perfect apartment. So lovely and bright. Great location and hosts were very supportive and helpful! Wish I could have stayed longer :)

Amazing small studio, very clean, quiet neighborhood. Be aware that it don’t have a kitchen, so you’ll have to order food constantly. Other than that, i love the place. Will book again in the future. Thank you
Location is wonderful. Easy to self-check in and the lobby had A/C blowing throughout day and night which was great.

Eva's place is one of the best gems in New York City. It's close to the park and public transport with easy access to the city yet you can find serenity in the neighbourhood. The host is very kind and attentive and they made sure the suite is equipped with everything that would make your stay comfortable. Highly recommended!

Eva and Tom are wonderful hosts. They put a lot of care into the studio they are renting out and everything is designed to create a comfortable “home away from home” experience. They are excellent communicators and are always thinking ahead - giving us heads-up about upcoming maintenance, time they will be away, etc. They are quick in responding any questions and are very generous in accommodating our needs.
I highly recommend this little gem in Inwood!

I came for the weekend to celebrate my birthday with my partner and some close friends.
We had such a great time. The space was so cozy and clean, with so many amenities. And that view! Wow.
Veronica sent us great recommendations for the area. Her instructions were clear and she was always quick to answer any questions via text.

The location is steps away from the beach and has a perfect layout- an open floor plan in the kitchen/living room to lounge while cooking. A balcony facing the water right off the kitchen for breakfast with a view. And an incredible roof patio for hanging out in a hammock!
Our host, Veronica, was very thoughtful and responsive throughout our stay. They provided beach umbrellas, extra towels, and boogie boards we could borrow which was a huge plus.
The place is clean and stylish with a perfect location. we had a great time! Veronica shared many helpful suggestions for restaurants and is quick to respond.

The house was wonderful and so clean! The location was great. It was on a quiet block, just a few steps to the beach, yet within walking distance to restaurants and the grocery store. The ocean view from the two terraces were beautiful and relaxing. Hosts made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Will definitely go back.
A stone’s throw from the beach, short walk to bars, grocery store, restaurants. We slept 7 with no problem at all. We would definitely stay here again.

Everything you could ask for. Really is ocean front.
Spacious and fully equipped modern home. You will not be disappointed.

What a great spot by the beach! It's right on the water in a quiet part of the Rockaways but a short uber/bike ride or 30ish minute walk to a lot of excellent spots. The house is beautiful with water views and comfortable beds. We hope to be back next summer!
Great place to stay in Rockaway for a family  get together! Spacious and minutes from the beach. Very communicative and helpful hosts before and during our stay! Highly recommend!
Great place in Rockaway Beach! There were three rooms and air mattress available. The owners were very kind and responsive. The amenities were great and parking was easy.

This was our second time staying at this Airbnb with friends and two kids. The Airbnb is in an amazing location right across the street from the beach and short walking distance to several restaurants and a supermarket. The hosts are super responsive to any questions or concerns. They also have all the amenities you may need for a beach day and the kitchen is well-stocked. The weather sadly did not cooperate with us this year and we were unable to take advantage of our proximity to the beach but would definitely stay here again the next time we plan a Rockaway beach getaway.
Beautiful and spacious spot right on the quiet beach. Perfect getaway from the city! Note that there are many more stairs than we anticipated as it’s a four story house!
This place was wonderful! Everything was so easy and they responded so quickly when we needed something. Definitely would stay here again 100%
Really great for the price. It was a bit noisy at times, but beyond that, I had a great stay.

My experience with Nomad Suites was excellent. They were in communication with me the whole time, and even offered to upgrade my room due to good reviews on my part and requesting an early check in. An excellent stay id recommend to anyone

A great home base for a stay in NYC. The location is awesome, with quick access to MTA and lots of nearby sightseeing activities. It is small, so if you're planning on spending a lot of time in the Airbnb, it might not be the best option. But if you need a place to sleep and stash your stuff while you're out exploring everything the city has to offer, this is a wonderful place for you!

Great location, clean room, comfortable beds, updated bath. The room is very small, make no mistake, but it includes all one needs (including desk and vanity) to make the lodging what you need. If you want NYC lodging to be a place to lounge and hang out, choose another location (and spend a lot more money). But if you want lodging only for a place to shower and sleep, this spot works very well.
Neighbors do construction in their apartments. Loud thumping the entire time I was there, difficult time sleeping

Absolutely amazing place, just as described. Host is extremely responsive and very, very friendly. Internet speed is incredible if that matters to you (it did to me!) and the rooms are super clean, and comfortable. The hosts even had a bottle for us for New Years to wish us well, and welcomed us to some ingredients in the fridge which made life really easy! Easily a 10/10 spot and I will be coming back as soon as I'm back in New York. Thank you guys for everything!

This is one of the best places I booked with Airbnb and the best amenities I had received ever. The attention to details, the amenities is more than 💯. I feel like I didn't need to bring anything with me except my clothes and shoes. EVERYTHING else was provided. I was so shocked!!! You will even get your own parking. Place was clean, as described. The bed on one of the room made a lot of noise if you are doing some business on it but it didn't bother us. The bathroom was a little small but didn't take anything away from our experience. We love the place. My kids still missed the house when we got back home. Excellent host 💯. Great communication. Thanks guys for everything. You Rock!!! I'll definitely return and book you guys every time I'm in town.

Lovely home in a quiet neighborhood within few minutes walking distance to the grocery, library and bus stop, 10-minute drive to the LIRR and 15-minute drive to JFK airport.  Eunice and Marc are the best hosts ever! They are very responsive and kind.  Well-stocked kitchen beyond our expectations.  Rooms are clean, beds are comfortable. Toilet and bath are adequate. We will definitely book again the next time we are in New York!

We stayed here for almost a week and had a great experience overall. My flight got in really early and Eunice and Marc were kind enough to let me check in early. They even left groceries for us to utilize while we settled in which was greatly appreciated. Kind and very responsive hosts.

Host we're very responsive as well as a nive family place to stay, all turns were accessible to supermarket, laundry etc a minute away by walking..really convenient.easy drive to the walmart and the mall.
Marc & Eunice are very kind, polite and respectful and they went out of their way to make us feel at home. Wonderful place and wonderful couple.

My parents liked the place, it has 2 bedrooms. Marc was responsive. The parking is available. The house is beautiful. The location is close to JFK, so prepare to hear some planes flying from time to time. We would come back again!

This is a wonderful place to stay. We were welcomed with all sorts of delicious treats. The apartment is well furnished and appointed with everything you could need. The place was immaculate and stocked with all the supplies needed to feel safe and clean during this difficult time. The location was perfect for us. I would definitely stay here again. You won't be disappointed. Enjoy!

Excellent location- excellent response and communication- the house is immaculate in cleanliness and sanitary
It was as if we were the first people ever in it
Combined B&B touches with 5 star hotel feel

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this lovely apartment.
Clean and comfortable and well stocked with essentials and goodies!
Yang and Su were very accommodating with an earlier check in and later check out time which we really appreciated
An easy 4 block walk to the subway.
We thought the street parking might be tough but we easily found a spot every time!
If we ever need a place to stay again in Brooklyn, we have found it!!

My family enjoyed our stay in this lovely apartment. It is absolutely as described. Clean, roomy enough for six adults, well stocked, great location, parking on same street, AND stellar communication from Yang and Su. This rental ticks all of the boxes. I wouldn't hesitate to book again. Neither should you. Enjoy!
P.S. Giovanni's Brooklyn Eats is about a five minute walk from apartment. Recommended by Yang & Su. My family dined there and we recommend it as well. Darling place with delicious food.

Best Airbnb ever. So lovely, comfortable and impeccably clean. As clean as I would keep my house! Thoughtfully and beautifully decorated too. The hosts have thought about everything that a person might need or forget to bring. Thank you for your kindness to us. It was greatly appreciated and will be remembered.

Yang & Su’s place is so cute! We stayed over a weekend to celebrate my sister-in-law’s 40th birthday. And it was our first time in NYC. We truly enjoyed our stay. My family, liked all the little personal touches to the AirBnB. Like, the snacks and bamboo toothbrushes. The shampoo and conditioners in each bathroom were wonderful also. It left our hair so soft. Lastly, we liked how close restaurants, convenience stores, and the station was to the place. Will definitely book again if we come to NYC in the future. ☺️
Yang and Su’s place was Uber clean and welcoming. The kitchen was stocked with the little things you need first thing in a new place. Would highly recommend! Our stay was perfect

Our stay at Yang & Su’s  house was a very neat experience. Their house is located near great restaurants and stores and close to a metro station. It was very well maintained and very clean with everything needed for a perfect stay. We enjoyed reading the many books and playing the many games, puzzles and video games.
Beautiful apartment, extremely well appointed.  Well laid out and stocked with everything you could need including a first aid kit.  Great neighborhood.  Easy parking if you are driving.

Very nice place to stay. We live a block away and needed an additional space for family members to stay and this was an amazing find. Very well kept. I used to work in big tech and the thoughtfulness of stocked snacks and stocked utensils reminded me of the kitchen pantry of my old job…  in a VERY GOOD way. Would say here again. 👍🏼
Very nice place to see the area.  It is close to the highway but noise was not a factor.
The place was spotless and quiet.  Neighborhood has lots of restaurants and shops as well as parks and trees. We felt very comfortable there.

Very conveniently located for us to visit a family member who lives in Brooklyn. Free parking for unlimited time on 18th st. Comfy beds, very clean, beautifully decorated, and lots of thoughtful touches and snacks left by hosts.

We visit the area often to visit our daughter and have stayed a many Air BnBs in the area.  Yang & Su’s is simply the best.  Clean, quiet, walkable, nicely decorated, it felt like home!  Easy to find, check in and easy to catch the subway to Manhattan or take a walk in Prospect Park.    We look forward to returning.
Our third flawless stay at Yang & Su’s, and looking forward to many more while visiting family in Brooklyn.
Ryan’s place is totally amazing and has a perfect location.  The home was very clean and Ryan was very responsive!  I would stay again!  Thanks!

Absolutely amazing stay at Ryan's gem in the heart of Williamsburg. This 5 Story building is state of the art. Very spacious, modern design, new appliances that gives you a fresh feel and relaxation while you can hang out in the living room, the rear yard basement as well as the bedrooms upstairs. I found this place to be very clean, comfortable, and perfectly sized. The bathrooms and showers were excellent. Kitchen contains everything one needs.
Everything was perfect and much better than it seems online. Ryan is the most thoughtful, responsible and responsive host. He was very accommodating and very quick to respond with any questions. We would highly recommend this wonderful town house! Cheers!
This place was above and beyond.  Thank you to Ryan.  A fantastic home and host.

Ryan’s place was exactly as pictured and described in his listing. It had all the necessary amenities and the space was beautiful, clean, and comfortable. Ryan was responsive and provided many details about the house and the neighborhood. Wish we could have stayed longer than one night, but it was the perfect spot to hang out, catch up with friends, and celebrate a special birthday.

Ryan was a great host, clear and concise with everything. Accomadating to the highest degree. His home was beautiful in its design, and you feel the amount of time and love that went into curating this beautiful property. Would absolutely recommend and would love to stay again.
We liked it all…Ryan’s home had all the bells and whistles one could desire. Great location close to lots of dining and easy access to subway. We’d love to visit again.

Ryan's place is just like pictured -- incredibly spacious, beautifully furnished and decorated, and super clean. My family and I had a wonderful time here. There was plenty of space to spread out, and the home was very comfortable. I was commuting into Manhattan, which was a breeze with the Bedford Ave subway station close by. There are also tons of nice shops and a Whole Foods a quick walk away.

Ryan’s place is stunning! It’s spacious, airy, has great light, and is beautifully decorated! It’s rare to find homes like this in/around NYC. This is a perfect getaway for a quiet weekend!
Ryan was great! He provided awesome recommendations for the area, was very responsive, and check-in/check-out was easy. 10/10 recommend!

Had such a great stay at Ryan's place. The location was super convenient (couple blocks away from Whole Foods and lots of great restaurants/bars) and the home was beautiful! The pictures really don't do this place justice, and the pictures are gorgeous. Ryan was always easy to reach whenever we had questions. I would highly recommend staying here if you have the chance.
Outstanding place — beautiful home, exactly as advertised by photos, spacious and clean, unbeatable neighborhood
Absolutely stunning home in a great location. The host was very easy to get in touch with and was very responsive. Great stay in a gorgeous home!

Architecturally and aesthetically stunning. It exceeded my expectations, and I am obsessed. Ryan is an amazing host. Kind, easy- going, and responsive. I've already booked my next stay. Highly recommended!
What an amazing place. Fantastic shower & bath, bed, and location. Amanda was very communicative and helpful. Would definitely stay again!

Beautiful home ,great location  very quiet area  people were all friendly, convenient to all restaurants and within walking distance.  Hostess responded in a very timely manner and was kind, only issue is lol and that was only my husband's issue he had a little trouble going up and down the spiral stairs due to his size hes 6ft tall and 260 lbs , but other than that we had a wonderful time.

Amanda's place was WONDERFUL! It is so beautiful. The pictures aren't enough to describe. Amanda was extremely helpful, easy to work with and very professional. We could not have asked for a more amazing Airbnb experience!
I'd recommend this place a million times over! It's more than worth it!
We had an amazing time and loved Amanda’s place.  Many thoughtful details.  Communication was amazing!
Me and my family had an Amazing stay. Amanda was an Awesome host if we needed anything she was there and a great location. I would definitely go back
Amanda’s place was amazing! Im definitely going to visit again!!! Clean,Cozy, and Close to lots of places to visit. Parking was ALWAYS available! Great community and neighbors!

Amanda was a great host.  She always responded in a timely manner.  Amanda was very accommodating.  The place was better than we could have imagined.  We felt right at home.  Stores/restaurants were within walking distance.  I will definitely use her again,  and highly recommend her to anyone who would needs a quaint place to stay.

My in laws stayed at Amanda’s place while they were visiting us on CI. Amanda was super responsive and made check in very easy. The apartment was great! Very welcoming with a great layout. The bed was super comfortable. An overall great place to stay when visiting City Island!

A great place to stay for a few weeks and enjoy City Island life. We enjoyed walking on the Island and to nearby Orchard Beach. Convenient to get to restaurants, coffee shops, and a local grocery. Comfortable bed, couch, and space overall. And a responsive host who helped us throughout our stay. Thanks!

We enjoyed a lovely stay as a small family at this Airbnb. The apartment spans two floors, with the upper level housing the living room, kitchen, and bathroom featuring a spacious, luxurious jacuzzi and shower. Downstairs, there’s a large bedroom and a convenient half bath. The outdoor area includes a charming deck and patio, perfect for warm weather. Amanda provided clear and helpful instructions for the house. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the bedroom’s location on the lower floor made it peaceful and cozy—we slept really well!
On City Island, you’re within walking distance of a fantastic coffee shop, an ice cream parlor, delicious restaurants (especially one right next door), and a grocery store just a block away. Since the apartment is next to a restaurant, we did occasionally hear garbage pickup early in the morning, but it didn’t bother us because the bedroom is tucked away downstairs and remained quiet.
We would definitely recommend this home!
Very spacious for a small group, a huge kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and tv den in the basement, it was a great stay!

Really convenient place to Stay long term you have almost everything You need in the home from kitchenware
To seasonings to cook with. I didn’t have to worry about purchasing much . The back courtyard does need a little TLC and doesn’t look as clean as the pictures but dyill a nice place to relax in the morning.

We had a great time at Gian's Airbnb, it's very spacious and we really liked how the house was decorated. The location of the Airbnb is perfect, it was a good starting point for our many day trips in NYC. Being able to park in front of the house was also very convenient. We would definitely recommend Gian's Airbnb to anyone who wants to visit NYC.

This is an incredible place to stay. It is beautifully decorated and clean. You will  love the place and the location. The host was very responsive. The back yard area was an added bonus. I will definitely be returning.
It’s a beautiful and cozy place. The block is clean and friendly with markets near by. Great place to come back to after exploring the city.
Lovely place close to many train lines in Bushwick. Very comfortable, especially the large couch in the basement to lounge. Would stay again for sure!

Gian and Natasha were very helpful throughout our trip they gave us recommendations for breakfast. Their townhouse is a delight it is very cozy and good space for a 4-5 group. The nearest subway is the Gates Avenue which took us to Manhattan everyday. Nice stay and overall experience thanks
This house was an absolute treat to stay in! So much space, very quiet, and everything was in great condition. Highly recommended place!

I had a great stay overall! I stayed for a month with my dog and it was so nice to have space for my dog and the place was well appointed with everything you need for a long stay. The WiFi was strong for WFH never had any issues on video calls or otherwise. Gian & Natasha were great with communication - a pleasure to work with! The walk to the subway, grocery stores, and bodegas are pretty convenient 5-10 minutes away. The train into Manhattan via Lower East Side is about 20min but depending on where you’re going in Manhattan total travel time can be up to 50+ mins so evaluate your outings accordingly.

Gian and Natasha’s home looked even better than the pictures. Lots of space, very peaceful and they had everything we needed for a month’s stay. I’ll definitely book again when I need a place to stay again!
The place was everything I thought it would be, great location, great room. Easy access to building and everything around the neighborhood would most definitely come back
location is amazing.  the building is safe and secure and the other guests were quiet and respectful of one another.  Room was very much as advertised.
This place is in an amazing location that’s close to convenient train lines. There are always things going on in the area and lots of awesome restaurants, would recommend for a long stay!

The location is sooo good! Close to so many restaurants, clubs, parks etc. It was nice being close to Brooklyn as well.  The place itself was very nice and had nice big windows and comfortable bedding. Only thing is that the microwave didn’t work so we couldn’t heat up food but not that big of a deal.
Apt is really cool, great position and cool neighborhood. Bring your masks for the night because the sun will wake you up early. Great communication with the host. Reccomended

Brand new landscaping made our arrival extremely pleasant,  we were very pleased with all the newly built van life upgrades. The outdoor shower was one of the best experiences ever and also the location can’t be beat. We woke up and took walks to the beach every day :) thank you so much for having us!

Sarah's place knocked our socks off! The camper is spacious yet cozy and is stocked with everything you might need for a few days away. The outdoor space is massive- lots of room to hang out in both the sun and the shade. The town feels small while still having everything you need, including a grocery store, brewery, coffee shop, and restaurants. All of that is in walking distance, as is the beach. It's a simple train ride from the city and a short walk to Sarah's from the train stop. We are already excited to go back!

Our second stay in this little slice of heaven. We will be back again ! Thank you Sarah for building such a magical space I especially love all the privacy created by landscaping and fencing . My son loved the experience.

I had a wonderful experience staying here with my dog. Sarah the host was great at communicating and provided a guide that helped made the entire stay easy. The camper was designed with love and provided lots of privacy. Excellent tiny house living experience & home base for surfing and other beach adventures. And the incinerator toilet is pretty cool!
Nice and cozy place even though the weather was a bit chilly. Outdoor bathroom was small and cold but wouldn't be a problem in the summer time.
This is such a cozy little treat. The outdoor shower was lovely to experience, and the private backyard areas were beautiful.

Sarah’s trailer was a dream! My daughter and I loved staying there and it was the perfect beach weekend. Sarah is a great host that thinks of everything, and is so kind and welcoming. We felt like part of the neighborhood and it was perfect! Very close to the beach, good food, easy to get to subway or ferry. Looking forward to coming back again!

A true oasis, perfect located! Walking distance to some great bars/restaurants, but also tucked away enough to keep the peace. The outdoor shower was such a treat, and we really enjoyed the fire pit! It is very well decorated, with a working organ and guitar. Not to mention the bed was super comfortable and we got great sleep. It’s our new favorite place, and will definitely be returning!

Very clean and cozy, the place had everything I needed. There was some noise from upstairs from time to time as described but not too bad. Short drive to restaurants and dollar stores and is located super close to the airport. The neighborhood was pretty quiet and seemed safe. Eve was a great host, very attentive to details as everything we needed were included. The stay was well worth the price point! Definitely recommended.

I had a comfortable stay here. The place was clean and accurate to the description provided. The location was great, close to where we needed to be but also quiet. I loved how the room was equipped with a heater, which was necessary after a long day of walking around in the cold. Thank you!
Eve is a real super host. We had everything we needed, she always helped us very fast and we enjoyed the time very much!
I loved this place, felt like home. Didn’t even feel like anybody was upstairs. Accessible parking. Easy to find. Quiet neighborhood

The host was very polite and would respond to any of my questions in a timely manner. Reasonable distance from shopping in a nice quiet neighborhood. I would recommend this rental, especially if you don’t want the noise in the city.

I just felt home away from Home after flying thousands of miles. Eve was extremely cooperative and responsive. Every ask she is ready with a solution or an answer. Loved the stay. Missing the home and feeling like am missing my d=farway home now.
Sarah is great, and this place is a super value for surfers visiting Rockaway or singles or couples looking for a beach getaway close to NYC and with a subway stop a short walk away. We will be back!

Great little camper/glamping spot! We loved how close this spot is to the beach as well as beachfront cafes and restaurants- perfect for staying a couple of nights.
