We met the host’s dog and she was super nice and accommodating with me and my daughter! Definitely recommend this as a quick visit for people looking for a beachfront stay that is kid/dog-friendly.
Cute, fun, out of the ordinary stay. Close to the beach. Well kept. Would stay again. Thanks so much!

Sarah’s place was so cute! We had a flight cancellation at JFK and all the hotels were booked up, found her spot and she was very responsive and helpful! Wish we could have stayed longer, the bed was very comfortable and the little trailer was very cozy and had thoughtful touches. Would definitely recommend.

Nice clean little studio. Convenient neighborhood very near the Q train.  Great neighborhood restaurants. Two flights up.  Bed and floor was a bit creaky but that’s not a problem if you’re staying on your own. Good comfortable desk for working. There’s a Nespresso store on Madison Ave for extra pods for the machine.
stayed for 2 months. Great location and Place was perfect.  alot of great restaurants and bars within walking distance

The place was great. Lots of walkable bars and restaurants nearby. Wifi worked so I could work remotely. Close to Central Park and the Q train. Definitely can get noisy with cars and delivery trucks but that's to be expected. The area felt safe as well.
Ina’s place is in a great location close to the subways and buses. Great Restaurants are very close. It was very well stocked and clean. I would definitely stay there again.

Awful experience. Terrible communication, apartments do not appear as they do in pictures. Neighbors are lousy, noisy and disrespectful. Witnessed a domestic dispute through the walls. Crazy expensive utilities.
Such a beautiful place when you walk inside, parking was definitely clutch. It was either street or driveway parking. Had such a good time! Thanks!!
Clean and upgraded airbnb. Host was very responsive with quick replies. Only thing is that there are a lot of stairs inside the property.

Great host very friendly and very accommodating. He had no problem with me checking in early or checking out late. Would recommend him anytime.
Thanks Daniel
we had a great stay. house had everything we needed. enough space for all of us to be comfortable.  everything was clean and free of clutter. easy access
Great, responsive host! the place was perfect. If only I had reasons to come to NY much more often i would be looking to book this spot everytime.

Home was clean. Many, many stairs. I have knee problems and this was a challenge for me. 1 flight to get to the door; 2nd flight to get to the bedrooms (1st level); 3rd flight to get to the kitchen/dining room.

I will breakdown by different areas
Host: very responsive and quickly able to cater our request for laundry detergent
Home: very clean and stocked all the needs in the kitchen.
Location: not the best.
1. it was very close to liberty Blvd. lot of homeless people there and buying groceries was very scary.
2. we had to take Uber from home to ferry station(Staten island to Manhattan) 2 times
a day for 5 days. walking ruled out the presence of homeless people.

The place was nice and clean . It was my kid’s first time visiting New York. It was over 2 hrs away in traffic. Every time we went .. we found it was the fast way for us becoming we went to multi places..
We had great time at Daniel place, it was spacious, clean with good appliances. I strongly recommend this place except for old age people as it has good number of steps.

Everything was just as advertised.
Having 3 bathrooms for 6 people was certainly a plus. Kitchen was well stocked, bathrooms were clean. An overall pleasant experience.

What can i say jasmine was very attentive, kind, and has created a magical space for her guests. My stay here was impeccable. Stylish, very clean. Unexpected amenities in the kitchen and bath,like San cks and great toiletries,Every part of the space is super stylish and luxurious. Even more beautiful than the photos! Will absolutely stay here again. The value of this space far exceeds its pricing. Book it!!! She even had milk for my baby 😁 lol

Couldn’t have been better. Jasmin’s place is at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awesome bars and restaurants. Her place is great, very clean and is equipped with everything you need. Jasmin was also very helpful since the beginning, available at all times whenever I had any questions. Totally recommend it.
Everything as advertised, great communication and great location. The small size of the kitchen made working in it difficult, and I wish it was better equipped. Would stay again.

This place is great! The location itsef is a great treasure. Walking distance from major subway lines, served eith buses, next to central park... Perfect. The building is quiet and peaceful, easy to find. The space is exctly what it loooked like on the photos. I'd go back anytime!
This place is nice. The hosts will try and charge you for anything extra you may ask for.
I will definitely stay here again. The place was clean, and in a great location if you’re in for work in the city.
10/10 would definitely recommend this place again! The location is nice and everything was in the apartment was clean! Definitely booking here again!

Location was great and close to the D/B line subway. Lots of restaurants and bars nearby in the lower east side / chinatown / little italy area. The room was quiet despite facing the street, and having laundry location in the same building was a plus. Internet speeds was also fast and I was able to stream without issues.

Vanessa has been more than simply an Airbnb host, she's been welcoming and treated me like a friend. She has always been willing to help and give suggestions and tried her best to make me feel at home. The house itself is spacious and cozy, both for the room and the shared spaces, and is located in a safe and quiet neighbourhood. There are easy and frequent connections to Queens, other parts of Brooklyn, and to Manhattan, and the metro stops are just ten/fifteen minutes on foot from the house. I would definitely recommend this accomodation.

My stay at Vanessa’s was perfect. I stayed at her place for 3.5 months and it was exactly what I needed - a clam space to have a break from the city after busy days.
Easily accessible to Manhattan, has everything you might need and Vanessa was a really great host!

My stay at this place was perfect! It was exactly what I needed. If you travel by yourself it is perfect. Everything was clean, I had everything I needed, and location was just perfect! Check in was easy, Jayden was waiting for me and helped with my bag, he was very nice! Communication was great too! I'm coming back to NY soon, and I would definetely stay here again!

Nomad was an excellent host, quick to respond and very helpful.  This location is excellent.  We were able to walk to all of the attractions we had planned except for Battery Park and the upper west side.  The accommodations met all of our needs.  We would stay again.
Central location, quiet enough for NYC, easy to get to and unassuming entry makes this gem really special i hope to stay here again!

Our room was on a third floor no elevator!
Needed to bring up our bags, baby and stroller which of course was difficult.
The place was clean, well located.

A great place for a few days stay in NYC. Comfortable beds, good shower. There were 3 of us, and we did not find it too crowded, but we also didn’t spend much time in the apartament. Even though it’s in the center, it’s not too loud at all (a little dark, because the windows are facing a wall, but it’s NYC so understandable). Would stay again.
Excellent location close to everything and remarkably quiet in the back of the building. We were prepared for the lack of elevator. Hosts were flexible and communicative.
Clean, comfortable and consistent w pictures. Very quiet but Old apt so AC loud. Smells of cat, esp w cat steps, litter box etc in still in apt. Hope is very responsive.

This is a great apartment in Manhattan midtown. It's quite large for what you might expect in a New York apartment. It's reasonably quiet as well, so you don't need to worry about being up all night due to the noise. The location is also convenient, as you can get to wherever you want to go in a short time.

Convenient location, clean and beautiful apartment. Close to supermarkets and within 10-min walking distance to Empire States Building. Very quiet! Excellent communication with the host, who was also gracious enough to allow us to check in (very) early. Would gladly stay again.

Apartment in perfect location, right between Trader Joe’s and Fairway. Within walking distance to Time Square (25min) and other popular places.
We felt like home 😊
Another great stay at Hope's Apartment. Good facilities and the location is ideal for local amenities and access to the subway. Would highly recommend.
Perfect location , 3 streets away from the subway . Very responsive host , always there to help us out with anything. We had an amazing time will definitely come back anytime we’re visiting nyc
Yvette was really friendly and personable! I was only a 5 minute walk to the trains and very convenient to local coffee shops/stores.
This is an amazing place to stay, rest, and get to every area that you desire within the city. Very quiet, clean and a great value.

We had a great time staying at Jennifer's hotel.
The location is great, lots to do nearby and close to the subway.
The room was quite, clean and spacious. The bed wasn't very comfortable (the mattress is sponge like and extremely soft).
The communication with Jennifer was a bit lacking. While she did let us check in early (thanks!), she responded late (took her more than 48 hours to reply to our request), and we were already in the city after we stored our luggage in some luggage storage.
Would still recommend though! Great value for the price :)

Overall, the stay was great. Clean and as described in the post. Just a few callouts, the host was not very responsive to the communication. I asked if early check in was possible and was never responded. Also, the bed has a layer of foam over the mattress which made it too soft. I felt like I was sinking towards the middle frequently. Other than that the location was convenient, close to station and easy to get around.
Yvette was very friendly, and her home was comfy and clean. She also gave great recommendations for local places to eat. The location is excellent—just steps away from Central Park.

Sara's place is a little oasis in BK. Close to amazing coffee shops and restaurants, close to the train, and a great sized space that was incredibly cozy. Also in the ways of amenities, Sara's kitchen was completely stocked which was fantastic and very comfortable bed with AC and heating. Definitely get the breakfast sandwich from Charter Coffee House down the street!
Our stay at Sara’s was great! The bed is very comfy and it’s in a great location.

Sara's place is absolutely perfect. My husband and I stayed here for close to two weeks and we couldn't have asked for a better place to stay. She's in a great location and the apartment has everything you need to be comfy. We had an issue figuring out the front door on our first night and she was kind enough to quickly come over and help us out - we felt like total idiots but she was so sweet about it. I definitely recommend staying here!

Sara’s apartment is lovely and had everything we needed for our stay in Brooklyn. Great space for both getting some work done and relaxing. Location is surrounded by Williamsburg restaurants, bars, shopping, and more, and about a 10-minute walk from the L which takes you into Manhattan in just minutes. Highly recommended!
Sara’s place was great for my partner and me. The space was light and airy, the bed was comfy, the kitchen was a really good size for NYC. We’d def stay again!

Sara’s place was exactly as advertised, a beautiful appartment in a great, walkable, and shop-filled area of Williamsburg. Being five blocks from the L and three stops away from Manhattan makes the place greatly suited for roaming tourists. Sara was responsive and helpful. Overall 10 out of 10, would definitely stay there again!!
Tip: make sure you stop by Variety Coffee Roasters on your way to the subway stop! ;)

We had a lovely time in Sara’s appartment. Its location made it very convenient to get to Manhattan within half an hour. Sara’s place was very clean and comfortable. Sara was very reactive and helped us with all of our questions☺️ we recommend this place without hesitation!!
Charming apartment that felt like home , close to the Subway and great selection of shops and restaurants close by

Sara’s place is comfortable and in a great location. The subway station is only a short walk away and journey to Manhattan very quick. Sara was easy to communicate with and happy to help with anything we needed.
The flat of Sara was very comfortable, and ideally located a few minutes walk from Graham av on L train. Good place to rest in busy city !

Cozy apartment with very slanted floors which made the beds slanted as well. Fixed it with some books. :) The sofa was smaller than the pictures show, also 2 chairs and most of the plants were missing. A few more cups and plates would have been nice. We liked the area and felt comfortable in the place.
One thing we think should be mentioned for older or not less mobile guests: the stairs leading up to the apartment are very(!) steep. Not everyone might be able to carry their luggage up by themselves.
Great location close to subways and Sara was great to communicate with, and really helpful when we locked ourselves out.
Great for a weekend stay! Small but functional and clean. Perfectly located in the middle of everything!
Unit was as described, loved the location! Close to so much. Will rent again. Small, but all you need for two people in a city where you're rarely in your room.
everything was as listed!! perfect for just needing a place to sleep if you’re not planning on spending a lot of time in the airbnb

Unbeatable location, steps from the river, the theater district, fabulous bars restaurants and coffee shops. You really feel like a local staying here, rather than a tourist. But it's also set back and so remarkably quiet. My unit was very compact, perfect for a few days solo or for a couple that's not *too* tall. I liked having control of the a/c and windows. Would use again for sure.
I love these apartments. They’re like a traditional New York studio apartment and the area is the best.  I do think they’re  overpriced though.
Quick trip easy check in comfy bed and even had Netflix access with a large shower worth the stay and pay.
Great service and comfortable environment, they were fast and very kind. The apartment was close to restaurants and a 7 minute walk to stations. Great find

I had a wonderful stay at this cozy studio in the heart of NYC! The location was perfect - just two blocks away from Times Square, which was a pleasant surprise. Although the space was small, it was perfect for a city break, especially if you don't have a car. The studio was clean and well-maintained, with all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. The host was also very responsive and helpful with any questions I had.

We had a great stay! The host was very communicative and the listing is as pictured. It was located in a shared building with a restaurant, so a bit noisy at times but overall not a big deal. About a 10 min walk to the closest subway station and to Times Square. Would stay here again.
Everything went great, the instructions, the check-in, location is really good! The only thing to improve is the noise at night because of the restaurants
Great stay for a couple days very loud though at moments small but it great location lots to do had luck with finding parking great host

Very great place to stay for a quick visit to New York. We were right next to a bus stop and close to the subways. Also very walkable to Times Square for food and shopping. The noise downstairs started to die down around 1 am each night, but it was something out of our control. Definitely recommend.
Good location, close to the Times Square. A little bit loud in the evening but I guess that cannot be avoided in such busy city.
Loved staying here!! Close to everything and was exactly what we needed, will definitely book again!!

We love the area; room was clean and appeared as described on the website; host was responsive when I had questions.  Note that the room overlooks a courtyard that is the back of a restaurant so if you're sensitive to noise in the early morning hours (2 - 3 am), bring earplugs.  We're not sensitive so we were good.  Definitely recommend it considering the price - I did not see a better deal for something with a kitchenette and a private bath during this time period on Air BnB.
Alex’s place was very nice and she was a great host. Very solid communication and she was very nice to me regarding check out. I would 100% recommend her place and I even plan on staying here again.

The Airbnb smelled really good and it was Very clean and a very convenient and safe place to stay. It is within walking distance to everything, target store, various restaurants, and New York attractions!

Beautiful home! Quick responses as well. I wouldn’t recommend driving a car because of street parking. Very limited street parking and paying to park can get expensive. You can get ticket and booted for not obeying the street signs, so please be careful and think about transportation staying here.

The location was great & walking distance to Times Square the only thing I wish I would’ve known was that the location was behind a hookah lounge, so if your a non smoker it wasn’t pleasant.The room smelled of hookah.
Very professional, prompt responses. Clean space and size was as advertised. Would definitely stay with them again.
great little getaway in a cozy location. could use some extra cleaning but you’ll probably be too busy exploring the city to care!

This was a cute, nicely appointed, apartment that was a good fit for my business trip. It was just enough space and the little kitchen area was nice to have as well. It was easy to walk to a bunch of places, including Central Park, and I enjoyed the stay here overall.

This is a very conveniently located, clean, affordable property whose management is very responsive.
The building is old and the price reflects that. Due to how the wall A/C unit is installed and the old windows, you're going to hear everything outside as though you had windows open the whole time. as a former New Yorker this didn't bother me but it might bother some people.
There were two safety-related issues that were a little baffling to encounter as they're both pretty obvious: the tension rod on the shower is supported by nails driven right into drywall, and so they're predictably very loose and can fall out easily, meaning a tension rod on your foot and nails on the bathroom floor.
The other is that the wall plates over several of the outlets are falling off and need to be replaced.
Those two issues are the only reason I'd knock down the score, both because they're safety-related and because they're just sloppy.
Great location! It's nearby lots of great restaurants in Hell's Kitchen, times square, and Javitts event center. I would recommend!

The unit is a typical tiny NYC place. Clean, quiet and comfortable. It was good for an overnight stay for just me. It is up a narrow staircase, something to keep in mind if you are not a small person or have a lot of bulky luggage.

As a 63 yr old with a cane, the steps did me in, but the height of the steps was not the same.  There should be a light or a reflective number outside the building to locate it more easily. The unit itself was perfect, clean, and exactly as described. The location is terrific and within walking distance of everything. Parking is not available on the street. Yes, it exists, but locals have their spots, and rarely do they move.
We really enjoyed our stay. The place is cozy and everything was exactly as described. The location is absolutely perfect. Anything and everything is within a five minute walk.
Great location. Easy to find and to deal with the hosts! Will recommend to everyone who looks for a place to stay and visit the city.

Space is staged well, but dissapointing and not safe. Lock is clumsy and flimsy. Had city official and their representative in our space without us available. Obvious repairs needed, and dirty.  Zip ties to lock windows, hand prints on ceiling. Rusty, moldy bathroom. Faucet didn’t work well. Stunk horrible. Bed and floor collapsing.

Alex was wonderful and the property was excellent. We loved the neighborhood and proximity to Broadway, Times Square, Central Park as well as great bars and restaurants.  The property was clean, comfortable and spacious. Happily recommend this property for anyone looking for the Midtown area.
Great location which is convenient to go everywhere! Clean room with all the things you need. Very responsive host!

Loved this place. Very private and quiet if you have trouble sleeping. (In my opinion since it’s a back building) host was super responsive and helpful as could be. Appreciate their spot to rest my feet while missing business with pleasure in the city. Thank you

Jeremy was very responsive whenever I had questions or concerns. The apartment is located in the heart of East Village, right above an excellent Korean restaurant, with many others in the immediate vicinity. This apartment is a great place to stay if you’re looking for an authentic NYC experience.

I had a wonderful time at Jeremy's apartment. The location is incredible! East Village is super lively and still retains some of its famous "edge." Lots of cool restaurants and cultural venues. You can't get bored. The apartment itself is small and not as renewed as I expected - bear in mind that this is an old building. That said, Jeremy was always very responsive and helpful. Every time I needed something - e.g., information about the building, an essential utensil that was lacking, assistance with something that seemed off, etc. - he immediately resolved the issue. Best "landlord" I've ever had in NY.

AnnaMarie is an exceptional host, she is available whenever needed and she responds very fast. She was accommodating enough to allow for a late check out, considering i had booked very last minute. The stay itself was unique, fun and comfortable, and in walking distance from restaurants, deli’s, etc. The NYC inspired art pieces displayed around the walls made our stay even more enjoyable. I will definitely be recommending and considering again for the future!

AnnaMarie’s place is as beautiful and comfy as it seems in pictures. She was very accommodating and caring throughout my stay.
Very lovely host and a very lovely space to spend time and make nice memories with close friends and family <3
AnnaMarie is an excellent host, so easy to communicate with! The place is also very nice!
Most communicative host I’ve had! Great location and the AC was doing wonders for us to cool off when we got back.
The platform is very good, it’s very convenient, and Ms AnnaMarie is very nice ,thank you for what you have done for my son!

The stay was truly great. Everything was exactly as pictured, and AnnaMarie went above and beyond to accommodate our every request. The location is convenient, and it is very cozy. Perfect for a couple or small group! Would recommend, for sure.

Great little classic NYC apartment! A great place to stay if you plan to be out adventuring about the city. Plenty of beds space for a group of friends or small family. small but full kitchen and refrigerator. Very stylish and colorful ambiance. Loved it! Thank you AnnaMarie, she is super communicative, welcoming and helpful. Stay here!

Everything is exactly as promoted on AirBnB. Emmory is great! Very helpful and deserves his ratings.
Nice coffee shop downstairs, good Mexican across the street, food store near by etc.
Would definitely stay again.
Thanks
D

Loved our stay at Emmory’s place.  So comfortable, clean and convenient and considerably quieter than other places we’ve stayed in NYC.  Emmory is super responsive and friendly.  She even let us store our luggage for a few hours after checkout and adjusted her own schedule to make it happen.  Thank you Emmory!

Great place to stay! Emmory is super helpful and responsive.
For anyone staying, highly recommend going to Sam Sunny nearby. Its an amazing restaurant that just opened up within walking distance of the airbnb too!

Emmory was very kind and responsive.  The place was clean and in a good location to certain things.  My only grip was that it was very small but knowing how expensive real estate is in  NYC, I understand.  I live in a 4,000 sq ft home in San Diego.

Emmory’s Airbnb was perfect for our stay in New York, situated amongst all of the main attractions whilst still being somewhere quiet and peaceful.
Amazing coffee shop is located just below you, which was such an added bonus for us on our trip.
The Subway and amazing restaurants are only just down the road.
Emmory was so helpful throughout our trip and was so easy to communicate with, we really appreciated it everything she had done for us. Made our stay so easy and comfortable
Thank you again for being an amazing host and would love to stay here again

Just amazing place to stay in NYC. Walking distance anywhere, from Central Park down to Wall Street. Cozy little apartment, quiet bedrooms (just one of the AC units was bit rattling), fully equipped with everything you might need. Loads of opportunities to have breakfast nearby, and delicious restaurants everywhere. For the money, I do not think you could do any better. And the host was so helpful, responding immediatelly and taking care. We did enjoy staying there !
Great stay at Inna’s place. Inna and Di were both extremely responsive and helpful with any issues I had. The outdoor deck was wonderful!

Having stayed in many NY apartments through Airbnb, I must say this one was among the best. Amazing and quiet neighborhood with easy access to transportation. The bed and furniture were very comfortable, and the kitchen had everything I needed to cook at home!  And Giorgio was the best…easy to reach and very willing to make our stay everything we wanted it to be.
We were in Giorgio's place for the month of June. The apartment is incredibly quiet. Also, there is no noise from neighbors. It is clean, convenient, great location, etc.

Great location in the Upper West Side, which is my favorite neighborhood in Manhattan. Safe, lots of great restaurants, cafes and bars, close to Central Park and museums, and quick and easy walk to the Subway.
Georgio is an excellent host. Very communicative and responsive. The apartment was spotless, well stocked, comfortable, and exactly as advertised. Nice extras included a bowl of candy and two chocolate bars, lots of toiletries including toothbrushes and toothpaste, shampoo, soaps and more, and a washer/dryer, dishwasher, and AC. The apartment is quiet with very little street noise. Only small negative is very little natural light, but this is not so uncommon in NY apartments. Overall, an excellent place to stay at a very reasonable price. I would definitely stay again.

Giorgio was a great host and his home was ideal for our needs. We found it to be even more spacious than the photos and were completely comfortable during our stay. Giorgio was quick to respond to our questions and needs and was always friendly and helpful. The location is great being only a few blocks from Central Park and the Hudson River parks and has all the shops you could need only half a block away. It's also close to a few subways that get you just about anywhere in Manhattan quickly.  We thoroughly enjoyed out stay and look forward to staying again.

Ms. Aicha's home is among the best places I have been to in the Airbnb world. I would know because I have been around all over staying at Airbnb spaces.
Ms. Aicha's home is truly my home away from home. When working during the week here in New York City, I can not wait to get back to this beautiful space she had provided. Ms. Aicha has been a most understanding and fun host. I look forward to my future stays here.
Best wishes, --Fred

Honestly I wanna here and never leave ! That’s how amazing my stay was - such a lovely woman , house , neighborhood! Away from the madness of Manhattan yet a stones throw away ! This is my home away from home from now on !
Aicha was a fabulous hostess!  We ran the NYC marathon, she made her space available to us, she drove us to the start.  She was superbly lovely.
Aicha is a wonderful host and has a beautiful home. She goes above and beyond to make sure her guests have a great stay. Would absolutely return!

Aicha went above and beyond to create a welcoming environment. Not only were her communications regarding checking in clear and concise, Aicha often provided tips about local travel, places to eat, and areas of interest to visit. It was like having a local tour guide available at all times.
Aicha's home was spotless and very calm and peaceful. It was great to sleep with the window open for fresh air and to hear crickets and the night wind. What a treat after long days of meetings in Manhattan!
I was in NYC to attend events in Manhattan and the daily trips from Aicha's home in Staten Island to Manhattan were not only super simple, but actually enjoyable!
I highly recommend Aicha as a guest, and her home as a place of quiet and rest. I will definetely stay with Aicha again.

Camille was a superb host! Everything was cute and cozy and we felt right at home. Camille’s family made us feel like welcome to enjoy the house and the backyard and we had a great stay. We will be back!

Very nice place and wonderful hosts. It was a little far away from all that major tourist locations but the train was right down the street and it wasn’t that bad of a ride. There was construction going on while we were there so it was kind of loud in the mornings but nothing that was too crazy.

Very beautiful interior, it was well equipped as well. Only issue is the the front entrance, bathroom, and bedroom entrences are low, so if you’re above 5’6 watch you’re head! But the host does specify this in the listing and had signs that read “watch you’re head” above the entrances which helped! Grocery store is close too. Very cute stay

Victoria is just the best, so kind so helpful so friendly and she made sure everything is going well throughout the entire stay. Everything about the apartment is just perfect, the location the place itself feels like home.
Thank you for everything

Great apartment for longer stays in Manhattan. The location is a bit away from the heart of NYC but has nice views of the Hudson. The host was pretty responsive and communicative throughout the stay when any issues came up
Great location in fidi with a lot of subway lines close by. Beautiful views that you can enjoy all day long, especially at sunset. Decent size place and felt like home for a month.
It has a great view! Location is the best, near subway stations. Quiet and safe neighborhoods. I had a little problem with the heater but Lane help to fix it promptly.

Lane's apartment was perfect for my month-long stay. It was clean, well-equipped with all the essentials (kitchenware, hair dryer, iron etc.), and offered a stunning view. The location is incredibly convenient, with easy access to major subway lines and a nearby Whole Foods. I also appreciated the building's shared laundry facilities and the gym, which was a nice bonus.
The host was cold. No toilet paper or soap. The location is close to the subway but not safe at night. The neighbors were very noisy. I would not go back again but overall the stay was ok.
Kevin was communicative. The place was clean and I appreciated the safety measures taken. The neighborhood has AMAZING food. The Caribbean food is to die for.

Everything was clean and I felt safe. The walk from the 5 train at Church Ave. was easy.  I liked the size of the space. Just right for me. I didn't really use the kitchen other than for to warm up breakfast items. Because I was there to visit my daughter and to see art in NYC, I mainly needed a good place to sleep and this fit the bill. Kevin checked several times to be sure I had what I needed. It was easy to check in and he answered my questions quickly. Very satisfied with this airbnb.
Very clean cool place. Greatly appreciate all the extra touches and how convenient it was to get to the train. Would definitely recommend his place! I will stay here again in the future!

Excellent location, quiet and perfect for relaxing after a busy day in Brooklyn. Spotless and comfy. I really appreciated the filtered water in the kitchen too! Kevin was responsive when the wifi briefly went out. I’d definitely stay here again.

Well-appointed studio apartment in Flatbush. Interesting area with Haitian and Jamaican restaurants. Good transport connections to Manhatten during the week, although check weekend disruptions on the Subway.

Kevin’s place is pristine and so cute! He was super flexible with our check in time (we ended up driving after our flights were cancelled). The bed is super comfy and the bathroom is luxurious as well. It is a bit out of Manhattan obviously but the subway navigation was easy for us and we didn’t mind at all. Kevin is responsive and checked on us several times. A peaceful getaway from the craziness of NYC! Book it!!

First of all, the space is amazing.  Its located in the perfect location for an event, and it looks even better than in the pictures.  Secondly, Karen went above and beyond in helping plan every detail (large and small) for the surprise birthday party I was throwing for my girlfriend.  She took the time to get to know me and more importantly, the birthday girl 's preferences, and she set up everything better than I could have imagined.   The attention to detail was truly impressive and the guests were all blown away.  I'd strongly recommend this space to anyone looking to host an event.

It was a real pleasure to stay at Paul's apartment in Bed Stuy. The apartment is around the corner from fun restaurants - e.g. just steps away from Saraghina - as well as a good grocery store where I was able to get what I needed for my week-long stay. The apartment is within comfortable walking distance of the subway, so my commute to upper west side Manhattan was straightforward. The apartment is spacious and bright with high ceilings, and is stylishly decorated. Paul is a great host. He's a clear communicator, friendly, and responsive. I would happily stay there again.

We had a really good time staying at Paul's place in Bed-Stuy! The apartment is spacious, bright and very comfortable for two people. We spent a week in NYC and chose Brooklyn as a place to stay, because we wanted a quiet neighbourhood which will allows us to chill and unwind after a long day of walking and sightseeing. And Paul's apartment was perfect for that - honestly, by far the best airbnb I've ever stayed in. Thank you!!
Nice place on 2nd floor. Good location in Bed-Stuy. Enjoyed our stay.

We stayed in Paul’s apartment for 3 months and had a wonderful time. Everything was exactly like the pictures plus it has a good desk for working from home. The bed is super comfortable and everything was perfectly clean when we arrived. The neighbourhood was wonderful, with the subway nearby and lots of great restaurants and bars around. Paul was easy to communicate with and let us check in and check out outside of regular hours which was super helpful. Would definitely stay again!

Aristo was very responsive and had wine, chocolate, and message for my birthday when I arrived with my friends, which was super nice! Location is a short walk away from great restaurants and bars. The apartment has such a unique charm and is decorated well.

A few friends and I stayed at Aristo's place and had a great time. We loved the location for all the amazing walkable restaurants and bars and easy access to the subway! Their place is fully stocked with all the essentials & more. It also has so much character with how it is decorated, which we loved! The outdoor space is convenient and the common spaces were great for accommodating working from home!
The place is conveniently located to several subway stops and near many bars/restaurants in Williamsburg. The apartment is crazy spacious plus there is a patio. Our group had a great time.
Airbnb does not match description. Whilst he was nice and they tried to clean the place, it wasn’t worth how much we paid.

Aristotelis is a very nice host. Very quick to answer all your messages / questions. The flat itself is cosy, and the shared outside patio is definitely a plus. The pictures you see on Airbnb are quite accurate and reflect the reality pretty well. It is located next to the subway, which is really convenient. But that's also a thing that you have to keep in mind. The flat is right in front of the subway, which means that you'll hear it in the bedrooms.
Ms Despina is an amazing hostess! She’s so sweet and her space is so clean and roomy. Parking was readily available, at least for me. I would stay at her place anytime.

The location is perfect with lots of great restaurants nearby as well as convenient access to transportation. The fridge is kind of loud and the pipe in the bathroom leaked a lot but other than that it was a great stay!
This is such a cute little place to stay. It was just like the pictures and a great location. Ivanna was a fabulous host. Would absolutely recommend 100%!
This is a great place to stay with everything you need for one person close to lots of shops and restaurants and close to the subway and highway

This home is very spacious, a huge plus in New York. It’s close to the N and W trains, and it was okay walking to and fro even at night. I recommend wearing earbuds to sleep, as the house has three units (one per floor, this unit being at the basement level) and the walls/floors are thin. Overall, we had a good time and Anastasia and her husband were lovely hosts. We also loved the occasional visit from the neighborhood cats.
I had a 4 month stay here for a clinical rotation in Manhattan. This was the perfect place: easy commute and fun things to do in the area. Anastasia was an excellent hostess.

I stayed here when I just arrived in NYC and until I signed a lease for an apartment. It was great! Amazing location, very cute and homey neighborhood, friendly and responsive hosts. I would definitely recommend it to someone in my shoes!
They place was very clean and nice 👌 and Mosey was very helpful very nice person.
Very comfortable space and very clean. Looks exactly like the pictures and very modern looking. We enjoyed our stay 10/10
Thank you so much! The place was cute and clean and there was wonderful communication from the hosts! I would stay here again!

Ernie was super attentive with us the entire stay. Everything was clean and done as shown in the picture. The communication was great, and they made sure that if we needed something to tell them periodically throughout the day. There was a cute little thank you note during the stay, and best of all we were always able to find parking. When we go back to NY, we will definitely be booking with them again.

Rudy and Ernie’s place was great! It was super clean and had everything we needed. Check in and out was very simple. Rudy and Ernie were there for us if we had any questions/concerns. Thanks for having us!
They were great host! The place was awesome, and they even showed us how to get us into Times Square via the bus &train. 100% recommend!!

Great stay, tight, cozy. Very surprised how clean it was. Summer time here and there was a really well cool AC, that was greatly appreciated. Snacks/Water were provided which was great. Would recommend, street parking was quite easy to find. In the beginning, didn't feel the neighborhood felt safe, but eventually eased into it. Place is close to the Jamaica LIIR and 23-30 minutes to Flushing, Queens. Would recommend!
Very clean, a good size/space and I would book again as well as recommended it to others.

Five stars all around. I have no complaints and would highly recommend Rudy and Ernie's to anyone coming to NY.
You will definitely not be disappointed.
Everything was perfect and clean, they even left a thank you card with little snacks on the table for us, much appreciated. Would stay again in the future!
Rudy is an amazing host, I’ve had multiple stays and I’m never disappointed. It’s always a great experience and a wonderful stay!
Extremely convenient location. I was able to check in early. Very clean and cute place. Very nice people. Thank you!!!

Our stay was very pleasant, and Ruby was so sweet and very responsive! The space looked exactly like the pictures and was very comfortable and nice! The upstairs neighbors can be pretty noisy throughout the entire stay though!
Rudy's place is as advertised.  I had a very pleasant stay. I would definitely stay again.
great space, reminded me of my Brooklyn roots. very clean, bed was super comfortable... would stay again

This stay is exactly what Airbnb envisioned when they started this company. First off, the room is huge. The bed takes up a small portion of the space, and there's a desk, two person table to eat at, dresser and a few other pieces of furniture in it and there's still tons of room to move around. The owners also really took the time to add little details to make your stay more enjoyable. If you book this place, you will not regret it. It's the best place I've stayed so far around NYC.
Great stay! Location was super convenient, room was comfortable and had everything needed for my stay. Check in and out process was super easy. Would definitely recommend booking here.
Renae’s place is very comfortable, cute and in a great location. Everything was as described on the Airbnb site and Renae was a good and timely communicator. Highly recommended.

This was very nice. Renae kindly allowed me to check in a bit early to drop off my bags from the airport. The location is superb, bordering Prospect Park and near a subway station. The rooms was nice.
The kitchen had a sign saying "this is not a shared space", which was a little confusing, I didn't know to what degree I could use the sink to wash dishes, or if I could boil water for tea. Otherwise a great stay.

We needed a place for the night after a wedding in town and it was perfect! Clean, quiet and private. This was my first time using a shared place and we didnt know anyone else was even there but Renae was quick to correspond when needed. It was quiet enough that I overslept the small window I left to explore the park the next morning. Next time!!

Renae's place was very clean and centrally located, we enjoyed the easy access to the subway and nearby Prospect Park. Renae was very responsive to our questions/concerns, and I would certainly stay with her/in her unit again on a future trip to Brooklyn!

Nice historic building very close to subway entrance, an incredible grocery store, and prospect park. Clean room, sheets and towels with a coffee maker right in the room.
We will definitely come back when we come to NYC again.
Great place to stay. Had lived in nyc for 10yrs and highly recommend this apartment. Thank you for hosting me!

The apartment is exactly what it looks like on the pictures and is located at a very convenient location :  with the subway around the corner and the Prospect Park across the street. The AC and fan in the room helped a lot throughout the heatwave) All in all, I was a very nice stay , would defo recommend)

Overall nice stay, clean room and bathroom, close to the park and subway station. I didn’t run into any other guests so it felt like I had the place to myself which was great. Be prepared to spend a really long time trying to open the glitchy lockbox out front. Quiet outside, however something in the room was making a random loud banging noise throughout the night so maybe bring earplugs. Would recommend though!

It was a smooth check-in, the bathroom was extremely clean and my room was professionally appointed with a host of amenities. This was my first experience in a shared rental situation and it exceeded my expectations.
Great stay! Loved the location. Was a great spot for a quick weekend getaway. Great communication and very friendly!

This apartment was perfect! Finding a 3 bedroom for such a great price in Brooklyn is so rare. The apartment was clean, beautiful and it just such a pleasant place to be. There were even some games for the kids to play. It is right across the street from a great park for the kids as well as the the Brooklyn Children's Museum. 1 block away from the shops on Kingston Ave. A 5 minute walk to the subway. It really is an amazing location. We were so happy and comfortable staying here!
The location was extremely comfortable and clean. My guest and I actually attempted to rebook for the following weekend of our stay.

The apartment was great. Subway only a few blocks away. Apartment was clean and beds were comfortable. It was perfect for our family of 5 to have a vacation with lout being crammed into a small room. I would definitely recommend.

Wonderful place to stay when parking is needed. Close to metro, safe and clean neighborhood. Apartment is tidy and cozy exactly as in the pictures. It has everything that is required for a pleasant stay. Highly recommended!!
Good apartment perfect for group visits. The whole place was equipped with anything we would need during our stay. Check in and out was as smooth as possible, would definitely stay here again!
Great place, identical to photos and well equipped. Very friendly and responsive host  who made stay very smooth. Would definitely recommend for anyone coming to the city

Morais's home was nice and very comfy. We felt at home. Morais called about halfway through our trip to check on us and see if we needed fresh towels or anything. Much appreiated.  Location was great and not far from the subway. Would definitely go back again on a future trip.

Overall this was a great place to stay, easy walking distance to public transportation, fairly well stocked with anything you needed. The bathroom was very small and the faucets weren't installed very well, but all very functional. There are only 2 mirrors, bathroom and in one of the bedrooms. It's a 3rd story walk up so getting bags up and the downstairs was not easy. We loved the location and enjoyed the neighborhood.
Make sure you have streaming services that you can log into if you want to watch TV. there are no window coverings in the living room but didn't feel exposed.
If you are a planning a trip to NY and don't wish to stay in Manhattan, this would be a great option.

We had a really good stay, it was a great apartment to come back to in the evening as we spent the days on Manhattan. The beds were comfortable and the space was good for 5.
Far more cost effective than staying on Manhattan and actually quite nice to be away and travel in every day.
There is big supermarket nearby and enough equipment in the kitchen so we could cook a snack etc when needed.
Definitely recommend!

Great place to say when visiting NYC. One issue is that the airbnb ad indicates there are two queen beds and two double beds. After arriving at the airbnb it was clear there are two double beds and two twins.

This was a great place to stay for the holidays! Morias’s was very responsive to my questions and gave us a flawless checkin! The 3 bedroom apartment had a spacious living room and kitchen area which was perfect for me! The location is also walking distance to the 3 train and my family and friend’s houses in Brooklyn, which was convenient when it came to visiting them!
Nathan is amazing , he is very responsive. We stayed for 6 months and had no problems. The house is equipped for a very comfortable stay.

Thanks for a nice stay. Jeremy was very responsive to any questions before/during my trip. The place itself is a little small but has a closet and a relatively large bathroom. The radiator was louder than expected. The stove/oven weren't very clean so I avoided cooking. Lots of nice places to eat nearby, it's a great location.

Jeremy was such a great host. Super responsive. Helped get some extra household supplies super quickly. The desk setup with a huge curved monitor was really great for working from home. The area is filled with amazing food and spots to go out. The apartment is small but mighty! Has everything you would need.

This Airbnb was exactly as advertised, a very clean and comfortable space which was a great place to unwind at the end of the day.  Check-in was easy and Andrew was very nice and communicative! The building is by the freeway so there is some noise, however the guest room faces away from the freeway so overall not too bad. The location was near several subway stops and it was super easy to go into Manhattan.

Super clean space. Very convenient location close to the subway, plus plenty of restaurants and bars around. Andrew was very easy to communicate with and the check-in process couldn’t have gone smoother. :)

Great stay! Would 100% come back. Andrew was lovely and was barely in the apartment anyways, so we often felt like it was a private stay.
Great location as well. Just a quick walk to the subway to get into Manhattan.
Private bathroom is a huge plus too.
Highly recommend!

Went to Brooklyn for a little weekend getaway, and was so glad to have stayed at Andrew’s. He was so personable and really helpful with recommendations for local eateries and activities. Would definitely stay again. Tutti is the sweetest little dog.
Andrew's place was absolutely wonderful—so peaceful and with such an amazing aroma! I'm already looking forward to returning.

The location of this Airbnb is fantastic- right by the trains and by many shops. The check-in process was easy. You will also have a nice, large private room. A drawback: you will not have access to the kitchen or a fridge, so no bringing home leftovers. There is a water filter accessible to guests, though. I was also requested to leave my room at 8am during my check-out, even though I thought check-out was supposed to be at 10am. I would have appreciated staying a longer time before check-out.
Jong was the host who let us in and checked us out, we never met Lisa. But Jong was very helpful and quickly responded to help us find the place, let us in, and help us feel at home.

Joseph's place was a Great stay the neighborhood is very nice. Joseph's home was very clean and comfortable. Joseph always communicated quickly and has a very pleasant family. I would definitely stay there again!

Our stay was great! We were a party of 3 and we fit comfortably in the space. Sheets were clean and their were plenty of amenities such as towels, soaps, and even a bit of food to hold you off until you got your own. We felt safe and secure in the space and the neighborhood as well. Our only critique is location (which the host isn't really responsible for), it takes roughly 45 min to 1 hour or more to get to Manhattan.

Joseph and his wife where very communicative; They accepted us earlier since we had the kids with us for the trip. We definitely recommend this home to anyone. We didn't mind taking Uber or walking to the subway station. we loved our stay.

Let's just say I didn't want to leave. I felt right at home, so comfortable and at peace. Very clean and cozy, and I will definitely go back. Mr Joseph is a wonderful caring host, you are in good hands.

Joseph was very nice and accommodating. he made sure my girlfriend, my brother and I were all aware of what to use and how to use things. he provided a list of contacts in case we needed to reach him. it was very clean and quiet. I will definitely be coming back again

I loved this place! It was a great price and what you see in the photos is very accurate. It’s a great location as the deli and a Haitian restaurant is on the same street and bus stop only a few minutes away. It’s just a hassle to get into the city from Brooklyn, that’s to be expected though. Great value and privacy.

Joseph and his wife were so nice and very responsive if we ever needed anything. Space looks just like the pictures! Very clean and great for a short stay. Very Close to a bus station but about 25-30 minute bus ride away from the nearest subway station.

It was a pleasure staying at Joseph’s place. He and is wife were lovely host. They are also very thoughtful with the treats they had for us in the cupboards when we got there. Thank you again. Will definitely return.

Excellent place to stay which was close to major bus routes. Walking distance to King's Plaza. Place was clean and very spacious with all the amenities. Joseph was an excellent host checking in on us often. We rented a car and for 5 days he let us use his driveway when street parking was an issue. 5 stars and I will definitely  stay here again when in NY.
I enjoyed staying at this airbnb the location to transportation and shopping was very convenient for me and the host is very nice and communication is always on point. I will recommend this airbnb.
Joseph was great. Very helpful, good communication. We stayed 4 nights, and didn't have any issues. Very quiet and comfortable.

Me and 2 friends had a great stay at Joseph's! How to check in was a tad unclear but when we arrived Joseph was on-site finishing preparations. He was very kind, helpful and pleasant. The location is unfortunately a bit far from the metro, but its so inexpensive that we had plenty of money leftover to get a taxi back when needed. Great place to crash while spending a weekend in NY.

This air bnb is a lovely studio with plenty of space in a continent location with great amenities - but the best bit is the host! Tugba was excellent and communicating and planning my stay, she went above and beyond to make sure I had everything that I needed and to make me feel welcome in a new city. She was very considerate and made my stay a success. I highly recommend this stay - and a visit to NYC!

Amazing place! Host is very helpful with literally all aspects of the stay. The commute to the city is very easy from here as well. Great stay. Place is exactly what it looks like in the pictures if not better. Very clean and nice smelling.
Highly recommend staying here.
Naressa and David were great host! The unit was beautiful and looked exactly as it is pictured in the listing.

Naressa was a great host! Very great communication and the house is amazing. The neighbor is fairly quiet and easily accessible to train stations. The home was very clean and the decor was AMAZING! The only downfall is parking. There isn’t much parking available given majority of the residents keep their vehicles parked throughout the day so I wouldn’t recommend driving in because there is a high chance of getting a parking ticket. Other than that, our stay was great and we would definitely stay there again during future visits!

This is the perfect home for a big or medium size group.
Close to grocery stores and a 5 minute walk to Subway.
The hosts were very responsive and accommodating and really made it feel like home!
Already planning my next trip back to NY and will definitely book here again!
This was a very nice Airbnb. The hosts were super accommodating  when it came to the things we needed. They were helpful and kind and didn’t bother us at all. Overall it was a great experience.

Naressa and her husband were absolutely AMAZING!!! They helped us so many times with the lock and made sure we were comfortable. The house was very clean and looked even better than the photos. My group of 8 had a great time there. We will definitely come back!!!

Naressa and David were awesome hosts. very prompt . when we told we would be parking our rental van but had to leave in late night change vehicle, Naressa called us in the night and reminded us voluntarily that we could park the van . Really apprecite that.

Awesome host, accommodations were exactly what we wanted. It was clean and hostess was amazing in getting what we needed. Was helpful with information and very pleasant. 5 star quality all the way.

Feels like home! My husband, our 8 month old baby, and our large dog stayed in this wonderful apartment for the month of December. We settled in quickly and the apartment had everything we needed. Gordon's apartment was gorgeous -- super tall ceilings and full of light. The photos don't do it justice. Gordon’s place exceeded our expectations, and we would’ve happily stayed longer if it hadn’t already been booked. Highly recommend!

Andrew’s place is very clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything you need for a short or long-term stay. A very simple apartment. Perfect for a small family or a couple friends. I thought it was better both quality and space wise than the pictures seemed to indicate.

Andrew's place was well taken care of and very clean. The bed was comfortable, and the closet and bathroom storage spacious for New York! We were very happy with our stay there, and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it for others.

Andrew’s place is in a great location - minutes away from bars, restaurants, and the C train going into Manhattan. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Andrew’s!
This was a perfect stay for my group & I. Any questions I had, they were answered right away. 10/10 would recommend
Jasvir let us check in early! We also appreciated the bottled waters provided, the large bathroom, and the firm beds.

Great place, the host is very communicative, flexible and willing to provide information when required. The place is clean, spacious and comfortable. Very near from several restaurants and cafeterias. You can connect very easily to subway and public transportation.
Very nice place to stay. Jasvir was available whenever needed. Nice clean house with all basic requirements. Will highly recommend this place to stay.

Host tried to claim we smoked inside and created a bug problem when there were roaches upon check in. Also nothing was smoked inside I remember clearly having a conversation with the hosts son thanking us for not doing so and following the rules when they saw us walking outside

Best host award of the year! I have stayed at many Airbnb’s but nothing compared to this one. Jasvir and her family are super friendly, responsible, and thoughtful. Clean and private rooms! Amazing AirBnB experience! Extremely clean, exactly as described. I stayed here for 30 days and did not have a single problem the entire stay. I would highly recommend!

great location it's very near to 2/3 number subway within 20 minutes you are in downtown

Very good location, close to subway and bus stops, good delis nearby, quiet street. Studio is actually better than pictures, with basic and effective appliances . Express subway lines took us to major NYC atractions in 10-20 minutes. We had a nice stay there
Wat a great stay! It was sooo close to the subway. We felt completely comfortable walking in the neighborhood. Book this place. You will not be disappointed.
The stay at Patrica's apartment was pleasant, the subway station and shops are very close. It is definitely a good option to stay and visit New York ☺️ I would stay there again
The apartment delivered everything in the description.  It is very close the 2/3 subway and close to the B/D lines which made it easy to get everywhere in the city.
This is my second time staying at Patricia’s and I loved it. Home away from home. Will definitely book again. 😌
We had a great stay at George's place. The apartment is clean, modern, spacious, and very well equipped. The location is amazing. George is very communicative and helpful. Highly recommended!
Clean room, well renovated. I enjoyed being able to sit downstairs and have a drink or two and literally walk upstairs.
Rogers Pub & Hotel is a great little spot on B116th. Perfect for weekend guests. Clean, quiet and a block from the beach. Exactly what we were looking for!
Angela was a wonderful host! Even when we needed het at like 10pm she was quick to reply and problem solve. Room was as pictured, 10/10

Owner made me feel very welcomed
Very clean
Highly recommended

Alex's place is beautiful, spotless and better equipped than my own home. He was helpful throughout even though we managed to lock ourselves out once.

We stayed at Alex's for 10 nights and all I can say that it was a home away from home. The apartment is beautiful, pictures can't do it justice, and it has been very thoughtfully designed. It was a very good choice, easy to move around in the city and with lots of options on restaurants shopping super markets. Also the building ammenities were very helpful
Stavros was a great host and we were very pleased with the apartment during our entire stay. Would absolutely recommend this rental to anyone looking for a spot in the city.
Stavro was very nice. The place is in a good location and had everything you need.

This home was beautiful! So spacious and welcoming. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. And couldn’t have asked for a more perfection location- so easy to commute to and from all over the city. I definitely hope to stay here again on my next visit.

Clean, roomy and close to subway station.
Ann-Deal was responsive and lovely to interact with.

This apartment is fantastic. It's private, safe and cozy, and really spacious for NYC. We only stayed one night, but it would be really comfortable to stay for a longer stretch. The bathroom had shampoo/conditioner and the kitchen had a coffee maker. Definitely recommend this place!
Had a great experience staying at Ann’s home. It was very cozy and had everything I needed. The street was easily accessible and I felt safe walking to and the from the hospital.

Very kind host. Nice interior space.
Construction and loud road outside but otherwise, nice.

Ann is very responsive & very helpful.  She provided clear photos of the entrance with the lock box.  The description of the place is 'garden level' which I didn't understand. Everything we needed was available.  Beds are very comfortable. This was a work-related trip, so I easily & comfortably walked to Columbia Hospital in 10 minutes.  Broadway has a lot of convenient groceries & small eateries.  It was all perfect!
Ann was very responsive. The place was nice and clean. I was looking for a place close to my son during our visit and she delivered! I will definitely stay again!

Ann’s place was exactly as described, and it provided us with the perfect home to return to after a long day of exploring New York City. Given such convenience and comfort, I would certainly choose to stay at Ann’s place again during any future trips to the city.

A gem! Will stay here again. The pictures don’t do it justice. For a family of five gathering to see two others, it was perfect. And the back private patio is huge, a nice place to relax with a cup of coffee or a glass of wine.

We had a great stay in Ann's lovely 2-bedroom condo. The unit is very clean and gets natural light. All the appliances are new and the unit is professionally cleaned. Easy walk to the A/C trains and easy to pick up CitiBike as well. We appreciated the air conditioning and private backyard as well.
We had a great experience staying at Ann’s place. It was enough space for all three of us. We enjoyed exploring the neighborhood and would definitely stay again. Grateful we found Ann’s listing.

This was a wonderful location and host for a NeW York weekend get away! It is right on the subway line that drops at time square and theatre district. Perfect for traveling friends or a family! Thanks!

This place was amazing! Honestly I think the beds might have been "too comfy" because I didn't want to get out! We loved the area and it was easy to get into city once you figure out subways. Our family had a wonderful stay at Ann’s place. Subway is very close and makes getting around very easy. Ann was very accomodating with our early arrival too which we appreciated. House was wonderfully equipped and very comfortable. Thank you so much!

Ann was super responsive!

Great place in Washington Heights! This was very convenient location for us because we had a lot of activities in both midtown and also on the Jersey side. Quick walk to for groceries, pizza or a coffee.
Very clean, we had everything we needed. The outdoor patio was a huge plus for us.
Host with quick responses and great recommendations. Would be happy to stay again
This was the best Airbnb experience I have ever had. I would strongly recommend Jillian to anyone considering a place in Manhattan.

Best BnB I've stayed at in New York. It's clean, newly renovated, there's a lot of space, stylish furniture, very safe, quiet street... I would stay here again. Definitely.

Jillian is very receptive and responsive. Very happy the unit was quiet. The sleeping area is easily blacked out with the curtains and doors. There was an extra duvet in the closet for the blanket hogs. :)
Nice place and safe area . Maybe it doesn't look like... but it is safe:) Shoops, food, metro station, everything is in a very short distance to  apartment. Real Harlem, real NY.

Mark and Kate were incredibly responsive and helpful. I have a highly active 4 year old so the stairs and access to outside is perfect.

We were very comfortable and had a great time! We are moving to the neighborhood and needed and spot to land so this house will be perfect when I have family come to visit.
Thank you again! - elfe x gio

I loved everything about the house…I actually played in the same park across the street in the 80’s and early 90’s….Stay in the residence more than sight seeing…Would’nt change a thing, the only problem I had was that my vacation was’nt longer…

This is a find.  Excellent location for walking and access to subways; excellent shower, bed, kitchen and sweet backyard for hanging out. There is a large grocery store a five minute walk away and a park across the street.  Kate was very responsive and pleasant to interact with.

Great place to stay! Easy walk to the subway when wanting to go into the city, and a spacious and peaceful place to stay. This was the perfect stay for us. We enjoyed how close it was to our family and friends and the little Caribbean parts of Brooklyn we love. The house was spacious and provided everything we needed to celebrate our special day. Kate was flexible and accommodating. Would highly recommend.

A great stay, a bit tight for 4 persons but 3 worked great. We had some problems with the water at times but Nina was very quick to help us and reimbursed us for those nights. Really good location!
Overall we are very happy!
The place is exactly as pictured and so close to the subway. It is perfectly convenient and I would certainly book again in the future!

excellent location 3 minutes from the metro. After it takes 40 minutes to Times Square, not so long. the neighborhood is nice with shops and no security concerns. the apartment is large and very correct. thank you, it was one of the best airbnb experiences in New York.
We were very comfortable at Badal’s place. The garden is amazing but little wild. We had a good sleep during night and we took a great rest after our day trips to Manhattan.

This flat was very nice and spacious (notably the room). We appreciated the quality of the beds. We got all necessary equipments, and it was very easy to arrive/leave and to communicate with the host.

We recommend this flat
Great stay. As soon as I walked in the owner of the hotel greeted me, had a nice chat, super awesome guy. The hotel itself is beautiful, convenient, right in LES. Room was great, bed was super comfy.

Beatrice is a great host with good vibes. Street parking is pretty good for NYC and the location was convenient for our trip. One of the best perks is being able to hear the birds in the sunny backyard : )

This stay could not have been more perfect for our first time to NYC! We were able to meet her early on our check in day and really appreciate that she is so close for questions or suggestions! We would stay here again in the future! Thank you for a wonderful trip!

Wonderful stay! The place was very spacious and thoughtfully set up. The outdoor Zen garden was beautiful and such a nice retreat at the end of the day. We highly recommend staying there!

This is an incredible airbnb in every way.  The location is convenient to getting wherever you need to go.  The block is quiet at night.  And the apartment is beautifully decorated with plenty of space.  I really enjoyed my stay and will be back.

Beatrice appartment is really confortable, ideally located in Harlem at garden floor. The back garden permited us to have a really quiet place (we even saw squirrels!). Furthermore, Beatrice was nice, avaiable and giving good tips about what to do in the city.  I recommend it without hesitation! Thank you for everything Beatrice!

We had an amazing time at Beatrice’place. It was perfect for 4 adults, lovely decoration and garden, so much space and well equipped. The kitchen had everything to cook, and we had towels and everything we need to stay a week.

The appartement is in a very typical street in Harlem, like in the movies. The street was very quiet.

Thank you Beatrice we really enjoyed our trip :)

I spent a week in NYC with my family. The apartment of Beatrice is very large, fully equipped and confortable. She checked in personally and we had a continuous dialogue with her during the journey. Thanks to Beatrice for all the support, for sure we will come back to you the next time.....
Nice place, I lived here two months it was very convenient for work., close to trains, and good coffee shops and places to eat. The plumbing is a little old, and the kitchen amenities are okay.

Again Nancy, thank you for an enjoyable, relaxing Stay!!

Great location!  Very clean and just what we needed for my daughters and myself for a girls weekend getaway.  He was always very quick to respond!  Would stay here again!
Exactly as described.. Liked having a walk-in closet . Perfect for our group of Mom and 2 daughters. Close the Madison Gardens and Macey’s! Desk reception helped arrange airport transportation.

Great location. You have everything you need and you can sleep up to 6 people comfortable what makes it better option for my family of 5 than a regular hotel. Unbelievable location that is convenient and walkable to all of midtown Manhattan!

Great location on a quiet street. Plenty of space. Lots of excellent restaurants nearby. The subway to Manhattan is just a few blocks away. We enjoyed our stay.

Great host and super easy to work with.  I book travel for a lot of my colleagues and he makes it super easy, even when in a different state.  Place was clean and has a pretty private patio.  Easy distance from a lot of attractions and metro.

Great area too.

We had a great experience at this place and it was an easy location with street parking and tons of restaurant options. Felt right at home the entire time!

Great location and HUGE space. J was very communicative and accommodating - he checked in before the stay to make sure we'd be able to find the location and during the stay to make sure everything was running smoothly. Highly recommend!

I stayed for a month and really felt at home. Jamaal is incredibly kind and went above and beyond to make me feel welcome and comfortable. The location is also amazing! Franklin Ave is such a vibe. 10/10 would stay again!

Host, he really kind and reply my chat so fast and constantly. Excellent Accomodation at the National!

Very clean and welcoming place. Simmone is incredibly flexible and responsive. Would definitely consider staying again.

great comfy place some stairs on the outside u need to climb that aren't mentioned otherwise not bad at all

Everything was just perfect. Next time pls leave a piece of paper with wifi password : ) We enjoyed our stay and daily staten island ferry trip to nyc.

Really enjoyed my stay, was such a cute quaint spot everything was very clean. Would recommend!! 10/10

It was really nice. Communication from the start was great and my mother is not too good with technology but erika explanations was straight forward. We had a great time and we will be back here if we came back to NY.

the place was so cozy and nice. we both have backs that are picky about mattresses, and the bed here was super comfortable and we never had soreness or aches. the kitchen had all the supplies we needed for cooking things like pancakes and lasagna. the bathroom was super clean and comfortable and had lots of space to store our bathroom items. it was also easy to keep the place clean during our stay with supplies available in the closet and cabinets.
erika was super welcoming and helpful! we stayed a month and had a perfect time.

Situated in an amazing location, this spacious studio was the perfect location for me to base my NYC adventure. There were a bunch of great nearby restaurants, and it was an amazing place to come back to after exploring the city.

The stay at Kyle’s place was great! He was very helpful all the time and the place is exactly as described, perfect to spend a bunch of days in the city! The area has a lot of restaurants and places and very close to main truistic locations and subway lines.

Enjoyed our stay at Kyle’s. The one minor issue we had with the air mattress was taken care of very quickly by Kyle. Everything else was just as we expected based on the ad. Kyle was very responsive and helpful.
Great place to stay at!  Very clean, cozy spacious and only 25-30 min away from Time Square, would definitely recommend this Airbnb for your trip :)

Great space in a quiet Brooklyn residential area. The host was super awesome to communicate with with prompt replies to any questions I had. The apartment itself was big, clean, and well-stocked with welcome items and snacks. Couldn't have asked for a better stay in NYC!

Very spacious house in a great location - loads of room both inside and out, and lots of nice touches in the house. Couldn't recommend enough!
Roxanne was extremely accommodating and let us check in a bit early. The home was extremely cute and clean, and there was plenty of street parking.

We had a fantastic experience at Roxanne's place! There were 6 adults and a baby staying there and we had more than enough room to be together when we wanted and to spread out and have down time when we wanted. The kitchen is stocked with absolutely everything you could ever want. The appliances look brand new. It was a delight to cook there. The welcome basket with goodies was so appreciated. Roxanne was quick to respond to any questions we had and was super flexible in allowing us to check in a bit early. We really appreciated that.
I can't really say enough about what a gem of a place this is. Do not hesitate to book it. Staying here will make your trip to Brooklyn unforgettable!

8 adults stayed 8 days in this wonderfull duplex and we felt at home from the very beginning. Easy check in and out for all every day,  because of the keycode. We are very thankfull to Roxanne that we were able to store our luggage in the duplex until late afternoon on check out date. Roxanne was very helpfull and very quick to respond. We highly recommend this wonderfull duplex.
Roxanne was very friendly and responsive. She was accommodating to our group, which was very helpful. The place was very clean and we felt very safe! We had a wonderful time visiting!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Roxanne’s  place. The pictures are accurate. We felt right at home and Roxanne added thoughtful welcome amenities. There is an excellent grocery store near by and some great places to eat on Tompkins Ave. we loved our stay at Roxanne’s and look forward to staying at her place the next time we are in NYC.
Roxanne was so responsive to any questions. We had ZERO problems! Loved having private back yard for relaxing after wedding festivities! Would use again

Spacious well appointed duplex with four comfortable beds, a kitchen ready to use, and two full bathrooms. Lots of games/pool table/outdoor patio for those who want to spend time in the unit. Close to the G line, buses, and citibikes to get around in the city.
Excellent experience! The duplex was clean our host was attentive. Super convenient location and easy to get around NYC. My friends and I couldn’t be happier!
Great place to stay, hostess was easy to get a hold of. This place is very clean and comfortable.
Annie was so sweet and was there whenever we needed her. Her and her husband helped us so much and made us feel so safe

My friend and I came to Brooklyn for one night to see a play. Annie's place was perfect for us. It was very clean and had a nice, cool back patio. For the price, it was amazing! Annie was very helpful and kind to us. My friend wanted to add that the bed was comfy and bathroom was neat. Thank you Annie, we will be staying there again if we come to Brooklyn again. 5 stars!
My second stay, and once again it didn't disappoint. Clean, great location, and Annie is very pleasurable. Will be my home away from home whenever Im in NYC.

Annie was a great host. She was quick to respond and very kind. The apartment was very clean and well-kept. The subway was less than 10 min walk away and near a lot of great restaurants in Brooklyn. Great location!
Roshan’s place is clean and well equipped. Great location, next to Macy, JCpenny and Target. Roshan is very friendly too and always helpful. High recommended

What a nice place! Very clean and welcoming. Wendy was also very responsive and answered all of my questions. You won't go wrong with staying here.

The apartment felt like home. Wendy is the best host. She was informative. We wanted to see the city but note you may want to do subway to travel to the city. Subway is a 15 minute drive. Wendy’s apartment was absolutely lovely, very warm, cosy and has everything you you’d need.

Will definitely be visiting NY again and will be checking in at Wendy’s!

Lovey it, Loved it Loved  it! You won’t be disappointed with this Airbnb! Beautiful, clean and cozy. Felt like home ☺️ Wendy was great at communicating and following up on things! Overall an amazing experience 😊

Our stay at Hugh’s / Wendy’s was terrific! Very beautiful, clean and spacious appartment in a very nice neighberhood… a place to very much go back again next time, also because of the very friendly host Wendy!

Wendy is an excellent host. This is a beautiful 2 bed 1 bath home that is beautifully decorated and renovated. It’s quiet and in a very nice neighborhood. We will look for this one again when we come back to New York.

Great place to experience Brooklyn. Walking distance to supermarkets, easy to check in and quiet neighborhood. Uber found it right away. TVs in every room. Plus we left clothes behind and Wendy was kind enough to send them back to us. Highly recommend!

I absolutely enjoyed my stay at Wendy’s airbnb! In fact, I kept referring to the apartment as “home” because it felt exactly like that.
