I will most definitely be sharing this Airbnb within my network!

Wendy's place is nothing short of extraordinary! The unit is elegantly, tastefully, and beautifully decorated, surpassing all my expectations. Despite my initial concern about street noise from the bedroom, I needn't have worried—I slept like a baby.
Wendy's place will be my go-to for all my future visits to Brooklyn. If her unit is unavailable, I'll adjust my plans to ensure I can stay there. Wendy is a fantastic host—responsive, intuitive, and incredibly supportive.
We had a great stay.  The set up is excellent.  One of the best ABNB we have stayed in

Thank you, Luis, for making our Brooklyn adventure a memorable trip!!!
This place is perfect for a group! Great location, close to lots of restaurants and bars and the subway as well. Cannot recommend it enough!

Luis Is an amazing person, first of all the property Is perfect, we were 7 people. The space Is clean, the neighborhood Is very calm. We had a great stay!  Doormen at the building were so nice. Very easy to get to public transit. Lots of grocery stores, coffee shops and restaurants. Very comfortable place and the bed was great. Thank you so much!

My sister and I shared this place to visit family in NYC. It was the perfect place to land! Very clean and welcoming. The property was very clean and exactly as described.
An enjoyable stay.

It’s a great apartment, we loved it! It was clean, spacious and had everything we needed. Daylian is a wonderful host, VERY helpful and responsive. It’s not a long walk from the subway station. It’s the last station of L line, and the whole Canarsie area is in quite a distance from Manhattan, but you can easily get there in 50-55 minutes, and the L line is very convenient. Highly recommended!
The airbnb was very nice and clean. Felt very comfortable in the area, train station was about a 10 minutes walk and there were also lil convenient stores and places to eat in walking distance.
This place was excellent. We were expecting to get nothing more than a sleeping room, but it was much more than that. Excellent value for money.
5 Stars! ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ Well deserved.
Talibs place was amazing and awesome experience!! Walking distance to dozens of great places to eat! Right by subway station!
Excellent appartment and great host. Only thing is perhaps parking: I personnaly parked the car in a pay parking for the week and used the subway🙂

The place looks according to the pictures. It is comfortable for a family of four. Each detail is well done. The neighborhood has everything you need. Thank you so much, Jinfa and Steven. I recommend 100%.
Very cute place, close to many city attractions, and it is located at a safe area. Was a little hot at night.

This studio apartment is spacious and well appointed. It had everything we needed, and was very clean and neat. The shower had good water pressure. The bed has a marvelous foam topper, and the sheets are very nice and comfortable. The apartment is on the 3rd floor and faces the back of the building, so there is minimal street noise. The neighborhood is very well located with many restaurants, markets, and public transportation within an easy walk. I look forward to staying here again.

This is a good place to stay for a visit to NYC. The location is excellent for quickly getting to the subway, which will take you anywhere. The apartment was clean but could use a few minor upgrades. For example, the shower curtain is a straight bar hung far into the tub which makes the shower feel smaller because it constantly sticks to you. Installing a curved curtain bar farther out would provide a big improvement. Toilet paper is only one ply and the tissue boxes were basically empty with no replacements when we arrived. These are all minor things that don't take away from the excellent location, but are small improvements that would be noticed by future guests.

Maria’s place was great! In such a great part of the city. It was super close to everything we wanted to do and was close to plenty of restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and convenient stores. While it was close to everything, it was very quiet at night, which was great. Exactly what was pictured and what we expected. Would definitely stay again!

The flat was even better than the pics! Super cute, super clean, super nice. Would repeat for sure. Great option for urban explorers that want to stay right in the 24/7 vibrant center of the city. Just a traveler tip: If you’re a light sleeper remember to bring your earplugs cause the AC and the fridge can get a bit noisy.

This apartment was a spectacular stay! I stayed here with my partner for our anniversary over the weekend, and we loved every second. The place is in a perfect location, is so very cute and thoughtfully decorated, and I would definitely return! Thanks for everything!
This was such a great experience, super well located, nice, clean and cosy. Maria’s communication is top notch. I will make sure to come back

Our stay was wonderful in this apartment. We did not hear noice from the street and felt safe/secure in the unit. The location is very close to Times Square and Penn Station which made sight seeing and transportation manageable. Communication was excellent throughout the stay. I stayed with one other person and was hopeful for more towels than one each, but that is minimal. We had a great time and a great stay!
We have nothing but positive things to say! Great location, very clean, fast responses! We would highly recommend to anyone! Felt safe and also pretty quiet at night! Thank you Maria!

This was an amazing place to stay at. We walked to Time Square every night because of how close it was to the apartment. I often found myself calling it "home" because it had such a home like feeling. At first the lockbox was easy to find, I just had trouble putting it back since it was my first time using a lock box but it was fairly easy. The keys to the apartment were a little tricky to get at first but by the second night we had the hang out it. You have to mess around with them a bit. She had everything that the apartment listed! Would love to stay here again.

This space was beautiful and really central to everything we had planned for our trip. The unit was clean and perfect even on rainy days when we spent time inside cooking and watching shows. Would absolutely stay again.
Clean and very comfortable stay close to Times Square and Broadway. Maria was very responsive with making sure we got the keys and were able to access the unit.

The apartment is super cute (pictures accurate), in a great location and Maria is very kind. One thing to keep in mind if booking in the summer though: we were uncomfortably hot while in the apartment. There is one small AC (but no fans), and even with the AC on the whole time it was difficult to spend time in the space and to get to sleep.
Great place in close proximity to MSG.  Super clean and Maria’s communication was precise.  Will definitely see if this spot is available on my next trip to NYC
Good location, easy access to just about any subway train you might need. Close enough to walk to Times Square and Theaters. Would recommend the Italian restaurant (Nitti's) that is right next door.
The place looked like the pictures. The beds and couches were comfortable. There was plenty of natural sun light in the day time with shades open. I would definitely would stay again.
Fantastic location! Exactly where you want to be if a city neighborhood is on tap. It made the month stay easy and fun.

This was a very nice house.I stayed 35 nights with my daughter. The location was perfect and safe. The subway station was close and the grocery store was close. The house was clean and newly remodeled as shown in the picture. Bright house with sunlight all day long, comfortable bed and clean bedding, sofa, warm water, perfect air conditioner. It's just a house I want to stay again.
Fantastic location. Balconies were a real plus. Fast elevator, decent laundry facilities. The renter was easy to reach and very accessible. Would definitely stay again.

Stayed here for an extended period of time and truly loved every moment.  There’s a wonderful bodega right across the street, the subway systems are all very close, grocery is not too far away.  Everything you need is a stones throw away and the apartment itself created a warm, home-y environment.  I’ll miss this place a lot and would recommend staying here to anybody I know.
We had a fantastic stay at Norma’s apartment.  Everything and anything you’d like or need is within walking distance or the subway.

What a gem! We felt SO at home in this space and the location could not have been more perfect. Easy access to lots of yummy restaurants and multiple subway lines. Tons of extra linens, excellent AC, super functional kitchen… we loved staying here.
Was great staying here, perfect location. Meital was on hand & gave loads of great recommendations and n the area
Great place for the price. Edward was very responsive and available for questions! Great location with lots to do in walking distance
We had a great stay. It was a short trip but the location was great. Easy to find and very walkable. Lots to do around the area and the host was very responsive. No complaints
The host is very responsible and will respond to your need quickly and effectively; the location is good, and the price is worthy

The unit is as described.  The location is great for public transportation, literally just across the street. If you need to move around the city easily, this is your best bet. The host was always responsive and accommodating.

I had a great stay here! I am a student and this place is very close to the hospital which was quite convenient. It is also very close to the train station. Giselle was always responsive. The place was nice to stay in and relatively large for NY!

she is really a nice girl and she make me feel welcome to her place, she told me everything i need to know and the place looks really clean and beautiful.
thanks again my girl and defenitly i have a place to stay the next time i would go to NY.

Ademi was very welcoming and accommodating to my dinner party size during one night of my weekend stay. The space alone was very spacious and the XL kitchen with wolf range stove literally STOLE my heart. The available amenities was insane, just the perfect birthday surprise to my partner. I'm talking full access to a hot tub, sauna, surround sound system, and then some. You got to experience it. It's a hidden gem with prime location. Angie's market has a solid inventory and very well maintained. If you want to have a moment to get away and play house for just a little bit, this is it. I'd absolutely do it again. Thanks Ademi!
Great hostess! Ademi was attentive, easy to communicate with and gave clear instructions. We had the whole house, great patio and great location!

It was a pleasure staying at Ademi’s house. The place was clean and very accommodating just like the pictures indicated. Communications with Ademi was great throughout the process. I would recommend this airbnb to any looking for a wonderful place to stay.
Great location but furnishings were poor quality, not a very comfortable space to spend a long time in.
Excellent location, shops, restaurants, cafes within walking distance. Very safe area. Quiet apartment, can't hear neighbors.
Clean apartment and great location with a responsive host. But, be aware that it's on the 5th floor and there is no elevator.

This is the perfect UWS place. The apartment is large with great amenities, and is conveniently located to Riverside and Central Park, many restaurants, shops, and grocery stores, and public transit including the subway and the crosstown M79.
I enjoyed our stay at Eves place, Eve is fantastic and making sure we settled well in her place.

it was a nice trip. she was a very great host. We needed an iron and she got us one. she was very responsive to our needs. the house is great in a great neighborhood. I would love to stay around there again

Ash is by far the best host I’ve ever had. He is incredibly responsive, proactive, caring and present, even if he wasn’t able to be there himself to help out with any issues. The home is enormous and beautifully appointed, nestled in a lovely neighbourhood. Feels very rare, very special. Highly recommend any place Ash rents as he’s truly the best.
Wonderful host and a beautiful house. Very clean and comfortable. I was always able to get in contact with the host if I had any questions. Highly recommend and would stay here again!
Had a great stay at Gisele's place! It's conveniently located next to a Trader Joes, some nice restaurants, gyms, etc. The apartment itself was clean and spacious. I would definitely stay here again!
This place was perfect for a month-long stay, close to public transportation, lots of restaurants in the area!
Neighborhood is perfect, peaceful and quiet. The room and the house is clean. Location is good, it’s near to train stations if you wanna go to downtown.

Very clean and peaceful airbnb. I really enjoyed my stay here. There is also a pretty view of the water out the window. The neighborhood is also quite. Mondys mother is super nice and welcoming. I had two heavy suitcases and a friendly gentleman helped me which I was thankful for. I would 100% recommend. God bless you.
great location and nice and clean air b and b. I would recommend this place 10/10 times.

The host was really nice to me. She helped me with my heavy luggage and gave me house slippers when it was raining outside. She was absolutely nice to even open the door for me when I forgot key at 3am in the morning and helped me with other things too. I would definitely book again .

I spent my last 3 days in New York in Rosianie’s place and I really appreciated it. The room is very clean, confortable and quiet, very similar to the pictures. Rosianie is also a really nice and kind host. Mondy was so reactive with the message if you have any questions. I definitely recommand Rosianie’s place !
Lovely place to stay in Queens, although it’s a bit out of the way, the room was clean everything was as expected. The host was quick to respond to my questions and communication was fluid.
Rosianie is a very sweet host, she always helped me when i had questions! very clean flat, super comfortable bed!

Unbeatable location-- walking distance to essentially everything for a fun weekend in NYC. Check-in was super easy and directions were clear. Same goes for check-out. The room was as expected (accurately advertised). It was clean, tidy, and noise wasn't a problem even though it's smack in the middle of the city! The beds themselves were also surprisingly comfortable. Will definitely try to use this again if coming back to the NYC area.

Very well located, near the 5th Av., all the touristic attractions, and train/bus stations. The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. It is okey if you only pretend to sleep and take a shower. We had a good time.
The location was perfect! Easy check in and check out. Would recommend this place to family and friends. Can't wait to go back.

This place is great in a pinch. It's in a great location and it's a decent value for your money, but don't treat this as anything more than a home base. The building itself is a little sketchy, but the apartment itself is clean and comfortable.
Great apartment with 3 beds. Also very clean which is much appreciated.  Would stay again.

Could not have asked for a better location in New York. The view of the Empire State Building from our window was definitely a highlight. It gets loud at night being in such proximity to the street but nothing a little white noise could not handle. Our family truly enjoyed our stay. Definitely recommend!

The apartment was exactly what we needed for our stay. It was comfortable for 5 people and easily walkable to everything we wanted to see. We got there early and the space was ready so we were able to checkin ahead of schedule. Obviously being in the middle of NYC it was a little loud at night. Only complaint is that it was difficult to get the room to a warm enough temperature so we weee quite chilly. The host was very quickly responsive to messages.

The apartment was exactly as described, it's in the center of Manhattan and close to everything. The only problem is the window that is fixed with tape and lets the cold air in. Apart from that, I recommend it.

The unit is small but very clean and nice.  it takes few mins to walk to the subway station.  We came one hour earlier, Fernando let us in as soon as it is available.  we will come back again definitely.

5/5 for location
5/5 for safety
3/5 for cleanliness - The towels provided smelled moist as if they hadn’t been washed in a while. The bathroom could have been a bit cleaner.
3/5 for convenience - There was only one roll of toilet paper. We had to go downstairs to get more rolls. Also, a key note is there was cold air coming in from the window and AC unit, from outside. That was a major inconvenience due to temperatures being in the 20s. Even with the heater on, the bed next to the window was freezing.
Overall, this would be a 5/5 if there was more attention to the cleanliness of the place and the window was fixed.

This apartment was close to the Q and 5 blocks or so to the 4/5/6. It felt relatively safe and the road was quiet. That being said, the apartment itself was quite old and pretty bare - no frills. Good location and quiet neighbors though.
Katya's place is good. It has a good internet connection, kitchen facilities, and a laundry machine. 15 mins by walking to two subway stations. Near the place are restaurants and grocery stores.

Wonderful quiet place to live in the center of Chelsea. Easy walk to multiple train stations. The building is a bit older than it looks in the pictures but still nice. Pretty much had everything needed to live comfortably for 2 months.
Everything works and such a nice and cozy place to stay. Very clean and tidy with all amenities in place

THIS HOUSE IS AMAZING . The house is exactly how it is pictured. When you walk in it was so clean and the smelled so good . Checking in was super easy and the location was close by the grocery store and other stores. We will definitely be visiting again. THANK YOU TEMI.
At home feeling. The bed is comfortable. The bathroom is a dream especially the shower so relaxing. The living room is spacious and the couch is comfortable

Temi's Place was absolutely beautiful, clean and neat, with everything you would need. Located in a nice quiet area with plenty of parking. close to shopping with a short car ride. Communication was quick and easy. Highly recommend, Will definitely return.

Loved it!!
Looked better in person than on the pictures. Very clean, had everything we needed. Temi was a very nice host. Safe and nice neighborhood and plenty of parking on devens street less than a minute walk ! would recommend everytime 👌
Saying that this is the perfect place is an understatement. Very clean, very safe, a home away from home. Will be staying here again.

The property is excellent. Accommodations are exceptional. Temi is a great host. Attentive, quick to respond and courteous always. We loved the living room furniture! Only recommendation would be to add some silverware and a few more plates/cups. There is no dishwasher which is why I assume there isn’t much in terms of plates/cups/glassware. Other than that, all amenities were great! Thank you again!

Thanks so much Temi for letting us stay at your home. It was clean and refreshing place to stay. The neighborhood is lovely and shops are just a few blocks away. It’s about 15 mins from the Staten Island Ferry and cost about 25 in a cab to get there; if you don’t drive. The house has all your basic needs and then some. I would definitely stay again.
Absolutely loved Temi’s place. Was everything and more. Very cozy and peaceful. Great neighborhood. Was easy to get to and was a swift and easy check in. Had an amazing time. Will be back for sure!!
Great space. A little noisy up stairs early mornings & late nights. Other than that it was perfect

Great place to stay in Staten Island. Lots of space, very clean, safe neighborhood. Plenty of street parking  available . The apartment is nicely furnished and very comfortable.  The host was very responsive to questions. We would happily stay here again.
Wonderful stay! If you're in town for the NYC marathon, this might be the easiest place to get to the start line. The space is clean and modern and cozy.

The studio is in a building with a lot of appartements. That can be sometimes noisy. It's depends on your luck but it's a good studio itself, very functional for a short stay in New York and conveniently located for the subways.
And Anna respond quickly to your questions. So I recommend it.
Anna was amazing. Responded to my late night texts and always kept me updated. Place is stunning and sterile. Would recommend booking 10/10
Anna was great! Kind, Quick responses and always willing to help. She was awesome to work with.
Host was very easy to reach and willing to answer any questions I had. Place was clean upon arrival, the check in process was very straightforward, and the airbnb was in a great location!
Great listing, especially for the price. It was great to be able to have a home base when we weren’t out and about. Anna was super responsive and very helpful when I asked questions. Would recommend!

This apartment is very small but the bed and bathroom are nice and clean and the location is excellent. The building itself was bizarrely laid out and the room numbers are confusing. The elevators were fast and responsive. The security was friendly. Would definitely stay again if I was in midtown
Nice apartment, host was great about responding to any questions we had, check in and check out process was easy, apartment was clean and comfortable

Anna’s place was great, it was close to the subway and a short walk to Times Square. Plenty of restaurants to choose from too. Very handy for two people, any more would be a squeeze. The apartment has everything you need for a short or long stay. Laundry on the ground floor too. Highly recommended

With the recent flooding in NYC, I was concerned I wasn’t going to be able to make it to my reservation. However, I was able to message Anna and ask about the area. She was very attentive and helpful through everything. We were going to a concert at MSG and it was the perfect distance away from everything I wanted to see. There were even earplugs waiting for us there too! Staying here really made my NYC experience better.
Anna’s place was perfect for girls weekend in the city to see a show at Madison Square Garden !!
Comfortable place that makes you feel at home. Clear instructions with great location. Hope to come back soon!
Perfect studio apartment set up. Building and apartment are very clean. Convenient location! Anna is a gracious host!
We had a nice stay at Anna’s place - it was exactly as described and in a great location!
Our stay was great. The location was central to everything we needed. Anna was super helpful in getting an early check in for us when some of our plans fell through on the morning we arrived.

The location is very central and convenient. The room is equipped with good kitchen facilities. There is enough supplied such as shampoo and toilet paper. However there is no couch as shown in the photo or description. The bed in my opinion is not super comfortable- it tends to be very warm. Some of the towels were dirty-with hair on them. Anna was slow in response at first but was helpful afterwards. The walls are very thin and we can hear our neighbors or cleaning lady outside. There was also a miscommunication about the room cost but we were able to resolve it. Overall it was an ok experience.
The location is perfect will all major places close by and extremely accessible. It is a perfect and cozy place for two people.
I really enjoyed my stay...nice, cozy, clean studio. Nice location near subway and it was easy to get to Manhattan. Parking wasn't the worst. Thank you Mindia

Great little place! Mindia keeps it clean and it’s great for a quick trip.
Tips:
- The door can be a little stubborn to get the key out, but if you push on the key hole while pulling the key out, it’ll come out. Just takes a couple of times to get the hang of it.
- The room for trash is right across the elevator to the left when you get out on the seventh floor (to the right if you’re exiting the apartment)
The stay was great! We actually arrived quite late at night but Mindia was able to have us checked in smoothly. The place was clean as well.

Overall had a good stay, however note the apartment is not smoke free and does smell smokey. Generally clean, although there was a candle in the bathroom that had some hair trimmings in it .. Mindia was very responsive and helpful.
Everything about the place was nice. Mindia was good at responding per checkin. Only thing is there was food in the fridge that made it difficult to put our things. But other than that great place.

This place was perfect! Clean apartment in a clean building, comfortable for 2 people, great location and Mindia went out of his way to make sure we had everything we could need. Would definitely stay again!

Perfect place for my boyfriend and I to stay during my visit to NYC. It was close to his neighborhood in Harlem and a short walk to a local grocery store, some restaurants and Broadway street. I arrived late in the evening and when I messaged him regarding parking he gave me his parking spot and sent me a link for a parking lot for future reference. The oven wasn’t working but Mindia offered to send someone to fix it immediately. The place was just as pictured and clean. Would love to stay here again if available. Great host!

I enjoyed everything about my stay here! From checking in to checking out everything was pretty easy and Mindia is always there to support or help if you needed! The place was accurate and when I visit again I definitely don’t mind staying again! I loved it!
Cozy place to stay, communication with Mindia was great! Quick walk to the Subway, made transportation into the city super easy
Awesome place, 3 blocks from empire state building. The towels were smelling bad even though replaced 2 times, besides that everything went fine.
Very clean, near everything, safety, tiny space but has what you need to spend a few days.

Our family of four did a whirlwind trip to NYC right before Christmas and Eduard's place was just what we were looking for.  It was warm, cozy and a perfect launch pad for full days of sightseeing in the Big Apple.  We would stay at Eduard's again.

it was great to have a place so clean, perfect for the needs of 2 adults and 2 teenagers.  it was walkable to so much including times square and broadway shows. when we ventured out further subway was very easy to get to.  We loved our stay!
No real complaints. Place was nice and we had a great time. Wish there was more affordable options but this worked.

Great location, great value - everything very functional - good internet connection and speed, cosy place, perfectly serves its function. Beds comfortable, air conditioning worked perfectly.
Lots of stores close by to buy any essentials. Would definitely return if in the city.

Definitely worth the money.  The room looks just a little bit bigger in the pictures but there was still enough space and the location is just perfect. Check-in and communication was 10/10 and I can absolutely recommend this place!
Mindia was such a warm and inviting host. Flexible check-in. Neighbors were super friendly and polite. Mindia will make sure you have a good stay.

Great place to stay for a couple nights - great transit access, overall good location.  Clean, comfortable bed and private bathroom!  Mindia is very responsive and took care of everything I needed, and allowed me to store my bag early. Also there were friendly neighbors in the building, and a vibrant vibe with people chatting on the sidewalk in lawn chairs.

Mindia was an A1 host. The place was great, and it was very easy to communicate with him when needed. As for location, I personally thought it was perfect. Super close to subway stations to get around quickly.
Would recommend and will probably be rebooking in the future! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had a fantastic 4-month stay at Emma’s place during an internship, the place was the perfect size for two people, was in a great location as I was working in Manhattan, had everything I needed for a long stay, which Emma made sure of. Bonus points for being in a gorgeous brownstone :)

Ashley’s place is adorable, clean, and extremely well situated. It’s just a quick walk to the L and some great restaurants and bodegas. It’s also a lot bigger than it looked in pictures! We were very happy and comfortable and would absolutely stay here again.

This condo is spacious and has 3 bedrooms.
Easy walking distance from the underground stop and has good restaurants or breweries within 10 min walk.
My family and I enjoyed Ashley’s place. It was in an area that had lots of bars and places for good food. The neighborhood was mixed which was a plus for us. The place was clean and well kept.

Ashley’s place was everything and more!! Honestly a very comfortable place to stay at and very spacious!! Very simple and easy check in. There is a brewery and a train station nearby as well and a couple convenient stores as well. Would definitely could back to this place for future visits to NY!!

Great spot for a friend's get-away. There were 4 of us and we each felt like we had our own space. It's a very large apartment for the city (2 floors). We felt safe and were very happy with the proximity to great restaurants, cafes, and bars. There seemed to be plenty of street parking spots available, and we opted for a small lot a couple blocks down on the same road. Ashley was a responsive and fantastic host, we'd certainly go back and stay here again!

We enjoyed our stay here. First location wise it was a 5 minute walk to the station which was so convenient. The interior was beautiful and aesthetically appealing. Ashley was very responsive in the questions we asked. Definitely would rebook and stay here also the area was very quiet!

We loved staying at Ashley’s place! It was super spacious and clean with plenty of places to sleep and an easy walk to the train. Ashley was super friendly and communicative and there was also a really good coffee shop right down the street. Would definitely stay here again!
This apartment was so perfect for my grandmother and dad to stay in! Accessible entrance, central air and just freakin adorable! Thank you Ashley!!!

We were three adults in town for a film festival. We loved Ashley’s place! It was more spacious than we anticipated with a large lower level bedroom with double bed and a half bath and a roomy BR on the street level also with double bed. A third room had a single bed which we didn’t use. There was a full bath off the kitchen - everything was clean, functional and very attractively decorated. We were surprised to find that the large Dali print on the wall over the stairway was actually the TV!
Ashley sent us lots of information about dining, shopping, transportation and entertainment in the neighborhood.
Ashley’s place was close to the L train which goes through Williamsburg and into Manhattan - exactly the places we wanted to go.
Everything was so convenient. We would definitely return again!

We had an amazing time at Ashley's place.   It was well stocked, clean, and more spacious than we expected for NYC.  The downstairs living room/chill zone has an awesome vibe and plenty of comfy furniture.  There were some great bars and restaurants right in the area, plus it was just a few blocks from the L train station for easy access to Brooklyn/Manhattan.
Ashley’s place is just as the pictures show, it’s very spacious. She was available when we needed her, and check in was a breeze. We were comfortable here. Would recommend

We really enjoyed our time at the place! It's super close to the subway and has great affordable food options nearby. The place is super clean, has easy access to the city and has a fun interior design with comfy bedding.
Comfortable and welcoming condo that had everything we needed within walking distance. I enjoyed the neighborhood and wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. Ashley is a great host.
We had a great time here for the US Open! The place was perfect for our group of 6 and the area was fun to walk around and get to know. Taking the subway was easy and safe.
The place looks exactly like the pictures is super clean and dated , Gabriela is a great host and answered all my questions , definitely I will be back location is great

Will recommend this place to friends and family. Its location is close to LGA and to all tourist locations in NY. Apartment was super clean and easy to access. Great service from the host, preparing candle lights before our arrival visit. Will definitely come back!

thank you very much for the surprise everything was excellent, my stay was very pleasant you made my experience wonderful very good communication you are the best god bless. I recommend this place to everyone is #1 👍💯
Beautiful and comfortable apartment! Includes parking, which is a HUGE plus in NYC! Thank you Gabriela!
Gabriel's place was perfect the pictures don't do it any justice and the location is great. would definitely recommend.
We had a wonderful stay at Gabriela’s. It was clean, comfortable and convenient. Home away from home.
This was the best stay ever. It was minutes from LaGuardia and had beautiful views. We will definitely stay here again very very soon!!!
The stay was amazing! Very clean and host accommodated us which I am very grateful for! Totally worth it! Sunrise view is AMAZING!
This was a clean, well maintained place that matched the descriptions and pictures. Gabriela was a great responsive host and would recommend to anyone who is looking for a place near NYC!

Great check in…
Everything in working condition…
Very clean…
Towels n linens were clean…
Parking was easy…
Overall had a great time with my wife and two daughters…will be back for sure…
Great location and Clean place ! However going up or down the stairs is difficult especially for the elderly and travellers with luggages .
Great NY stay. Yvette was attentive without being intrusive, and generous with flexibility on arrival/departure and good guidance on local amenities.

It’s as described you get what you pay for plenty of space it was perfect for our group of 7 adults and 1 child. It cost us on avg. $35 daily to get to the PATH train ($2.75) to New York City. Overall the house isn’t perfect but it works.

This is a beautiful apartment with a lot of space and open area.  Very nice amenities, comfy bed, adjustable heat, easy access.  I found parking directly in front of the apartment on the street!  Very close (10 min walk) to King’s Theater!!! Loved my stay!

First time in NYC we got this place because is just one block away from subway station. 30 minutes ride and we were already in Manhattan. Place was very warm and cozy. Beds were very firm and comfortable, shower was sparkling clean and nice. Very spacious place and quiet neighborhood. There is no coffee maker but several stores nearby where you can buy it for a few bucks.

Nisheka’s home was absolutely beautiful! It looked exactly like the pictures. I stayed with three other people and we had more than enough room for all of us.
This home is right near the subway station, which made our trip much more stress free! Literally less than a five minute walk.
If you’re considering booking this apartment, this is your sign to do so! Nisheka was very attentive, informative, and genuinely kind.
Nisheka's place was very nice and clean. I would absolutely stay there again in the future A++

Nisheka's Airbnb was the perfect spot for our NYC weekend. We originally booked this location because we had tickets to see a show at King's Theater. The apartment was very clean and even had a desk for me to work from during the day. Nisheka was an amazing host and provided detailed instructions for check-in and check-out and was available for any issues that came up during our stay. I would definitely recommend Nisheka's apartment for anyone traveling to NYC!

Our stay @ Nisheka’s place was GREAT to say the least!! We will definitely be coming back in the future. Nisheka also provided great recommendations for things to do around NYC which gave us a great starting point for our first time in NYC.
To Nisheka, Thank you again 🙌🏾
Nisheka was a fantastic host. There was an issue and she did a great job problem solving. It saved our trip from disaster!

Nisheka‘s place is definitely a good choice. Nisheka's place was lovely, and she was a great host. The apartment was spacious and incredibly clean with thoughtful amenities scattered around. Rosetta is an awesome host house was fully equipped,  spacious,clean and all the above. This home was amazing i promise I'll be back ❤️

thanks Rosetta once again the place was amazing. i wanted a early check-in you did tgat for me with no hesitation.  Rosetta was very polite and attentive everything just perfect.  I didn't want for anything and it's always great experience when you allow me to stay here 😊 I'll be back soon thanks again.

Rosetta place was great! The pictures were accurate and the place looked even better in person. First impression was how clean and fresh the place was. Housekeeping did a great job.  Loved the rear balcony, the L train was about 4-5 blocks away, also very convenient if your wanting to go into the city. Definitely recommend booking.

Rosetta is an excellent host! My wife and I appreciate her hospitality. Her Airbnb is absolutely warm and very inviting. Awesome space, location location location! Nothing was far at all. We literally parked and majority of the time got an Uber. Everything was as described and Rosetta is just the sweetest!!
Narrow driveway so keep that in mind when renting a car-the house feels like a home Would be happy to stay again and or recommend.

Cozy apt very close to the Bronx Zoo! Parking on the road was difficult but we parked in a parking lot to the left of the building and had no issues.

Cristal was an amazing host. Super responsive when I messaged her with questions. The apartment had everything you could need, the stocked kitchen was definitely a nice thing to have as well. Nothing but good things to say about my fiancé and I’s stay. Definitely recommend and will keep in mind for the next time I travel to NYC!
Great Host , Great Stay everything was right I strongly recommend it , Definitely will be booking again as soon as we can

Excellent 2 night stay . Check in was quick & easy. I was the 1st guest !!! Everything seems new.
Joel and his wife were quite nice
The place is as advertised. Nice and clean. A few nice " homey " touches. Bathroom is modern . Everything was great . I would definitely return when I come back to my hometown Woodhaven. Thanks Joel. It'sobvious you will do well. You're dedicated to being a great host
Joel was a wonderful host ensuring quick responses to any questions I had. And asked how I was doing throughout the stay. Would utilize this place again in the future.
Joel was a great host! Everything was super easy and accessible. A perfect place to get away to and I will definitely be booking this place again. Great stay!

Very convenient location with around a 10-minute walk to the train. Joel was always helpful in communicating about and changes to transport in the area and replied with any concerns I had. Overall, the place was spotless and very tidy so I felt right at home! Highly recommended 😄

I would like to thank Joel for being very responsive. I had a problem with the WIFI and informed Joel, he replied to me in a couple of seconds and the issue was resolved very soon.
Thank you Joel!

I can't recommend Joel's place anymore. Joel was very informative, helpful and accommodating. he even accommodated a delivery for us from a company that does not deliver to Ireland, I was so grateful for this 🤍
Joel's place is just under an hour from Times Square, but honestly, it was so great, we got to see so much of Queens and Brooklyn, which was fantastic 🤍 It is the perfect location to see all of the city and the bus to Manhatten and surrounding areas is only a 2 minute walk from the apartment. The apartment was warm, super clean, spacious and perfet for what you need when exploring the city 🤍
thank you so much Joel, we will be recommending your place to anybody we know coming to New York 🍎🗽🇺🇲🤍🤗

Pros: Good Value, Safe Building, Clean Space, True 2 Bedroom, adequate closet space.
Cons: Kitchen is small, but adequate for light meal preparation. The dining table is too small and awkward. Sofa is not very comfortable.
Overall, if I find a good rate, I will stay again.
Our stay at Yael’s place was very comfortable. Apartment was clean , lots of storage space and  had everything needed for a long term stay.

A very cozy space and perfect for our trip! You won't be disappointed.
Easy check in and we had no issues during our stay. We loved it!
This spot was a great find. Decorated and cozy. Everything was modern and clean. Definitely staying here again

I had a great time at this Airbnb. The space was very comfortable, well furnished and conveniently located, and the hosts were very prompt with their responses. I’d definitely want to stay here again!

Everything about this place was amazing. You get to capture what it’s like to live in the city, are close to the Subway to go anywhere in Brooklyn / NY, and have an amazing room for yourself. The price is great, the host is incredible, and her dog is the SWEETEST! I hope to be able to visit again, and thank you for everything, Rachel.
Rachel’s place is perfect for anyone looking to stay in Brooklyn! Easy walk to any train or bus, good local shops and friendly people! The room was wonderful with plenty of thoughtful amenities.

Very comfortable place for my partner and I who were mostly out and about throughout the day. Check in and check out instructions were clear. Neighborhood is pretty quiet, most restaurants and other things are a bit of a walk, but the train is close by. Rachel was easy to be in space with and Bowser the dog is the cutest, sweetest guy.

From the initial greeting with a radiant smile to checking in on us throughout the stay, this was one of the best we've had on the platform. Rachel provided fantastic local recommendations and her friendly, four-legged co-host Bowser brought the always welcome joy and laughs.
Rachel was a great host, her place was very welcoming and we felt right at home. Will be trying to stay with Rachel the next time we’re in Brooklyn for sure.👌

Unfortunately, my experience at this Airbnb was very shocking and uncomfortable. The building itself smelled strongly of chemicals or paint, while the house smelled of weed and must. There was a broken window covered with a garbage bag that wasn’t disclosed, and it let in constant noise from outside—including people rummaging through trash and screaming for whatever reason.
During my stay, there were multiple incidents of crime just outside the building, which made me feel unsafe. On top of that, the bathroom was also not as shown, and the overall cleanliness left a lot to be desired.
I ultimately left a day early because I felt sick and couldn’t stay in those conditions any longer. I would not recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a safe and comfortable place to stay. Rachel was nice and Bowser was the sweetest boy. just wish there was more transparency overall.

The apartment is tiny but very comfortable and equipped with everything you need. We stayed with a small baby and the hosts are very wonderful people - Noelle immediately responded to all our requests and provided us with a high chair, a crib and a bath for the baby, and other things that we needed.
As for the location, you can’t imagine it better, next to the train station to Manhattan, a direct line of 20 minutes and you are in the center. There are also many cafes, restaurants, pastries and beauty salons - there is everything for every taste. There are two large pharmacies and a couple of small supermarkets within walking distance. 24/7 deli market is just on the corner.
The area is really nice, lively and at the same time quiet and peaceful.
So, you know what? I'm definitely recommend it! ;)

This is my 2nd time staying at this beautiful home. Maria is very quick to respond to your questions and concerns. The home is very clean. Neighbor are friendly and I love the neighborhood. This will be my go to spot for anytime I am in Brooklyn.
The house was as described by the pictures and description. The neighborhood is extremely friendly! Perfect for late night runs!
A very well kept place, spacious, and a beautiful setting in a nice area! Will definitely have Maria host for us in the future again!

Maria was a great host!
Her place was in a perfect location, walkable distance to restaurants, pharmacy and grocery stores.
The pictures were exactly how described, VERY clean, felt like home and a comfortable space.
This is a place that I would be definitely booking again any time I visit New York!!
it was a great stay but the outside was too noisy in the morning. not the owner's fault tho

Small studio style apartment with bunk bed. Perfect if you’re with a group of friends and just looking for a place to sleep. Not a lot of space (as the pictures depict) or places to sit, but great location.

We had a great stay with our family of 6 (2 adults, 4 kids)! Ideal location near major subway stations and easily walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, parks, etc. and we always felt safe coming and going. The space was tight, which is what we expected, and ended up being fine for us since we were out and about all day and really only used it to sleep and shower. It was very convenient to have a laundry room and luggage storage on-site. The building had some unpleasant smells in the hallways and also in our bathroom, but swapping out the towels and shower curtain helped. Henri was an extremely responsive host, responding to our questions and requests in a very timely manner. Aside from the city itself, service was a highlight of this stay!

Henri's place was very centrally located which was great as it was our first time in New York. Although small, the place is great value for money for someone who will spend most of the time in the city. Would love to come back!
Was exactly what we expected. Small budget hotel room with bunk single/double beds. Minimal space but it was a budget option. Very clean. Henri was very helpful and responsive!
This place was perfect! Especially for after a concert at MSG, it is a five minute walk from the venue and was very convenient.

The location is absolutely amazing - two blocks from an L stop, in a neighborhood with tons of great food options, near a park. Eli and the other guest pretty much left me to my own devices for the entire stay, which was exactly what I wanted. The place itself is a bit DIY and not spotlessly clean, but the room I stayed in was calm and had everything I needed. All in all, a great value. I would stay here again.
Eli is great! Great communication, very helpful and just an all around cool person. I stayed for 2 weeks and felt immediately at home in his house.

The place delivers what it has promised - great location - 4 mins to L train, very clean and tidy and the best part - full privacy even with other guests living you have peace and quiet in your room. Eli is a great host and responds quickly to your messages. Definitely will stay again here.

Eli was very friendly + responsive to messages. The location was OK with access to the subway and a few solid restaurants nearby. Being a share space (with 2 other rooms on the same floor) you do need to be mindful of noise as sound travels through the place. Thanks again!
Really enjoyed my stay at Eli's place! He's a kind and thoughtful host, and he provides a comfortable space for a solo traveler checking out Bushwick!

Eli is welcoming, available and ready to help, while remaining extremely discreet.
The apartment is very clean, the neighborhood is quiet and there's no noise at night.
It was my first time staying in Brooklyn, and it was definitely a great experience! Eli is a great host and always available to help. He also has wonderful recommendations to explore Bushwick :)

My Husband, kids and I came into town for our daughter's HS Graduation and stayed at Michela's home.  It is an amazing space.  She has put a lot of time and effort into turning her home into a very comfortable and  esthetically pleasing place to be.  She was gracious, easy to communicate with and easy to get a hold of.  The area was safe and the majority of neighbors were friendly and kept to themselves.  There are two very nice parks within walking distance.  I would most definitely stay here again and again and would recommend for anyone to do the same!!

Lovely spot with cool interior touches. Michela made the experience super easy and everything was clean, comfortable. Location is very close to JFK (within 10min drive to any terminal), but a little far from downtown Manhattan (expect 30 - 50min drive). Individual room controlled AC and vinyl player really made the day. All in all an awesome spot for short term visit to NYC.
Absolutely loved it. The house is clean, the bath room is lit Bluetooth with LED lights, I will be booking again perfect place to vacation for short and long vacation time.

This is a hidden gem! Located right next to JFK, Mick's place made the early morning commute to JFK a breeze. The place is clean, well equipped for a family of 4-6. Paid laundry and grocery/deli stores are located nearby - SUPER CONVENIENT, especially for international travelers/tourists.
Check-in is straightforward, and Michela is always ready to help you with any issue. I had to check in late (Around 01:00 AM) on a Monday, and Michela was accommodating and responsive.
This was a great experience - My family loved it!
My family and I loved our stay. We felt like we were at home, the neighborhood was very quiet. The place was very clean and the host was always there to help out if we needed something.

Mick's place was just as described. All areas looked exactly as the pictures. Our check in was very smooth and Mick was very communicative and responsive of our questions. We felt safe in the area. The beds are so comfortable, we all enjoyed a goodnight sleep every night! You can hear airplanes during the day, but it is for me as white noise for babies.  Overall it was a great place to stay for a few days with my family.

Mick was such a great and welcoming host. I had an issue with my delayed flight and the host made sure i was not stressed about check-in. The place was very easy to find, plenty of parking. The house was very clean and as described. Mick made us feel right at home. When in town again, we will definitely rebook. Will be no need to look elsewhere!

Great host and great location! It is upstairs another apartment so be cautious when traveling with young kids. Otherwise, we loved our stay and Mick was very accommodating and responsive. Would definitely book again.

My stay at Keith’s was great! His communication is very good and his home is really your home away from your home. The area is very peaceful and quiet for the most part. Everything that we needed was available for us to use. I could go on and on about all the good stuff but I’d love for you all to experience it.
I totally recommend Keith’s place!

Large apartment that is quiet and private and in a great location. The apartment haad very helpful items like washing up liquid, soap, laundry pods and tissues. The renovated kitchen and bathroom are lovely. The apartment is within walking distance of Murray Hill LIRR, making it easy to get into Manhattan and other locations. The host Queen and Jeff are helpful and respond quickly. I had a great stay and recommend this as a great option for accommodation in Queens NY.
It locates in a cozy and convenient zone. Street parking but there's enough lots. It only takes around 10 minutes to go to metro station by bus.
We felt right at home. Very cozy. Thank you for the positive experience on our first Airbnb long stay.

Great location, apartment is spacious but spending too much time there during the day was quite depressing as there is no natural light, all four windows in the apartment look onto a brick wall 3/4 metres away. Fixtures are quite dated. Floor was dirty when I arrived (my feet were filthy after walking around in bare feet), after after some negotiations on a group chat with Michael and the "cleaner" the floor was washed again.
Andre is very helpful and responsive. The place looks as good in person as it does in the pictures. Amenities and appliances are all new and very nice.
the price is higher than it should be for a basement, however the apartment is quite good, but a little noisy from the floor above
If I could give 10 stars I would! Victor was a great host and his apartment was lovely. The pictures don't do it justice. He was very accommodating and welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!
Great spacious apartment and súper central location. Victor was always super responsive and helpful. Super recommended
Victors place was ideal for a trip to NY. Friendly host, and a spacious and comfortable unit. I’d stay here again.

My mom and I stayed at Victor’s place and although it was for a short time we loved everything about it. I was in a very nice neighborhood, everything was very clean and it was very easy to get where we had to go. We would definitely consider staying there again.
A great spot. Victor’s place is just as listed. It was convenient to shops and the subway. Made for a great, comfortable, accessible and affordable stay.
Victor’s place is very clean and comfortable. Close to the subway and many places to eat. We would stay there again.

This was our 2nd stay at Victor's place and we loved it just as much.  Victor is so responsive and kind.  He quickly answers any questions we have with the details we need.  The bed and living room are comfy relaxing spaces and the kitchen and bathroom are well equipped and stocked for our needs.  We had plenty of hand soap, body wash, shampoo, conditioner, dish soap, toilet paper, paper towels, linens and towels.  Also coffee & coffee maker and hair dryer too.  WIFI and TVs work great.  Very clean and quiet.  Close to our daughter's apartment so we are thankful to have such a nice place to stay nearby when we visit her.   We also really appreciated that, since it was very cold and snowy/icy on this trip, Victor kept the outside steps ice free with salt and it was nice and warm inside.
Great spot, great host, great area. huge bonus that we never struggled for parking on this street!!

Victor was very prompt and responsive.  Everything is managed remotely but with efficacy. The accomodations was pristine and matched the way described. We reached there after midnight, but as per instruction entry was pretty easy. We liked everything about the accomodations and would prefer to stay there again when we visit Brooklyn again.

The apartment is perfect with an excellent location in a quiet neighborhood of Brooklyn, with 2 subway stations a few blocks away with easy connection to Manhattan.
We spent 2 excellent weeks in Victor's apartment, where we returned to rest in the excellent beds he has after a whole day of walking. I highly recommend staying at Victor's apartment if you are looking to rest in a nice and quieter neighborhood than Manhattan.
Very nice apartment in Clinton Hill. Mostly clean and well serviced. A bit of a trek to the subway but nice neighborhood.

This is an amazing find for NYC. Clean spacious, well equipped, nicely decorated. All the furnishings are new and in good condition, bed is (very) firm. Nice large TV for streaming.
The neighborhood is fine with plenty of shops and restaurants.
It is off the beaten path in terms of of tourism so you’ll need to navigate the subway.
Everything was just like in the description. Apartment was really great, close to the metro station. Neighborhood was quiet and safe. I recommend this place!

We stayed at Victors place for a quick weekend. The neighborhood was easily walkable with some cute coffee shops and restaurants. The unit was exactly as described; and very spacious- could easily accommodate 2 couples without feeling too cramped. We enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay again!
Excellent find!! It’s an amazing space to stay in!  It had everything we needed and more. The location was walkable and would stay there again in a heartbeat.
Great location, and a great stay! Mark was very flexible with check-in, and was very responsive as we transitioned Airbnbs throughout NY. Thanks Mark!

My girlfriend and our dog stayed here for around 2 1/2 weeks after moving back to the City.
Mark’s place was very comfortable and very well located. It had a big desk which was good for remote work and a functional kitchen.
Mark was very, very responsive.
Would strongly recommend this location.
Mark was very responsive and his place is right near fun 5th Avenue with lots of great shops and restaurants.

Emon was an amazing host. The apartment is literally in the perfect location. It is super close to the west side highway, subway, midtown, and West Village. I can't think of a better location. Emon was very responsive and always helpful. The studio is very spacious, with plenty of room. The neighboring tenants are very kind. It's not the most quiet in the nighttime but that's normal anywhere in the city. Overall, super great experience. Emon was awesome, and the apartment was great!

Our stay for two was a great experience. The description of the listing and photos are true. I loved that there was lots of space in this apartment, the convenient layout of the kitchen, and the access to the backyard. The ACs are very quiet to sleep at night. The wifi was fast and reliable. The street is indeed very quiet which was a relief in Brooklyn.  The worry-free access to the apartment is bliss. The communication with the host was fast and accommodating. Having a washer and dryer was very handy for us since we didn't take lots of clothes with us. The mattresses on the beds are very comfy. It's a good value for money in Brooklyn for the time we stayed (2 weeks in mid-June 2022). Two bagel shops with one of the best bagels in NY are located very close to the house. And lots of other conveniences, like grocery shops, bakeries, subway stations, are in walk distance.

Issac is a gracious host and his place was just as advertised. We enjoyed our stay in this charming and walkable neighborhood. Easy access to Manhattan on the nearby F train. Will return next we visit family in Brooklyn.

Great spot to stay in Brooklyn!
Close to train and good restaurants.
Definitely would stay here again.
Very clean..could use a smell update...though rooms should very inviting with smells.The deck was great and the cleanisness was up to par!!
Easy check in, pictures and descriptions were as described. Private and quiet and near a ton of restaurants. Would stay again in the future.
By far the largest face you will get for the money in Manhattan. Service was incredible and the place was very clean.

I originally booked a separate address and was directed to a separate location.
Went for a work trip with some reps from our company. The delay is getting into new location was frustrating to say the least.
Having to change locations I spoke with multiple people in their organization. I had a pleasent experience with 1 partner, Eskander.
And the initial contact simply brushed my concerns off and hung up on me.
The new location was clean, the only downfall was the beds. Firm. Very firm. If that’s your preference, great it’s a good spot. If you prefer softer beds like myself, it was a long couple of nights.

It was really nice just like the pictures. Nice neighborhood it was super chill from my experience. I would definitely book again. Host has great communication was very nice and helpful/thoughtful! Thanks a million! Hey

Our stay at Curlene’s’ was great. The place is clean and as described. Curlene is also very responsive and always available when there’s a question. Public transportation is in walking distance and neighborhood is nice.
Well definitely have her place as first choice next time coming to New York.
A great, clean and pretty spacious spot. close to buses to connect to subways. great communication and understanding. would definitely book again in future trips
We had a great stay at Curlenes in Brooklyn. Peaceful and in walking distance to the subway.
Modern, clean, and a little small apartment but it met all out needs. The bed was super comfortable.

Curlene's place was great and we felt right at home. It was walkable to many nice restaurants, things to do in the Brooklyn area, and to subway stops to get into Manhattan. She left some breakfast stuff for us and the back patio is relaxing. We definitely plan to stay again.

I truly recommend this place to anyone visiting NYC! The place was easy to get to. Public transportation is very easy to get, the B17 has a stop right by the house. The host was amazing and super helpful. Very great experience 😊
Clean and comfortable appartment. Curlene answered super fast and helped us when we had a problem.

We really loved our stay in this apartment! It had everything we needed, was so clean and communication with Robert went very well and easy! Loved the neighbourhood as well; easy to reach with the metro ! Would definitely recommend!

We absolutely loved the apartment. It was a great location, clean, comfortable and well stocked. The hosts were super responsive and made everything super seamless. We will be back to this place again!

My family of three had a wonderful time at this location! It suited our needs perfectly for a weekend getaway. The host was proactive in their communication and we felt at home from the moment we got there. There was a useful packet to read about the apartment and neighborhood. I am so glad we booked!

Robert and Curtis’ place was exactly what our family of four needed for our NYC visit. The space is comfortable and has a fantastic location for hanging in Park Slope or hopping on the subway into Manhattan. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Great option for a small family/baby. Near a ton of amazing restaurants and stores. The hosts stocked the place with everything we needed. Way better and more convenient for us than a hotel stay.  Place was clean and nicely appointed. Would stay again if back in nyc.
The space was very nice, clean and bright. Location excellent. Communication was spot on. No issues, no problems, we loved it!!

Robert’s home was beautiful! Exactly like the photos. Robert was responsive and helpful when we stayed here and offered a lot of great ideas on things to do in the area in the handbook they provided. We loved staying in Brooklyn and would return again. Thank you!

Yonette I can’t say ENOUGH positive things about staying with her at this location! I had never been to NYC, never used AirBnB, so everything was my first time doing so & thanks to her she made me a committed, loyal, returning experience!
This place is so beautiful inside, you wouldn’t think all of everything that’s in there from looking outside but there is literally everything you could need! Safe, quiet, & even rapid Rocky streaming for your bing needs late at night! I HIGHLY recommend using Yonette for your NYC trips! Thank you again!

Place was clean and organized. We enjoyed our stay in New York. I had multiple trips to Manhattan where a train is nearly 5 minutes away. It is truly a luxurious place inside and we hope to come again on another visit to New York!
I loved my stay, only 7 minute walk to station that got you straight to manhattan! Very clean space, not a loud area, and right next to a cute field!

Kenneth’s place had everything you need! The hosts were VERY responsive, helpful, and accommodating. We appreciated how clean and large the apartment was. You don’t always find something this large in NYC! The apartment is also newly renovated and was kept very clean. We also loved how close it was to the 2, 3 & 4 trains that take you into Manhattan (8 min walk, 3 blocks). It was a slightly farther walk to the A & C trains that take you to Manhattan as well (15 min walk). The area was well lit when we were walking home and we always felt safe. Thanks again to these wonderful hosts for having us!

Kenneth and Nikkita were the perfect hosts. Always willing to help and so easy to reach. Their apartment was also very beautiful, clean and fully stocked with appliances and the things we needed to make us feel right at home.
They also adjusted the check out time when we asked. My family and I would definitely stay there again without a second thought.

It was beyond perfect for the occasion
location, size, price. couldn't have asked for anything better.
Lee’s place is exactly as described. It’s NYC so there’s a lot of street noise. The apartment is nothing fancy, but it’s close to all the action, clean and exactly what we needed. Thanks Lee.

The location was great. The closest subway station was only 3 blocks away. Check in and check out was super easy. Lee was very responsive throughout the whole process. Would definitely recommend if planning to stay in Manhattan!

Great host and place. Easy in and out, clean, quiet and awesome location.
Definitely a great choice while in NYC.
Thanks!

We had a fantastic time. The unit is a great size for a couple and is perfectly located near transit, attractions, grocery stories, pharmacies, liquor stores, etc.  Everything is pretty well stocked; laundry is easy to use, the unit is actually pretty spacious for a studio, and the bathroom was really clean and well stocked. The door men were very nice, too. Lee was also really nice and helpful and we enjoyed working with her. Definitely recommend!

Sergio’s place is clean and conveniently located to a subway stop that is 5 mins by foot. He is very friendly and patient with all of my queries and provided some good recommendations around the neighborhood!
Great place located in a nice neighborhood.  Easy access to the subway.  Room was spacious and had a great AC window unit.

Don't hesitate guys. You will LOVE Sergio's place. The room is huge, the bed is comfy, everything was clean and check-in was quicker than quick.
Sergio is the best, gives you all the help you need and is just lovely to talk to.
I really loved the location and that there is a metro station just 2 blocks away.
My top tip for the neighborhood would be really good mexican food in the brothers café, right up the street and if you don't mind a 12 min walk, go check out the mad café! Such a gem in sunnyside.
I'll be back :)

This was really a cozy and convenient air bnb. Subway is only a short walk away to the 7 train, and only 2 stops to Manhattan. The home was clean and well kept and the host was very hospitable. Will definitely return
Great stay host was very accommodating with the check in and out so I give 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great stay very clean he even offered to let me stay if I needed any extra time I will definitely book again place was very clean and spotless would definitely book again!!!
Tenzin is a wonderful host. So kind and responsive. His place is great, you won’t be disappointed.
Cosy and nice apartment well located in East Village. It was great to stay there with my husband and 2 cats!
We loved our time at Jessica's place! The apartment is well-maintained the location can't be beat! Would return in a heartbeat!

Iryna was a nice host to attend to issues as quickly as possible. For the couple bumps i had with the room my stay was great. I would recommend crashing here if you would like to be close to downtown. Great food and nice area.

the appartment is in a very good location (union square in Manhattan near all the subway and mass transit youll need) although the building has its years, the studio is very clean, well organized you have everything you need. Good place to stay if you want to be near the best of NY. Iryna is very kind.

Very lovely Place! Iryna made most out of this tiny but very comfortable flat :-) it was pretty Noisy due to contruction from the apartment next to it but thats definetely not the hosts fault! All in all good accomadation.
Right in the heart of New York! Great for a short stay - very quirky! Comfortable and warm x

The appartment was in the perfect place, right walking distance from everywhere if you want to walk. Iryna was helpful and fast to reply anytime we had questions, even being proactive to ask if we had arrived okay. The room is small and the building looked old, but I guess it's everywhere the same, but the fact of having the upper bed gives much more space to it. We can't complain about anything from our stay :)

I needed a place to stay near 3rd Avenue for one night and this location was perfect. I was surprised by how affordable it was and the place was clean. The shower was out of order but it wasn't an issue for one night and looked like it was fixed by the next day. All's well that ends well.
Check in was easy, location was great. This room makes very efficient use of the space. It’s cozy but it has everything you need and more. Even the book selection was good!
The location is everything. The place is cozy once you get there. Just beware of the bathrooms and the building stairs.

This flat worked well for a short stay. Everything was clean and well equipped. Host was totally responsive & excellent location. I was a bit old for the loft bed ladder and shared bath, but property would work great for a younger person.
Great stay! Perfect location, lots to do in the area and very close walk to the subway. Would absolutely stay here again!

Iryna was a great host for my sister and me. She responded very quickly and friendly to our requests. The instructions for self check-in were very easy to follow. The location of the accommodation is very central - lively but not crowded. Perfect for flexible, young people who are not put off by a bunk bed and shared showers and toilets. We loved it. :-) Thanks Iryna

Make sure you want to used shared bathroom, glad it was just across the hall.
And make sure you want to climb a ladder to the bed! Everything else was perfection
This was a great place to stay in a fun New York neighborhood. Iryna was a  great communicator and check in was easy
Very well located  and Iryna is a great host: very reactive and a problem solver.

This is a solid stay for any solo traveler. The apartment is small but comfortable and clean with a full kitchen, fridge and microwave. Understand that the shower and toilet situation is separate from the unit itself, on the same floor, but easily accessible and clean. For myself, as a solo traveler in town for work, this place is affordable and fits the bill for what I needed which was just a good nights sleep in a good neighborhood.

Iryna was very responsive by website message and was flexible with my checkin.  The loft bed was as advertised, but at 68 years old, I found I was not that comfortable with the high ladder and common floor bathroom across the hall when needed in the middle of the night.  My personal room was locked and secure, so I felt very safe.  This room was much more affordable than a hotel alternative.
Elena was great. The place is exactly as advertised and in an amazing location. Also great communication. So much to do in the area and also everything you’d need in there.

A cute and charming studio in an amazing neighborhood. The place is a bit small (it is a studio after all) but worked out fine for me as a single guest. You're in walking distance of amazing restaurants, bars, Prospect Park, and super close to the C line train which was awesome. Elana and Alesh were responsive and accommodating, which was much appreciated! A+ hosts for an awesome stay.

Elana and Mike were incredible hosts for my three months in their studio. They were super responsive if I had any issues and went out of their way to make sure I had everything I needed. The studio is incredibly spacious and had everything I could have needed for an extended stay, and Prospect Heights is beautiful, walkable, and just a short subway ride from Manhattan. I wouldn’t change a single thing about my stay and I can’t recommend Elana and Mike’s place highly enough.

Great and comfortable place. Very clean. We like the bathrooms were really good. We traveled with family and friends. Jeff is quick to responds and very accommodating. Gave us some suggestions on things to do. Very close to the F train. I do recommend it.

Our family of three couples loved the space. We had a great place to make coffee and tea (bring your own) , comfortable beds, and three bathrooms. The space is four flights. One bathroom is on the first floor two floors from beds. It worked well that each couple had their own bathroom with one agreeable couple using the first floor bathroom. Location was great to Time Square and Rockefeller Center. Walked home from our musical. Several cute restaurants around that we used for breakfast. Paris was very responsive.

This apartment is spectacular. I had the opportunity to spend Christmas with my family, and it's truly magical. Nearby restaurants offer excellent food and ambiance, and the host is truly great—constant communication and attentive to every need. All I can say is that this place is magical and very well located.

This is a lovely older home with plenty of space to stretch out, plus a nice communal area to gather. We were four couples celebrating a birthday, and everyone enjoyed their stay very much. It’s a great location, and everything you need is easily accessible. The host was always extremely responsive as well.
This place was absolutely amazing. The stairs were a little much but doable.  I would definitely come here again.

We loved our brief visit to Paris’ home - it’s very comfortable, and centrally located.  Was so easy to walk to the theater and restaurants.  A very roomy and comfortable house.  Loved everything about it and Paris was very responsive and helpful!  Looking forward to coming back soon.  🙏🏼
Paris’s place was exactly as described. Easy check in. Great location. Perfect for a large group of 8 to all stay together in the city. Would recommend and stay again!
Wonderful location, great for large family, close to everything Manhattan has to offer and very responsive host!

Exceptional host, an exceptional place. Paris was very responsive and proactive before and during our stay. For a party of 7 , this place was perfect. Had all the amenities and was centrally located. It was very easy to get to the subway for trips to Times Square, Chinatown, Brooklyn, LES, UES and FIDI. Would definitely stay here again.
We loved the place. Very spacious and easily handled my family of adults. Location is great near central station. Worked really well for us!

This town house is excellently situated in midtown for exploring New York. The accommodation is large and very comfortable and includes an outside yard and bbq. Close to a number of subway stations and surrounded by many good restaurants and bars it makes an excellent home from home.
Paris is a communicative and attentive host who responds swiftly to messages and request. For any large group visiting NYC I would recommend this property.
Great communication leading up to and during our stay. Location was fabulous. Super comfortable and everything needed for a great stay in New York was provided. Would highly recommend.

We celebrated our daughter’s college graduation and had many family members attending from out of state. The location is perfect to easily reach many parts of the city. Paris was accommodating and extremely easy to reach.

Very good service by Paris, extremely fast in response and always very polite answers.
Instructions were clear and the house looked better than the picture. Very beautiful place
We will definitely come back next year
Awesome option to stay near the main attractions of New York. Cute apartment, very well maintained and definitely met our needs!
Awesome house to stay!! Smells good when u walk inn very clean. And Gloria responds fast when you have a question.

Gloria was a great host! Stayed for a night there were no issues at all we liked the area close walking distance to deli. No issues with neighbors and found parking right in front of the apt. We asked for late checkout and she was able to accommodate us without any problems. We will definitely stay here again next time we come!

I highly recommend Glorias place. It is exactly as pictured, with a great vibe, and in a great location. Parking was easy to find, the neighborhood is friendly, and it only took us minutes to get everywhere we needed to go. Gloria is a great host, and was responsive and friendly anytime i had a question or request. Our group of 8 all agree that this is not only a budget friendly place we hope to stay at again, but would recommend to others as well. There were plenty of blankets, pillows, and towels, as well as nice touches like board games and streaming movies on tv... she even has coffee and tea for her guests. 5 out of 5 stars.
Thanks, Gloria
Gloria’s place was beautiful and just like pictures. There was enough space for all 11 people in our group. Everything was very nice and clean.
Listing said air conditioning, but the window unit was still sitting in the hallway uninstalled. Was early in spring, so it wasn't too bad and I assume this will be installed soon.

Gloria was very friendly, responsive and accommodating. The apartment was perfect for our group of 7 women. We were attending a conference in Manhattan and it was a quick Uber ride right to the venue or to the 2 train which left us across the street from the venue.  The place was very neat and clean and the living room was perfect for us to chit chat in the evenings. I would rent from Gloria again.

Gloria place is a nice accommodation for a budget friendly visit to New york. Its clean with well stock kitchen as well as enough linens. This place only has one private room. The other rooms are pass through but it worked well for us.

Vangelis was always very friendly and comprehensive.
Very reachable and respectful.
I highly recommend him as a host.
Imrul was such an amazing host! Super kind and considerate, he went above and beyond to make sure we always felt at home while staying at his place.

Great great experience. Imrul was responsive and the place really fit our needs. (We had an apartment fiasco -- wasn't ready when landlord said it would be -- and we needed a one month temporary place. This was just perfect for our needs!)

Lourdes apartment was perfect for me. Great location, clean and modern. The communication was just right. My husband and I travel often and I have to say, we enjoyed this stay the most.
Looking forward to another stay soon. This space is definitely a winner!!!! We'll be in touch Lourdes, be well.

The place was very cute and clean! It had all the amenities necessary and Lourdes responded very promptly as well. We arrived a little earlier than our check in and were able to leave our bags at the Airbnb which was very helpful.
