Lourdes is super friendly and nice. Apartment is clean and smell great. Location is good too, easy  to access and great security in the apartment. Will definitely recommend and come back if I have the chance
Great efficiency apartment, clean, bright, well stocked and well located.  Lourdes is, indeed, an exceptionally helpful and responsive host.  We will gladly stay there again!

I really like the studio, 5-6 min walking distance from my son’s apartment! Nice place, clean easy to access and I felt safe.
For sure I will book her place again when I will visit my son.

We loved our month at Lourdes place. Facilities were clean and bed was comfy.
Lourdes was friendly and very responsive to any queries.
Tony the PM was also very friendly and full of local knowledge.
Happily recommend.
I had a great stay here! It was both easy to get to Manhattan for work and to explore lots of Brooklyn. Lourdes was a great host!
Had great time staying at this place. The appartment was sparkling clean with all essentials in order. Its in a great location. Definitely recommend the place if you are planning a trip to NYC

We had a wonderful 5-week stay at Amri’s place! It was clean and fresh, free of clutter, and had everything we needed to be comfortable. One of the best locations in Williamsburg easily walkable to everything, two blocks from Domino Park, and very peaceful. The huge patio was a nice bonus, and the WiFi worked so well out there we could work outside on nice days. Amri and Jason were quick to respond to every question. Don’t hesitate to book!
The place looks exactly like the photos and was nice and clean. It was easy to check in and in a good location near the train. Lots of space and huge TV which was nice.

I enjoyed staying at this clean, beautifully decorated place! I loved the backyard it was cozy and lots of toys for our little one to play with. This location is easily accessible to Coney Island, it has a gated community beach as well all within walking distance. Very nice playground and basketball court inside the gated community. Alex and his wife are friendly and Alex always made sure we were comfortable. Overall a wonderful place to book! You won’t regret it!! 😊
I would use Brooklyn Evoke again. My guest and I had a wonderful experience. The host and the owner was friendly and helpful and the place was spacious.
We have no complaints. The place was clean, easy to access, and the neighborhood was quiet and secure.
It was far from nightlife in the city if that’s what you’re looking for, however very comfortable and clean overall.

The place was just what we wanted. It was in a nice, private area with great restaurants nearby. The rooms were comfortable and we had everything we needed. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back.
I love, love, love this place.  Whenever I return to Brooklyn this is where ill stay.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Seagate. It was a perfect fit for two small families. We enjoy dining on the back porch and the kitchen was well stocked.
Everything was spotless and we were grateful for the ACs! Check out was also very chill. We made sure it was generally tidy and the trash was taken out before leaving, but beyond that we were appreciative that there weren't a bunch of other clean up tasks as many other places have.
Would definitely recommend.
I would just note that the public beach is legit a fifteen minute walk (20-25 with little kid walking pace) , just outside the security gate. It's clearly noted in the description, but it's worth a mention because it looks so close on the map. (This is a me thing, but may be helpful for someone booking to consider). The beach in the community was $20 per person (including kids).
Place was very nice & spacious. Living room was cozy. It was easy to access the Airbnb and with private parking.

This space was perfect for the 3 month stay. Everything was as decribed and the host answered all questions even checking often to make sure we were comfortable.i would deff 10/10 stay here again with my team
The stay was very nice, I will definitely come again! The location is perfect and the communication with Guy is very easy. Thank you !

Great value, pleasant neighborhood, friendly hosts, very short walk to the station (more like 2-3 minutes vs. "1 minute" as stated in the listing). May not be a good choice for someone who's a light sleeper - even though the other lodgers are respectful of quiet hours, the dog downstairs isn't, and even just people walking in the hallway or up/down the stairs could be enough to wake a light sleeper. But it's adequate if you just need a bed and access to a basic kitchen and shared bathroom. I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again for a short visit. Overall I feel fortunate to have found it for the price.

Worth every pennies!!! The hosts went out of your way to make you fee comfortable. Great location the train is literally like 3 min walk. Soo much access to living space and the room are Cleann!!!!!. I love this trip mostly cause of the Airbnb.

Guy's place was a delight to stay in during my time in NYC! It was in a peaceful location in Astoria right by the river. There was a grocery store across the street and access to public transportation - buses and the ferry in a few minutes away. Everything about the listing matched the experience. I highly recommend staying here, especially if you're looking to access the different boroughs!

Easily to find location, clear and simple instructions and access. A bit noisy early mornings due to building construction site across the street during our stay. Travelling time to Manhattan was 35 min to 1 hour was reasonable to us and known before check in. Totally recommend Guy's place for visiting NY

Guy is a tremendous host, proactive, honest and very willing to ensure your stay is amazing.  how apartment is as described and very well maintained, clean and has everything you could need for a long term stay.  the neighborhood is developing and near city housing project which can rockin on the weekend evenings.  public Park along river is end of the street and perfect for dog walking or exercise.  Guy makes the stay well worth it

This was a great stay, very clean and comfortable. Getting to and from other parts of NYC is easy enough except during odd hours when the train service to the nearby station becomes somewhat limited. And pretty quiet for NYC.

I had a wonderful stay! The studio is lovely and very well appointed. I enjoyed the natural light of the space. You provided all the necessities and I enjoyed the touches of whimsy. If you’ll have me… I’d love to come again. Thanks for a great stay!

I had a great time staying at James&Laureta's for 3 nights.  Even though the Airbnb is a studio apartment, it is spacious enough to serve as a living/working space for two people. The space was very clean and hygienic. With a little effort, we were able to find street parking around the apartment and then used the subway to travel within NYC, the nearest subway stop being less than 5 minutes of walk.

Very cute studio apartment in BK/Bedstuy! Very clean & open so you can unpack comfortably!! Reasonably priced for the location (super close to MTA station and only a walk or a MTA stop or two away from lots of great BK food spots). Would absolutely stay again!
It was a wonderful experience and the atmosphere was serene just what I needed didn’t need to communicate because everything was done taughtfully

James and Lauren’s were responsive and good to deal with but unfortunately the place didn’t match expectations or the descriptions (especially of the area). I accept there is subjectivity in this and it was a new environment  for us however there is quite a bit of adverse commentary  on the neighborhood on the web that would be worth prospective visitors considering, alongside the hosts sunny descriptions.

This place is exactly as advertised. Really nice room, tastefully decorated, clean, comfortable bed. Thank you!
Would definitely stay here again.
Great area as well- lots and lots of restaurants and coffeeshops.
The neighbors were a bit loud at times, but that's to get expected.
James and Laureta's room was as advertised.  In walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops and what we found most helpful was that it was a 2-minute walk to get on and off the subway.  Thanks!

The studio was true to the description and a great place for 1 person to stay while in Brooklyn. The hosts were responsive and provided clear instructions.
The walls are thin in the house so it is a bit noisy but that is to be expected given the close quarters.
Thanks for a welcoming place to stay!
This place is so beautiful and in such a great location. Very clean and comfortable. Hosts were very responsive. I would love to come back!!
It was my first time using Airbnb and I'm so happy that my stay went smoothly. Very easy to follow their instructions and the overall experience met expectations.

Really nice stay on a peaceful street. Self checkin was easy. The walls are a little bit thin so you can hear the neighbors, but this is common in brownstones like this one. Great cafes and shops nearby!

We enjoyed our stay!
The description mentioned that this building is not very soundproof — that didn’t interfere with our sleep, but this is something to be mindful of if you are a light sleeper.

This was a quiet location. The subway was around the corner so getting around the city was easy. Communication was great and they greeted me at the door. Clean apartment and comfy beds. The kitchen was stocked with coffee cups, cleaning supplies and coffee and tea. They also left a welcome basket with snacks, sparkling cider and NY keepsakes. Also a nice card. We loved it. ❤️

They were very nice. Hanna was responsive all the time. In fact, the house super was an extreme gentleman. They have provided all the support we need. The only drawback I found is the location. They have provided all the essential commodities and welcome box, which surprised us all. Normally, other people in AirBnB don't do that. I wish them success!
We enjoy the place it was very nice and clean.  We really enjoyed the stay the subway was nearby.  I will definitely come back if I can. Thank you Ms. Hanna for everything.  Sonia C. 08/12/23

Thanks Joel for your house! A great location close to a kids playground, and a short walk from good places to eat, and a private parking lot which is hard to get in other places.
Joel was quick to respond to our questions, and explained how everything works in the house very clearly.

I reserved Leah’s place for my parents, who had a lovely stay. The apartment was clean, cozy, spacious, and clutter-free and Leah had helpful instructions laid out around the apartment. The area is quiet and lovely and the apartment is very close to the M train. Thanks Leah!
This place is so perfect . The location the apartment everything about it . The bed is so comfortable . The host is awesome also .

We enjoyed this place and could see ourselves staying again. We frequent NYC a couple times a year to visit family and it's great. The only concern was that the motion activated lights, at night they clicked on instantly. Other than that the experience was awesome.
This was the second time the apartment was booked, Moise was a great host, helpful and kept great communication. Nice apartment and clean. I recommend Moise as a host!
Amazing place. Looks just like the picture. It was peaceful and clean. Effortless checkin. I would stay there again.
Amazing! Every detail was as advertised. The host were amazingly responsive and friendly. Super private and I love that. I would recommend 10/10 this home.

Nice place. I felt very comfortable. Parking was not the best. Would’ve preferred a designated area. And no washcloths only 2 towels. My mistake for not packing my own. Otherwise good stay. I would definitely stay again when we visit.

The location is very easy to find ;close to all the action of Manhattan but also feels private and for New York standards very quiet. Luis was the best host, very communicative and helpful explaining the surroundings places of interest, Luis made sure that everything was set before leaving providing extra sheets and left us a lovely bottle of wine. Airbnb pictures do not give it justice. The place is spacious rooms are a good size very accommodating if you’re coming to stay with a larger group. I would definitely recommend staying in this airbnb!
Great location. Quiet and cozy. The host Luis took care of all the requirements and inquiries during the stay. Most of all, extremely cost-efficient if you have a big group
Great place! It’s very hard to find a spacious triple bedroom place in such perfect location in NYC. Parking across the street, very good amenities. Definitely going back to it when I’m im the city.

I highly recommend Luis' place.  It is clean, comfortable, spacious and in the heart of Manhattan.  The apartment is located in a quiet street but walking distance to great restaurants and bars and close to everything touristy you may want to do in NYC. The host is very responsive and flexible.  We appreciated his long list of recommendations for spots to visit and places to eat. Also, it is very convenient that there is a parking garage across the street for those who drive in the city but want to park their car during their stay.
We enjoyed our stay at Luis’ place. It was in a quiet neighborhood yet a hop, skip, and a jump to everything!
Wonderful place that is walking distance to many great dining establishments and coffee places. Luis put together a comprehensive list of places to go and things to see. Highly recommend

This was a FABULOUS and perfect Airbnb for our party of six. It’s ground level, secure, clean, comfortable, and in an awesome quiet neighborhood. It’s hands down the best Airbnb I have stayed in, in New York. I highly recommend this place and hope to come back!

Our stay was very nice. We stayed in 'Shirley 4 President.' It was a gorgeous room, very spacious, and had heaps of natural light. The neighborhood was awesome and it was walkable to lots of great restaurants. If you don't mind sharing a bathroom with lots of people, then this is a great deal and a pleasant stay.

My bedroom was really large, sunny, and comfortable. There were snacks and water in the room, which I really appreciated. The location is great; just a few blocks to a wonderful tea shop (Brooklyn tea), lots of bustling areas, train lines, a really nice peaceful park, etc.
Michelle’s place really made our trip. Super close to transit, a 10 minute walk to the subway to Manhattan that’s super reliable and easy to ride. A very cozy, quiet, clean room.

A but noisy , but not far to Manhattan , people are kind !
Not dangerous at all!
You can spend a few day easily

Jaspreet was a great host and communicated well. The listing is accurate and neighborhood seems safe. Host provided a clear detailed of the stay and it’s amenities. Also gave food and bar suggestions in the area. Overall wonderful stay felt like home away from home

The stay at this Airbnb was an absolute treat. The pictures perfectly show and describe the Airbnb as it is! Great location, close to everything you need and great food delivery choices all nearby. One of my favorite things about this Airbnb was how cozy it felt; my guest and I had a very wonderful time. Thank you Jaspreet!
great place !! secure clean very modern . Jaspreet was execlent answered every question and help me with the parking in the back of the unit .

This is an extreme value. The place was very cute and quaint, exactly like the photos. The location was great. We had no issues with parking- I'm not sure why other reviewers said there was some confusion or difficulty. The area was quiet, walkable to everything you needed. We would definitely stay here again. Jaspreet was available and helpful, very friendly.

This was not our first time staying here. We’re repeat guests because we really like this little spot. It’s very cozy, has everything we need and the private parking in the back just seals the deal for us every time. Jaapreet is very responsive and it really matters to us that hosts pay attention to details like providing shampoo/conditioner/body wash. It’s nice to have the option even if we don’t need it; but in this situation we actually forgot our own so it worked out well.
One of the best stays this host is the best and everything is just how it seems in the photos a must stay again

Even though I only stayed for a couple of hours, the host was very responsive and welcoming during my entire stay. it's a very peaceful and quite neighborhood and the property has all of the essentials

The space is perfect for 2 people, comfortable, clean and well stocked. I recommend and be back on our next trip to NYC. Communication was great and our host was very accommodating to our schedule and needs

Jaspreet was a wonderful host! Always responded very quickly. But also a great communicator, makes you feel comfortable, safe, and right at home. The place was very beautiful just as the pictures. I’d Recommend this to anyone!
My stay was amazing, area was very modern & clean!! Jaspreet was very sweet & responsive. Definitely recommend!!

Jaspreet’s was a wonderful host, his place was exactly as described, very clean, and felt very safe. Would definitely come back. The only downside we had, and it wasn’t under Jaspreet’s control, was the creaking and drain pipe noises coming from upstairs since we stayed at the basement level.
Jaspreet was very responsive and friendly! The space was easy to access and very clean.
ABSOLUTELY LOVED this place. Communication with the host was 10/10. Neighbours is amazing. Close to the airport. The stay is absolutely beautiful and super clean. Will be coming back!
Very great place, comfortable, the host will respond quickly if you need anything, and the neighborhood is quiet and places to eat near by will stay there again.

Jas was a great host! The place was clean, it had a full kitchen with a proper oven so we cooked many of our meals at home. The area is quite safe and close to all types of public transport, the bus stop is literally outside the house. Definitely recommend this place! 10/10 points.

One of the best airbnb i stayed at. Overall apartment, communication was great and the location was perfect. The outside was a bit loud due to neighbors but that’s just the city. Would and probably repeat my stay with this listing!

Telmo is an excellent and responsive host. The place was in pristine condition when we arrived. Great location in Bushwick, less than a five minute walk to the L subway line and plenty of restaurants within walking distance.
Telmos place was great. Everything was clean and neat. The host was available at all time and helped immediately if a problem occurred. Would definitely recommend for long and short stays.

We had a great stay at Telmo’s Airbnb! The place was clean and cozy and conveniently located. There was a laundromat and thrift store right next door and a subway stop only a 3 min walk away. Communication with the host was easy, would recommend!
Second time staying with Telmo awesome host very great unit would stay again easy access to everything that is Brooklyn, New York!

Priscilla and Ray were excellent hosts—incredibly kind, flexible, and helpful. I will definitely stay with them again, and recommend their place to anyone who's looking for a place in the area! Beautiful views and peaceful feel.

Beautiful property most especially the patio. My husband and two babies stayed here- my only concern and heads up would be there is no door to the one bedroom. We found it difficult with the babies. But truly a perfect space for a couple by themselves. Hosts are extremely friendly and respond promptly. They also provide just about everything, shampoo, conditioner, hand soap, dish soap, etc. I was pleasantly surprised by this and wish I had packed less lol
Fanta is an excellent host and responds to messages super fast. The apartment was super clean and neat. I will definitely be staying there again the next time I’m in New York.
the location is quite noisy and the isolation internally and externally is not sufficient. The host was great and helpful.

Such a steal for a quick stay in the city. It’s at a great location in Tribeca, but you do hear the sounds from the street. Complementary ear plugs are provided but I didn’t need them as I was pretty tired and a deep sleeper. The room was great and the check in and check out was a breeze.

Buyer beware there isn’t central heat or cool in this building unless over 70 or under 55 in the room per hotel staff. They did let us know we had a portable heater in our room but it still was super cold at night after they supposedly turned on the heat. We stayed in October I can’t imagine what the true NYC winter is like here.The room itself was rundown with frayed towels and sheets and the room felt like a closet for 2 people. The staff was very nice and accommodating but overall this place is super expensive for what you’re getting. The big upside here is being close to the subway station right outside. You decide if it’s worth it.

Really cool space, location is amazing, clean, easy check in. Honestly everything was really good except the noise at night which is pretty common in SoHo or most of NYC. The front desk is really cool though they have complimentary ear buds to help.
very responsive and friendly. Bed very comfortable and bathroom very clean and nice. I would stay there again.
Small room but perfect for a one night stay in Manhattan. Hosts were very helpful and responsive. Subway right outside the front door of building. Great value overall. Enjoyed my stay!
Great place to say for our concert at Madison square garden. Right at the Q and N train Canal St stop. Tons of restaurants and shops around and great for the price. Would definitely stay again!
great last minute option and would be a great first choice. a little bit of an odd layout, but very comfortable!
As advertised. I stayed on the eight floor, so there wasn't too much street noise. The room was small but perfectly suited my needs. Would happily stay here again.
Good location. Near to China town , Wall Street . But the price is really high 186 dollars (I think because of Saturday). Room is not big , like hongkong hotels size .

Great little base to explore Manhattan for the price you pay. The room we had was small, but if you're just looking for somewhere to sleep that's very central and a good location for subway stations, then it's perfect.

I really enjoyed my stay here it was very calm, quiet and clean. The bathroom was beautiful bed was comfortable and it was a nice view from the room. Room was smaller than expected but if you plan on going out alot like we did its more than okay. Theres so much nearby everything is walking distance. Overall 8.7/10 for the room and i would stay here again value for price is very good. Thanks so much to the host for communicating and giving me a later check out as well:)

Only in town for a night, made it very comfortable for a quick turnaround!
I would stay there again for sure!

Pretty loud and can hear the streets all day and night. Gets hot and no way to turn it down.
People at front are awesome though!

I dont like this place , It is good location but Hotel is very dirty and smelly ! I And If You checked out and they dont keep the luggage for you. You have to pay $5 each luggage! Not helpful at all . I am not recommended

I overall liked my stay but the listing didn’t match the room I stayed in at all, my room was much smaller than the photos in the listing showed. It’s worth it for the price and the host was very responsive. Would go there again!
Staff was friendly and the room was okay, but there were lots of blood stains on my blanket and the bathroom towels were dirty.
Very friendly welcome, to NYC. The room was clean and just what I needed. Good location right next to a subway to go anywhere in the city.

Great location! Nice host, everything went smooth w my stay! Close to Tribeca, I loved walking there. I’ve had pretty much great view from my window. Felt like I was having a true NYC experience w diversity of cultures, mix of cuisines. Loved the architectural style of buildings in the neighborhood. Suggested.

A great place to stay and very accessible location! Easy to walk or take the subway to many neighbors across NYC! This Airbnb operates just like a hotel. They were able to accommodate a late checkout which helped us out a lot

This was my first time coming to New York and for it being so last minute I loved the stay . The place was nice and clean and the front desk was so friendly he chatted with my boyfriend and I definitely made us feel so welcomed. I love the room we got and I will be staying again hopefully soon .

Bad place for a family. At night the neighborhood looked insecure and very dirty (more than the average Manhattan).
The room was not very clean. The Tv didn’t work at all, and the internet connection was lousy. The room was cold and the heating was not enough.
The pictures didn’t match.
Stains in the carpet.
Very noise.
Too much for the price.

Location pretty good, close to a lot , easy to navigate, not in the most upscale area but still felt safe. Room was nice and clean. Only complaint front desk girl was rude and indifferent, we were really excited to be there and she was just not friendly.
Great location,  easy to get around city.  exactly what  I needed.  clean and cozy.
My stay here was wonderful. The host had great communication and the location, for the price, is unbeatable in Manhattan.
This hotel is in a great location, right outside is a subway station and you’re really close to lots of good food. Room was small but fit my boyfriend and I pretty comfortably. Overall a good stay :)
Host was so accommodating . We enjoyed our stay! Near a lot of great areas. Would recommend to anyone
super convenient location located right outside of subway entrance. close to Manhattan chinatown and city vibe where all the street vendors are. comfy bed and a good one for budget stay in NYC.

Great deal. Right next to the NQRW lines. Front desk was friendly, and room was surprisingly clean (windows were a bit dusty but I didn’t touch them).
Note: *really heed their warning not to place your room card next to your phone.* I slipped mine into my phone case during an early jog and got locked out of my room because the card stopped working.

SoHoBlu’s is in the heart of a busy, vibrant area. Proximity to transport is perfect with a selection of train lines close by.
The welcome and helpfulness throughout my stay made a huge difference as I was travelling on my own.
I would definitely recommend this listing.

For the price and the location it's a phenomenal value. But prepared to be in a very small room and not a great bathroom (clean but bare minimum).
I would have given it more stars but I had to wait 45 mins for the host to check in after a long day at the office.

This place canceled on the morning of my check in. Left me with the hellish task of getting airbnb to rebook me so I wouldn't be homeless in NYC. I wouldn't be booking with them or ANY AIRBNB. They wanted to give me a refund only and I had to fight for another booking. With crazy service and cleaning fees and now this.... DONE with airbnb. Their days are numbered.
Great location, the host was very friendly and helpful. The place was close to Soho shopping street. Clean and spatious room.
Dope spot shout out Lucas was super chill at the check in, good vibes & environment for a minimalist like myself .
Can highly recommend SoHoBlu, booked and arrived within 2 hours and they were very helpful accomodating me for my emergency stay. Excellent service and helpful staff!

My flight got delayed 8 times before it got canceled due to weather so I wasn’t even in New York City when my reservation started. I was stuck in the airport for 17 hours over something completely out of my control and they will not refund me.
Place was small but close to everything and half the price from any other hotel or BnB we could find. Great communication

I reserved this last minute for pride. It's definitely worth the money. It's conveniently located next to chinatown, with accessibility to multiple rail lines like the A, Q, N, R, just to name a few. Also Twenty four hour 7-11 just a block away.
And the staff were very friendly
Very accommodating with late check-in time due to flight cancellation. The guy working the front desk was very friendly & helpful. Rooms look like the pictures.
Great place to stay, Affordable, and comfy. Just a bit noisy, but that’s to be expected in NYC.
Horrible would never stay again. Dingy tiny can hear everything in the next room. Tiny I mean TINY room. Nasty feels just dirty and run down. NEVER Again
The place is nice for a few days get away in NY. It’s smaller than expected.   Front desk was very responsive.

great place, value for money.
good location.
i recommend for short stay.

The place is at the heart of Chinatown, well positioned to explore south Manhattan by foot and with excellent subway connections at canal street station. The apartment is small but adequate and very clean.
Cool Hotel at the Border of Chinatown to Tribeca, if you like noisy Streets like I do. ✌🏼🥰

Affordable, comfortable place with a great location (super walkable and right beside a subway station)! Room was clean, and was well air conditioned and even came with a portable fan. Affordable compared to other places in NYC!
very good area if you want to stay in the city, cool restaurants and shops around and the hosts were very responsive. would recommend and would definitely book again.

Great price for a place in Manhattan, and located conveniently near a number of subway trains. We had an amazing weekend stay here and the front desk was always responsive and accommodating. The room was comfortable and worked perfect for a short stay in the city!

I have never stayed in NYC at an Airbnb. Thus I was apprehensive. I chose this place because it was only a few blocks from my daughter’s Lafayette dorm. I was so impressed with the check-In process, gentleman at the entrance, responsiveness to my wifi situation, flexibility to. check out late, and overall clean and friendly place. I had the 7th floor, corner unit so it was quiet and safe.
I will definitely stay here again. Thank you to the folks for making it so comfortable.

This place was perfect for me. I'm a podcaster so when I travel to NYC it's usually for podcasting stuff, which means I travel alone. The room is small but it's all I need for one person (though 2 people could use it). And I LOVE that I don't have to share a bathroom with other guests (kind of unusual for a NYC room). Shower worked great and was wonderful hot water. Reliable internet, comfortable bed, and...THE PLACE WAS CLEAN. It's an older building but everything worked and I'll definitely be planning to stay here on future visits.

For the price, this location was perfect. The bed was super comfortable and clean. The bathroom was clean and the host was super responsive with providing more towels upon request. The room is a good size for one traveler or a couple. It is noisy but thats NYC for you! Would definitely come back 😊

Could have been a little bit more updated for the cost, though the staff were nice and helpful. There were sounds of traffic, but we had no problems going and staying asleep. Could hear people in the hallway but not in nearby rooms. Overall it was a good place to stay and was as advertised.

Perfect location close to the subway and very clean. The room was a little bit small but perfect for a short visit to NY. It wasn’t as noisy as I was expecting it to be by reading the other comments. I would definitely stay there again if im passing by NY again.

good price pour the location, place is clean, people do their jobs and dont ask questions
could be appreciated in the future:
- toothpaste
- ac control (was hot)
also, shower was too strong, hard to avoid flooding the whole bathroom
would come again! thanks

We enjoyed our stay and the little space heater kept the room super warm. It was loud until about 1 am but we were tired and the supplied ear plugs helped. Great price for a very assessable location. It worked great for us and will stay there again.

Good place for its price. Excellent location in the heart of Manhattan. After dark, the area immediately outside is a bit uncomfortable to walk around alone. If you are using a cab after dark then it is just fine!
It wax exactly as advertised, which is always nice. For a place in a good spot in NYC, you can't beat it. We'll definitely stay again.
Great stay, room as described and in photos, clean, staff very helpful. Noise from street is significant; otherwise this place was great.

The instructions were very simple and clear on checking in and out. During the day there is always someone at the reception for helping out if something is needed. The room was big enough for two people and also very comfy bed. The metro is close by as well as lower Manhattan. We really liked our stay!

The location is vibrant and convenient. The staff at check in and out were very friendly. No bells and whistles here, just a place to rest your head and access all the city has to offer. This hotel is truly meant for young travelers looking to enjoy nyc nightlife. If you are here on business or with a family I would personally select a different hotel.
No shade been thrown, just honesty.
Very small but good value for money in NYC. Right by the metro station, so easy to get around. Very loud though since walls are paper thin.
eaay to find next to a subway and near little italy and chinatown.. place was just small and you needed to get some of the stuff you need downstairs but overall good for budget

As a solo traveler, this place is the best! The greatest location and being very close to all of the attractions and walkable distance! Great restaurants and bars nearby and best part.. the subway station is right at the main door! For those who love to travel solo or need a small space for yourself and still be able to be near everything, this is the place! Thank you again for a memorable stay!! Will definitely be returning back here again soon!

Soho garden hotel was a good spot for my sister and I for a few days in NYC. Amazing location.
Folks working there were kind. Didn’t find it super noisy, we slept well.
My complaints: no safe in the room even though it was advertised, dirty bathroom and AC was absolutely blasting… we had to layer up to go to bed lol.
It was my first time in New York and I had a fantastic time! This place is super solid and simple and you are in the middle of Manhattan so that's great! Will definitely be back!
Close to all the good things SoHo has to offer and subway lines all within a 5 minute walk away so it’s easy to get around the whole city.

This location was a good balance of great location and adorable price that fit my needs for this trip to NYC. Their quick and clear communication as well as flexible check-in times are strong assets of this stay. I am grateful!
Hotel was right next to metro station. Staff is friendly. Community fridge was nice to have. Souvenir stores, vendors, and restaurants nearby. Noisy at night but they provide you with earplugs.

A really good stay, everything as promised in a great location. Basic, but clean, comfortable and secure, and properly air conditioned throughout my stay (which was absolutely crucial in very hot conditions).
Both my original booking, and then an extension to my stay were short notice, but staff were extremely communicative and helpful in both instances in accommodating that.

Fairly decent place for the price. The room was clean enough and so was the bathroom. I got what I paid for. Wasn't a very big fan of the neighborhood, however. Too many people surrounding the front of the place just to sell you stuff.
Room was clean and the front desk workers were very kind and helpful! Hotel is also in a great location with a train station located steps away!
Honestly it wasn’t what I expected. It was a great spot, especially at such a last minute. Hidden gem really.

Extremely well worth the price… very cozy and centrally located to everything a subway entrance is literally outside the door very convenient! This will be my go to spot on my next visit to NY… definitely recommend it!
great location and in the heart of  heart of Soho and all great trend shopping very close by. plenty of restaurants. For food I recommend going to Odd Sister and Citizens of Soho.

Great stay, simple and affordable
One thing - some rooms can get quite cold in the summer (65 degrees in my room during the day and colder at night) with the AC on, so you can (and should) ask for a space heater
Was a nice place to stay. The only problem are the hawkers in front of the building car calling women.
Was there during fashion week so maybe that’s why it’s a bit expensive but other than that a clean safe place to stay in the city close to everything

Great space near everything. Perfect room for one person to sleep after exploring much of the city.
Very friendly staff
Good and cheap and close to subway is all you’ll need in the big Apple and this place meets all. Will stay again.

The Hotel was perfect to stay in the heart of Manhattan. The bathroom was bigger than expected and the unadvertised view on the city was amazing! The staff was proactive and immediately helped us with our special assistance request.

Conveniently located near to subway, fun bars cafes etc. Room is functional and good for a couple of people. The bed was soft and comfortable. Bathroom was decent with high pressure and hot water, but drainage was inefficient. Carpets inside hotel were stained and dirty looking.
Note: the noise from the street (we were second floor) was exceptionally loud even though the windows were closed. Fortunately the hotel provides ear plugs.

Very noisy spot, did not match the pictures what so ever. And prepare for a dirty room. I ended up finding panties in my room which told me right away they don’t clean the space enough. As soon as you step in you’ll see the stains in the carpet and the lack of cleanliness overall.

The accommodation was spacious and it met all expectations except the street was really noisy. We were warned about that and got earplugs for free. I still did not sleep really well. It is something that the guest should count with if he or she decides to stay at SoHoBlu.

We recently stayed at SohoBlu for a week in late November / early December and it was a great experience. Our room was warm and really clean and also aesthetically pleasing. Beds very comfortable.
The location, right next to the metro, is super convenient. While there's some traffic noise, it wasn't loud to bother (plus they gave us earplugs but we didn't use them).
We highly recommend SohoBlu for anyone looking for a comfortable stay in the city.

Terrible deal , terrible host
No heat no consideration stay far away from this host or hotel comfort all together
They refused to give me even $1 back after paying $500 a night for a room with no heat
I will be challenging the payment
Great place , I stay here all the time with my boy friend & we love it ❤️just to get a good night rest & everything is near by . I love it.
Staff and place overall was very solid, convenient, thoughtful, generous and caring.  Far better than I expected!

AC and heat don't work. The Device of the room temperature its fake. If you need to turn down the temperature in the winter you need to open the window because it gets so hot that is the only way for you to sleep
Easy and great place to stay if you are looking for a quick trip at an affordable price. Only downside is that the AC was broken but it you could crack a window to offset the heat. Highly recommend.
Everything was great except the central heating. It was too warm all the time and in such a tiny space, it was very challenging.
Very nice people at the desk especially for late check ins. Very great for the price. Really liked my stay
This incredible find in the heart of soho/chinatown was by far the best place we have ever stayed in NYC, and we will be booking here for Fashion Week every year.
Very central, easy to access. Host was responsive and helpful. Room was small but clean and functional and definitely worth the price.
The sheets were wrinkly and there was hair on all the towels. If you’ve ever been to a Red Roof Inn, it’s like that, but in SoHo.

I absolutely loved my stay at SoHoBlu. Check-in was extremely easy, hosts and staff were super friendly and accommodating. I couldn't believe what a great value it was for New York City. I will definitely be back!

I stayed here for two nights and can say that it satisfied every need I had for that time. Very nice responsive people at the counter always available, and an overall great experience. Also a great deal at the price point it is at. Thank you!
For the amount I paid, this was not worth it. The AC doesn’t work at night, which is when you really need it. Im a hot sleeper, and a Summer trip in NYC needs AC.

I had a very good experience at this Airbnb. The location was very good — super convenient and well connected to all the major NYC sights and neighborhoods.
The room was clean, well-equipped, and thoughtfully arranged, with useful little details like a kettle, hand sanitizer, TV, and even a portable fan to complement the central AC — a lifesaver during the heatwave. The host was responsive and provided extra towels and anything else I needed upon request.
Overall, it had everything you need for a comfortable stay, and the combination of great amenities and an unbeatable location made it an easy choice. Would definitely stay again!

We had a fabulous time. The place was beautiful, everything was brand new. I was so impressed with some items in the place that I ordered them for my house. Bruce was a great host!! It is in a super fun neighborhood with so many neat places to see and explore. Also the corner store had everything you could ever image, amazing fruits I have never seen before. I highly recommend this place and will be using it again.

The unit is just as pictured. Fully updated and clean. Super clean. Also very comfortable, I slept so well.
Bruce was a great host, easy communication and even allowed us to leave our bags because of an issue with our next Airbnb.
10/10
Bruce is a fantastic host!  The place is beautiful and very comfortable.  Plenty of great food within walking distance.  100 percent would stay again!
This is a great place if you’re looking to stay in Queens. It was right around the corner from our son’s place. Likes close proximity to the subway and having a grocery next door was awesome too

Bruce is a super host for a reason ! He gets it! As a fellow super host and hotelier , I highly recommend this property. The subway two blocks away made this suburban stay all with while. Local restaurants only a five minute walk away that stood out included Zenith Thai, Pattanian Thai and Rustica Taverna. Will be back again on our next NYC trip.

Bruce’s place is absolutely beautiful. Exactly as described and perfectly clean. He was easy to communicate with and we especially loved how quiet the building and the street were. The neighborhood is friendly and safe, with parks within walking distance. Highly recommend.

Suliman is a very responsive, respectful, and accommodating host. He made sure that everyone was comfortable and safe. The house was extremely clean and the stay was cozy. I would recommend this location to anyone wishing to stay in this area. There’s a train and bus nearby so you can get to other parts of the city relatively fast and the beach is walking distance so you’ll have a lot to do.

We had a wonderful month long stay at Noomi in Chelsea. It's in such a great spot, close to everything and the trains. The apartment had everything we needed from cookware in the kitchen, to closet space, to small table and desk to work from, to a large tv in the bedroom and really appreciated the 2 balconies to get fresh air. The free laundry in the basement is a huge plus. Having 2 sets of keys was really helpful. The wifi was always super fast and reliable. Noomi made sure we had everything we needed during our stay. Would stay at this or another Noomi location again in the future.
It’s a small cute place in Chelsea, has good internet and nice bed. I was working so didn’t actually spend too much time there. Location is amazing. Tastefully appointed.
I stayed for here for work. Place is in a great location, close to the subway. Lots of restaraunts around. Would highly recommend.
great find , didn’t have the pleasure of meeting but this was definitely worth it for the price and would recommend !!
It was a nice place to stay at. Difficult to find parking, but Suliman alleviated my worries by telling me it was okay to park on the side next to his building. Didn't get a ticket, so 10/10.

loved staying at suliman's place. he was very accomodating regarding check-out, even offered a later check-out. he provided towels and small bars of soap which was a lovely gesture. kitchen was clean and well organised. bathroom was clean. o have stayed in the area before and it's close to two subway stops and there's plenty of markets/bodegas in the area.

Nice and clean place. Bathroom and kitchen were extremely clean. Shower had super good water pressure. Good location metro stations are in walk-able distance.  Lots and lots food places around. Next time I need to stay in south Brooklyn, I'll try to book Suliman's place again.
Very welcoming host! I stayed only for 1 night but Suliman was very responsive to all my questions and updates. Warm cozy place and  safe neighborhood, walking distance from beach.

Perfect for a quick stay! Excellent well-serviced location. Smooth check-in. Very clean.
What makes this spot special is the host, Suliman; an extremely friendly guy who was very helpful, responsive, and even offered flexible check-out since I needed a few more hours to pack and leave.
Highly recommended!
Very responsive host helped us out either alot of inconvenience that airbnb had brought us through would definitely book again clean and and felt very comfortable sadly i only booked one day
Suliman was a great host.He provided place clean and tidy plus had all the aminities

Suliman is a very kind and welcoming host. He was proactive to make sure he was available for my late check-in time. He definitely puts in effort to make his guests feel at-home! The house is a nice space with four bedrooms and two shared full baths. One of the bathrooms had a strange smell though. The room is a good size and well-furnished. The place is about a 15 minute walk from the subway Q train. The only concern is that the bedroom door can't be locked when away. However, I think that is in compliance with NYC law. It was a good place to spend the weekend!

Noom’s apartment was spotless and well kept, with a good amount of space for New York City especially in Chelsea. The host was very communicative. The building as well as the surrounding area were also very clean. The location couldn’t be better, close to everything you might need. I would definitely stay here again!
I will stay again in a heart beat. Very clean and organized. He provided snacks and beverages. He also showed me in himself.
Michael's place was very nice and clean. The amenities available to the guest provided by Michael exceed expectations.
Was a great stay! Host was very helpful and clean! The place was stocked to the nines with amenities and even had snacks! Definitely one of the best stays
Our stay was in and out but Micheal was pleasant and check in was fast and easy. Micheal place is as described… Clean and put together. Totally satisfied with out stay.
Perfect stay! Very accommodating and professional. Super clean and comfortable Recommend to anyone visiting the Brooklyn area!

We had a great time at Elijah’s place!
A bit outside of Manhattan but definitely easy to reach with the subway.

This location was perfect for me and  my friend. Everything we needed was in walking distance. The train was right down the street so we hopped on it every chance we could to go out places further. The host was easy to talk to and responsive. I most definitely would stay here again!

Whenever visiting we will stay again !!
The host was responsive. We truly enjoyed our stay . This air bnb was perfect for us. If ever in. The NewYork area give this place a try you will not be disappointed.

We stayed at Sedons for our NY City visit. Sedons flat was exactly as displayed and described here - we did not miss a thing. The check in was easy and we felt Secure in the house. Sedons replys super fast to questions and is a very helpful host.
Unfortunately, Jamaica was not the neighbourhood we felt super safe in (not Sedons fault) and it took us quite a while to get to Manhattan. So we absolutely can recommend Sedons flat but would not choose to stay in Jamaica again.
Shanti is a great host and the room is exactly as described. Location is great and with the public transportation you can get anywhere you want to in the city.
We loved Shanti’s home, it was clean and very esthetically pleasing. The bed is super   comfortable. Definitely recommend this stay.  One of the best Airb&B I’ve ever stayed in.
Shanti was very helpful and the room was quite clean and comerfortable，the living room was spacious and we did not have opportunity to see other guests. thanks to Shanti， hope to see you again.
Shanti is very helpful and is polite when reminding the house rules. I highly recommend staying here as there is not a better place to go when on a budget.

Roberts place was amazing super close to the beach. There’s was many wonderful restaurants in walking distance and plenty of things to enjoy. I would totally stay here again and would recommend it to any one looking to stay in rockaway beach.

This was my second time staying at Robert’s place and I love the proximity to the beaches and great bars and cafes. It’s super basic which I love - has everything you need for a great beach getaway for a few days at a decent rate as everything has blown up in the area over the last ten years.

The space looks newly renovated and is very clean. Makes me think this is a new renal for this and a few reasons; there were no checkin/checkout details, had all brand new linens, towels, dishes, the gas stove wasn’t hooked up which was a disappointment. Hamza did let me check in early though which was great! Communication when promoted was fine
Fabulous location and great price for the size, amenities and centralized stay. Easy to get anywhere in the city.

The location is great - very close the subway, restaurants, and grocery stores. The street is quiet. The studio was very clean when I arrived and Jay communicated very well during all my stay. The only bad thing is that it was pretty hot at some points during the summer. Overall it was a good stay.
Cozy place, great area. I really enjoy staying at Jozef place. Great location near to two subway stations so you can connect to almost everywhere in Manhattan. I really recommend you the place.
The place was good... enough for 8 people ( adult & kids ) in midtown for a short trip. The beds were decent, a small kitchen and private bathroom made it comfort stay.
Henri is very communicative and reponds quickly. Our room was clean and the location is in the center of everything.

Clean and safe and easy access to attractions via subway. Got there easily walking from Penn station.  Water was lukewarm in shower, and bathroom teeny tiny but it is NYC.  Crowds for week after Christmas were almost unbearable but we still had fun. We were a family of 5 trying to enjoy the sights.

This condo was in the perfect location and was exactly like in the pics. There were 4 of us gals staying and it was just enough space. The view of the Empire State Building was impressive and you can literally walk to Time Square in minutes. Safe neighborhood and great staff when you arrive. I can’t think of one negative thing to say about this place and highly recommend it! I will definitely stay here again on my next trip!
It was exactly what we needed. Took the Amtrak, arrived to Penn Station and walked an easy 2 blocks.

This was the perfect spot for our group. With 4 adults and 4 kids we were able to all have a space to sleep. Yes it’s small, but you’re in NYC and aren’t hanging out in the room anyways. The bathroom is tight, especially the shower, but there was plenty of hot water for 8 humans to clean up and enough towels to dry off with. There is also a decent size closet to store your bags in so they aren’t in the way. Henri was very responsive and helpful!!! Being able to leave luggage with his staff before and after check-in was the best amenity, especially since the subway is so close.
Henri’s place is situated at a great location with many restaurants around the area, and also easy access to subway.

Great location right in the heart of Korea Way. Henri made everything super easy with clear instructions. There’s parking structures nearby that you can park if you’re driving in. But overall it is walking distance to transit and major hot spots like the Empire State Building!
The place was more spacious in person and fit my family of 6 comfortably at an affordable rate. Overall this was a great spot if you’re okay with getting cozy with your traveling party

This is a prime location closer to many attractions, restaurants and subway. The place was clean, the host was very responsive, and it had everything what you need for a couple days of stay. We were very happy and will certainty stay again.
Great walking location. We had 4 people and i don’t know that I would want to comfortably sleep more than that! But for the price, it was a great deal for the 4 of us.
This was my first time in NYC and Henri made my stay enjoyable.  There was a lot to do near the room, easy access to the subway, and the staff is friendly.  Henri is the place to book!

It is a nice apartment. It is spacious, cozy and comfortable with all of the essentials and some thoughtful additional touches. I enjoyed my long weekend. Maxine is a great host who is communicative and responsive. I would stay here again.
Amazing host, located close to the subway, lots of great food around! Could’ve used a full size mirror because I like to dress up and see what I look like, but wonderful stay nonetheless!

The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Maxine was just the perfect host; she was responsive and very thoughtful. Anything we needed she was willing to provide.
She provided umbrellas for the rainy day and provided great information about restaurants and stores around the apartment. I would stay here again and highly recommend her apartment for anybody looking for a clean and convenient place to stay with a great host.

Maxine was wonderful.  Not only did she let us check in early, but she personally met us at the building to give us the keys and show us which one was for which door.  She even offered to have someone carry my bag up the stairs for me!  The place was very clean, and there were snacks, along with bottled water and canned food.  Maxine checked with us the next day to make sure everything was okay and to see if there was anything she could do to help make our stay more enjoyable.  I have yet to have a more courteous or helpful host.

My girlfriend and I really enjoyed our stay here. Maxine is a wonderful host! She really made us feel right at home. Both the building and apartment are really well kept, the subway is close, and the bed was comfy. There is also a laundromat and coffee shop a block away, which made it an all-around great spot for our extended stay!

Great studio in the heart of the east-village. I stayed here for roughly 6 months for an exchange semester at nyu. The location was great, plenty restaurants and bars nearby and 12 min walking to nyu campus. I can only recommend it.

I stayed here from February to August of 2024. Jeremy is an A+ host. Any time I had an issue he was responsive within an hour, if not 5 minutes. The space is amazing, too! Large kitchen, queen bed, and nice living room and desk area with TV. Jeremy even provided me a second monitor while I studied for the NY bar exam. Highly recommend this stay and great host!

Elisha’s apartment was spacious, comfy, and smelled great as soon as we walked in! The area is super walkable and we loved seeing all of the unique houses in the neighborhood :)).
Lovely stay overall.

Light and bright 2BR - super comfortable and open space - washer/dryer and dishwasher was a huge plus!  Unit is decorated super cute with lots of thoughtful amenities.  The host was very helpful and kind and it made for a nice stay in a Victorian neighborhood, walking distance to the subway.

Elisha's house was comfortable for my family to stay.
It is a 5-minute walk from the subway, so we can conveniently walk around New York and there are many markets around so we can easily buy what we need.
Also, Parking spaces are also assigned exclusively so you can use them comfortably.
Elisha also provided us with the items we needed immediately which allowed our family to stay in the accommodation comfortably.
Also, Elisha is very friendly so I felt like comfortable.
Thank you so much

Our stay was fantastic. We were there for my sons baseball college showcase and it was a great location. We were only a 4 min walk to the Subway and a short drive to the baseball stadium. We felt safe and at home. Elisha was helpful and communicated very well with us. Having a washer and dryer was a plus. Having your own parking spot was a Major Plus! We would definitely go back to her place when we go back to Brooklyn.

Description of listing is accurate,  comfortable flat with modern furniture and amenities.  Ease to public transportation,  walking distance to Bay Plaza/mall and area was quiet.  Host is helpful and responsive

Edouard was a fantastic host! Always available for questions and general housekeeping questions. Would highly recommend to anyone with a short term stint at Lincoln hospital as it’s a quick 10 minute walk
A very nice stay and clear instructions for the building. Natalie was super helpful when we had a problem during our stay and super accommodating!

I loved this Airbnb. It was gorgeous. Slightly too far from Times Square for my personal taste but everything else about it was absolutely incredible. Spacious and quiet. Nicely renovated. Loved my stay here. Would stay again and again.

The place is super spacious considering it's in Manhattan.  Natalie is very flexible with good response time.  The neighborhood isn't what I'm accustomed to but after a day or two, I felt generally safe walking around. All and all, it worked well for us.
Place was clean and just as the post described. Also, host was responsive and accommodating. I would stay again.

loved this place. it is a little gem! the area was right on the verge of harlam and manhatten. daytime was great and amazing. night time we stayed in. we love the layout and cleanliness. the place I swear was sound proof and the outdoor patio was the best addition. Would recommend a stay for a weekend here!
It was a super cozy stay with a 6 minute walk to the nearest MTA station. Parking is super convenient, and Felicia was such a pleasure!!

Thank you for a great stay in Brooklyn! The apartment was very nice. Clean and comfortable. We were within easy walking distances to our daughters apartment and any of the trains we needed to take. Felicia made everything about our trip smooth and easy. A great place to stay, would definitely reserve again in the future.
Incredibly convenient location and easy access to anything you need. It was clean, quiet, and incredibly spacious. We were easily able to get to and from Manhattan.

My experience staying at Felicia's place was outstanding, from start to finish. The apartment exceeded my expectations — spacious (it was much larger than it looked in the pictures), beautifully decorated, with a clean, modern feel. Although it's located in a bustling neighbourhood, it was peaceful and quiet inside. Felicia checked in with me promptly and made herself available for any questions I had. The neighbourhood itself was awesome. This was my first time in Brooklyn, and I loved walking around and exploring. The subway was just a short walk from the apartment, and I got around the city quite easily. I look forward to coming back and staying at Felicia's awesome apartment again!

Easy to get in, Juan was easy to communicate with and it was as close to LGA as described. Great for a quick or last minute stay!

So the most important thing to me is sleeping well, and Juan had a MATTRESS TOPPER! Very comfy bed and he did not go cheap on the pillows. The sheets were soft and I was warm enough but not too warm as the AC unit did it’s job and even had a remote to adjust.

Despite being in NY it was quiet as I slept.
Mostly Hispanic neighborhood, which I love, the kindest of ethnicities in my opinion.
Door had a lock so I felt safe and secure, I’d stay at Juan’s again.

Very clean, easy access, no problems, will come back on my next trip back

Thank you so much for your nice room! Also, I am sorry that I was not able to tell you my appropriate in person because I left this early morning.

Muchas gracias Juan!! I loved the spot! I love Queens!! I will be back! Great price! Walking distance to LGA and Buccaneer Diner was great! Thank you so much!

Juan's room is clean and tidy, with essential furniture. The house is close to LaGuardia Airport, only a 15-minute walk. This is a great place to stay in if you need to take a flight from LaGuardia. I recommend Juan's room to everyone.
This is a boutique hotel and there's an additional amenities fee charged when we arrived that was not obviously stated in the listing.

We will absolutely stay here again!
I was not able to even get into the location …. they didn’t let me friends in because they weren’t on the hotel room reservation but i booked it through here… need a refund asap!!
Great location. Really enjoyed our stay here. Beautiful old building with excellent updates. Very well maintained.

Had a nice stay here. It was really well-situated, a little noisy from the street. Super clean, great room, well decorated. They have storage for your stuff. They have a restaurant. It’s around a bunch of restaurants too. Would recommend

Comfortable and clean room for a reasonable price.  Check-in and check-out was really easy and smooth. Great location. Close to the subway. My only complaint would be that it’s noisy at night but it’s NYC, unless you’re on a high floor you’re going to hear some noise. I recommend this place.
Perfect stay for the 3 of us. We loved the bar in the hotel (Broken shaker), and the room was very nice. Would definitely recommend

It was a great spot, we didnt need use google to find restaurants all the time because the coffee shop, bar and & restaurant in the hotel was great. Will definitely stay here again. I have to mention that the door man was so helpful & great as well!!

Clean studio apt, close to bus stops, plenty of restaurants and stores near by. Zurita had good communication, the place is just as listed.

good location, very new and clean, Imsul was very nice and responsive. Would definitely go back!

the place was great.  it had a good location. A train straight to Manhattan made it convenient.

Nice and clean. Brand new. A bit loud

Can’t wait to return!

The room was super clean, comfortable and smelled so fresh.
I look forward to booking with Summer and Kamilya again

Hotel like studio apartment with kitchen amenities and right in the heart of midtown. Minutes walk to many NYC landmarks!

a wonderful place, very nicely arranged and modern, quiet area and very close to many utilities, the house is 10/10

We enjoyed our stay. The location was great as its close to subway. Its in quiet neighbourhood. Place was clean and as described on listing.

I strongly recommend this airbnb treasure in NYC.

Just remember to switch from the 3 train to the 4 train at Utica Avenue to catch a quicker ride into the city. Thanks for a great stay.
Exceeded our expectations. Elena was such a gracious host, and the place was perfect for us!
Super nice and clean, convenient location for sightseeing in New York City. Very thoughtful host to provide extra blankets to keep us warm and cozy during our stay.

Elena was very responsive. I quickly got into the Airbnb thanks to her clear instructions. The location is at Hell’s Kitchen, i.e. a lot of great restaurants are within walking distance; Target is only a few min walk; delis are all around the corner (as expected); Times Square / closest subway station is about 10-15 min walk away. Very convenient.
Not a complaint to Elena’s Airbnb but would like to set out some expectations for folks out there: In old buildings in New York’s fashion, the bathroom is relatively small and very clampy. The Airbnb is located on the 4th floor. I had a 50lbs suitcase. The stairs were very steep. So prepare yourself mentally before walking up those stairs.

The apartment looks just like the photos and was very comfortable but a little warm for me. I should point out that I would prefer to sleep in an igloo, so most people will be very comfortable. Since the apartment is on 10th Avenue, it may be further from public transportation than some people would prefer, but it worked very well for me. It's very easy to get wherever you want to go and very conveniently close to the theater district. Elena was both responsive and flexible. I really enjoyed my stay and being right in the heart of NYC!

Very comfortable apartment, easy to get in and out of.  Pretty central location for Times Square, although a bit of a walk to the nearest subway.  Lots of amenities for long stays.  Overall a great choice for a trip to New York!

“Excellent Airbnb experience! The property was immaculate, and the host went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Communication was seamless, and the location was perfect. I would highly recommend this Airbnb and would gladly stay here again in the future!”

Paul’s place was really incredible. Was so warm and sunny and comfortable and clean. Felt more like staying in a home vs. an apartment. Parking was fairly easy to find even on alternate side parking days. He was very responsive to my questions. The kitchen was large and amazing. The shower had great temperature and water pressure. The bed was super comfortable. It was really nice to be able to go out on the back porch even in wintertime.

it was just perfect. The apartment is very clean, wondedul bed and we were só much welcomed.
The localnis very close to the Subway and a safe área.
i was a great pleasure tô know Paul and Sandy. The are relly special People.

Lauren’s place was absolutely spectacular — the PERFECT accommodation for our family with 3 young kids, plus my parents in law and our nanny. The space was inviting, beautiful, so spacious, and conveniently located. Luxury accommodation in NYC with a young family is hard to come by and this place was an absolute gem! Thank you, Lauren and team, for making our holiday so memorable!
Amazing views, clean apartment, responsive host. Only comment would be is that a welcome pack with basics (water, coffee, bread etc) would be a good addition.

Alberto’s place was a brilliant location. 2 mins walk from the subway. 4 mins walk from Macy’s and many other shops. 1 block from Korea town and so many incredible restaurants.  This is a great apartment to stay in. We stay as a couple and our child. I can’t imagine 5 adults staying here though. It’s definitely not big enough for 5 adults with and sort of privacy.  Has all you need for a play to sleep and hang out in between all you’re going to be doing in Manhattan. The shower is amazing. It’s a power shower! Would definitely recommend staying here.
Great location! If you have double stroller be prepared to wrap up as doesn’t fit elevator as vintage building! Very responsive host!

Alberto was very responsive and gave clear instructions. The apartment was clean and decorated nicely. We had a little trouble with the toilet. It would run constantly and if we lifted the handle to stop the water running, the chain would fall off the flapper.  I put the chain back on 6 times. The check-out process was a little crazy. We waited a little over 30 minutes to turn in our key and store our luggage. We waited down a very narrow hallway that was also packed with other people doing the same as well as housekeeping trying to get by all the suitcases with their carts, etc.  My suggestion would be to arrive at checkout early. Other than that, we enjoyed our stay and the location.
location location location... we are spending most of time outside anyway... but the location just superb for the price ... everything else no complaints... as expected space in the heart of NYC
Everything is great. Chris is a good host, minor problems were resolved very quickly. I recommend.
Good for a short stay. Could be cleaner but not bad if you’re just there 1-2 nights. Host was nice and accommodating.
This little place is a Gem!  Beautiful little room with everything you need. Friendly, clean and in a great location.

My stay here was absolutely wonderful. The communication with Shkedy was very clear, fast and very informative. The space was small, quiet and cozy, just what I needed after a long day of walking around the city. Bars, restaurants, shops and transportation are plentiful around this location! The amenities in the room and even in the lobby area stood out for me. I highly recommend staying with Shkedy. Great price, location and communication. Thank you!

Great place to stay for a city break. Host is teally friendly and helpful, with great suggestions.
Will certainly return.

Sasha was very friendly and helpful! Location is very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to Prospect Park, bars and restaurants.  And also thank you for flexible check-in & out!

Lisa’s place was exactly as described. I was happily surprised to find a washer and dryer included. The apartment is nicely laid out with bedrooms up front and the space where you hang out in the back. Great kitchen, everything you need for cooking. Bring all oil and spices. We had two kids with us and had plenty of space for them to run around in the back yard and an amazing set of playgrounds a block away in either direction. Great food a couple blocks away and on DoorDash if needed. Location was great for the price. It was only 30 mins by subway to midtown, the subway entrance was a couple blocks away. Easy to get in and we got an early check in at 10am for an extra $50. Totally worth it since our flight got in at 8am. We really had a great time and would definitely stay here again.
Had a great stay. Little issue with panel and code checking in, but problem was solved with a phone call immediately. Great stay overall 🤙

Stayed here because it was convenient to my daughter attending Columbia summer school. Close to subway for sightseeing, Broadway shows and baseball. 15 minute walk through Morningside Park (up 122 stairs!) to Westside Market open 24 hours. Excellent fruit, cheese and salads. Would have been private and quiet but for the replacement of basement stairs going on for the duration of six nights stay. Overall a positive experience.

Absolutely loved staying in this apartment in Harlem.
Great space for our family of 4. Lisa was a wonderful help and always happy to answer my questions. We will be back!!
Thank you Lisa. Your place was beautiful and we had everything we needed. There was ample space and the place felt very cosy!

We loved the location and the apartment was perfect. Everything was really clean. Check-in and check-out were super easy. The neighbors upstairs were a little noisy, but we expected that from the reviews that were previously posted. We had zero issues with the apartment and the neighborhood was nice and convenient. We would definitely stay here again in the future. Great job, Lisa!

We enjoyed our stay very much. The area was great with some restaurants and bars and a store close by if you don't feel like heading into the main tourist areas. A few nights we stayed local and had a nice evening.

We absolutely loved our stay at this spot! The space was cute, quaint, and had just the right vibe for our trip—it truly felt like a cozy home away from home. Everything was clean, thoughtfully decorated, and super comfortable. The hosts went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed, and their communication was top-notch from start to finish. We felt so welcomed and taken care of. Would definitely stay here again next time we’re in the city!
It was a nice cosy house, home away from home and what truely stands out is the backyard. I just loved it. Definitely recommend to everyone visitng Newyork.

Absolutely exceptional Airbnb! Douglas and his wife Monica were exemplary hosts, communicating very quickly ahead of and during our stay. They live upstairs so were able to pop down and help us out very quickly when we had a little difficulty getting into the apartment.
The apartment itself is wonderful! They have thought of everything from cooking supplies to slippers and the decor is so beautiful. Including authentic Moroccan zelige tiles- gorgeous! It was impeccably clean.
The location is very convenient for a number of transport stops and restaurants, Whole Foods etc (and Douglas provided a very helpful local guide including some great recos). It's quiet during the day and evening despite being so central.
Could not recommend this Airbnb more! Thank you Douglas and Monica for a wonderful stay!

The extra touches were outstanding, extra amenities making every thing easy, tea towels, coffee pods, charging station with cords, extra supplies in equipment, extra towels plus comfy beds and great shower !
Would come back.

Comfortable, private and beautifully decorated.   Easy check in.  Moderately easy walk to Harlem landmarks, subway and Central Park.  The steps down to the apartment and steep bath shower stall may be difficult for those with mobility issues.  We will be back!

Had a great time at Douglas and Monica’s apartment. The space itself was beautifully decorated and furnished. Only a short walk to the subway and close to some great restaurants, jazz club, a Whole Foods and Trader Joe’s. The hosts provided clear instructions and helpful neighbourhood suggestions. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

Lovely apartment and super cool despite the heat, even without the air con.  Transport to downtown straight forward and quick.  We even walked it a couple of times (long but lovey through Central Park).  Was really interesting to stay in diverse neighbourhood.  Hosts super responsive.
Douglas’s place is nicely decorated and felt cozy.  It was a garden level unit so not much sunlight but you are across from a park.  Quiet at night.

A superb host who went above & beyond to provide a wonderful place to stay. Great communication before and during our stay.  We felt right at home and it was a brilliant base from which to explore different parts of the city. Highly recommend.
The apartment was acceptable according to the pictures...but the communication was not fluid ..and the air conditioned (only one) was not enough powerful for the summer heat..

Luis is a wonderful host, very understanding, and super helpful. He is  genuine and great. The basement apartment was spotless, the linens clean and Scented, the mattress super soft. He even had juice and water waiting in the fridge for us. The whole stay felt strangely luxurious for such simple and clean comforts. Thank you Luis

Luis's place is a great example of exactly what Airbnb should be. A man who takes pride in offering his home to a guest with a clean and great smelling home. Even including the entertainment. Every host could learn a thing or two from Luis and his affinity for the details 😏.

That’s a really nice place very great price with wonderful host.
Luis’s is very nice and patient. The house is big with all we need and the place is easy to find.

Avraham was a wonderful host, very polite and he was very responsive. The place was beautiful, my kids were very happy. There was a wide variety of restaurants.  I would definitely visit again. Thank you so much Avraham !

It’s how you can see in the pictures, it’s big and well communicated with 3 subway lines. The only problem is that windows are not hermetic enough and you can hear everything from outside and if it’s cold it can get a little bit chilly inside.
If they change the windows then it will be a 10.
Great place to stay at! The hosts were very nice and helpful when I had any questions or issues. It was a quiet area and very peaceful. The place was very clean and I enjoyed my stay!
We had a very nice time at Avraham’s place. Very nice and clean and he gave us clear instructions that made it very easy to find and get in. Fit 7 of us perfectly, it was a great deal!
Worked well for what it was bathroom was a little dirty and a few roaches in the room
Our stay at Jonathan’s was the absolute best! He was super responsive and check-in was so easy. We will absolutely be looking to stay again!

Jonathan was a fantastic host, easy to communicate with and his space was the perfect balance of private and shared. This spot is also very walkable, just the right location for being close to everything but not right on top of it.

I would highly recommend Hugo’s apartment in Brooklyn. A very nice space that is much bigger than I envisioned. My family and I stayed there for four nights and found it to be quiet and relaxing. The full kitchen really came in handy cooking for my kids, and everything in the kitchen is done very well. The whole place is fully renovated and includes a washer and dryer inside the unit which is was very convenient.
The location is less than a block from the R train which gives you good access around the city.
Great place to stay we would use again if we travel back to the city.
Hugo's place was great: great location, clean, and spacious. The host was very responsive and immediately answered all questions. I would highly recommend Hugo’s apartment in Brooklyn.

Perhaps the best studio apartment I’ve ever stayed in. Handsome, user-friendly, well-appointed, and in a great neighborhood. The washer-dryer was a great boon after three weeks in the UK. Perfect spot for exploring Park Slope, or just staying in with a stupefying array of restaurants ready to deliver to your door. The neighbors did do kind of a block party on Sunday, but they were perfectly friendly, and the music didn’t go too late. Huge TV, great kitchen, beautiful shower. Highest recommendation.
A real gem, beautifully furnished and decorated, with lots of amenities. Hosts went out of their way to make the stay enjoyable!

Seamless transaction from start to finish. Very communicative and gave great instruction on what to expect and logistics. Place was just as described and super clean. So close to the R train. Would definitely stay here again.

Wonderful communication from start to finish. The apartment is cozy and relaxing. Great location close to the subway. We enjoyed the thoughtful touches such as ear plugs and a sound machine. 10/10 would stay again!
