Our hosts were fantastic and the best communicators we have had with Air BnB.  The location was great to our needs and we were made to feel very  comfortable- including our two pooches.  We highly recommend this place and will stay here next time we visit Brooklyn.
Beautiful decorated and comfortable studio unit in a great neighborhood! Hugo is a very responsive and accommodating host. I felt totally at home and will definitely stay at this location again.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Hugo's place! The property was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was fantastic, close to restaurants and a number of nearby attractions.
Hugo and his team were incredibly responsive and kind, making sure I had everything I needed throughout my stay. I especially appreciated the peaceful backyard where I had the opportunity to enjoy the firepit outdoors while appreciating the natural surroundings and having a glass of wine.
I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a relaxing experience. Thank you, Hugo, for being such a wonderful host- I hope to come back soon!

This place was amazing and I don’t think I could have picked a more perfect place for what I needed.  The host was extremely kind and responsive and the apartment itself was amazing.  I am familiar with the neighborhood already but for anybody looking to make a trip to the city the location is perfect also.

Hugo’s place was exceptional and perfectly setup and outfitted for my stay!
His team was quick and extremely polite and friendly and helpful with communication.
Will be staying here when in the area for any visits to Brooklyn area
Great place with great accommodations. Not so close to the city but very close to the subway. Good communication with Leslie
Great location, very safe. Lovely cafe just a half a block. Store right across the street from that. Very walkable. It was a good location and plenty of space. Beds were very comfortable.

This was exactly as described. A bit of a hiccup when checking in; probably related to newness of place but once resolved worked flawlessly. Clean, easy access to trains. Rooftop super great. One bedroom is upstairs by itself..nice if you need some privacy.
Really terrific place. Huge living space which was great,  given I needed to work for large chunks to time. Close to 5th Ave with wonderful restaurants. Very private. Would recommend.

What an amazing place and fantastic host!
I highly recommend , our host has been super nice, the place is amazing and communication perfect .
Thanks a lot for a fantastic family vacation

Everything was excellent, we were very pleased, the towels smelled very nice, cleanliness, clear instructions on all possible points, I didn’t have to ask anything. Everything was explained as clearly as possible.  The best I've found in Brooklyn, highly recommend.
We loved our time at Hugo's place! It is a very spacious place in a prime location in Brooklyn.

If you want the full throttle that New York has to offer staying in the heart of Brooklyn exactly where this place is will give you everything that you need to create such memories as my family and I did not only is this place inside clean spacious. It’s literally walking distance to absolutely everything. From restaurants to shopping to the Barkley center, and just a drive away to time Square. This is the place for you to create amazing memories.
The apartment was excelente in location and spacious. This is one of the best apartment I have stayed in in NY. The communication with host was great. I will definitely stay again!

We recently completed a five night stay. The apartment was perfect and Hugo could not have been a better or more responsive host. We loved the area and will definitely return to this apartment the next time we’re visiting the area.
We had a great time!  Hugo was very accommodating and responsive.  Would highly recommend for anyone wishing to stay in the Brooklyn area!
Really great beautiful apartment- very comfortable + in a great location a few blocks from prospect park in a great neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants

We really enjoyed our stay at Hugo's place. We were traveling with a baby and a toddler, so wanted a bit more space than a hotel room. This place is huge! It was perfect for the kids and a comfortable retreat from the bustle of the street. The location is also excellent with great restaurants and shopping one block away on 5th.

Hugo has a great place - better than the pictures by far.  Large,open floor plan was perfect for our dinner and movie time, yet the 2 suites gave plenty of privacy.  Perfect WELL-stocked kitchen.  Hugo allowed us to stay longer when a business called popped up.  5 stars!

Awesome location and host was flexible, friendly, and very responsive! We had a heat problem (first cold snap!), host fixed it right away. Highly recommend this host. One note, while pictures matched perfectly, apartment but address did not, which threw me upon arrival.

stayed here for 5days, 6 nights as a group of 8. location is great with easy access to the subway & plenty of places nearby to eat & get coffee. was great for what we needed it to be. would stay again

The 3 bedroom apartment has a lot of space and worked great for our family.  The unit was on a busier street than we thought (based on the listing address) but you couldn't hear it from inside.  The sky lights added a lot of nice light during the day.  One of the bedrooms had no heat but the beds were very comfortable and the linens were soft.

The Apartment is in an excellent location, one block away from the subway and walking distance from iconic NY places. The size is perfect for 5/6 persons, it has three confortable bedrooms. The host was always helpful y responded immediately to the few questions we made. He also allowed flexible check out as he had availability which was helpful to seize the last day we were able to leave the luggage at the apartment. Everything went well and will use again when coming to NY.

This is great apartment for a large group in the middle of Manhattan. The apartment is an older building but that was not a problem for us, except that there is no thermostat inside the apartment to control the heat and the building is centrally heated. The host was proactive to address any concerns and would promptly adjust the thermostat at request. Overall a great host even otherwise and great value for the nightly rate for the stay.
Well placed, metro nearby, shops, bars, accessible and practical. A bit noisy but perfect for a one-week, 6 person stay

The address provided on the reservation was incorrect, causing confusion.
This listing is not adequately set up for 8 people, as several essential items were missing to accommodate a group of that size.
The property also needs significant updating and refurbishment.

Great value spot in the heart of Manhattan. Place was as described and provided an excellent base. Tusnoda was super helpful and family of six had a great time. Sofa bed was super comfortable (17 year old)!
You won’t regret it. Lane was super accommodating, very friendly and helpful. I’d definitely stay again if she’d have me too

The place was clean and very confortable ,  the host was easy to contact and responed eight away. The neighborhood was safe and neighbors friendly. I visit Brooklyn offten because its my childhood home and most of my family are in Beooklyn. I will use Gershon's place again
Great place! Very clean, thoughtfully furnished and close to the bus stop. Parking spot is cherry on top. We would definitely recommend.

We all enjoyed staying there for 6 nights with family 6a+2c. The place was as described, we had enough space to chill out and live there. The interior quality was amazing. Please pay attention to the address when trying to get there using taxi from JFK. It happened to us, and as well to other people living upstairs, that the taxi driver circulated until found the correct address. The neighborhood was safe and nice. It took us 45-50 mins to get to Manhattan using metro.
Great place. Very clean & in a good location in Brooklyn. Not too far from a lot of places & you get the the nyc vibe. Would definitely book again

We were a family of 5 visiting New York and enjoyed our stay in lovely, comfortable, clean , quiet accommodation, close to bus route and subway . Enjoyed the use of 4 huge tv screens as well, the photos of apartment matched our expectations. Would definitely recommend staying there.

Beautiful home more spacious than I anticipated. Great space for a larger group traveling. The neighborhood is nice, though just around the corner it feels a bit more urban. Still, overall a great place.

This is the best deal I the ever had in airbnb.
Prime location close to Union sq, the apartment is classy decorated with all you need for a perfect stay.
Sonia was responsive and amazing host.
I will always try to come back here when visit NY again.
Unbeatable
Good location for our needs. Variety of places to eat. Nice to have a local Target at walking distance.  Fresh French patisserie near. Easy access to bus and subway.

Sonia’s place is exactly as described. It’s clean and tidy and looks identical to the photos.
A few things to note:
- the apartment is a bit more East than listed but not far from the actual spot listed in Airbnb
-there is NO WiFi in the apartment. This only mattered for me when I had to take a zoom call and my phone wasn’t getting great reception.
Otherwise, Sonia is responsive and caring about your stay!
Nice stay. The apartment is right in the middle of activity, and yet it is surprisingly quiet! No traffic noise at night.

Christopher’s place was extremely spacious, clean and comfortable!  The location was perfect. Close to many dining options and near a lovely park. We even had a front row view of the 2024 NY marathon! We cannot wait to come back!

The apartment is nice and its clean. Great, fun neighborhood.
The host was very easy to work with and super responsive. He worked with us on early check in which was great.
Very clean, modern and nicely outfitted with everything we needed. The stairs leading up to the apt are pretty narrow for any folks traveling with big/heavy luggage. Location was incredible.
I am very impressed with the stay. I really enjoy staying here. would definitely come back again.

Beautiful backyard full of flowers, firm and comfy pull out couch, located between several transit stations, very friendly hosts. I appreciated all of the eco-friendly touches, the immaculately clean sheets and towels, and the cosy at-home vibe. There’s also an adorable older cat in the living room! Perfect launching point for discovering Manhattan and Brooklyn on a budget. Thanks Mark!
Mark’s place was great! A few blocks from the Chauncey J, perfect for what we needed for our visit home. Thanks so much !!
It was an amazing Airbnb! Mark it was an excellent host! I recommend it if you are visiting NYC! It’s pretty close to the subway, great area and amazing vibes in the apt

We really enjoyed our stay. The location is perfect, well connected and the room was nice and clean. Mark is an amazing host: very welcoming, always responsive and made our stay easy and more enjoyable. Highly recommended!

This place is a really small basement with no natural light, no plates, glasses, cutlery or kitchen sink, just a microwave. Also has no heating so gets really cold and expects to keep the whole place warm with 1 tiny electric heater. Address on the listing is also wrong. Also quite a lot of noise coming from upstairs at times.

Shoutout to Arianna for being so responsive! Any issues I had, she was quick to respond.  I would definitely stay here again. This place is on the ground level with a few stairs and some doors to get through so definitely keep that in mind if you gave heavy luggage/aren’t able to use stairs.
Arianna’s place was a nice and comfortable space. Looks like the pictures and was accurate to the description. Arianna was a responsive and accommodating host and I would rent from her again.
This property was absolutely wonderful! It is a cozy basement apartment with easy access to both the ACE trains as well as the J line! The property was clean and the host was so responsive!

Arianna was a great host. We appreciated her responsiveness and detailed instructions regarding check in and check out. This is an efficiency stay. It’s a basement level airbnb that’s good for those who won’t be spending much time at their airbnb. We appreciated how close the airbnb was to the subway station, it was only about a 4 minute walk to the entrance. The only thing that we didn’t love was the noise from the upstairs neighbors. We could hear them throughout the night, walking around and talking. It kept us awake a bit. My only recommendations would be to add hooks in or outside of the bathroom to hangs towels. A broom or a small vacuum would also have been helpful. We experienced some rainy weather during our stay so we tracked in a bit of dirt that we would’ve like to better clean up, but we were unable to.

Pristine, and peaceful. Vladimir’s place was the perfect haven of comfort for three travellers in New York for the week. We were impressed with the cleanliness of the place. The place was warm in the cold spring weather and a had just enough space to cook some simple meals. The proximity to the Park, grocery, bars and the 86th street subway was very convenient. Great quiet and safe area with a welcoming and generous feel. Would stay again!!
Vladimirs space was excellent. A superb space for anyone’s stay in the upper east side!
Vlad was a great host! Very responsive and welcoming. The apartment was perfect- just what we needed.

The apartment is well located on a lovely street with easy access to everything the city has to offer.  It is exactly as described and is like most every other apartment in NYC.  We felt safe.  We were comfortable.

Vlad was very accommodating to our needs and quick to respond when we had a question. He had great recommendations for going out. The apartment was exactly as described, clean and comfortable! We would definitely stay again and recommend the place.

Vlad’s place is in the perfect location on the Upper East Side. It’s just a block away from the subway line that takes you into midtown and downtown, and a short walk from Central Park. The apartment was clean, tidy, and comfortable. It worked so well for my family of three. We hope to come stay here again!

My parents and I really enjoyed staying at Vlad and Sash's place. Cozy, well stocked, close to the subway, lots of great spots and restaurants nearby, and located on a quiet and lovely street. We truly appreciated how responsive and considerate the hosts were, preparing extra towels in advance, and delivering additional coffee pods. It is a lovely apartment, perfect for a family of 3 or 4. Thank you for having us, Sash and Vlad!

Excellent stay. Ayanna was friendly, helpful, and responds quickly. The place is modern, and clean. Conveniently close to the subway, and transportation is easy. I really loved the roof deck. Great Brooklyn vibe.

it was very comfortable, felt like I was home and bathrooms was really nice I really love the sliding doors and the rooftop was my favorite. I literally woke up got a sausage egg and cheese and my coffee and sat right at the rooftop with that beautiful view. Highly recommended to book your gonna love it and never wanna leave

This place is going to be my go-to spot whenever I’m in Brooklyn. The rooftop was great for hanging out on hot days. It’s close to transportation, so getting around is a breeze. And, there are some good food spots nearby. Highly recommend!

Amazing host with an amazing Airbnb - Came from London and it was my first time booking an apartment abroad but the entire process was easy and seamless.
Apartment was clean and had everything you needed - Highly-recommended.

Great apartment in a convenient location. Super spacious, it worked well for my teenage daughter and I with two full bedrooms and bathrooms. We had a minor issue with the AC that Ayanna kindly worked out straight away.
Highly recommended.
great place for the price. it's the best deal you'll get in midtown Manhattan. a little crammed but good for the most part
Pretty good spot to stay, especially since its in ktown. Really convenient as its by the subway too

This by far was one of the best Airbnb’s that we’ve had when we visit Brooklyn! Great location, house was very well kept, and everything worked. The host was very responsive and made sure we had what we needed for our stay. Would definitely recommend and book with them again!

Comfortable place with good beds. Second bathroom is very small. It might not be a great place to cook but we weren’t trying to do that. Not a lot of stores and restaurants around. Nice little porch for morning coffee.

The house was perfect for our New York weekend. It was nicely decorated and they had everything you would need! We loved the snacks and waters.
We loved Brooklyn Botanical gardens, Dkyer heights Christmas lights and ice skating under Brooklyn bridge.

I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a place to stay in Brooklyn within easy reach of places.
While my family and I were there for a funeral and in the winter, everyone who we needed to see or who needed to come get us were like "we are just around the block from there" or "we are two mins away from you". The funeral parlour and repasse hall was also close by making it so much easier and less stressful during an already stressful time.
The host was so accommodating and responsive to us before and during our stay, we cannot thank her enough.
This place is a definite 5++++++++++++++++

Great apartment with a lot of room for relaxing! Loved sitting on the porch just enjoying the mornings. Convenient location to subway, easy to get to sightseeing.
We had a little hiccup with the hot water when we first arrived, but Shemi responded quickly and got it all sorted for us! We really appreciated the help and easy communication during our stay!
I enjoyed my time in the Airbnb. The hosts added complimentary touches that made my stay very welcoming.
Perfect location! Vincenco and his team were very communicative and the instructions were very clear. Very nice place to stay.
Great place, easy location. Quick walk to Wall st station, slightly longer to Fulton. 20 min walk to chinatown. and the restaurants / cafe in fidi are also pretty good.
A great value for the size and location! Two bedrooms is hard to find with such a walkable distance to so many things in NYC. Would definitely stay here again if we ever come back to the city.

Friendly and professional host, responsive and flexible. She even let us check in early as the unit was ready. The location is great, and the unit is comfortable for a family or friends traveling together. Bed was comfortable and the kitchen is fully equipped for cooking, if needed. It worked out perfectly for me!
Amazing Location, you can walk everywhere. The apartment has everything that you need and the host is super friendly and flexible.
The place is as the pictures show. The location is excellent. We were allowed to make an early check in. All was great.

Bed bugs, unresponsive host, the address doesn’t match. Ended up stranded in the middle of NYC at 2am with 2 small children becuase she wouldn’t reply and her co-host who is amazing and the only reason she deserves any star couldn’t do anything without her and she wouldn’t even reply to him.
Cozy and comfortable 2 bedroom in a great location. Only downsides, very little natural light inside the apartment (windows mostly look into air shafts) and thin walls with loud neighbors.

Rybner’s place was just as pictured.  It was on a quiet street although so close to the Barclays center and transportation.  The place was spacious and clean.  We had a few issues with the internet, etc but he responded right away to correct the situation.  We enjoyed our stay and hope to return.
We enjoy the space, the only thing we concern is the wifi is not stable, but since we didn't use it a lot, we use our own data most of time.
Great place to stay in Brooklyn!  Rybner was a responsive host and we very much enjoyed our stay.

Lovely modern apartment in a great location. Our three-generation family had plenty of room and Rybner was very responsive. Having the elevator open right into the apartment is nice. I would stay here again any time.

It was an easy experience and we will definitely come stay here again in the future. Very clean house and so close to transit. Kitchen appliances are top notch and the heated floor tiles in the bathrooms were a huge hit.

Easy to find and centrally located near several restaurants. Host was very easy to communicate with and quite helpful during our stay. Location was very clean and well kept. Would definitely consider staying there again if in the area.

Great location, close to subway, very assessable to downtown NY. Had to search for good restaurants in the area.
Accommodations were awesome. Everything we needed.
Loved this place! Very easy checkin and checkout process. Nearby stores and restaurants. Easy uber pick up and drop off spot. Loved everything about the stay and looking forward to coming back.
A very nice apartment in Brooklyn.  Very close to the subway, it was a great place to go and explore the city

The space was modern and just right for our group of 5. Location-wise it was very close to Barclays Center, multiple subway lines, and a variety of food & grocery options. Also very accessible as there were no stairs to climb. Be sure to pay attention to your DMs before check-in because the address on the listing will be different from the actual location. As a host, Rybner provided timely communication and clear instructions for a smooth check-in. The host even allowed us to drop off our luggage early prior to check-in time. All in all, we had a great stay!

Great place for a family visit to Brooklyn.  Location is closer to Dean Street and 5th Avenue versus the location listed in the document.  Once we arrived, check-in was easy, pictures were accurate, and it was extremely clean.  Thank you.
The place has a great location that allows you to do many things, and close to everything. Riki was quick to respond to any comment we may have.
riki was great with providing the details and information about the stay. it was a great area to be in as well
Place was very clean and smelled very good upon walking in. Easy check-in and host was very kind and responsive
For the 4 nights that we were in NYC, Riki's place was the best location and value. We visited 5 museums and spent time in Times Square and went to two shows. It was fun! We would stay there again.
Riki’s place is exactly as described. It’s in a phenomenal location and has all the basics you’ll need. Great value for nyc.
We really enjoyed our stay and the neighborhood. Place was spacious and clean. If you're planning to walk a lot and want to explore UES this is a very good option. Excellent value.
A very good option to stay in NY. Aidee and his partner are very polite and flexible.
Clean and comfy apartment in a great location, quiet street, near subway, restaurants, and the East River.

The place was ok! It needs a good cleaning. The bathroom floor looked a little dirty. The microwave was a little bit dirty from the inside. The mattress was comfortable. Nice size kitchen with enough utensils if you need to cook a quick meal. The neighborhood is beautiful with great restaurants and lots to do. I would go back!

Lovely stay in the Upper East Side
I had a great experience staying at this apartment in the Upper East Side. The location is fantastic just a few minutes’ walk from Central Park and very well connected to everything I needed.
John was very helpful and understanding, especially since my flight was delayed. He waited for me, explained everything clearly and made check-in smooth and easy.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for my stay. Aldee and host were very responsive throughout the process, and I really appreciated their kindness and communication.
I would definitely consider staying again in the future. Thanks again for everything!

They did have a few problems with the bathroom wall, a hole directly through , and the constant smell of smoking in the halls and elevator on a “non smoking property “ was pretty confusing. They should for sure at least have one or two staff members rotating so be able to speak to about these issues ..
Great location, very nice place, clean and comfortable. The host is friendly and helpful. We had a great time, would recommend this place.

Perfect location to explore New York. We could walk to many places and the subway is just around the corner.  We loved this flat and will come back for sure. We stayed for 9 nights and enjoyed our time there. I can recommend this place for sure.
Convenient location, but it was on an extremely noisy street and I had a lot of trouble sleeping.

This place is very okay. For NY, it's not a bad deal at all, but the place is quite basic with an uncomfortable couch and very little to no amenities. As others flagged, it's quite noisy at night, especially if you sleep with the windows open (which we had to do in November because the heat for the building was unbearable and there's no way to turn it down or off).

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! It was impeccably clean and smelled wonderful. The bed was large and comfortable, with clean sheets that added to the comfort. The space itself exceeded my expectations; it was even nicer and more spacious than in the pictures. The host was very helpful throughout my stay. Highly recommend this place!
Peter is an outstanding host. Very welcoming and made me feel right at home. I love this Airbnb and will definitely book again.

Peter's place is very clean, comfortable & cozy as advertised. It was just the right size for me & my girlfriend. Peter himself was very friendly and responsive. I would stay again & I would recommend this place to others if they're looking for a place to stay in that area.

Peter's home is very clean, updated, and nice!!  Its deep in Brooklyn,  but maybe a block from the L train. Peter was very nice and friendly. Parking was very do-able in the neighborhood (we found parking in front of the house every night no problems).  Would definitely stay again.
I highly recommend this apartment. Very clean and very well equipped, close to small shops and the metro.

Peters place was clean and nicely decorated. Located conveniently close to the train station with regular services right into Manhattan. Plenty of good food options in the neighborhood.
It was a great place to stay, would highly recommend.
Place was okay for a night stay. I am from NJ suburbs, and felt the neighborhood was not well kept and unsightly. Apt was clean and quiet, no issues there. Owner responds quickly.
the suite was in the perfect area. I enjoyed the space. you will not regret.  I will book again.
Wonderful place, very clean and centrally located. Zviadi was very responsive, and I have zero complaints about the place or the customer service.

Zviadi and Jido's Airbnb was honestly perfect, the location was right in the heart of downtown Manhattan and was very comfortable with everything we needed. We'd be really happy to stay with them again!

The place looked as published. The 2 bedrooms were very comfortable & clean. Having a full kitchen was great. The bathroom & shower were adequate. The AC worked fine & was very needed. Walking up 3 flights got real old real fast. We are in our late 70's & thought a 3 floor walkup was going to be OK, they weren't. Zviadi was extremely helpful & communicative, especially when the wifi dropped out & the toilet backed up. He was exceptionally prompt in taking care of both of those issues.
Great base in NY… close to so many great parts of NY… lots of bars and cafes close by… very much a grungy style of neighbourhood but I sensed this was real NYC not a postcard.
it was a good location & close to city. the building was a little gross, but the apartment was nice.

Katie’s place was amazing! It is exactly as you can see it in the pictures. It was the best Airbnb experience I have had. There is a lovely park nearby, lots of restaurants around. G train is only 6min away, A and C trains are a little further - 10min away. Talking of Katie’s place - it was top-notch! You can find everything there - kitchen/shower amenities. The place is very cozy, terrace upstairs is amazing, and so is the balcony. Katie herself is a super sweet and friendly person - she helped us with any question we had! Truly, one of a kind! We were super lucky we got this place and cannot express how homie it felt!

The place was great for a family of 5 over Christmas and NYE. The closest metro was the G line, 8min walk and there was also the A/C line about 14 min away. Almost everything in Manhattan is approximately 40 - 45 min travel (walk time included).
The place was spacious, and nicely decorated. The kitchen was completely equipped with everything we needed and we cooked a lot.
Nice working space, but the wifi was a bit spotty on some days due to some neighborhood outages, had no issues connecting via my hotspot though.
Good value! Thanks!
Levi, place was amazing look exactly like the picture. Levi responds pretty fast, & was extremely helpful with any questions issues or concerns. Will definitely be booking with him again.
Levi was very accommodating for my last minute booking in Brooklyn. Communication was clear and efficient. The place was homely and clean. I would book with Levi again!

Easy peasy quick booking for a last minute no-frills week-long stay for me and a kitten. Was very grateful for the super deep soaking tub 🛁
Levi was able to get me in a little early on the day of check-in which smoothed things over a lot and was quick to respond to any inquiries. very accommodating. Thanks!
I loved the stay and the house was amazing very clean and very spacious the host responded very fast they were amazing I would definitely book again
Nice place! We had a wonderful stay with my family. Maria always quickly responded. It was definitely a place of comfort ❤️
The site is very nice and clean, we were able to stay without any problems and we were very comfortable in the space.:)

If you are familiar with the area, it is very convenient.  Close to the train, supermarket, resturants, etc.  The only difficult part is parking.  Typical issue for NY but you will find a parking spot quickly.

We had a wonderful time staying here.  The place was very clean and comfortable.  The neighborhood was family friendly and safe.  There was super easy access to the subway lines and we enjoyed the local eateries around the place.

Evert has a beautiful home and we enjoyed our stay but there needs to be televisions in the bedrooms especially for down time. Wifi needs to be updated. It worked the first day we got there and would not reconnect even though we put in the password several times. I did reach out to Evert about the problem and he did not respond so we used our cellphone Hotspot for the Television in the Livingroom.

My boyfriend, two friends and I flew into New York for a weekend trip.  Before making the reservation Melissa and I messaged, she was extremely accommodating and quickly responded.  Once in New York the entry instructions were sent and easy to follow.  When entering we were happy the place looked like the photos on the site.  Shops and food within walking distance.  When leaving everyone picked their bedrooms for the next stay…as we would definitely love to stay there again.  The only thing that I was upset about was we didn’t sign the guest book.  Shout out to Melissa and her wonderful place.

Melissa was extremely responsive and accommodating. She provided very clear instructions to get inside and always responded when I reached out with questions. The apartment was looked just like photos and was spacious for new york. Be aware the area is very busy and constant movement but thats new york right ☺️.

Highly recommend this place. Just 2 mins walk to the MTA and bus stop right in front of the house. Hosts were really responsive and helpful with everything that we needed. Clean house overall and great location.

The apartment was just as depicted. Newly renovated, clean, clutter free. The balcony was a bonus. Very nice spacious accommodation. It was thoughtful that Melissa provided coffee. She was responsible and helped with parking in the shared driveway. Overall a great stay. The neighborhood is alive and well even at 2am when trying to get shut eye. Would bring earplugs and would definitely stay there again!
The stay was excellent! The place was clean, well-equipped, and just like the photos. Communication with the host was quick and easy.
Great place, host was great with communication! And the place is big enough where you don’t feel cramped
Great location-safe, close to transit, in a great neighborhood with amenities, and host was super quick to respond/provide information and assistance!

We spent three months in this wonderful apartment in the Park Slope area. We felt very comfortable. Everything was perfect, and Julien and Bertie were so kind and helpful. We would definitely go back.

Very beautiful newly renovated place , very stylish, excellent and comfy beds. Everything is super clean. We felt ourselves at 5 star hotel.
The host was extremely helpful and kind to us in order to accommodate us.
Definitely recommend the place if you have a big group and need 3 rooms .

Deyana was a wonderful host. She went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. She accommodated us even after check out.
The guesthouse will be my go to place when visiting Brooklyn.
Overall a very pleasant experience. Very responsive. Great decorations!
Thank you for everything Deyana 🙏🏻

Had a wonderful stay ! Deyana’s place is well equipped , super clean and beautifully decorated. Deyana was very responsive from my first inquiry to the end of our stay. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!
Deyana did a wonderful job with this unit. Every room looked like the pictures but better.

Deyana was such a great host. My family and I was in town for my father’s funeral and she was very sympathetic to our needs. The place was spotless and well put together, very peaceful and quiet. She also provided us with a parking spot which was also a plus. We definitely enjoyed our stay and give it 5 stars!! Thank you so much Deyana! ❤️

I had a fantastic stay at Deyana's apartment in Brooklyn! She truly lives up to her Superhost status—her communication was excellent from start to finish, and she went above and beyond to make sure I felt comfortable and had everything I needed.
The apartment itself is spotless, well-maintained, and tastefully decorated, providing a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. It’s located in a nice neighborhood, offering a more relaxed vibe than the hustle and bustle of Manhattan. While it’s not directly next to a subway station, the nearby bus connections make it easy to reach the subway and explore the city. Deyana was very helpful in providing guidance on transportation options, which made getting around much smoother.
I would absolutely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a well-managed and comfortable place in Brooklyn. Thank you, Deyana, for being such a great host—I hope to return someday!

This place was cozy and modern. Clutter free and safe neighborhood. Subway was only 10 min drive. Our host was very responsive and even gave us some complementary laundry loads. They had complimentary snacks and coffee for us when we arrived. They even had some emergency toothbrushes and toothpaste.
We had a WONDERFUL stay--SUGGEST maybe a Air B N B book to give instructions on the Split heating-- But great location, as described, So many friendly persons in apt complex next door we met--
Michael greeted us upon arrival and gave us some great info about the area and how to get around. One of our best Air BnB experiences yet! Thanks!

Perfect location with endless things to do around the area. Stayed for Govball and was only a 20 min walk away from the park. The house was amazing, nice homey feel and everything was clean and looked amazing. If we ever need to stay in the area again this will definitely be our first choice
Thank you for hosting me! The Airbnb was nice and comfortable! The neighborhood was cozy and felt safe. The binder with all the recommendations and information on transit/ the area was lovely!

This cozy and private studio in Rego Park is a hidden gem! The location is super convenient—just a 10-minute walk to catch a bus to Flushing or take the subway to Manhattan. The neighborhood is peaceful, and the studio is clean and comfortable. The host was incredibly welcoming, allowing me to check in early and sharing great local restaurants.
I’d definitely stay here again next time!

I had a great time in this place,Martha is super helpful with tips regarding tourism, she made me feel as I knew NY before as she provided me with tips about the place.
Two things to note, if you are caribbean man like me, I wouldn’t advise this place during winter, the cold breeze skips through the door and windows which make the nights super cold inside despite the heater. Well if you are from winter places, i assure you it wont be a bother.
Secondly, there is no area to prepare meals as listed, I guess the microwave is interpreted as such but that is not what i understood.
Otherwise, it is a perfect spot, private, quiet. I would definitely do it again but summer only.
The pace was great. Very clean, very private, 10-14 mins walk to the train station and very quiet neighborgood. The host was very responsive. Would definitely love to come back.

Our stay was great! The place was exactly as described, and the location in Queens is quite convenient and well connected to Manhattan via public transport. Everything was super clean and the bed was very comfortable. Our hosts even gave us lots of local recommendations and always replied quickly to our questions. I would totally recommend this place to anyone visiting New York!
Takeshi’s place feels like home, and Takeshi is the perfect host. Thanks so much for having me.
Takeshi is a great host and really took care of us. The apartment has everything you need and makes for a great stay.

Cozy and comfortable, typical New York old building;~
without roaches it would be perfect.

We loved this efficiency apartment for our overnight stay.   With the functional kitchenette and high ceilings, it felt spacious and very livable, and would have easily worked well for a longer stay.  The location is unbeatable, the shared bathroom spaces were pristine, and the stairs have that jaunty angle you expect of NYC walkups.  If you're a backpack traveler like me, you'll be just fine.  :)

A couple hiccups along the way during our stay, but nothing Maria couldn’t fix! We will definitely stay again next time we are in Bushwick. We didn’t get to use the rooftop, as we ended up with less time than we expected, but it’s such a plus to have the outdoor space!

Nice artistic place in up and coming area of Brooklyn, close to a few cool bars and restaurants and an easy Uber to the other cool neighborhoods. Cool stay for a quick trip! Maria is a responsive and friendly host as well!
Nice Deli with tasty sandwiches across the street, subways nearby. Maria is friendly and helpful.

Maria’s place was amazing! Beautifully designed and could feel the history all throughout. My son loved the loft bunk bed and we slept amazing! The art throughout was truly amazing, our family loved every inch. Great location, easy parking. Carmenta’s is a must, right around the corner! We will definitely choose Maria’s place in the future. Great stay. Maria was so kind and we were able to check in early which was great with our toddler and infant. Couldn’t ask for more! Thank you Maria!

Maria’s Bushwick apartment was a great homebase for our trip to New York. The neighborhood itself was so fun and vibrant. Very walkable to food, entertainment and a lovely park! Getting to Manhattan by train was a breeze. I would definitely return again!

Very charming, artistic space where the kitchen and bathroom were tightly and cleverly packed. Living room is a good size. Maria is a great host, very responsive. The roof area was quite lovely to  swing in the hammock or sit in a chair. Felt very safe, and the neighborhood has a lot of shops and restaurants. About a 10 minute walk to the subway.

In a good location when it comes to the Jamaica train station right there,about a 5 minute walk from the property and a 20 min train ride to Penn station. The walk home at night is a little sketch with it being a couple streets off the main road but not terribly bad and you can take a taxi from the station if anything. Overall for the price it’s good

Overall we enjoyed our stay.  Only gripe would be the height clearance of the bedroom and particularly the bathroom. I am 6'4. Hit my head a couple times in the groggy hours and taking a shower was a challenge indeed. Very short and tight.
Nice place to stay, so convenient to have washer/dryer in unit. Location is great, easy access to subway and other public transportation through Grand Central.
Jinsup was great to deal with and her place was awesome - looked like the pictures and was very clean!  We had a great stay!
My stay here has been a great experience. The host was very attentive & helpful throughout my stay. The home is clean, convenient, and in a great area. Would definitely recommend.

Haru's place is situated 3-5 minutes away from Union Square and several subway stations. If you're in NYC for a few nights it will allow you to reach a lot of places pretty easily. However the apartment is pretty small and some changes could make it more cosy so I wouldn't recommend it for a long stay, it's good if you plan on spending most of your days outside.

I enjoyed my stay at Haru's place.  The pros were the central location, fair price, comfy bed, and AC.  Cons included the toilet being across the hall instead of in the unit (which is in the Airbnb listing, but I somehow missed this detail, so I'm flagging it here!), a bit of uncleanliness, and no TV.  It was fair for the price I paid, but next time I'll probably shell out a little more to have my own bathroom. :)  Make sure to bring flip flops!  Haru was super communicative and offered to store my bags from noon on when I couldn't check in early.  Thanks, Haru!

The beds were comfortable, everything was neat, it was as needed in for a great time in NYC, really close to Union Square, pretty quiet.
The stove and oven worked great, the pots and pans were non stick and the spatulas were metal so they were scratched up. Though the internet connected and Haru reset it, it never worked very effectively, and phone data ended up being the way to go.
The building felt safe, the stairs coming up are slanted and a bit nerve wracking, but completely functional, and great for a stay in Union Square. Easy to get to, and easy to come in and out of.
Haru was kind, and didn't respond immediately, but always responded and made check out very easy.
Thank you!

Really great stay, the location was ideal it looked just like the pictures and the communication was really easy.
We loved it

Great location, keep in mind that this is not a room in a persons place. It's a separate and secure room, with a shared bathroom and shower. We enjoyed our stay, and would recommend this as a place to stay

Location was great. I slept well every night and felt safe every time J came back. The street was never super crazy busy at night and it felt quiet compared to other parts I stayed in. Everything was clean in the apartment when I went as well. Definitely recommend if you’re staying in NYC. I’ll be coming back next time for sure.

The length is great and you sleep quietly and comfortably. Even the shared bathrooms were always spotlessly clean. A typical New York apartment, small but enough space for everything you need. I particularly liked the fact that there were lots of hangers in the closet and the subway is a stone's throw away. Haru was also very friendly and the communication was flawless. If you are not looking for luxury but a good real apartment with good connections in Manhattan and other parts of New York, this is the right place for you. Highly recommended.

The location was great, close to the subway, Target and Whole Foods. Shared bathroom was opposite the bedroom door. The room was quiet as it was at the back, the only detail is the thin walls that can hear other residents, but this is normal for this type of room.
I didn't like the bed, but my wife said she liked it.

Hal's place is good value, given high accommodation and other prices across Manhattan. I particularly appreciated the location, on the northern edge of East Village, which is now I think the most vibrant and interesting area of Manhattan, with great cafés and bars, new galleries opening, particularly around the stunning New Museum (now closed for building work / extension), cinemas, loads of young people, big farmers market on Union Square at weekends. Must all be big fun when the weather's warmer than during my wintery stay. I recommend Pete's Tavern, for food, drink and good company, five or ten minutes walk from Hal's place. The room is compact, quiet, comfortable double bed, all well equipped, you can cook or microwave if you wish. Shower and toilet nearby, across the corridor, shared. That's the only minus point. But they were also both clean and well maintained during my stay. Hal communicated well before and during my stay. Thanks Hal.

Great location, AC worked well, WiFi worked well, had a microwave, small stove, and a large fridge! But bed wasn’t very comfy imo. But the worst part was having to lock the door and walk in a public hall to a shared bathroom in the middle of the night 😬

Great experience and value.  Hal responded quickly when i checked in.  Excellent location, felt very safe.  Never needed to wait to use the shared bathroom.  Room is a bit small, but servicable and clean.

Great no-frills room for a night in Manhattan. Note that you'll share the bathroom (2 per floor) and shower (1 per floor) with others, but for me that wasn't a problem at all.  Communication with Hal was excellent, he's a super nice host!

Very clean and great place for those who want to stay in Manhattan for a few days. Hal was very responsive and instructions to attain the keys were clear.
In summary, I recommend this place for its affordability and location.
Nice place in a good area. Good proximity to restaurants + coffee shops + bars. Stefano was very friendly and accommodating
Stefano was a good host. He met us at check-in to ensured the place was to our liking before leaving.

We had a great stay in Ridgewood at Stefano's place. It was clean, quiet, and just like the description. He was very attentive (remotely) and helpful. Would definitely stay there again. Mil gracias, Stefano!
Thanks so much Hal! We enjoyed our stay and everything was easy to find and clean! Definitely stay with Hal if you need a clean, safe, centric and affordable spot in NYC.

Lovely place!! My group really enjoyed the apartment. 2 bathrooms were really useful for my party of 5. The kitchen is well equipped and we could make a great dinner that we all enjoyed eating outside in the patio. This is 5 stars, I strongly recommend.
gem in the city, great location,  walkable and spacious. was pleasantly surprised by this apartment. was the perfect place for a week in NYC with family.

Great host. Will definitely stay again. Quick responses and matched listing.
Great to have two bathrooms for 5 adults. Spacious for nyc apartment.

The apartment is conveniently located, it is clean and comfortable. Not having a proper dining table is a minus, as the terrace is unfortunately impossible to use as the smell from the nearby restaurant is unbearable. Overall, it is a very recommandable place and the owner is available and attentive.

Park South was very nice . The bedrooms were nicely sized and having two bathrooms was great and they were also nicely sized. The best part was the large deck. Which we enjoyed every morning and every night. We would definitely rent this again.

We absolutely loved staying in this apartment! It was perfect for our group of five girls and we were thrilled with the location- there were food and coffee spots just a short walk away! My favorite part was having our own private rooftop patio- I feel this is rare in NYC. I’d definitely stay here again. Thank you!

Loved staying here! Host was awesome and super responsive! Location was perfect - very safe - with tons of amazing restaurants and cafes. Enjoyed our daily morning cup of coffee and walk to Gramercy Park. Bedrooms are generously sized. The private patio is awesome and very spacious! Rare to find a 3 bedroom in the city! The host, place, and  location made our NYC very memorable.

My girl friends and I had a lovely time using this home as our home base while in NYC. The home is spacious, clean, and perfect for groups. The area is close to lots of delicious coffee spots and walkable to a lot of great eats. The host was responsive and had clear instructions for check in and check out. They were also quick to answer any questions.
Beverley was very sweet. She was responsive and very much accommodating. Her home was perfect and she was a great host.
Staying at Beverley’s place was easy. The apartment is spacious, squeaky clean, good WiFi, a 15 minute walk from the subway, safe, and comfortable. Beverley is super kind and welcoming.

My stay at Beverly's was awesome, the house was very clean & well kept, the beds were very comfy and Beverly is an awesome host with greay communication & hospitality. Would definitely stay here again!

This was a wonderful opportunity for us. The price was good and having 2 bedrooms was wonderful. Beverly was as kind of a host as any that we have had in our travels. Street parking wasn't too crowded. The bus stop and the L train station were both within a reasonable walking distance. And everything inside the stay was very clean.
Very much a New York experience. The house is the essence of Brooklyn and what its like to live there

Beverley’s Place, was an amazing stay. The home was clean, had all amenities, quiet area. Beverley was an amazing host. Me and my sister were in town for a funeral and this place felt like home to us both. She is very kind and went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. I will definitely book again when I visit this summer!

My friend and I stayed here for 30 weeks, and it truly became our home away from home. The apartment is perfectly located in the Upper West Side. It’s close to everything you need: grocery stores, cafes, restaurants, and multiple subway lines (A,C lines were the easiest). Central Park is just a short walk away, which was a huge plus for us. There’s a washer and dryer in the basement which was very convenient and price was a lot cheaper than the laundromat. Would definitely recommend this place to someone staying in manhattan.

Convenient location. Walkable area. Lobby has a very strong and unpleasant smell. Easy access to building. Host recommends parking but a big car won’t fit. But there’s another parking garage 10 min. walk.
Room was spacious for 3.
Beds are not comfortable at all. There were hairs from previous guests everywhere.
Towels have stains. Thankfully I brought my own.
Bathroom was dirty but had enough toiletries and toilet paper.
Water pressure was really nice.

Very affordable and sizable space, walking distance of several subways. Commutes to times square and manhattan run about an hour however very worth it in terms of cost.
Would reccomend!!

This is my second time staying here and this time we had a small girls weekend getaway! We loved the place and it was a great spot to stay in! I will definitely stay here again in the future! The area is also nice and so many cute places to see and great restaurants.
I loved staying here! Emily and Saul were super attentive and sweet! The space was clean and the environment was nice. I highly recommend staying here
This place was very nice, it feels just like home. We were unbothered and we were very comfortable. The check in was very easy and smooth and there is a local gym just down the street.

A bit remote, but we knew this in advance and enjoyed to travel by ferry, subway or Uber into the city and back.
Clean and comfortable beds and a very quiet surrounding. It took some while until hot water came out of the shower’s faucet, but that’s nothing unusual in a building from the 1930s, I guess.
If you’d love to see New York but don’t want Manhattan’s crowds and pricing, that’s your place ;)
Very nice neighborhood, bit far from downtown. If you have back problems definitely don't book this place , the beds were terrible!

Our stay was unfortunately not what we expected.
The unit had a strong cigarette smell upon arrival, and we noticed cigarette ashes on the floor, which raised concerns about cleanliness. We also weren't provided with washcloths or some basic essentials, which made things inconvenient.
To add to the frustration, we had an issue with the door code after returning late from a long night out, which left us standing outside trying to figure it out — not something you want to deal with when you're tired.
the experience fell short of what we hoped for.
While the location may have been fine, the condition of the space really affected our experience. We hope future guests have a better experience if improvements are made.

The place was very beautiful & comfortable. It was such an easy process to get in & out and we felt very safe staying there . Had no issues with neighbors & it was just an overall comfy and great stay ! Will def stay here again in the future

This place was exactly as shown! Clean and easy to find. The directions they provided for check in and how to navigate the building were very thorough and informative. It made the check in process a breeze.
The place was clean easy to find and quiet no loud noise will definitely be back thank you 🤗
Very prompt responses. We had a great time and will come back again. Thank you Emily and Saul.

Place was very clean and well organized.
The remote to tv didn’t really work.
But overall my stay was nice and peaceful 😊
Good communication from Emily. The check in process was very easy. Lastly the apartment was exactly what I was looking for: cozy, nice decor, super clean.

Bath water was brown when first put on but quickly changed
Paid for late check-in but cleaners came early more than once knocking on the door
I appreciate it the hospitality, the stay I had was such a great experience. I enjoyed my whole night .
good place, especially for the price. neighbors were extremely loud late into the night, but nothing the hosts could control.

Great location. Place is small but good enough. Bathroom looks brand new, clean and modern. There was an issue with house flies in the apartment. They sent the super to fix this but it didn't really get rid of the issue. I bought my own fly traps and was able to get rid of most of them.

A nice and comfortable suite wit bathroom. Secure and clean. I felt safe. No noticable noise or problems. Great communication. The area is full of restaurants and bars. Subway into Manhattan is a block away.
Great listing. Safe neighborhood and responsive hosts. Perfect for my 3-day stay. Would happily stay here again for future visits.
I really liked the room it was small but clean! I liked the neighbourhood. It was far from basically everything but for the price I’m not complaining plus it was a 5 minute walk to a subway station.

The place was very clean and definitely what I was looking for even if it was for a night, wish I could have stayed longer. Emily and Saul were very attentive about my stay and it was easy to communicate. They responded really fast 👍🏻
Our stay was absolutely wonderful. The area is beautiful, the game room was nice. I would definitely recommend this place to others!
place is quick and to the point.  I stayed here for two nights for work. there were hair and mold in the bathroom. other than that it's a quick place for a quick stay. surrounding area has a lot.
Not fancy but clean and safe place to stay while in the City. It is located a bit far from Manhattan but it was private and easy to access.

The room is nice, very small. It’s in a nice neighbourhood. Unfortunately there is absolutely nowhere to fill up water bottles in the building. We were there when it was quite warm and ended up having to buy so much water.
Would not go back. Place did not match listing photos, was also very dirty. Marajuana use in the unit next door all night long. Had to barricade the door, didn’t feel safe.

Emily and Saul’s place is wonderful! Everything was smooth from checking in and out. The place is very comfortable and I will definitely keep coming back when I’m visiting friends and family in the area.
Emily and Saul are great hosts!! They were very responsive and made sure I felt right at home. Place was as described and perfect for a night stay.

Very basic, but clean. AirBnb listing gives impression it's a personal apt/unit. But because of NYC short term rental rules (30 day min stay) it's classified and called a hotel. multiple units/apts are all rentals. Not a problem.. and not uncomfortable.. Just had expected it to look and feel like previous Airbnb stays.. and it was more akin to a hotel. But fine nonetheless.

The host was responsive and nice, however the place looked much smaller than in the pictures + the mattress was too soft and uncomfortable. Kind of noisy street (people shouting on the street + trash trucks were loud too) + noisy neighbors on the floor.
Great place to stay, comfortable, safe, easy to get in, definitely I come back on a future
The stay was actually very comfortable and the maids take cleaning very seriously so the room is usually spotless. Would definitely book again.

I had a wonderful experience at this Airbnb . It was near 2 metro station so public transportation was easily accessible!
It was located in A nice neighborhood, shops around the corner, but still gave you the feel of urban life .
The waiting room and hall ways smell AMAZING and the cleaning staff are nice a respectful!
Overall , I would 100% come back !
Great location and close to the subway and supermarkets.   Love Bay Ridge and I will be back.

I had a pleasant stay at this hotel, thanks to Emily and Saul, who were incredibly responsive and proactive in their communication. The location is fantastic, and I loved the cozy music playing in the lobby, which added a nice touch to the atmosphere.
The hotel is situated in a converted apartment building, with each unit resembling subdivided apartment rooms, all equipped with dedicated bathrooms. Overall, it offers great value for the price and is fairly clean.
However, there are a few areas that could use improvement. The bathroom would benefit from an update, and the mattress needs to be replaced, as it has unfortunately caved in. Additionally, the carpet could use a good vacuuming.
I would recommend this place for its charm and value, but a few upgrades would make the experience even better.

Emily & Saul’s Airbnb was the perfect weekend birthday getaway for me and my girlfriend! I highly appreciated the timely responses from our hosts as well as the simplicity of checking in & out of the Airbnb. I’ve never been to BayRidge prior to this but I will definitely be returning soon to this lovely Airbnb. Bed is extremely comfortable and the studio is perfect for two guests. Spacious, cozy, & the perfect getaway. Thank you Emily ☺️

Loved my stay here at Bayridge. The people at the front desk were very nice and they made sure to have everything ready at check in. They had everything we needed for our stay. I would stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a place in Bayridge!

Emily and Saul’s place is very peaceful, I had an amazing time. The host Emily always checked in with me and made sure I was comfortable. The place is very clean which is very important to me. Would definitely recommend.

Khin was a proactive and responsive host with excellent communication. We encountered a few minor issues during our stay, but Khin addressed them promptly. The location is fantastic—everything is within walking distance. The space was just as described and matched the photos accurately.
Very clean and comfortable place. Super responsive host. Will definitely come back next time I need to be in Upper Manhattan/Harlem area.

The place was very nice. Comfortable beds and towels. Outside area was dirty and your average NYC. Only problem was that someone came in after our first night, mond you I only rented 2 nights, and shut off the A/C. Came back from a long and hot day to a super hot room. Room didnt cool to normal temp until the next day when we had to leave.

I had a wonderful stay! The room was clean, comfortable, and stocked with all the toiletries you could possibly need. The location was perfect: in a safe neighborhood with an easy commute to the city. Our host was incredibly sweet, responsive, and very accommodating throughout the entire stay. I would absolutely book again!

Yira was great! Room was modern, clean, and cute! Wine was a special touch. Thank you! Definitely recommend! Nice place in the Bronx. Close to LGA 15 min away. Had a short stay but was comfortable. Looks exactly like the pictures.
Lovely short stay. Room was beautiful. I didn’t get to complete my entire stay. I would definitely return if invited! Thanks again😘
This was the cleanest and most modern AirBnB I’ve stayed in. Many extras like bottled water, snacks, tooth brush, razors, Kureg with K-cups. Very comfortable bed and furnishings.

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment is adorable, cozy, and looks just like the pictures. It was extremely clean and Gabriel had snacks and water which was wonderful after a long trip. Gabriel was very responsive and helpful. We really enjoyed our cozy little stay. Thank you!
It was super nice! Everything was clean when we got there and it was easy to get in to! It's also super conveniently placed by multiple subway entrances!
We had a great time at this Airbnb. We Love The Neighborhood. The apartment was very nice and clean!
amazing place close to anything you could want to do! we had trouble with the passcode getting in and he was super responsive and helped us right away.
Jing was so kind to my mom and I! My mom said she enjoyed her stay. PS: Jing’s paintings are beautiful!

I was in town for one night and a Day. Everything was as advertised, easy to enter & access, had all the amenities as advertised, communicable areas & my private space were spotless clean. Most importantly, the night I flew in it was bone chillingly cold, the wind chill was terrible. I easily accessed the entrance and was welcomed to perfect heat. My room was heated so well and I slept perfect. The booking served its purpose efficiently & I am satisfied. Four minute walk to a main road with multiple city bus services!

Hello,
Patrica and Jing's place was super nice. It's in a private and peaceful neighborhood. From the start, the communication, pictures, and updates to passwords were top-tier. The price was unbeatable. I had my room but had to share the bathroom and the common space with other guests. I heard them in the morning but never saw anyone, which was a delight. The reserved parking space was great. When I came back at night, all the street parking was taken, and if not for the reserved space, I would have had to park several blocks away.
I want to thank Patricia and Jing for a wonderful time. I will stay again!

Great host and very comfortable stay! Jannelle went above and beyond to make us feel at home and make sure we had everything we needed. The location is great, with a grocery store nearby and just a minute walk from the BC lines, and a couple blocks from the 2,3 lines.
The dedicated office was great for working from home, and the wifi was fast. Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay.

I had a great stay at Saheedat’s apartment. It was very clean and comfortable, the view was amazing and she was responsive whenever I had questions. The building’s concierge staff was friendly and helpful throughout my stay and I enjoyed using the gym and basketball court. Checking in and out was seamless and the location is prime. Highly recommend.

We loved this place. The apartment has its own entrance, so it feels private, it's easily spacious for a couple for a long stay and is super clean and newly decorated. The bedroom is large and there's cosy living room with TV and new kitchen. The shower water pressure is AWESOME. It was properly cold weather while we were here but the apartment has great heating. Chris & Sarah are amazing hosts - Chris was there to greet us and even a bottle of wine waiting for us in the apt. And if you're looking for recommendations, these guys know every spot. This place is literally round the corner from great spots and subway is less than 5 mins walk.

My husband and I stayed for a week at this studio. The location is conveniently located to quickly get to Williamsburg and Manhattan. The host was really responsive throughout and the studio itself was well-equipped, we had everything we needed for remote working and cooking. Will definitely stay again next time we visit!

I had a great time at this Airbnb! The hosts went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of. I had to dry a dress I was wearing one night and they dried it for me in their dryer - totally saved my whole night! Very thankful!
The host were very nice and responsive to our needs, great advice on getting around town. It was a very cozy space for a couple and a nice backyard to lounge.

small new york room, as described, quiet neighborhood, felt safe
the refrigerator was loud and the kitchen and bedroom are one space
Bathroom quite nice

Yoel is AWESOME. And so is his place…if what you are looking for is a clean, cool, private basement room in/near Brooklyn’s Bushwick district. Ensuring that I arrived while it was still daylight so that I could get my bearings is the only thing I would’ve done differently. LOVE how close it is to the MTA! While staying I only had one request - I was low on coffee - and Yoel went out of his way. He did not only address the need. He gave me a unique experience in coffee tasting!

Aloha ,
Taking my island born wife to NYC was made simple and easy staying at Yoels in Brooklyn.
We were absolutely delighted with the location & the actual space was Very clean, beachy & Very Cute!
Our hosts were absolutely charming & incredibly helpful with local recommendations.
We will be staying there again soon on our next trip to the City!!!
Aloha & Mahalo Plenty 🤙🏽🤙🏽
Sincerely
Michael & Jeannine

The place was amazing! Great location and area, 5 min from transit and convenient grocery stores super close by. Place looks exactly like the pictures; super clean and a great find in nyc! Freddy was super responsive and very accommodating.

The place was very clean. Freddy was very responsive and asked if we needed anything. The price is very convenient. Me and my family loved this stay, had a lot of room for all 7 of us. The subway is about 3 blocks away, and Central Park about a 20 minute walk away. Thank you so much Freddy!

within walking distance to public transportation
host was flexible and communicative
house was spotless
well worth the price!

Freddy was a good host who gave clear instructions on how to enter the apartment.  When we needed something he was quick to respond. There are restaurants and supermarkets nearby within easy walking distance. The beds were clean and comfortable.
I love Harlem. Everything is walkable, train station not far. The people in the area were friendly. House was cozy and comfortable. Host was responsive and very helpful. I enjoyed my stay.

Had an AMAZING stay!!! Not only was the room homey and comfortable, it had the most comfortable bed I ever slept on! 10/10 service from the front desk and area was safe and close to so many different things to do.

Everything was good, but the heater in the bedroom was not working.
They tried to fix it but it didn’t fixed til I leave. But other than that, everything was perfect, would love to visit again.
A little tricky to find at first, it is clean, host is very responsive, and close to Fulton station.
Great place to stay in NYC.  Extra nice having baggage hold before and after checkout and lounge to use.  Good AC as well.  Will stay again
Wonderful place, as described. Host is very helpful and responds fast. Beautiful rooftop. Enjoyed the stay!

Yehuda went above-and-beyond. So easy to communicate with. She was always checking in to make sure everything went smoothly for us. Everything was clean and exactly as advertised. The location is inconvenient if you are planning to explore Manhattan or areas in West Brooklyn, but for our stay (work trip) it was exactly what our group was looking for. Yehuda made the stay amazing!

The house was just as beautiful as the pictures. I wish it was in a different location  with parking. We had multiple family members with cars and parking was difficult. Other than that ours overall stay was great. The Yehuda was  amazing, very responsive and helpful. I would definitely recommend for large groups.
Location was great, host Joshua was on point, clean environment and very spacious. Great brown stone. I would recommend to a friend

Kayan was always very kind and attemptive. Her place is beautiful and cozy, close to all subway, groceries stores, pharmacy, cellphone store to say a few. I wish I could have stayed longer.
I definetelly recomend it.
Thank you, Kayan for everything!!
Extremely clean, extremely helpful, and extremely smooth stay. No problems were had and the location is amazing.

Everything from the clear instructions to enter the building/room to the moment you check out was perfect. The photos do not do this place justice. Beautiful tall windows give you a nice view of the city and allow natural light to enter. WiFi works perfect. Water stayed hot and the room had plenty of extra towels. You have ample amount of space to store your clothes neatly and put any large items like suitcases in the closest. You have a pharmacy with everything you need right next store and plenty of places to eat out. If you don’t feel like leaving, DoorDash drivers are able to bring the food right to the door. But most importantly, the king size bed felt like you were sleeping on clouds. 10/10 recommend and will be staying here again in the future
Our stay was amazing from check in to check out. Very well cleaned, responsive host, and very close to many destinations. Would stay here again for sure!

Clean, light-filled apartment, centrally located in the financial district, with friendly front desk staff. They even left a card and bottle of wine for my birthday. I recommend this listing and would definitely stay here again.

This was a very convenient location. Although the smoking activity near the apartment was a bit questionable. There isn’t anything the host can do about it. The building and the apartment were excellent. I would go back.
Excellent location. Very small, but comfortable, clean and secure. The Irish pub next door was a bonus!
Clean, great location and response was quick. Usage of laundry and dryer was free which was very helpful. Definitely worth visiting again.

We enjoyed out stay at 17 John’s.
The place was very clean and comfortable. Nice location, close to subway.
We would choose this place again for our future visit to the area.
Was better than I expected. Easy to access, clean, and definitely somewhere I’ll stay again.

A TOTAL NIGHTMARE!
We flew from San Diego to New York for our granddaughter’s graduation, with our son and other granddaughter traveling with us. The morning we were set to arrive, I got an email from Airbnb saying our reservation was canceled and we’d be refunded—no explanation, no warning, nothing from the hosts. We were shocked and left scrambling to find last-minute accommodations in a packed city. It caused a huge amount of stress during what should’ve been a joyful family occasion. The hosts never contacted us directly or explained why they canceled. The complete lack of professionalism and courtesy was astounding. This experience disrupted a major family event and left us feeling abandoned. Travelers deserve better.
Nice area and close to everything. Tiffany was  quick to assist. will recommend the place to everyone

My stay in this apartment was simply perfect! The place is exactly as described—clean, cozy, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The location is great, well-connected, and close to all major attractions. The host was incredibly kind, always available, and attentive to every need. You can tell there’s great attention to detail, which made my experience even better. If I ever come back to this area, I would definitely choose to stay here again. Highly recommended!

Great location! Close to restaurants, Central Park and museums.
Nice view of 62nd.

we recieved a different unit for the first night that was less desirable.   the location was extremely noisy.  due to the traffic backup that was constant.    bring earplugs.   bed was very comfortable.

Great place. The flat feels newly refurbished. There is road noise and honking (its opposite an exit from Queensborough brdige) but no more than would be expected in the city, and the windows and balcony doors (which open) are double glazed. The street felt safe & residential, and nice to come back to every night. There are shops for groceries within walking distance. All the appliances and fixtures, including the air-con, worked well. Overall, felt very comfortable in this place - both the flat and neighbourhood itself, are glad we chose it, and would come again!

Lovely place, just as pictured, very clean and easy to get in with Latch app.  I booked even though reviews said it was noisy, but New York is noisy!  The air conditioner helped with the noise!   It was a lovely studio way lots of room!
I stayed with my dog and this place was perfect. Clean and tidy so I was very comfortable.

It was great staying here! It’s in a great location with plenty of restaurants, services such as laundromats, grocery shops and a CVS right down the street. It’s also right next to Washington Square Park as an added bonus! Nat and co were incredibly responsive to my questions and made sure my stay was comfortable. It is perfectly sized for one person. I definitely recommend it for your long-term stay in Manhattan.

Rafael's place is a gem. About 2 blocks south of Houston, you can't beat the location. The space is modest in size but like other great NYC apartments it is used efficiently. If you have spent time in NYC then you will know what this means. As the listing mentions, the loft has a low ceiling, so it is worth being aware of that for the people in the group who will be sleeping in that room. Rafael was responsive and very friendly, and he was able to accommodate us with an early check-in, which was a great help. Overall, we had an incredible time staying at Rafael's place, and I would highly recommend it for groups visiting NYC who are interested in staying in Lower Manhattan. Thanks, Rafael!

Our family of four stayed here four nights and we were really pleased. The location cannot be beat - high end shopping, restaurants and people watching galore. Two MTA stops nearby as well so you can get anywhere on Manhattan and to Brooklyn in 30 mins or less.  The space is small yet efficiently used as one would expect in this neighborhood.  Might not be great for a family with small kids - the stairs down and ladder up require attention and care while using. Watch the check out video to the end of- I didn’t and had some hiccups getting in. Rafael and his assistant were responsive and understanding.  I would highly recommend this rental - great location, amenities and a helpful host.
